children.translated_text: He who made it was not able to make it; he shattered his foot and toe.

children.text: cakāra bhadram asmabhyam ātmane tapanam tu saḥ ||
children.translated_text: He made good fortune for us, but torment for himself.

children.text: apāmārgo 'pa mārṣṭu kṣetriyaṃ śapathaś ca yaḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Apāmārga</s> wipe away hereditary disease and whatever curse there is.

children.text: apāha yātudhānīr apa sarvā arāyyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drive away the sorceresses; drive away all hostile beings.

children.text: apamṛjya yātudhānān apa sarvā arāyyaḥ
children.translated_text: Having wiped away the sorcerers, having driven away all hostile beings,

children.text: apāmārga tvayā vayaṃ sarvaṃ tad apa mṛjmahe ||
children.translated_text: with you, O <s>Apāmārga</s>, we wipe all that away.

children.text: Chapter 121
uto asy abandhukṛd uto asi nu jāmikṛt
children.translated_text: You are also one who makes a person kinless; you are also one who makes a person bereft of relatives.

children.text: uto kṛtyākṛtaḥ prajāṃ nadam ivā chinddhi vārṣikam ||
children.translated_text: And cut off the offspring of the maker of <s>kṛtyā</s> like a yearly reed.

children.text: brāhmaṇena paryuktāsi kaṇvena nārṣadena
children.translated_text: You have been set around by a brahmin, by <s>Kaṇva Nārṣada</s>.

children.text: senevaiṣi tviṣīmatī na tatra bhayam asti yatra prāpnoṣy oṣadhe ||
children.translated_text: You advance like a gleaming army; there is no fear where you reach, O plant.

children.text: agram eṣy oṣadhīnāṃ jyotiṣevābhidīpayan
children.translated_text: You go at the head of the plants, shining forth like a light.

children.text: uta trātāsi pākasyātho hantāsi rakṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are also the protector of the simple one, and you are the slayer of the demon.

children.text: yad ado devā asurāṃs tvayāgre nirakurvata
children.translated_text: When the gods at first drove out the <s>Asuras</s> with you,

children.text: tatas tvam adhy oṣadhe 'pāmārgo ajāyathāḥ ||
children.translated_text: from that time, O plant, you were born as <s>Apāmārga</s>.

children.text: vibhindatī śataśākhā vibhindan nāma te pitā
children.translated_text: Splitting apart, hundred-branched; 'splitter' is the name of your father.

children.text: pratyag vi bhinddhi tvaṃ taṃ yo asmāṁ abhidāsati ||
children.translated_text: Split apart in return the one who assails us.

children.text: asad bhūmyāḥ sam abhavat tad yām eti mahad vyacaḥ
children.translated_text: Non-being arose from the earth; that goes to <s>Yama</s>, the great expanse.

children.text: tad vai tato vidhūpāyat pratyak kartāram ṛcchatu ||
children.translated_text: Let that indeed smoke away from there; let it reach back to the one who made it.

children.text: pratyaṅ hi saṃbabhūvitha pratīcīnaphalas tvam
children.translated_text: For you have arisen turned back; your fruit faces backward.

children.text: sarvān macchapathāṃ adhi varīyo yāvayā vadham ||
children.translated_text: From all my curses, drive death far away to a wider distance.

children.text: śatena mā pari pāhi sahasreṇābhi rakṣā mā
children.translated_text: Protect me with a hundred, guard me with a thousand.

children.text: indras te vīrudhāṃ pata ugra ojmānam ā dadhat ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, lord of plants, set fierce force in you.

children.text: Chapter 122
ā paśyati prati paśyati parā paśyati paśyati
children.translated_text: She looks near, she looks toward, she looks afar; she looks.

children.text: divam antarikṣam ād bhūmiṃ sarvaṃ tad devi paśyati ||
children.translated_text: Heaven, midspace, earth: all that, O goddess, she sees.

children.text: tisro divas tisraḥ pṛthivīḥ ṣaṭ cemāḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthak
children.translated_text: The three heavens, the three earths, and these six separate directions:

children.text: tvayāhaṃ sarvā bhūtāni paśyāni devy oṣadhe ||
children.translated_text: with you, O divine herb, may I see all beings.

children.text: divyasya suparṇasya tasya hāsi kanīnikā
children.translated_text: You are the pupil of that heavenly well-winged bird.

children.text: sā bhūmim ā rurohitha vahyaṃ śrāntā vadhūr iva ||
children.translated_text: She has mounted upon the earth like a bride, weary for the carriage.

children.text: tāṃ me sahasrākṣo devo dakṣiṇe hasta ā dadhat
children.translated_text: May the thousand-eyed god place her in my right hand.

children.text: tayāhaṃ sarvaṃ paśyāmi yaś ca śūdra utāryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With her I see everything, both the <s>śūdra</s> and the <s>Ārya</s>.

children.text: āviṣ kṛṇuṣva rūpāni mātmānam apa gūhathāḥ
children.translated_text: Make the forms visible; do not hide your own self.

children.text: atho sahasracakṣo tvaṃ prati paśyāḥ kimīdinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And you, thousand-eyed one, look directly upon the kimīdins.

children.text: darśaya mā yātudhānān darśaya yātudhānyaḥ
children.translated_text: Show me the yātudhāna demons; show me the yātudhānī women.

children.text: piśācānt sarvān darśayeti tvā rabha oṣadhe ||
children.translated_text: Show all the piśācas; saying this, I take hold of you, O herb.

children.text: kaśyapasya cakṣur asi śunyāś ca caturakṣyāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the eye of <s>Kaśyapa</s>, and of the dog, the four-eyed one.

children.text: vīdhre sūryam iva sarpantaṃ mā piśācaṃ tiras karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not conceal from me the piśāca creeping like the sun in the open space.

children.text: ud agrabhaṃ paripāṇād yātudhānaṃ kimīdinam
children.translated_text: I have seized from the protecting band the yātudhāna, the kimīdin.

children.text: tenāhaṃ sarvaṃ paśyāmy uta śūdram utāryam ||
children.translated_text: With that I see everything, both the <s>śūdra</s> and the <s>Ārya</s>.

children.text: yo antarikṣeṇa patati divam yaś ca atisarpati
children.translated_text: The one who flies through the midspace, and the one who crawls beyond heaven,

children.text: bhūmiṃ yo manyate nāthaṃ taṃ piśācam pra darśaya ||
children.translated_text: the one who thinks the earth is his refuge: show that piśāca.

children.text: Chapter 123
ā gāvo agmann uta bhadram akrant sīdantu goṣṭhe raṇayantv asme
children.translated_text: The cows have come here, and they have brought good fortune; let them sit in the cowshed and gladden us.

children.text: prajāvatīḥ pururūpā iha syur indrāya pūrvīr uṣaso duhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May they be here with offspring and many forms, milking many dawns for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: indro yajvane gṛṇate ca śikṣata uped dadāti na svaṃ muṣāyati
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> aids the sacrificer and the singer; he comes near and gives, and does not steal what is his own.

children.text: bhūyobhūyo rayim id asya vardhayann abhinne khilye ni dadhāti devayum ||
children.translated_text: Increasing his wealth again and again, he places the god-seeking man in an unbroken pasture.

children.text: na tā naśanti na dabhāti taskaro nāsām āmitro vyathir ā dadharṣati
children.translated_text: They do not perish; no thief harms them, nor does any hostile assailant dare attack them.

children.text: devāṃś ca yābhir yajate dadāti ca jyog it tābhiḥ sacate gopatiḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: With those by which he sacrifices to the gods and gives gifts, the lord of cattle remains together with them for a long time.

children.text: na tā arvā reṇukakāṭo 'śnute na saṃskṛtatram upa yanti tā abhi
children.translated_text: No dust-cutting horse overtakes them, nor do they go near the place of slaughter.

children.text: urugāyam abhayaṃ tasya tā anu gāvo martasya vi caranti yajvanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Following the wide-ranging, fearless domain of that mortal sacrificer, the cows roam about.

children.text: gāvo bhago gāva indro ma icchād gāva somasya prathamasya bhakṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Cows are <s>Bhaga</s>; cows are <s>Indra</s>. May cows be what I desire; cows are the first share of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: imā yā gāvaḥ sa janāsa indra icchāmi hṛdā manasā cid indram ||
children.translated_text: These cows here, O people, are <s>Indra</s>; with heart and even with mind I desire <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yūyaṃ gāvo medayatha kṛśaṃ cid aśrīraṃ cit kṛṇuthā supratīkam
children.translated_text: You cows make even the lean one fat; even the unsightly one you make fair-faced.

children.text: bhadraṃ gṛhaṃ kṛṇutha bhadravāco bṛhad vo vaya ucyate sabhāsu ||
children.translated_text: You make the house auspicious, O auspicious-voiced ones; your great power is spoken of in assemblies.

children.text: prajāvatīḥ sūyavase ruśantīḥ śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ
children.translated_text: Rich in offspring, shining in good pasture, drinking pure waters at a good drinking-place,

children.text: mā va stena īśata māghaśaṃsaḥ pari vo rudrasya hetir vṛṇaktu ||
children.translated_text: let no thief master you, no evil-speaker; let <s>Rudra</s>'s missile pass around you.

children.text: Chapter 124
imam indra vardhaya kṣatriyaṃ me imaṃ viśām ekavṛṣaṃ kṛṇu tvam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, increase this kṣatriya of mine; make this man the sole bull of the clans.

children.text: nir amitrān akṣṇuhy asya sarvāṃs tān randhayāsmā ahamuttareṣu ||
children.translated_text: Drive out all his enemies; subdue them all to him; let him be higher among those above.

children.text: emaṃ bhaja grāme aśveṣu goṣu niṣ ṭaṃ bhaja yo amitro asya
children.translated_text: Grant this man a share in the village, among horses and cows; exclude from a share the one who is his enemy.

children.text: varṣma kṣatrāṇām ayam astu rājendra śatruṃ randhaya sarvam asmai ||
children.translated_text: Let this king be the summit of ruling powers; O royal <s>Indra</s>, subdue every enemy for him.

children.text: ayam astu dhanapatir dhanānām ayaṃ viśāṃ viśpatir astu rājā
children.translated_text: Let this man be lord of wealth among wealths; let this king be lord of the clans among the clans.

children.text: asminn indra mahi varcāṃsi dhehy avarcasaṃ kṛṇuhi śatrum asya ||
children.translated_text: In him, <s>Indra</s>, place great splendors; make his enemy without splendor.

children.text: asmai dyāvāpṛthivī bhūri vāmaṃ duhāthāṃ gharmadughe iva dhenū
children.translated_text: For him, heaven and earth, milk out abundant favor, like two cows giving warm milk.

children.text: ayaṃ rājā priya indrasya bhūyāt priyo gavām oṣadhīnāṃ paśūnām ||
children.translated_text: May this king become dear to <s>Indra</s>, dear to the cows, the herbs, and the cattle.

children.text: yunajmi ta uttarāvantam indraṃ yena jayanti na parājayante
children.translated_text: For you I yoke victorious <s>Indra</s>, by whom men conquer and are not conquered.

children.text: yas tvā karad ekavṛṣaṃ janānām uta rājñām uttamaṃ mānavānām ||
children.translated_text: He will make you the sole bull of the peoples, and the highest of human kings.

children.text: uttaras tvam adhare te sapatnā ye ke ca rājan pratiśatravas te
children.translated_text: You are superior; below you are your rivals, whoever your opposing enemies are, O king.

children.text: ekavṛṣa indrasakhā jigīvāñchatrūyatām ā bharā bhojanāni ||
children.translated_text: As the sole bull, friend of <s>Indra</s>, eager to conquer, bring in the provisions of those who act as enemies.

children.text: siṃhapratīko viśo addhi sarvā vyāghrapratīko 'va bādhasva śatrūn
children.translated_text: With the likeness of a lion, consume all the clans; with the likeness of a tiger, beat down the enemies.

children.text: ekavṛṣa indrasakhā jigīvāñchatrūyatām ā khidā bhojanāni ||
children.translated_text: As the sole bull, friend of <s>Indra</s>, eager to conquer, tear away the provisions of those who act as enemies.

children.text: Chapter 125
agner manve prathamasya pracetasaḥ pāñcajanyasya bahudhā yam indhate
children.translated_text: I call to mind <s>Agni</s>, the first, the wise one, belonging to the five peoples, whom they kindle in many ways.

children.text: viśoviśaḥ praviśivāṃsam īmahe sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: We implore him who has entered clan after clan; may he release us from distress.

children.text: yathā havyaṃ vahasi jātavedo yathā yajñaṃ kalpayasi prajānan
children.translated_text: As you carry the oblation, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, as you knowingly arrange the sacrifice,

children.text: evā devebhyaḥ sumatiṃ na ā vaha sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so bring us good favor from the gods; may he release us from distress.

children.text: yāmanyāmann upayuktaṃ vahiṣṭhaṃ karmaṅkarmann ābhagam agnim īḍe
children.translated_text: In every course, in every rite, I praise <s>Agni</s>, most ready to be yoked, the conveyer, the receiver of a share.

children.text: rakṣohaṇaṃ yajñavṛdhaṃ ghṛtāhutaṃ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The demon-slayer, increaser of sacrifice, offered with ghee: may he release us from distress.

children.text: sujātaṃ jātavedasam agniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ vibhum
children.translated_text: Well-born <s>Jātavedas</s>, <s>Agni</s> <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the all-pervading one,

children.text: havyavāhaṃ havāmahe sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the carrier of oblations, we call upon; may he release us from distress.

children.text: yena ṛṣayo balam adyotayan yujā yenāsurāṇām ayuvanta māyāḥ
children.translated_text: By whom the seers made strength shine forth as their ally, by whom they drove away the māyās of the asuras,

children.text: yenāgninā paṇīn indro jigāya sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by which <s>Agni</s>, <s>Indra</s> conquered the <s>Paṇis</s>: may he release us from distress.

children.text: yena devā amṛtam anvavindan yenauṣadhīr madhumatīr akṛṇvan
children.translated_text: By which the gods found immortality, by which they made the herbs honey-sweet,

children.text: yena devāḥ svar ābharant sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by which the gods brought the sunlight: may he release us from distress.

children.text: yasyedaṃ pradiśi yad virocate yaj jātaṃ janitavyaṃ ca kevalam
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Agni</s>, to whom belongs this whole thing that shines in every direction, whatever has been born and whatever is yet to be born.

children.text: staumy agniṃ nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In need I call upon him again and again; may he release us from distress.

children.text: Chapter 126
indrasya manmahe śaśvad id asya manmahe vṛtraghna stomā upa mema āguḥ
children.translated_text: We continually think of <s>Indra</s>, we think of him; the hymns to the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer have come near to me.

children.text: yo dāśuṣaḥ sukṛto havam eti sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who comes to the call of the generous man who has done good deeds: may he release us from distress.

children.text: ya ugrīṇām ugrabāhur yayur yo dānavānāṃ balam āruroja
children.translated_text: He who, with strong arm, is the strong one among the strong, who shattered the power of the <s>Dānavas</s>,

children.text: yena jitāḥ sindhavo yena gāvaḥ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by whom the rivers were won, by whom the cows were won: may he release us from distress.

children.text: yaś carṣaṇipro vṛṣabhaḥ svarvid yasmai grāvāṇaḥ pravadanti nṛmṇam
children.translated_text: He who protects peoples, the bull who finds the light, for whom the pressing-stones proclaim manly power,

children.text: yasyādhvaraḥ saptahotā madiṣṭhaḥ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose sacrifice, with its seven priests, is most exhilarating: may he release us from distress.

children.text: yasya vaśāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo yasmai mīyante svaravaḥ svarvide
children.translated_text: He whose subject bulls and oxen are under command, for whom the chant-poles are measured out for the finder of light,

children.text: yasmai śukraḥ pavate brahmaśumbhitaḥ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for whom the bright one, adorned by prayer, is purified: may he release us from distress.

children.text: yasya juṣṭiṃ sominaḥ kāmayante yaṃ havanta iṣumantaṃ gaviṣṭau
children.translated_text: He whose favor the soma-pressers desire, whom they call on, arrow-bearing, in the quest for cows,

children.text: yasminn arkaḥ śiśriye yasminn ojaḥ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in whom song has taken refuge, in whom strength abides: may he release us from distress.

children.text: yaḥ prathamaḥ karmakṛtyāya jajñe yasya vīryam prathamasyānubuddham
children.translated_text: He who was born first for the doing of deeds, whose heroic power was recognized as that of the first,

children.text: yenodyato vajro 'bhyāyatāhiṃ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by whom the raised thunderbolt advanced against the serpent: may he release us from distress.

children.text: yaḥ saṃgrāmān nayati saṃ yudhe vaśī yaḥ puṣṭāni saṃsṛjati dvayāni
children.translated_text: He who as master leads battles together into combat, who brings together both kinds of prosperity,

children.text: staumīndraṃ nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Indra</s>; in need I call upon him again and again. May he release us from distress.

children.text: Chapter 127
vāyoḥ savitur vidathāni manmahe yāv ātmanvad viśatho yau ca rakṣathaḥ
children.translated_text: We think upon the rites of <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s>, you two who enter and guard what has life.

children.text: yau viśvasya paribhū babhūvathus tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You two who have become those who encompass the whole world: may you two release us from distress.

children.text: yayoḥ saṃkhyātā varimā pārthivāni yābhyāṃ rajo yupitam antarikṣe
children.translated_text: You two by whom the earthly expanses are reckoned, by whom the region of the air is fixed in the midspace,

children.text: yayoḥ prāyaṃ nānv ānaśe kaścana tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose course no one has reached after: may you two release us from distress.

children.text: tava vrate ni viśante janāsas tvayy udite prerate citrabhāno
children.translated_text: Under your ordinance peoples settle down; when you have risen, O brightly shining one, they are set in motion.

children.text: yuvaṃ vāyo savitā ca bhuvanāni rakṣathas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You two, <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s>, guard the worlds; may you two release us from distress.

children.text: apeto vāyo savitā ca duṣkṛtam apa rakṣāṃsi śimidāṃ ca sedhatam
children.translated_text: Drive away evil-doing, O <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s>; drive off the demons and the destructive fiends.

children.text: saṃ hy ūrjayā sṛjathaḥ saṃ balena tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For you send forth together with nourishment and together with strength; may you two release us from distress.

children.text: rayiṃ me poṣaṃ savitota vāyus tanū dakṣam ā suvatāṃ suśevam
children.translated_text: May <s>Savitṛ</s> and also <s>Vāyu</s> impel wealth, increase, bodily vigor, skill, and blessed ease for me.

children.text: ayakṣmatātiṃ maha iha dhattaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Establish here great freedom from disease; may you two release us from distress.

children.text: pra sumatiṃ savitar vāya ūtaye mahasvantaṃ matsaraṃ mādayāthaḥ
children.translated_text: Bring forward a gracious thought for aid, O <s>Savitṛ</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>; gladden the mighty, exhilarating draught.

children.text: arvāg vāmasya pravato ni yacchataṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring the desirable gift downward toward us; may you two release us from distress.

children.text: upa śreṣṭhā na āśiṣo devayor dhāmann asthiran
children.translated_text: May the best blessings come near to us; they have stood in the divine abode of the two gods.

children.text: staumi devaṃ savitāraṃ ca vāyuṃ tau no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I praise the god <s>Savitṛ</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>; may they two release us from distress.

children.text: Chapter 128
manve vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī subhojasau sacetasau ye aprathethām amitā yojanāni
children.translated_text: I call to mind you two, <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, rich in enjoyment and of one mind, who have stretched out immeasurable yojanas.

children.text: pratiṣṭhe hy abhavataṃ vasūnāṃ te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For you two have become the foundations of goods; may you two release us from distress.

children.text: pratiṣṭhe hy abhavataṃ vasūnāṃ pravṛddhe devī subhage urūcī
children.translated_text: For you two have become the foundations of goods, grown great, divine, fortunate, and wide-reaching.

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, be pleasant for me; may you two release us from distress.

children.text: asaṃtāpe sutapasau huve 'ham urvī gambhīre kavibhir namasye
children.translated_text: Unburning, well-warming, wide and deep, I call upon you two; I revere you with the poets.

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, be pleasant for me; may you two release us from distress.

children.text: ye amṛtaṃ bibhṛtho ye havīṃṣi ye srotyā bibhṛtho ye manuṣyān
children.translated_text: You two who bear the immortal draughts, who bear the oblations, who bear the streams, who bear human beings,

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, be pleasant for me; may you two release us from distress.

children.text: ye usriyā bibhṛtho ye vanaspatīn yayor vāṃ viśvā bhuvanāny antaḥ
children.translated_text: You two who bear the cows, who bear the forest trees, within whom are all the worlds belonging to you two,

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, be pleasant for me; may you two release us from distress.

children.text: ye kīlālena tarpayatho ye ghṛtena yābhyām ṛte na kiṃcana śaknuvanti
children.translated_text: You two who satisfy with nourishing liquid, who satisfy with ghee, without whom they can do nothing at all,

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, be pleasant for me; may you two release us from distress.

children.text: yan medam abhiśocati yenayena vā kṛtaṃ pauruṣeyān na daivāt
children.translated_text: Whatever here burns against me, whatever has been done by human agency and not by divine agency,

children.text: staumi dyāvāpṛthivī nāthito johavīmi te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>; in need I call upon them again and again. May they two release us from distress.

children.text: Chapter 129
marutāṃ manve adhi me bruvantu premaṃ vājaṃ vājasāte avantu
children.translated_text: I call to mind the <s>Maruts</s>; let them speak over me. Let them help this prize in the winning of the prize.

children.text: āśūn iva suyamān ahva ūtaye te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I have called on the swift ones, as if well-guided, for aid; may they release us from distress.

children.text: utsam akṣitaṃ vyacanti ye sadā ya āsiñcanti rasam oṣadhīṣu
children.translated_text: Those who ever pour out the unfailing spring, who pour sap into the plants,

children.text: puro dadhe marutaḥ pṛśnimātṝṃs te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I place before me the <s>Maruts</s>, the sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>; may they release us from distress.

children.text: payo dhenūnāṃ rasam oṣadhīnāṃ javam arvatāṃ kavayo ya invatha
children.translated_text: You inspired poets who stir the milk of cows, the sap of plants, and the speed of coursers,

children.text: śagmā bhavantu maruto naḥ syonās te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the <s>Maruts</s> be helpful and kindly to us; may they release us from distress.

children.text: apaḥ samudrād divam ud vahanti divas pṛthivīm abhi ye sṛjanti
children.translated_text: Those who carry the waters from the ocean up to heaven, who from heaven send them forth over the earth,

children.text: ye adbhir īśānā marutaś caranti te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Maruts</s> who, ruling through the waters, move about: may they release us from distress.

children.text: ye kīlālena tarpayanti ye ghṛtena ye vā vayo medasā saṃsṛjanti
children.translated_text: Those who satisfy with nourishing liquid, who satisfy with ghee, or who bring birds together with fatness,

children.text: ye adbhir īśānā maruto varṣayanti te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Maruts</s> who, ruling through the waters, send rain: may they release us from distress.

children.text: yadīd idaṃ maruto mārutena yadi devā daivyenedṛg āra
children.translated_text: If this thing, O <s>Maruts</s>, has come in such a way through what is Marut-like, or if through divine action, O gods,

children.text: yūyam īśidhve vasavas tasya niṣkṛtes te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you, O <s>Vasus</s>, have power over its release; may they release us from distress.

children.text: tigmam anīkam viditaṃ sahasvan mārutaṃ śardhaḥ pṛtanāsūgram
children.translated_text: I praise the sharp-fronted, well-known, mighty Marut host, fierce in battles,

children.text: staumi maruto nāthito johavīmi te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I praise the <s>Maruts</s>; in need I call upon them again and again. May they release us from distress.

children.text: Chapter 130
bhavāśarvau manve vāṃ tasya vittaṃ yayor vām idaṃ pradiśi yad virocate
children.translated_text: O <s>Bhava</s> and <s>Śarva</s>, I call you two to mind; know that possession of yours, whatever of yours shines forth in this quarter.

children.text: yāv asyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You two who rule over this two-footed creature, you who rule over the four-footed creature: release us from distress.

children.text: yayor abhyabhva uta yad dūre cid yau viditāv iṣubhṛtām asiṣṭhau
children.translated_text: You two, for whom what is near and even what is far away is overcome, you two who are known as the foremost of arrow-bearers,

children.text: yāv asyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you two who rule over this two-footed creature, you who rule over the four-footed creature: release us from distress.

children.text: sahasrākṣau vṛtrahanā huve 'haṃ dūregavyūtī stuvann emy ugrau
children.translated_text: I call upon the thousand-eyed ones, the slayers of <s>Vṛtra</s>; praising the fierce ones, I come from far past the cattle-range.

children.text: yāv asyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You two who rule over this two-footed creature, you who rule over the four-footed creature: release us from distress.

children.text: yāv ārebhāthe bahu sākam agre pra ced asrāṣṭram abhibhāṃ janeṣu
children.translated_text: You two who at the beginning undertook much together, and who sent forth dominion among peoples,

children.text: yāv asyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you two who rule over this two-footed creature, you who rule over the four-footed creature: release us from distress.

children.text: yayor vadhān nāpapadyate kaścanāntar deveṣūta mānuṣeṣu
children.translated_text: From whose blow no one escapes, either among the gods or among human beings,

children.text: yāv asyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you two who rule over this two-footed creature, you who rule over the four-footed creature: release us from distress.

children.text: yaḥ kṛtyākṛn mūlakṛd yātudhāno ni tasmin dhattaṃ vajram ugrau
children.translated_text: Upon the maker of <s>kṛtyā</s>, the root-worker, the sorcerer, lay down the thunderbolt, O fierce ones.

children.text: yāv asyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You two who rule over this two-footed creature, you who rule over the four-footed creature: release us from distress.

children.text: adhi no brūtaṃ pṛtanāsūgrau saṃ vajreṇa sṛjataṃ yaḥ kimīdī
children.translated_text: Speak for us in battles, O fierce ones; with the thunderbolt strike down the one who is a <s>kimīdin</s> demon.

children.text: staumi bhavāśarvau nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Bhava</s> and <s>Śarva</s>; being in need, I call upon them. May they release us from distress.

children.text: Chapter 131
manve vāṃ mitrāvaruṇāv ṛtāvṛdhau sacetasau druhvaṇo yau nudethe
children.translated_text: I call you two to mind, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, increasers of <s>ṛta</s>, of one mind, you who drive away the treacherous.

children.text: pra satyāvānam avatho bhareṣu tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You protect the truth-speaker in contests; may those two release us from distress.

children.text: sacetasau druhvaṇo yau nudethe pra satyāvānam avatho bhareṣu
children.translated_text: You two of one mind drive away the treacherous; you protect the truth-speaker in contests.

children.text: yau gacchatho nṛcakṣasau babhruṇā sutaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You two, watchers of men, who go to the pressed Soma with the tawny one: may those two release us from distress.

children.text: yāv aṅgirasam avatho yāv agastiṃ mitrāvaruṇā jamadagnim atrim
children.translated_text: You who helped <s>Aṅgiras</s>, you who helped <s>Agasti</s>, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Jamadagni</s> and <s>Atri</s>,

children.text: yau kaśyapam avatho yau vasiṣṭhaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you who helped <s>Kaśyapa</s>, you who helped <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>: may those two release us from distress.

children.text: yau śyāvāśvam avatho vādhryaśvaṃ mitrāvaruṇā purumīḍham atrim
children.translated_text: You who helped <s>Śyāvāśva</s> and <s>Vādhryaśva</s>, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Purumīḍha</s> and <s>Atri</s>,

children.text: yau vimadam avatho saptavadhriṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you who helped <s>Vimada</s> and <s>Saptavadhri</s>: may those two release us from distress.

children.text: yau bharadvājam avatho yau gaviṣṭhiraṃ viśvāmitraṃ varuṇa mitra kutsam
children.translated_text: You who helped <s>Bharadvāja</s>, you who helped <s>Gaviṣṭhira</s>, <s>Viśvāmitra</s>, O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Kutsa</s>,

children.text: yau kakṣīvantam avatho prota kaṇvaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you who helped <s>Kakṣīvant</s> and also <s>Kaṇva</s>: may those two release us from distress.

children.text: yau medhātithim avatho yau triśokaṃ mitrāvaruṇāv uśanām kāvyaṃ yau
children.translated_text: You who helped <s>Medhātithi</s>, you who helped <s>Triśoka</s>, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, and you who helped <s>Uśanas Kāvya</s>,

children.text: yau gotamam avatho prota mudgalaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you who helped <s>Gotama</s> and also <s>Mudgala</s>: may those two release us from distress.

children.text: yayo rathaḥ satyavartma ṛjuraśmir mithuyā carantam abhiyāti dūṣayan
children.translated_text: The chariot of those two has a true path and straight reins; it goes against the one who acts falsely, spoiling him.

children.text: staumi mitrāvaruṇau nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; being in need, I call upon them. May they release us from distress.

children.text: Chapter 132
ahaṃ rudrebhir vasubhiś carāmy aham ādityair uta viśvadevaiḥ
children.translated_text: I move with the <s>Rudras</s> and the <s>Vasus</s>; I move with the <s>Ādityas</s> and with all the gods.

children.text: ahaṃ mitrāvaruṇobhā bibharmy aham indrāgnī aham aśvinobhā ||
children.translated_text: I support both <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; I support <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>; I support both <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: ahaṃ rāṣṭrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ cikituṣī prathamā yajñiyānām
children.translated_text: I am the queen, the gatherer of treasures, the knowing one, the first among those worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: tāṃ mā devā vy adadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhātrāṃ bhūry āveśayantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods apportioned me in many places, making me dwell in many stations and enter many forms.

children.text: aham eva svayam idaṃ vadāmi juṣṭaṃ devānām uta mānuṣāṇām
children.translated_text: I myself speak this, what is pleasing to gods and to human beings.

children.text: yaṃ kāmaye taṃ tam ugraṃ kṛṇomi taṃ brahmāṇaṃ tam ṛṣiṃ taṃ sumedhām ||
children.translated_text: Whomever I desire, him I make mighty: him a brahman, him a seer, him very wise.

children.text: mayā so 'nnam atti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇati ya īm śṛṇoty uktam
children.translated_text: Through me he eats food, the one who sees, who breathes, who hears what is spoken.

children.text: amantavo māṃ ta upa kṣiyanti śrudhi śruta śraddheyaṃ te vadāmi ||
children.translated_text: Those who do not think of me dwell close beside me. Hear, O famed one; I tell you what is worthy of faith.

children.text: ahaṃ rudrāya dhanur ā tanomi brahmadviṣe śarave hantavā u
children.translated_text: I stretch the bow for <s>Rudra</s>, so that the arrow may slay the hater of sacred utterance.

children.text: ahaṃ janāya samadaṃ kṛṇomi aham dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: I make combat for the people; I have entered heaven and earth.

children.text: ahaṃ somam āhanasaṃ bibharmy ahaṃ tvaṣṭāram uta pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam
children.translated_text: I bear the swelling <s>Soma</s>; I bear <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, and <s>Pūṣan</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇā haviṣmate suprāvyā yajamānāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: I bestow wealth upon the oblation-giver, upon the sacrificer who presses Soma and is well aided.

children.text: ahaṃ suve pitaram asya mūrdhan mama yonir apsv antaḥ samudre
children.translated_text: I give birth to the father on the head of this world; my womb is within the waters, in the ocean.

children.text: tato vi tiṣṭhe bhuvanāni viśvotāmūṃ dyāṃ varṣmaṇopa spṛśāmi ||
children.translated_text: From there I spread out over all beings, and with my greatness I touch yonder heaven.

children.text: aham eva vātaiva pra vāmy ārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: I myself blow forth like the wind, setting all worlds in motion.

children.text: paro divā para enā pṛthivyaitāvatī mahimnā saṃ babhūva ||
children.translated_text: Beyond heaven, beyond this earth, so great have I become in majesty.

children.text: Chapter 133
tvayā manyo saratham ārujanto harṣamāṇā hṛṣitāso marutvan
children.translated_text: With you, O <s>Manyu</s>, mounted on the same chariot, the men, exulting and thrilled, O companion of the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: tigmeṣava āyudhā saṃśiśānā upa pra yantu naro agnirūpāḥ ||
children.translated_text: with sharp arrows and weapons sharpened, let the men of fiery form advance toward us.

children.text: agnir iva manyo tviṣitaḥ sahasva senānīr naḥ sahure hūta edhi
children.translated_text: Like fire, O <s>Manyu</s>, blazing, overpower; as our army-leader, O overcomer, be invoked for us.

children.text: hatvāya śatrūn vi bhajasva veda ojo mimāno vi mṛdho nudasva ||
children.translated_text: Having slain the enemies, distribute the wealth; measuring out strength, drive away the foes.

children.text: sahasva manyo abhimātim asmai rujan mṛṇan pramṛṇan prehi śatrūn
children.translated_text: Overpower hostile attack for this man, O <s>Manyu</s>; shattering, crushing, crushing utterly, go forth against the enemies.

children.text: ugraṃ te pājo nanv ā rurudhre vaśī vaśaṃ nayāsā ekaja tvam ||
children.translated_text: Your fierce force cannot indeed be restrained; being master, bring them under control, you who are single-born.

children.text: eko bahūnām asi manya īḍitā viśaṃ viśam yuddhāya saṃ śiśādhi
children.translated_text: You alone, O <s>Manyu</s>, are praised by many; sharpen each clan for battle.

children.text: akṛttaruk tvayā yujā vayaṃ dyumantaṃ ghoṣam vijayāya kṛṇmasi ||
children.translated_text: With you as ally and unbroken, we make a brilliant battle-cry for victory.

children.text: vijeṣakṛd indra ivānavabravo 'smākaṃ manyo adhipā bhaveha
children.translated_text: Maker of conquest, like <s>Indra</s>, unassailable, be our overlord here, O <s>Manyu</s>.

children.text: priyaṃ te nāma sahure gṛṇīmasi vidmā tam utsaṃ yata ābabhūtha ||
children.translated_text: O overcomer, we sing your dear name; we know that source from which you came forth.

children.text: ābhūtyā sahajā vajra sāyaka saho bibharṣi sahabhūta uttaram
children.translated_text: Born together with prosperity, O thunderbolt, O arrow, you bear superior strength, born together with strength.

children.text: kratvā no manyo saha medy edhi mahādhanasya puruhūta saṃsṛji ||
children.translated_text: With resolve, O <s>Manyu</s>, be strong and gracious to us; O much-invoked one, join us for great wealth.

children.text: saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dhanam ubhayaṃ samākṛtam asmabhyaṃ dhattāṃ varuṇaś ca manyuḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Manyu</s> place for us the mingled wealth, the twofold wealth gathered together.

children.text: bhiyo dadhānā hṛdayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitāso apa ni layantām ||
children.translated_text: May the enemies, bearing fears in their hearts, defeated, lie down away from us.

children.text: Chapter 134
yas te manyo 'vidhad vajra sāyaka saha ojaḥ puṣyati viśvam ānuṣak
children.translated_text: Whoever has served you, O <s>Manyu</s>, O thunderbolt-arrow, grows in strength and vigor, continually mastering all.

children.text: sāhyāma dāsam āryaṃ tvayā yujā vayaṃ sahaskṛtena sahasā sahasvatā ||
children.translated_text: With you as ally, with force that creates force, with forceful force, may we overcome both the <s>Dāsa</s> and the <s>Ārya</s>.

children.text: manyur indro manyur evāsa devo manyur hotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Manyu</s> is <s>Indra</s>; <s>Manyu</s> indeed was the god; <s>Manyu</s> is the <s>Hotṛ</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: manyuṃ viśa īḍate mānuṣīr yāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sajoṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The human peoples praise <s>Manyu</s>; protect us, O <s>Manyu</s>, in agreement with your ardor.

children.text: abhīhi manyo tavasas tavīyān tapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn
children.translated_text: Come against them, O <s>Manyu</s>, stronger than the strong; with ardor as your ally, strike the enemies apart.

children.text: amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasūny ā bharā tvaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Slayer of foes, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, and slayer of <s>Dasyu</s>, bring all good things to us.

children.text: tvaṃ hi manyo abhibhūtyojāḥ svayaṃbhūr bhāmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Manyu</s>, are of overpowering strength, self-born fury, conqueror of hostile attacks.

children.text: viśvacarṣaṇiḥ sahuriḥ sahīyān asmāsv ojaḥ pṛtanāsu dhehi ||
children.translated_text: Seeing all peoples, overcoming, stronger still: place vigor in us in battles.

children.text: abhāgaḥ sann apa pareto asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetaḥ
children.translated_text: Unfortunate, I have gone far away from your purpose, O discerning one of mighty force.

children.text: taṃ tvā manyo akratur jihīḍāhaṃ svā tanūr baladāvā na ehi ||
children.translated_text: Without purpose, I have offended you, O <s>Manyu</s>; come to us as your own self, giver of strength.

children.text: ayaṃ te asmy upa na ehy arvāṅ pratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadāvan
children.translated_text: I am yours; come here near to us, turned toward us, O overcomer, giver of all.

children.text: manyo vajrinn abhi na ā vavṛtsva hanāva dasyūṃr uta bodhy āpeḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Manyu</s>, bearer of the thunderbolt, turn yourself toward us; let us slay the <s>Dasyus</s>, and be mindful of us as an ally.

children.text: abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā no 'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri
children.translated_text: Advance against them; be on our right side; then let us strike down many <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: juhomi te dharuṇaṃ madhvo agram ubhāv upāṃśu prathamā pibāva ||
children.translated_text: I offer you the supporting first portion of honey; let the two of us drink first in silence.

children.text: Chapter 135
apa naḥ śośucad agham agne śuśugdhy ā rayim
children.translated_text: Burn away from us the evil that has flamed up, O <s>Agni</s>; burn it away toward wealth.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Burn away from us the evil that has flamed up.

children.text: sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe
children.translated_text: With good fields, good going, and desire for goods, we sacrifice.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Burn away from us the evil that has flamed up.

children.text: pra yad bhandiṣṭha eṣāṃ prāsmākāsaś ca sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: When the most blessed prosperity of these comes forth, and when our patrons come forth,

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: burn away from us the evil that has flamed up.

children.text: pra yat te agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam
children.translated_text: When your patrons, O <s>Agni</s>, prosper, may we too prosper for you.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Burn away from us the evil that has flamed up.

children.text: pra yad agneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ
children.translated_text: When the rays of mighty <s>Agni</s> go forth on every side,

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: burn away from us the evil that has flamed up.

children.text: tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūr asi
children.translated_text: For you, O one facing every way, encompass all from every side.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Burn away from us the evil that has flamed up.

children.text: dviṣo no viśvatomukhāti nāveva pāraya
children.translated_text: Carry us across hatreds from every side, as across in a boat.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Burn away from us the evil that has flamed up.

children.text: sa naḥ sindhum iva nāvāti parṣa svastaye
children.translated_text: May he carry us across the flood as in a boat, for well-being.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Burn away from us the evil that has flamed up.

children.text: Chapter 136
brahmāsya śīrṣaṃ bṛhad asya pṛṣṭhaṃ vāmadevyam udaram odanasya
children.translated_text: The <s>brahman</s> is its head, the <s>Bṛhat</s> is its back, and the <s>Vāmadevya</s> is the belly of the odana.

children.text: chandāṃsi pakṣau mukham asya satyaṃ viṣṭārī jātas tapaso'dhi yajñaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The meters are its two wings, truth is its mouth; the sacrifice was born wide-spreading from ardor.

children.text: anasthāḥ pūtāḥ pavanena śuddhāḥ śucayaḥ śucim api yanti lokam
children.translated_text: Boneless, purified by the purifier, cleansed and pure, they go to the pure world.

children.text: naiṣāṃ śiśnaṃ pra dahati jātavedāḥ svarge loke bahu straiṇam eṣām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jātavedas</s> does not burn their generative organ; in the heavenly world there is abundant female company for them.

children.text: viṣṭāriṇam odanaṃ ye pacanti nainān avartiḥ sacate kadācana
children.translated_text: Those who cook the wide-spreading odana are never attended by reversal or ruin.

children.text: āste yama upa yāti devānt saṃ gandharvair madate somyebhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He sits beside <s>Yama</s>, he approaches the gods, and with the Soma-drinking <s>Gandharvas</s> he rejoices.

children.text: viṣṭāriṇam odanam ye pacanti nainān yamaḥ pari muṣṇāti retaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who cook the wide-spreading odana, <s>Yama</s> does not rob them of their seed.

children.text: rathī ha bhūtvā rathayāna īyate pakṣī ha bhūtvāti divaḥ sam eti ||
children.translated_text: Having become a chariot-warrior, he travels by chariot; having become a bird, he passes beyond heaven.

children.text: eṣa yajñānāṃ vitato vahiṣṭho viṣṭāriṇaṃ paktvā divam ā viveśa
children.translated_text: This, stretched wide, is the best carrier of sacrifices; having cooked the viṣṭārin odana, he entered heaven.

children.text: āṇḍīkaṃ kumudaṃ saṃ tanoti bisaṃ śālūkaṃ śaphako mulālī
children.translated_text: It extends āṇḍīka, kumuda, lotus-fiber, śālūka, śaphaka, and mulālī.

children.text: etās tvā dhārā upa yantu sarvāḥ svarge loke madhumat pinvamānā upa tvā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samantāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May all these streams come to you; in the heavenly world, swelling with sweetness, may lotus ponds stand around you on every side.

children.text: ghṛtahradā madhukūlāḥ surodakāḥ kṣīreṇa pūrṇā udakena dadhnā
children.translated_text: Lakes of ghee, banks of honey, waters of liquor, filled with milk, water, and curds,

children.text: etās tvā dhārā upa yantu sarvāḥ svarge loke madhumat pinvamānā upa tvā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samantāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may all these streams come to you; in the heavenly world, swelling with sweetness, may lotus ponds stand around you on every side.

children.text: caturaḥ kumbhāṃś caturdhā dadāmi kṣīreṇa pūrṇāṃ udakena dadhnā
children.translated_text: I give four jars in four portions, filled with milk, water, and curds.

children.text: etās tvā dhārā upa yantu sarvāḥ svarge loke madhumat pinvamānā upa tvā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samantāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May all these streams come to you; in the heavenly world, swelling with sweetness, may lotus ponds stand around you on every side.

children.text: imam odanaṃ ni dadhe brāhmaṇeṣu viṣṭāriṇaṃ lokajitaṃ svargam
children.translated_text: I set this odana among the brahmins, wide-spreading, world-winning, heavenly.

children.text: sa me mā kṣeṣṭa svadhayā pinvamāno viśvarūpā dhenuḥ kāmadughā me astu ||
children.translated_text: May it not be exhausted for me, swelling with svadhā; may it be for me a many-formed cow yielding desires.

children.text: Chapter 137
yam odanaṃ prathamajā ṛtasya prajāpatis tapasā brahmaṇe 'pacat
children.translated_text: The odana which <s>Prajāpati</s>, first-born of <s>ṛta</s>, cooked through ardor for <s>brahman</s>,

children.text: yo lokānāṃ vidhṛtir nābhireṣāt tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||
children.translated_text: which is the support and navel of the worlds: with that odana may I cross beyond death.

children.text: yenātaran bhūtakṛto 'ti mṛtyuṃ yam anvavindan tapasā śrameṇa
children.translated_text: With which the makers of beings crossed beyond death, which they found through ardor and toil,

children.text: yaṃ papāca brahmaṇe brahma pūrvaṃ tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||
children.translated_text: which <s>Brahman</s> of old cooked for <s>brahman</s>: with that odana may I cross beyond death.

children.text: yo dādhāra pṛthivīṃ viśvabhojasaṃ yo antarikṣam āpṛṇād rasena
children.translated_text: Which supported the earth that nourishes all, which filled the midspace with sap,

children.text: yo astabhnād divam ūrdhvo mahimnā tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||
children.translated_text: which, upright by its greatness, propped up heaven: with that odana may I cross beyond death.

children.text: yasmān māsā nirmitās triṃśadarāḥ saṃvatsaro yasmān nirmito dvādaśāraḥ
children.translated_text: From which the months were fashioned, having thirty spokes; from which the year was fashioned, having twelve spokes,

children.text: ahorātrā yaṃ pariyanto nāpus tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||
children.translated_text: which day and night, circling around, did not overtake: with that odana may I cross beyond death.

children.text: yaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇadavān babhūva yasmai lokā ghṛtavantaḥ kṣaranti
children.translated_text: Which became the giver of breath, possessing breath-giving power, for which the ghee-filled worlds flow,

children.text: jyotiṣmatīḥ pradiśo yasya sarvās tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||
children.translated_text: all whose directions are luminous: with that odana may I cross beyond death.

children.text: yasmāt pakvād amṛtaṃ saṃbabhūva yo gāyatryā adhipatir babhūva
children.translated_text: From whose cooked form immortality arose, which became the lord of <s>Gāyatrī</s>,

children.text: yasmin vedā nihitā viśvarūpās tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||
children.translated_text: in which the many-formed <s>Vedas</s> are deposited: with that odana may I cross beyond death.

children.text: ava bādhe dviṣantaṃ devapīyuṃ sapatnā ye me 'pa te bhavantu
children.translated_text: I ward off the hating, god-reviling rival; let those who are my opponents go away.

children.text: brahmaudanaṃ viśvajitaṃ pacāmi śṛṇvantu me śraddadhānasya devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: I cook the <s>brahmaudana</s> (sacred rice-offering), the all-conquering one; let the gods hear me, who have faith.

children.text: Chapter 138
tānt satyaujāḥ pra dahatv agnir vaiśvānaro vṛṣā
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, true in strength, the bull, burn them forth.

children.text: yo no durasyād dipsāc cātho yo no arātiyāt ||
children.translated_text: Whoever would harm us from afar, whoever would try to injure us, and whoever would act hostilely toward us,

children.text: yo no dipsād adipsato dipsato yaś ca dipsati
children.translated_text: whoever would try to injure us when we do not seek to injure him, and whoever, when we seek to injure, seeks to injure us,

children.text: vaiśvānarasya daṃṣṭrayor agner api dadhāmi tam ||
children.translated_text: him I place between the two fangs of <s>Vaiśvānara Agni</s>.

children.text: ya āgare mṛgayante pratikrośe 'māvāsye
children.translated_text: Those who prowl at the house-front, at the answering cry, on the new-moon night,

children.text: kravyādo anyān dipsataḥ sarvāṃs tānt sahasā sahe ||
children.translated_text: the flesh-eaters, and all the others who seek to harm: all those I overpower by force.

children.text: sahe piśācānt sahasaiṣāṃ draviṇaṃ dade
children.translated_text: I overpower the <s>piśācas</s>; by force I take their wealth.

children.text: sarvān durasyato hanmi saṃ ma ākūtir ṛdhyatām ||
children.translated_text: I strike down all who act with hostility; let my intention prosper together with me.

children.text: ye devās tena hāsante sūryeṇa mimate javam
children.translated_text: The gods who laugh with that, who measure their speed by the sun,

children.text: nadīṣu parvateṣu ye saṃ taiḥ paśubhir vide ||
children.translated_text: and those who are in the rivers and on the mountains: may I be joined with those creatures.

children.text: tapano asmi piśācānāṃ vyāghro gomatām iva
children.translated_text: I am a burner of the <s>piśācas</s>, like a tiger among cattle.

children.text: śvānaḥ siṃham iva dṛṣṭvā te na vindante nyañcanam ||
children.translated_text: As dogs, seeing a lion, find no low hiding-place, so they find none.

children.text: na piśācaiḥ saṃ śaknomi na stenaiḥ na vanargubhiḥ
children.translated_text: I cannot make common cause with <s>piśācas</s>, nor with thieves, nor with forest-prowlers.

children.text: piśācās tasmān naśyanti yam ahaṃ grāmam āviśe ||
children.translated_text: The <s>piśācas</s> vanish from the village into which I enter.

children.text: yaṃ grāmam āviśata idam ugraṃ saho mama
children.translated_text: From whatever village this fierce power of mine enters,

children.text: piśācās tasmān naśyanti na pāpam upa jānate ||
children.translated_text: the <s>piśācas</s> vanish from it; they do not come to know evil there.

children.text: ye mā krodhayanti lapitā hastinaṃ maśakā iva
children.translated_text: Those babblers who anger me, like mosquitoes angering an elephant,

children.text: tān ahaṃ manye durhitān jane alpaśayūn iva ||
children.translated_text: I regard those ill-disposed men as petty people.

children.text: abhi taṃ nirṛtir dhattām aśvam iva aśvābhidhānyā
children.translated_text: Let <s>Nirṛti</s> bind him, as a horse is bound with a horse-tether.

children.text: malvo yo mahyaṃ krudhyati sa u pāśān na mucyate ||
children.translated_text: The wicked one who is angry with me: he is not released from the nooses.

children.text: Chapter 139
tvayā pūrvam atharvāṇo jaghnū rakṣāṃsy oṣadhe
children.translated_text: With you, O plant, the <s>Atharvans</s> of old slew the <s>rakṣases</s>.

children.text: tvayā jaghāna kaśyapas tvayā kaṇvo agastyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With you <s>Kaśyapa</s> slew; with you <s>Kaṇva</s> and <s>Agastya</s> slew.

children.text: tvayā vayam apsaraso gandharvāṃś cātayāmahe
children.translated_text: With you we drive away the <s>apsarases</s> and the <s>gandharvas</s>.

children.text: ajaśṛṅgy aja rakṣaḥ sarvān gandhena nāśaya ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Ajaśṛṅgī</s>, goat-horned one, make all <s>rakṣases</s> perish with your scent.

children.text: nadīṃ yantv apsaraso 'pāṃ tāram avaśvasam
children.translated_text: Let the <s>apsarases</s> go to the river, to the crossing of the waters, to the place of neighing.

children.text: guggulūḥ pīlā nalady aukṣagandhiḥ pramandanī
children.translated_text: <s>Guggulū</s>, <s>Pīlā</s>, <s>Naladī</s>, <s>Aukṣagandhi</s>, and <s>Pramandanī</s>:

children.text: tat paretāpsarasaḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana ||
children.translated_text: therefore go away, O <s>apsarases</s>; become awakened.

children.text: yatrāśvatthā nyagrodhā mahāvṛkṣāḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ
children.translated_text: Where there are aśvattha trees, banyan trees, great trees, and crested ones,

children.text: tat paretāpsarasaḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana ||
children.translated_text: there go away, O <s>apsarases</s>; become awakened.

children.text: yatra vaḥ preṅkhā haritā arjunā uta yatrāghātāḥ karkaryaḥ saṃvadanti
children.translated_text: Where your green swings are, and the arjuna trees, where the striking instruments and lutes sound together,

children.text: tat paretāpsarasaḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana ||
children.translated_text: there go away, O <s>apsarases</s>; become awakened.

children.text: eyam agann oṣadhīnāṃ vīrudhām vīryāvatī
children.translated_text: This one has come, powerful among the plants and creepers,

children.text: ajaśṛṅgy arāṭakī tīkṣṇaśṛṅgī vyṛṣatu ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ajaśṛṅgī</s>, <s>Arāṭakī</s>, sharp-horned; let her unman them.

children.text: ānṛtyataḥ śikhaṇḍino gandharvasyāpsarāpateḥ
children.translated_text: Of the dancing, crested <s>gandharva</s>, lord of the <s>apsarases</s>,

children.text: bhinadmi muṣkāv api yāmi śepaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I split the testicles; I attack the penis.

children.text: bhīmā indrasya hetayaḥ śataṃ ṛṣṭīr ayasmayīḥ
children.translated_text: Terrible are the missiles of <s>Indra</s>, a hundred iron spears.

children.text: tābhir haviradān gandharvān avakādān vyṛṣatu ||
children.translated_text: With those let him unman the <s>gandharvas</s> who eat oblations and who eat marsh-grass.

children.text: bhīmā indrasya hetayaḥ śataṃ ṛṣṭīr hiraṇyayīḥ
children.translated_text: Terrible are the missiles of <s>Indra</s>, a hundred golden spears.

children.text: tābhir haviradān gandharvān avakādān vyṛṣatu ||
children.translated_text: With those let him unman the <s>gandharvas</s> who eat oblations and who eat marsh-grass.

children.text: avakādān abhiśocān apsu jyotaya māmakān
children.translated_text: Set my lights in the waters against the marsh-grass eaters and the burning ones.

children.text: piśācānt sarvān oṣadhe pra mṛṇīhi sahasva ca ||
children.translated_text: O plant, crush all the <s>piśācas</s> and overpower them.

children.text: śvevaikaḥ kapir ivaikaḥ kumāraḥ sarvakeśakaḥ
children.translated_text: One is like a dog, one like a monkey, a youth with hair all over.

children.text: priyo dṛśa iva bhūtvā gandharvaḥ sacate striyaḥ
children.translated_text: Having become dear to the sight, the <s>gandharva</s> attaches himself to women.

children.text: tam ito nāśayāmasi brahmaṇā vīryāvatā ||
children.translated_text: We drive him away from here with powerful <s>brahman</s> (sacred utterance).

children.text: jāyā id vo apsaraso gandharvāḥ patayo yūyam
children.translated_text: The <s>apsarases</s> are your wives, O <s>gandharvas</s>, and you are their husbands.

children.text: apa dhāvatāmartyā martyān mā sacadhvam ||
children.translated_text: Run away, immortals; do not consort with mortals.

children.text: Chapter 140
udbhindatīṃ saṃjayantīm apsarāṃ sādhudevinīm
children.translated_text: The breaking-through, conquering <s>apsaras</s>, skilled in play,

children.text: glahe kṛtāni kṛṇvānām apsarāṃ tām iha huve ||
children.translated_text: the <s>apsaras</s> who makes the throws at dice: her I call here.

children.text: vicinvatīm ākirantīm apsarāṃ sādhudevinīm
children.translated_text: The searching, scattering <s>apsaras</s>, skilled in play,

children.text: glahe kṛtāni gṛhṇānām apsarāṃ tām iha huve ||
children.translated_text: the <s>apsaras</s> who takes the throws at dice: her I call here.

children.text: yāyaiḥ parinṛtyaty ādadānā kṛtaṃ glahāt
children.translated_text: She with whom one dances around, taking the winning throw from the dice-game,

children.text: sā naḥ kṛtāni sīṣatī prahām āpnotu māyayā
children.translated_text: let her win the throws for us; by magic let her obtain the stake.

children.text: sā naḥ payasvaty aitu mā no jaiṣur idaṃ dhanam ||
children.translated_text: Let her, rich in milk, come to us; let them not win this wealth from us.

children.text: yā akṣeṣu pramodante śucaṃ krodhaṃ ca bibhratī
children.translated_text: Those who rejoice among the dice, bearing grief and anger,

children.text: ānandinīṃ pramodinīm apsarāṃ tām iha huve ||
children.translated_text: the delighting, rejoicing <s>apsaras</s>: her I call here.

children.text: sūryasya raśmīn anu yāḥ saṃcaranti marīcīr vā yā anusaṃcaranti
children.translated_text: Those who move following the rays of the sun, or who move along the gleams,

children.text: yāsām ṛṣabho dūrato vājinīvānt sadyaḥ sarvān lokān paryeti rakṣan
children.translated_text: whose bull, rich in steeds, from afar at once goes around all the worlds, protecting them,

children.text: sa na aitu homam imaṃ juṣāṇo 'ntarikṣeṇa saha vājinīvān ||
children.translated_text: may he come to this oblation, enjoying it, together with the atmosphere, rich in steeds.

children.text: antarikṣena saha vājinīvan karkīṃ vatsām iha rakṣa vājin
children.translated_text: Together with the atmosphere, rich in steeds, protect the speckled calf here, O steed-rich one.

children.text: ime te stokā bahulā ehy arvāṅ iyaṃ te karkīha te mano 'stu ||
children.translated_text: These drops of yours are abundant; come here hither. This is your speckled one; let your mind be here.

children.text: antarikṣeṇa saha vājinīvan karkīṃ vatsām iha rakṣa vājin
children.translated_text: Together with the atmosphere, rich in steeds, protect the speckled calf here, O steed-rich one.

children.text: ayaṃ ghāso ayaṃ vraja iha vatsāṃ ni badhnīmaḥ
children.translated_text: This is the grass, this is the pen; here we bind the calf.

children.text: yathānāma va īśmahe svāhā ||
children.translated_text: According to name we gain mastery over you; <s>svāhā</s>.

children.text: Chapter 141
pṛthivyām agnaye sam anamant sa ārdhnot
children.translated_text: On the earth they bowed together to <s>Agni</s>; he prospered.

children.text: yathā pṛthivyām agnaye samanamann evā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu ||
children.translated_text: As on the earth they bowed together to <s>Agni</s>, so let there be bowing together to me; let them bow down together.

children.text: pṛthivī dhenus tasyā agnir vatsaḥ
children.translated_text: The earth is a cow; <s>Agni</s> is her calf.

children.text: sā me 'gninā vatseneṣam ūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām
children.translated_text: May she, with <s>Agni</s> as calf, milk refreshment, strength, and desire for me,

children.text: āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: first long life, offspring, nourishment, and wealth; <s>svāhā</s>.

children.text: antarikṣe vāyave sam anamant sa ārdhnot
children.translated_text: In the atmosphere they bowed together to <s>Vāyu</s>; he prospered.

children.text: yathāntarikṣe vāyave samanamann evā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu ||
children.translated_text: As in the atmosphere they bowed together to <s>Vāyu</s>, so let there be bowing together to me; let them bow down together.

children.text: antarikṣaṃ dhenus tasyā vatsaḥ
children.translated_text: The atmosphere is a cow; <s>Vāyu</s> is its calf.

children.text: sā me vāyunā vatseneṣam ūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām
children.translated_text: May it, with <s>Vāyu</s> as calf, milk refreshment, strength, and desire for me,

children.text: āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: first long life, offspring, nourishment, and wealth; <s>svāhā</s>.

children.text: divyādityāya sam anamant sa ārdhnot
children.translated_text: In heaven they bowed together to <s>Āditya</s>; he prospered.

children.text: yathā divyādityāya samanamann evā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu ||
children.translated_text: As they bowed in unison to the heavenly <s>Āditya</s>, so may acts of homage bow in unison to me.

children.text: dyaur dhenus tasyā ādityo vatsaḥ
children.translated_text: Heaven is a cow; her calf is <s>Āditya</s>.

children.text: sā ma ādityena vatseneṣam ūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām
children.translated_text: May she, with <s>Āditya</s> as calf, milk out for me refreshment, strength, and desire,

children.text: āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: first long life, offspring, increase, and wealth. Svāhā.

children.text: dikṣu candrāya sam anamant sa ārdhnot
children.translated_text: In the quarters they bowed in unison to <s>Candra</s>; he prospered.

children.text: yathā dikṣu candrāya samanamann evā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu ||
children.translated_text: As they bowed in unison to <s>Candra</s> in the quarters, so may acts of homage bow in unison to me.

children.text: diśo dhenavas tāsāṃ candro vatsaḥ
children.translated_text: The quarters are cows; their calf is <s>Candra</s>.

children.text: tā me candreṇa vatseneṣam ūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: May they, with <s>Candra</s> as calf, milk out for me refreshment, strength, desire, first long life, offspring, increase, and wealth. Svāhā.

children.text: agnāv agniś carati praviṣṭa ṛṣīṇām putro abhiśastipā u
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> moves within <s>Agni</s>, having entered him, the son of the seers and protector against curses.

children.text: namaskāreṇa namasā te juhomi mā devānāṃ mithuyā karma bhāgam ||
children.translated_text: With obeisance, with reverence, I offer to you; do not make the gods' share a wrongly divided rite.

children.text: hṛdā pūtam manasā jātavedo viśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān
children.translated_text: Purified by the heart and by the mind, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, O god, knowing all inspired ways,

children.text: saptāsyāni tava jātavedas tebhyo juhomi sa juṣasva havyam ||
children.translated_text: yours are seven mouths, O <s>Jātavedas</s>; to them I offer. Accept the oblation together.

children.text: Chapter 142
ye purastājjuhvati jātavedaḥ prācyā diśo 'bhidāsanty asmān
children.translated_text: Those who offer from the front, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, who assail us from the eastern direction,

children.text: agnim ṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyag enān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
children.translated_text: having invoked <s>Agni</s>, may they turn away and tremble; I strike them back with the counter-charm.

children.text: ye dakṣiṇato juhvati jātavedo dakṣiṇāyā diśo 'bhidāsanty asmān
children.translated_text: Those who offer from the south, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, who assail us from the southern direction,

children.text: yamaṃ ṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyag enān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
children.translated_text: having invoked <s>Yama</s>, may they turn away and tremble; I strike them back with the counter-charm.

children.text: ye paścājjuhvati jātavedaḥ pratīcyā diśo 'bhidāsanty asmān
children.translated_text: Those who offer from the west, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, who assail us from the western direction,

children.text: varuṇam ṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyag enān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
children.translated_text: having invoked <s>Varuṇa</s>, may they turn away and tremble; I strike them back with the counter-charm.

children.text: ya uttarato juhvati jātaveda udīcyā diśo 'bhidāsanty asmān
children.translated_text: Those who offer from the north, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, who assail us from the northern direction,

children.text: somam ṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyag enān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
children.translated_text: having invoked <s>Soma</s>, may they turn away and tremble; I strike them back with the counter-charm.

children.text: ye 'dhastājjuhvati jātaveda udīcyā diśo 'bhidāsanty asmān
children.translated_text: Those who offer from below, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, who assail us from the northern direction,

children.text: bhūmim ṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyag enān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
children.translated_text: having invoked <s>Bhūmi</s>, may they turn away and tremble; I strike them back with the counter-charm.

children.text: ye 'ntarikṣājjuhvati jātavedo vyadhvāyā diśo 'bhidāsanty asmān
children.translated_text: Those who offer from the midspace, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, who assail us from the crosswise direction,

children.text: vāyum ṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyag enān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
children.translated_text: having invoked <s>Vāyu</s>, may they turn away and tremble; I strike them back with the counter-charm.

children.text: ya upariṣṭājjuhvati jātaveda ūrdhvāyā diśo 'bhidāsanty asmān
children.translated_text: Those who offer from above, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, who assail us from the upward direction,

children.text: sūryam ṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyag enān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
children.translated_text: having invoked <s>Sūrya</s>, may they turn away and tremble; I strike them back with the counter-charm.

children.text: ye diśām antardeśebhyo juhvati jātavedaḥ sarvābhyo digbhyo 'bhidāsanti asmān
children.translated_text: Those who offer from the spaces between the directions, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, who assail us from all the directions,

children.text: brahmartvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyag enān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
children.translated_text: having invoked <s>brahman</s>, may they turn away and tremble; I strike them back with the counter-charm.

children.text: Chapter 143
ṛdhaṅmantro yoniṃ ya ābabhūvāmṛtāsur vardhamānaḥ sujanmā
children.translated_text: He who, a prospering mantra, came into the womb, immortal in vital breath, growing, well-born,

children.text: adabdhāsur bhrājamāno 'heva trito dhartā dādhāra trīṇi ||
children.translated_text: with undeceived vital breath, shining like a serpent: <s>Trita</s>, the supporter, upheld the three.

children.text: ā yo dharmāṇi prathamaḥ sasāda tato vapūṃṣi kṛṇuṣe purūṇi
children.translated_text: He who first sat down upon the ordinances: from there you make many forms.

children.text: dhāsyur yoniṃ prathama ā viveśā yo vācam anuditāṃ ciketa ||
children.translated_text: The supporter first entered the womb, he who perceived speech before it was uttered.

children.text: yas te śokāya tanvaṃ rireca kṣaraddhiraṇyaṃ śucayo 'nu svāḥ
children.translated_text: He who poured forth his body for your flame, while the bright ones, dripping gold, followed their own powers,

children.text: atrā dadhete amṛtāni nāmāsme vastrāṇi viśa erayantām ||
children.translated_text: there they set the immortal names; may the peoples send garments forth to us.

children.text: pra yad ete prataraṃ pūrvyaṃ guḥ sadaḥsada ātiṣṭhanto ajuryam
children.translated_text: When these went forth to the more distant, ancient place, standing in each seat, undecaying,

children.text: kaviḥ śuṣasya mātarā rihāṇe jāmyai dhuryaṃ patim erayethām ||
children.translated_text: O poet, while the two mothers of power were licking, may you two impel the yoke-bearing lord for the kinswoman.

children.text: tad ū ṣu te mahat pṛthujman namaḥ kaviḥ kāvyenā kṛṇomi
children.translated_text: That great, broad-striding homage of yours I now make, O poet, by means of poetry.

children.text: yat samyañcāv abhiyantāv abhi kṣām atrā mahī rodhacakre vāvṛdhete ||
children.translated_text: When the two, going together and advancing, went over the earth, there the two great enclosing ones grew mighty.

children.text: sapta maryādāḥ kavayas tatakṣus tāsām id ekām abhy aṃhuro gāt
children.translated_text: The poets fashioned seven boundaries; to one of them the distressed man came near.

children.text: āyor ha skambha upamasya nīḍe pathāṃ visarge dharuṇeṣu tasthau ||
children.translated_text: At the nest of the nearest <s>Āyu</s>, at the branching of the paths, he stood among the supports.

children.text: utāmṛtāsur vrata emi kṛṇvann asur ātmā tanvas tat sumadguḥ
children.translated_text: And I go, carrying out the vow, immortal in vital breath; the living self of the body has gone well into that.

children.text: uta vā śakro ratnaṃ dadhāty ūrjayā vā yat sacate havirdāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Or <s>Śakra</s> places treasure there, or through strength, when the giver of oblations joins himself to it.

children.text: uta putraḥ pitaraṃ kṣatram īḍe jyeṣṭhaṃ maryādam ahvayant svastaye
children.translated_text: And the son praises the father, the sovereignty, the eldest boundary; they have called on it for well-being.

children.text: darśan nu tā varuṇa yās te viṣṭhā āvarvratataḥ kṛṇavo vapūṃṣi ||
children.translated_text: Now behold those stations of yours, O <s>Varuṇa</s>; from one who has turned toward the vow you make forms.

children.text: ardham ardhena payasā pṛṇakṣy ardhena śuṣma vardhase amura
children.translated_text: With half you fill half with milk; with half, O mighty one, you grow in force.

children.text: aviṃ vṛdhāma śagmiyaṃ sakhāyaṃ varuṇaṃ putram adityā iṣiram
children.translated_text: We would strengthen the helpful protector, the powerful friend, <s>Varuṇa</s>, the swift son of <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: kaviśastāny asmai vapūṃṣy avocāma rodasī satyavācā ||
children.translated_text: For him we have spoken the forms praised by poets; Heaven and Earth are truth-speaking.

children.text: Chapter 144
tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham yato yajña ugras tveṣanṛmṇaḥ
children.translated_text: That indeed was the eldest among beings, from which the sacrifice arose, fierce and of blazing manly power.

children.text: sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūn anu yad enaṃ madanti viśva ūmāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Born at once, he drives away enemies, when all the invigorating powers exhilarate him.

children.text: vavṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrur dāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti
children.translated_text: Growing by might, rich in strength, he places fear in the hostile <s>Dāsa</s>.

children.text: avyanac ca vyanac ca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu ||
children.translated_text: He has opened out and spread abroad; winning, the offerings bow to you in the exhilarations.

children.text: tve kratum api pṛñcanti bhūri dvir yad ete trir bhavanty ūmāḥ
children.translated_text: In you they abundantly mix resolve, twice over, when these invigorating powers become threefold.

children.text: svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā sam adaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: From sweetness, sweeter with sweetness, pour forth; with that honey, with honey, fight in concert.

children.text: yadi cin nu tvā dhanā jayantaṃ raṇe raṇe anumadanti viprāḥ
children.translated_text: Even if the inspired poets rejoice in you as you win wealth in battle after battle,

children.text: ojīyaḥ śuṣmint sthiram ā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhan durevāsaḥ kaśokāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O more powerful, forceful one, stretch out a firm body; let not the ill-disposed, the bringers of grief, deceive you.

children.text: tvayā vayaṃ śāśadmahe raṇeṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri
children.translated_text: Through you we make ourselves strong in battles, seeing many things fit for combat.

children.text: codayāmi ta āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ te śiśāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: With words I set your weapons in motion; with <s>brahman</s> I sharpen your vital powers.

children.text: ni tad dadhiṣe 'vare pare ca yasminn āvithāvasā duroṇe
children.translated_text: You have set that down in the nearer and the farther place, in the house where you aided with aid.

children.text: ā sthāpayata mātaraṃ jigatnum ata invata karvarāṇi bhūri ||
children.translated_text: Set in place the moving mother; then drive onward the many dark powers.

children.text: stuṣva varṣman puruvartmānaṃ sam ṛbhvāṇam inatamam āptam āptyānām
children.translated_text: Praise, in his height, the one of many paths, the powerful one, the most impelling, attained among those who are to be attained.

children.text: ā darśati śavasā bhūryojāḥ pra sakṣati pratimānaṃ pṛthivyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: With strength, possessing much vigor, he becomes visible; he surpasses the measure of the earth.

children.text: imā brahma bṛhaddivaḥ kṛṇavad indrāya śūṣam agriyaḥ svarṣāḥ
children.translated_text: These sacred utterances of <s>Bṛhaddiva</s>, winning heaven, will make foremost power for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: maho gotrasya kṣayati svarājā turaś cid viśvam arṇavat tapasvān ||
children.translated_text: The self-ruling one rules the great enclosure of cattle; ardent, he will overflow even the swift whole world.

children.text: evā mahān bṛhaddivo atharvāvocat svāṃ tanvam indram eva
children.translated_text: Thus the great <s>Atharvan</s>, son of <s>Bṛhaddiva</s>, spoke of his own body as <s>Indra</s> himself.

children.text: svasārau mātaribhvarī aripre hinvanti caine śavasā vardhayanti ca ||
children.translated_text: The two sisterly powers, moving in the mother, unharmed, impel these two and increase them with might.

children.text: Chapter 145
mamāgne varco vihaveṣv astu vayaṃ tvendhānās tanvam puṣema
children.translated_text: Let my brilliance be present in the contests, O <s>Agni</s>; kindling you, may we nourish our body.

children.text: mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaś catasras tvayādhyakṣeṇa pṛtanā jayema ||
children.translated_text: Let the four directions bow to me; under your oversight may we win the battles.

children.text: agne manyuṃ pratinudan pareṣāṃ tvaṃ no gopāḥ pari pāhi viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, driving back the wrath of others, you are our guardian; protect us on every side.

children.text: apāñco yantu nivatā durasyavo 'maiṣāṃ cittaṃ prabudhāṃ vi neśat ||
children.translated_text: Let the ill-willed go downward and away; let the thought of these men here disappear, awakened and scattered.

children.text: mama devā vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto viṣṇur agniḥ
children.translated_text: Let all the gods be with me in the contest, together with <s>Indra</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: mamāntarikṣam urulokam astu mahyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ kāmāyāsmai ||
children.translated_text: Let the wide world of the midspace be mine; let the wind blow for me, for this desire.

children.text: mahyaṃ yajantāṃ mama yānīṣṭākūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu
children.translated_text: Let them sacrifice for me; whatever intention is my chosen aim, let the truth of my mind come to pass.

children.text: eno mā ni gāṃ katamac canāhaṃ viśve devā abhi rakṣantu meha ||
children.translated_text: May I not fall into any sin whatever; let all the gods protect me here.

children.text: mayi devā draviṇam ā yajantāṃ mayi āśīr astu mayi devahūtiḥ
children.translated_text: Let the gods bring wealth to me; let blessing be in me; let invocation of the gods be in me.

children.text: daivāḥ hotāraḥ saniṣan na etad ariṣṭāḥ syāma tanvā suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the divine priests win this for us; may we be unharmed in body and rich in good heroes.

children.text: daivīḥ ṣaḍ urvīr uru naḥ kṛṇota viśve devāsa iha mādayadhvam
children.translated_text: Make the six divine wide spaces broad for us; all you gods, rejoice here.

children.text: mā no vidad abhibhā mo aśastir mā no vidad vṛjinā dveṣyā yā ||
children.translated_text: May overpowering force not find us, nor censure; may no crookedness or hated malice find us.

children.text: tisro devīr mahi naḥ śarma yacchata prajāyai nas tanve yac ca puṣṭam
children.translated_text: Three goddesses, grant us great shelter, and grant what is thriving for our offspring and our body.

children.text: mā hāsmahi prajayā mā tanūbhir mā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan ||
children.translated_text: May we not be abandoned in offspring or in our bodies; may we not fail before the hater, O king <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yacchatv asmin have puruhūtaḥ purukṣu
children.translated_text: Let the wide-striding bull grant us great shelter in this invocation, the much-called one, rich in many goods.

children.text: sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḍendra mā no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, tawny-horsed one, be gracious to our offspring; do not injure us, do not hand us over.

children.text: dhātā vidhātā bhuvanasya yas patir devaḥ savitābhimātiṣāhaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Dhātṛ</s>, <s>Vidhātṛ</s>, the lord of the world, the god <s>Savitṛ</s> who overcomes hostile designs,

children.text: ādityā rudrā aśvinobhā devāḥ pāntu yajamānaṃ nirṛthāt ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, and both <s>Aśvins</s>, the gods, let them protect the sacrificer from ruin.

children.text: ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantv indrāgnibhyām ava bādhāmaha enān
children.translated_text: Let those who are our rivals go away from here; with <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> we drive them off.

children.text: ādityā rudrā uparispṛśo no ugraṃ cettāram adhirājam akrata ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Ādityas</s> and <s>Rudras</s>, touching us from above, have made a fierce discerning overlord for us.

children.text: arvāñcam indram amuto havāmahe yo gojid dhanajid aśvajid yaḥ
children.translated_text: We call <s>Indra</s> here from there, he who wins cattle, wins wealth, and wins horses.

children.text: imaṃ no yajñaṃ vihave śṛṇotv asmākam abhūr haryaśva medī ||
children.translated_text: Let him hear this sacrifice of ours in the contest; O tawny-horsed one, be favorable to us.

children.text: Chapter 146
yo giriṣv ajāyathā vīrudhāṃ balavattamaḥ
children.translated_text: You were born in the mountains, strongest of the plants.

children.text: kuṣṭhehi takmanāśana takmānaṃ nāśayann itaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>kuṣṭha</s> (costus plant), destroyer of <s>takman</s> (fever), destroying fever from here.

children.text: suparṇasuvane girau jātaṃ himavatas pari
children.translated_text: Born on the mountain at the birth-place of <s>Suparṇa</s>, around <s>Himavat</s>,

children.text: dhanair abhi śrutvā yanti vidur hi takmanāśanam ||
children.translated_text: people go to you when they have heard of you through treasures, for they know you as the destroyer of fever.

children.text: aśvattho devasadanas tṛtīyasyām ito divi
children.translated_text: The aśvattha, dwelling-place of the gods, stands in the third heaven from here.

children.text: tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ devāḥ kuṣṭham avanvata ||
children.translated_text: There, as the vision of immortality, the gods obtained <s>kuṣṭha</s>.

children.text: hiraṇyayī naur acaraddhiraṇyabandhanā divi
