children.translated_text: A golden ship moved in heaven, bound with golden fastenings.

children.text: tatrāmṛtasya puṣpaṃ devāḥ kuṣṭham avanvata ||
children.translated_text: There, as the flower of immortality, the gods obtained <s>kuṣṭha</s>.

children.text: hiraṇyayāḥ panthāna āsann aritrāṇi hiraṇyayā
children.translated_text: Golden were the paths there, and golden the oars.

children.text: nāvo hiraṇyayīr āsan yābhiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ nirāvahan ||
children.translated_text: Golden were the ships by which they carried <s>kuṣṭha</s> away.

children.text: imaṃ me kuṣṭha pūruṣaṃ tam ā vaha taṃ niṣ kuru
children.translated_text: O <s>kuṣṭha</s>, bring this man of mine; bring him near and set him free.

children.text: tam u me agadaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Make him free from disease for me.

children.text: devebhyo adhi jāto 'si somasyāsi sakhā hitaḥ
children.translated_text: You are born from the gods; you are the well-placed friend of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: sa prāṇāya vyānāya cakṣuṣe me asmai mṛḍa ||
children.translated_text: For this man of mine, be gracious to breath, to diffused breath, and to sight.

children.text: udaṅ jāto himavataḥ sa prācyāṃ nīyase janam
children.translated_text: Born in the north from <s>Himavat</s>, you are carried eastward to the people.

children.text: tatra kuṣṭhasya nāmāny uttamāni vi bhejire ||
children.translated_text: There the highest names of <s>kuṣṭha</s> were distributed.

children.text: uttamo nāma kuṣṭhāsy uttamo nāma te pitā
children.translated_text: Highest is your name, O <s>kuṣṭha</s>; Highest is the name of your father.

children.text: yakṣmaṃ ca sarvaṃ nāśaya takmānaṃ cārasaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Destroy every wasting disease, and make fever without sap.

children.text: śīrṣāmayam upahatyām akṣyos tanvo rapaḥ
children.translated_text: Head-pain, injury, disease of the eyes, and bodily affliction:

children.text: kuṣṭhas tat sarvaṃ niṣ karad daivaṃ samaha vṛṣṇyam ||
children.translated_text: <s>kuṣṭha</s> will drive all that out, whether divine in origin or bound up with virile force.

children.text: Chapter 147
rātrī mātā nabhaḥ pitāryamā te pitāmahaḥ
children.translated_text: Night is your mother, the cloud your father, and <s>Aryaman</s> your grandfather.

children.text: silācī nāma vā asi sā devānām asi svasā ||
children.translated_text: Either your name is <s>Silācī</s>; you are the sister of the gods.

children.text: yas tvā pibati jīvati trāyase puruṣaṃ tvam
children.translated_text: Whoever drinks you lives; you protect the man.

children.text: bhartrī hi śaśvatām asi janānāṃ ca nyañcanī ||
children.translated_text: For you are the bearer of people through all time, and the one who brings them low.

children.text: vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣam ā rohasi vṛṣaṇyantīva kanyalā
children.translated_text: You climb tree after tree, like a young girl longing for the male.

children.text: jayantī pratyātiṣṭhantī sparaṇī nāma vā asi ||
children.translated_text: Conquering, standing firm against opposition, either your name is <s>Sparaṇī</s>.

children.text: yad daṇḍena yad iṣvā yad vārur harasā kṛtam
children.translated_text: Whatever has been done by staff, by arrow, or by the destructive force of an enemy,

children.text: tasya tvam asi niṣkṛtiḥ semaṃ niṣ kṛdhi pūruṣam ||
children.translated_text: you are the release from that; set this man here free from it.

children.text: bhadrāt plakṣān nis tiṣṭhasy aśvatthāt khadirād dhavāt
children.translated_text: From the auspicious plakṣa you come forth, from aśvattha, khadira, and dhava,

children.text: bhadrān nyagrodhāt parṇāt sā na ehy arundhati ||
children.translated_text: from auspicious nyagrodha and parṇa; come to us, O <s>Arundhatī</s>.

children.text: hiraṇyavarṇe subhage sūryavarṇe vapuṣṭame
children.translated_text: Golden-colored, fortunate one, sun-colored, most beautiful in form,

children.text: rutaṃ gacchāsi niṣkṛte niṣkṛtir nāma vā asi ||
children.translated_text: you go to what is broken, for release; either your name is <s>Niṣkṛti</s>.

children.text: hiraṇyavarṇe subhage śuṣme lomaśavakṣaṇe
children.translated_text: Golden-colored, fortunate one, powerful one with hairy breasts,

children.text: apām asi svasā lākṣe vāto hātmā babhūva te ||
children.translated_text: you are the sister of the waters, O <s>Lākṣā</s>; the wind has become your very self.

children.text: silācī nāma kānīno 'jababhru pitā tava
children.translated_text: Your name is <s>Silācī</s>; the goat-brown <s>Kānīna</s> is your father.

children.text: aśvo yamasya yaḥ śyāvas tasya hāsnāsy ukṣitā ||
children.translated_text: The dark horse that belongs to <s>Yama</s>: with its blood you are sprinkled.

children.text: aśvasyāsnaḥ saṃpatitā sā vṛkṣāṁ abhi siṣyade
children.translated_text: Fallen from the blood of the horse, she streams over the trees.

children.text: sarā patatriṇī bhūtvā sā na ehy arundhati ||
children.translated_text: Having become a flowing, winged one, come to us, O <s>Arundhatī</s>.

children.text: Chapter 148
brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād vi sīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>brahman</s>, born first in the east, the radiant <s>Vena</s> uncovered from the boundary.

children.text: sa budhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataś ca yonim asataś ca vi vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He opened up its deep foundations, the womb of what exists and of what does not exist.

children.text: anāptā ye vaḥ prathamā yāni karmāṇi cakrire
children.translated_text: Those of you that are unfulfilled, whatever first deeds they performed,

children.text: vīrān no atra mā dabhan tad va etat puro dadhe ||
children.translated_text: let them not harm our heroes here; this I place before you.

children.text: sahasradhāra eva te sam asvaran divo nāke madhujihvā asaścataḥ
children.translated_text: Your thousand-streamed ones sounded together on the vault of heaven, honey-tongued and attending closely.

children.text: tasya spaśo na ni miṣanti bhūrṇayaḥ pade pade pāśinaḥ santi setave ||
children.translated_text: Its swift spies do not close their eyes; at every step there are noose-bearers for restraint.

children.text: pary ū ṣu pra dhanvā vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: Go around, indeed, with the bow stretched for the winning of strength, conquering the obstructions on every side.

children.text: dviṣas tad adhy arṇaveneyase sanisraso nāmāsi trayodaśo māsa indrasya gṛhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For overcoming hatred beyond the flood, with flowing powers, you are named the thirteenth month, the house of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: nv etenārātsīr asau svāhā
children.translated_text: Now by this you have repelled that one; svāhā.

children.text: tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāv iha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: With sharp weapons and sharp missiles, auspicious <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s>, here be gracious to us.

children.text: avaitenārātsīr asau svāhā
children.translated_text: Downward by this you have repelled that one; svāhā.

children.text: tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāv iha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: With sharp weapons and sharp missiles, auspicious <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s>, here be gracious to us.

children.text: apaitenārātsīr asau svāhā
children.translated_text: Away by this you have repelled that one; svāhā.

children.text: tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāv iha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: With sharp weapons and sharp missiles, auspicious <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s>, here be gracious to us.

children.text: mumuktam asmān duritād avadyāj juṣethām yajñam amṛtam asmāsu dhattam ||
children.translated_text: Release us from evil and from blame; accept the sacrifice, and place immortality in us.

children.text: cakṣuṣo hete manaso hete brahmaṇo hete tapasaś ca hete
children.translated_text: O missile of the eye, missile of the mind, missile of <s>brahman</s>, and missile of ardor,

children.text: menyā menir asy amenayas te santu ye 'smāṁ abhyaghāyanti ||
children.translated_text: you are the counter-harm against harm; let those who assail us be without means of harm.

children.text: yo 'smāṃś cakṣuṣā manasā cittyākūtyā ca yo aghāyur abhidāsāt
children.translated_text: Whoever, hostile, attacks us with eye, with mind, with thought and intention,

children.text: tvaṃ tān agne menyāmenīn kṛṇu svāhā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, make them harmless by counter-harm; svāhā.

children.text: indrasya gṛho 'si
children.translated_text: You are the house of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā pra viśāmi sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yan me 'sti tena ||
children.translated_text: I resort to you; I enter into you, with all cattle, all men, all self, all body, together with whatever belongs to me.

children.text: indrasya śarmāsi
children.translated_text: You are the shelter of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā pra viśāmi sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yan me 'sti tena ||
children.translated_text: I resort to you; I enter into you, with all cattle, all men, all self, all body, together with whatever belongs to me.

children.text: indrasya varmāsi
children.translated_text: You are the armor of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā pra viśāmi sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yan me 'sti tena ||
children.translated_text: I resort to you; I enter into you, with all cattle, all men, all self, all body, together with whatever belongs to me.

children.text: indrasya varūtham asi
children.translated_text: You are the protective enclosure of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā pra viśāmi sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yan me 'sti tena ||
children.translated_text: I resort to you; I enter into you, with all cattle, all men, all self, all body, together with whatever belongs to me.

children.text: Chapter 149
ā no bhara mā pari ṣṭhā arāte mā no rakṣīr dakṣiṇāṃ nīyamānām
children.translated_text: Bring to us; do not beset us, O <s>Arāti</s>; do not injure the sacrificial fee that is being led away.

children.text: namo vīrtsāyā asamṛddhaye namo astv arātaye ||
children.translated_text: Homage to deprivation, to non-prosperity; homage be to <s>Arāti</s>.

children.text: yam arāte purodhatse puruṣaṃ parirāpiṇam
children.translated_text: The man whom, O <s>Arāti</s>, you set before us as one who hems us in,

children.text: namas te tasmai kṛṇmo mā vaniṃ vyathayīr mama ||
children.translated_text: for him we make homage to you; do not distress my request.

children.text: pra ṇo vanir devakṛtā divā naktaṃ ca kalpatām
children.translated_text: May the divine gift be made ready for us by day and by night.

children.text: arātim anupremo vayaṃ namo astv arātaye ||
children.translated_text: We drive <s>Arāti</s> away after her; homage be to <s>Arāti</s>.

children.text: sarasvatīm anumatiṃ bhagaṃ yanto havāmahe
children.translated_text: Going forth, we call upon <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>Anumati</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: vācam juṣṭāṃ madhumatīm avādiṣaṃ devānāṃ devahūtiṣu ||
children.translated_text: In the gods' invocations to the gods, may I utter speech that is favored and honey-sweet.

children.text: yaṃ yācāmy ahaṃ vācā sarasvatyā manoyujā
children.translated_text: The one whom I ask for with speech joined in mind with <s>Sarasvatī</s>,

children.text: śraddhā tam adya vindatu dattā somena babhruṇā ||
children.translated_text: may faith find him today, given by tawny <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: mā vaniṃ mā vācaṃ no vīrtsīr ubhāv indrāgnī ā bharatāṃ no vasūni
children.translated_text: Do not injure our request; do not injure our speech. Let <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> both bring us goods.

children.text: sarve no adya ditsanto 'rātiṃ prati haryata ||
children.translated_text: All of you, wishing to give to us today, repel <s>Arāti</s>.

children.text: paro 'pehy asamṛddhe vi te hetiṃ nayāmasi
children.translated_text: Go far away, O non-prosperity; we turn your missile aside.

children.text: veda tvāhaṃ nimīvantīṃ nitudantīm arāte ||
children.translated_text: I know you, O <s>Arāti</s>, blinking and prodding.

children.text: uta nagnā bobhuvatī svapnayā sacase janam
children.translated_text: And naked, crying out, you attach yourself to people through sleep,

children.text: arāte cittaṃ vīrtsanty ākūtiṃ puruṣasya ca ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Arāti</s>, injuring a man's thought and intention.

children.text: yā mahatī mahonmānā viśvā āśā vyānaśe
children.translated_text: She who is great, of great measure, has pervaded all the quarters.

children.text: tasyai hiraṇyakeśyai nirṛtyā akaraṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: To her, golden-haired <s>Nirṛti</s>, I have made homage.

children.text: hiraṇyavarṇā subhagā hiraṇyakaśipur mahī
children.translated_text: Golden-colored, fortunate, golden-cushioned, and great,

children.text: tasyai hiraṇyadrāpaye 'rātyā akaraṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: to her, golden-robed <s>Arāti</s>, I have made homage.

children.text: Chapter 150
vaikaṅkatenedhmena devebhya ājyaṃ vaha
children.translated_text: With fuel of vaikaṅkata wood, carry ghee to the gods.

children.text: agne tāṁ iha mādaya sarva ā yantu me havam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, gladden her here; let all come to my call.

children.text: indrā yāhi me havam idaṃ kariṣyāmi tacchṛṇu
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, come to my call; I will perform this, so hear it.

children.text: ima aindrā atisarā ākūtiṃ saṃ namantu me
children.translated_text: May these <s>Indra</s>-connected atisaras (overrunning spells) bend intention toward me.

children.text: tebhiḥ śakema vīryaṃ jātavedas tanūvaśin ||
children.translated_text: With them may we be able to gain heroic power, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, mastering the body.

children.text: yad asāv amuto devā adevaḥ saṃścikīrṣati
children.translated_text: Whatever that godless one from over there wishes to contrive among the gods,

children.text: mā tasyāgnir havyaṃ vākṣīddhavaṃ devā asya mopa gur mamaiva havam etana ||
children.translated_text: let <s>Agni</s> not carry his oblation; let the gods not go to his summons. Come to my summons alone.

children.text: ati dhāvatātisarā indrasya vacasā hata
children.translated_text: Run forth, O atisaras (overrunning spells); strike by the command of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: aviṃ vṛka iva mathnīta sa vo jīvan mā moci prāṇam asyāpi nahyata ||
children.translated_text: Churn him as a wolf churns a sheep; let that living one not be released; bind even his breath.

children.text: yam amī purodadhire brahmāṇam apabhūtaye
children.translated_text: The <s>brahman</s> (spell) which those men set before themselves for destruction,

children.text: indra sa te adhaspadaṃ taṃ praty asyāmi mṛtyave ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, it is under your foot; I hurl him back to death.

children.text: yadi preyur devapurā brahma varmāṇi cakrire
children.translated_text: If, in former times, at the gods' stronghold they made <s>brahman</s> and armors,

children.text: tanūpānaṃ paripāṇaṃ kṛṇvānā yad upocire sarvaṃ tad arasaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: making body-protection and surrounding protection, whatever they approached, make all that sapless.

children.text: yān asāv atisarāṃś cakāra kṛṇavacca yān
children.translated_text: The atisaras (overrunning spells) which that one has made and which he will make,

children.text: tvaṃ tān indra vṛtrahan pratīcaḥ punar ā kṛdhi yathāmuṃ tṛṇahāṁ janam ||
children.translated_text: you, O <s>Indra</s>, <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, turn them back toward him, so that they may crush that man like grass.

children.text: yathendra udvācanaṃ labdhvā cakre adhaspadam
children.translated_text: As <s>Indra</s>, having obtained the utterance, made them underfoot,

children.text: kṛṇve 'ham adharān tathā amūñchaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so I make those men lower, for everlasting years.

children.text: atrainān indra vṛtrahann ugro marmaṇi vidhya
children.translated_text: Here, O <s>Indra</s>, <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, fierce one, pierce them in the vital spot.

children.text: atraivainān abhi tiṣṭhendra medy ahaṃ tava
children.translated_text: Right here stand over them, O <s>Indra</s>; let me be strengthened as yours.

children.text: anu tvendrā rabhāmahe syāma sumatau tava ||
children.translated_text: We take hold in following you, O <s>Indra</s>; may we be in your favor.

children.text: Chapter 151
dive svāhā ||
children.translated_text: To heaven, svāhā.

children.text: pṛthivyai svāhā ||
children.translated_text: To earth, svāhā.

children.text: antarikṣāya svāhā ||
children.translated_text: To the midspace, svāhā.

children.text: antarikṣāya svāhā ||
children.translated_text: To the midspace, svāhā.

children.text: dive svāhā ||
children.translated_text: To heaven, svāhā.

children.text: pṛthivyai svāhā ||
children.translated_text: To earth, svāhā.

children.text: sūryo me cakṣur vātaḥ prāṇo 'ntarikṣam ātmā pṛthivī śarīram
children.translated_text: The sun is my sight, the wind my breath; the midspace is my self, the earth my body.

children.text: astṛto nāmāham ayam asmi sa ātmānaṃ ni dadhe dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ gopīthāya ||
children.translated_text: I am this one named Unfallen; he places his self in heaven and earth for protection.

children.text: ud āyur ud balam ut kṛtam ut kṛtyām un manīṣām ud indriyam
children.translated_text: Up with life, up with strength, up with what has been done and with the spell, up with insight, up with the faculty.

children.text: āyuṣkṛd āyuṣpatnī svadhāvantau gopā me staṃ gopāyataṃ mā
children.translated_text: Life-maker and life-mistress, rich in <s>svadhā</s> (inherent power), be my protectors; protect me.

children.text: ātmasadau me staṃ mā mā hiṃsiṣṭam ||
children.translated_text: Be seated in my self; do not injure me.

children.text: Chapter 152
aśmavarma me 'si yo mā prācyā diśo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt
children.translated_text: You are stone armor for me; whoever, an evildoer, assails me from the eastern direction,

children.text: etat sa ṛchāt ||
children.translated_text: let that fall upon him.

children.text: aśmavarma me 'si yo mā dakṣiṇāyā diśo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt
children.translated_text: You are stone armor for me; whoever, an evildoer, assails me from the southern direction,

children.text: etat sa ṛchāt ||
children.translated_text: let that fall upon him.

children.text: aśmavarma me 'si yo mā pratīcyā diśo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt
children.translated_text: You are stone armor for me; whoever, an evildoer, assails me from the western direction,

children.text: etat sa ṛchāt ||
children.translated_text: let that fall upon him.

children.text: aśmavarma me 'si yo modīcyā diśo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt
children.translated_text: You are stone armor for me; whoever, an evildoer, assails me from the northern direction,

children.text: etat sa ṛchāt ||
children.translated_text: let that fall upon him.

children.text: aśmavarma me 'si yo mā dhruvāyā diśo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt
children.translated_text: You are stone armor for me; whoever, an evildoer, assails me from the fixed direction below,

children.text: etat sa ṛchāt ||
children.translated_text: let that fall upon him.

children.text: aśmavarma me 'si yo mordhvāyā diśo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt
children.translated_text: You are stone armor for me; whoever, an evildoer, assails me from the direction above,

children.text: etat sa ṛchāt ||
children.translated_text: let that fall upon him.

children.text: aśmavarma me 'si yo mā diśām antardeśebhyo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt
children.translated_text: You are stone armor for me; whoever, an evildoer, assails me from the intermediate regions between the directions,

children.text: etat sa ṛchāt ||
children.translated_text: let that fall upon him.

children.text: bṛhatā mana upa hvaye mātariśvanā prāṇāpānau
children.translated_text: With the great <s>Mātariśvan</s> I call here mind, breath, and down-breath.

children.text: sūryāc cakṣur antarikṣācchrotraṃ pṛthivyāḥ śarīram
children.translated_text: From the sun I call sight, from the midspace hearing, and from the earth the body.

children.text: sarasvatyā vācam upa hvayāmahe manoyujā ||
children.translated_text: From <s>Sarasvatī</s> we call speech here, yoked with mind.

children.text: Chapter 153
kathaṃ mahe asurāyābravīr iha kathaṃ pitre haraye tveṣanṛmṇaḥ
children.translated_text: How did you speak here to the great lord? How to the father, the tawny one of blazing manly force?

children.text: pṛśniṃ varuṇa dakṣiṇāṃ dadāvān punarmagha tvaṃ manasācikitsīḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Varuṇa</s>, having given the dappled cow as a fee, O <s>Punarmagha</s>, you reflected again with your mind.

children.text: na kāmena punarmagho bhavāmi saṃ cakṣe kaṃ pṛśnim etām upāje
children.translated_text: Not through desire do I become <s>Punarmagha</s>; I knowingly took possession of this dappled cow.

children.text: kena nu tvam atharvan kāvyena kena jātenāsi jātavedāḥ ||
children.translated_text: By what poetic wisdom, then, are you <s>Atharvan</s>? By what birth are you <s>Jātavedas</s>?

children.text: satyam ahaṃ gabhīraḥ kāvyena satyaṃ jātenāsmi jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: Through true poetic wisdom I am deep; through true birth I am <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: na me dāso nāryo mahitvā vrataṃ mīmāya yad ahaṃ dhariṣye ||
children.translated_text: No slave, nor an Aryan woman, by greatness has measured the vow that I shall uphold.

children.text: na tvad anyaḥ kavitaro na medhayā dhīrataro varuṇa svadhāvan
children.translated_text: There is no other poet more poetic than you, nor one wiser in intelligence, O self-powered <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ tā viśvā bhuvanāni vettha sa cin nu tvaj jano māyī bibhāya ||
children.translated_text: You know all those beings; even the crafty man has feared you.

children.text: tvaṃ hy aṅga varuṇa svadhāvan viśvā vettha janima supraṇīte
children.translated_text: For you, indeed, O self-powered <s>Varuṇa</s>, know all births, good guide.

children.text: kiṃ rajasa enā paro anyad asty enā kiṃ pareṇāvaram amura ||
children.translated_text: What else is beyond this expanse? What lower thing is on this side of what is beyond, O wise one?

children.text: ekaṃ rajasa enā paro anyad asty enā para ekena durṇaśaṃ cid arvāk
children.translated_text: One thing is beyond this expanse, and another is on this side; beyond the one, even the hard-to-reach is near.

children.text: tat te vidvān varuṇa pra bravīmy adhovacasaḥ paṇayo bhavantu nīcair dāsā upa sarpantu bhūmim ||
children.translated_text: Knowing this, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, I proclaim it to you: let the <s>Paṇis</s> be down-speaking; let the slaves crawl low upon the earth.

children.text: tvaṃ hy aṅga varuṇa bravīṣi punarmagheṣv avadyāni bhūri
children.translated_text: For you, indeed, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, speak of many blameworthy things among the <s>Punarmaghas</s>.

children.text: mo ṣu paṇīṃr abhy etāvato bhūn mā tvā vocann arādhasaṃ janāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not become one who goes against the <s>Paṇis</s> to such an extent; let people not call you ungenerous.

children.text: mā mā vocann arādhasaṃ janāsaḥ punas te pṛśniṃ jaritar dadāmi
children.translated_text: Let people not call me ungenerous; singer, I give your dappled cow back to you.

children.text: stotraṃ me viśvam ā yāhi śacībhir antar viśvāsu mānuṣīṣu dikṣu ||
children.translated_text: Come to my whole hymn with your powers, among all the human directions.

children.text: ā te stotrāṇy udyatāni yantv antar viśvāsu mānuṣīṣu dikṣu
children.translated_text: Let the hymns raised to you go forth among all the human directions.

children.text: dehi nu me yan me adatto asi yujyo me saptapadaḥ sakhāsi ||
children.translated_text: Now give me what you have not given me; you are my yokefellow, my seven-stepped friend.

children.text: samā nau bandhur varuṇa samā jā vedāhaṃ tad yan nāv eṣā samā jā
children.translated_text: Our kinship is equal, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, and our birth is equal; I know that this birth of ours is equal.

children.text: dadāmi tad yat te adatto asmi yujyas te saptapadaḥ sakhāsmi ||
children.translated_text: I give what I have not given you; I am your yokefellow, your seven-stepped friend.

children.text: devo devāya gṛṇate vayodhā vipro viprāya stuvate sumedhāḥ
children.translated_text: The god, giver of life, sings to the god; the inspired sage of good understanding praises the inspired sage.

children.text: ajījano hi varuṇa svadhāvann atharvāṇaṃ pitaraṃ devabandhum
children.translated_text: For, O self-powered <s>Varuṇa</s>, you generated father <s>Atharvan</s>, bound to the gods.

children.text: tasmā u rādhaḥ kṛṇuhi supraśastaṃ sakhā no asi paramaṃ ca bandhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore make splendid bounty for him; you are our friend and highest kinsman.

children.text: Chapter 154
samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devān yajasi jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: Kindled today in the dwelling of man, O god <s>Jātavedas</s>, you sacrifice to the gods.

children.text: ā ca vaha mitramahaś cikitvān tvaṃ dūtaḥ kavir asi pracetāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring them here, O knowing one of <s>Mitra</s>-like greatness; you are the messenger, the poet, the far-seeing one.

children.text: tanūnapāt patha ṛtasya yānān madhvā samañjant svadayā sujihva
children.translated_text: O <s>Tanūnapāt</s>, traveling the paths of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), anointing them with honey, pleasing them, good-tongued one,

children.text: manmāni dhībhir uta yajñam ṛndhan devatrā ca kṛṇuhy adhvaram naḥ ||
children.translated_text: strengthening our thoughts with insights and the sacrifice, make our rite reach the gods.

children.text: ājuhvāna īḍyo vandyaś cā yāhy agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Being invoked, praiseworthy and worthy of homage, come here, O <s>Agni</s>, together with the <s>Vasus</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ devānām asi yahva hotā sa enān yakṣīṣito yajīyān ||
children.translated_text: You are the mighty hotṛ of the gods; urged on, sacrifice to them, the best sacrificer.

children.text: prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastor asyā vṛjyate agre ahnām
children.translated_text: The forward-stretched barhis is spread out in the direction of the earth, at the front of this dwelling, before the days.

children.text: vy u prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam ||
children.translated_text: It spreads out more widely, broader and more spacious, pleasant for the gods and for <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: vyacasvatīr urviyā vi śrayantāṃ patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ
children.translated_text: Let the spacious ones spread out broadly, adorning themselves like wives for their husbands.

children.text: devīr dvāro bṛhatīr viśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Divine doors, lofty and all-impelling, be easy passages for the gods.

children.text: ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau
children.translated_text: At the near sacrifice, bringing good impulse, let <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Naktā</s> sit down in their womb.

children.text: divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne ||
children.translated_text: The two heavenly women, lofty and fair with golden ornaments, bearing bright, shining beauty.

children.text: daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai
children.translated_text: Let the two divine hotṛs, first and fair-spoken, fashion the sacrifice so that man may sacrifice.

children.text: pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā ||
children.translated_text: Urging the poets in the assemblies, directing the ancient light through the quarter of the earth.

children.text: ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyam etv iḍā manuṣvad iha cetayantī
children.translated_text: Let <s>Bhāratī</s> come quickly to our sacrifice, and <s>Iḍā</s>, mindful here in human fashion.

children.text: tisro devīr barhir edaṃ syonaṃ sarasvatīḥ svapasaḥ sadantām ||
children.translated_text: Let the three goddesses, <s>Sarasvatī</s> and the skillful ones, sit upon this pleasant barhis.

children.text: ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpair apiṃśad bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: He who adorned these two mothers, heaven and earth, and all beings with forms,

children.text: tam adya hotar iṣito yajīyān devaṃ tvaṣṭāram iha yakṣi vidvān ||
children.translated_text: today, O hotṛ, urged on and best in sacrifice, knowingly worship that god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> here.

children.text: upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjan devānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi
children.translated_text: Release them near, anointing them by your own power: the gods' draughts and oblations in due season.

children.text: vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena ||
children.translated_text: Let the forest-lord, the immolator, and the god <s>Agni</s> enjoy the oblation with honey and ghee.

children.text: sadyo jāto vy amimīta yajñam agnir devānām abhavat purogāḥ
children.translated_text: Straightway, newly born, <s>Agni</s> measured out the sacrifice; he became the forerunner of the gods.

children.text: asya hotuḥ praśiṣy ṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtaṃ havir adantu devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the instruction of this <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), in the speech of truth, let the gods eat the oblation made with <s>svāhā</s>.

children.text: Chapter 155
dadir hi mahyaṃ varuṇo divaḥ kavir vacobhir ugrair ni riṇāmi te viṣam
children.translated_text: For <s>Varuṇa</s>, the poet of heaven, has given to me; with fierce words I drive down your poison.

children.text: khātam akhātam uta saktam agrabham ireva dhanvan ni jajāsa te viṣam ||
children.translated_text: What was dug, undug, or clinging fast, I have seized; like a rift in a waste, your poison has sunk down.

children.text: yat te apodakaṃ viṣaṃ tat ta etāsv agrabham
children.translated_text: Whatever waterless poison of yours there is, that I have seized here in these.

children.text: gṛhṇāmi te madhyamam uttamaṃ rasam utāvamam bhiyasā neśad ād u te ||
children.translated_text: I seize your middle, highest, and lowest sap; out of fear it shall perish from you.

children.text: vṛṣā me ravo nabhasā na tanyatur ugreṇa te vacasā bādha ād u te
children.translated_text: My cry is a bull, like thunder in the cloud; with a fierce utterance I drive it away from you.

children.text: ahaṃ tam asya nṛbhir agrabham rasaṃ tamasa iva jyotir ud etu sūryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I have seized that sap of his with men; as light from darkness, let the sun rise up.

children.text: cakṣuṣā te cakṣur hanmi viṣeṇa hanmi te viṣam
children.translated_text: With my eye I strike your eye; with poison I strike your poison.

children.text: ahe mriyasva mā jīvīḥ pratyag abhy etu tvā viṣam ||
children.translated_text: O serpent, die; do not live. Let the poison turn back and come against you.

children.text: kairāta pṛśna upatṛṇya babhra ā me śṛṇutāsitā alīkāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Kairāta</s>, speckled one, grass-burrower, brown one, listen to me; O black ones, O deceitful ones.

children.text: mā me sakhyuḥ stāmānam api ṣṭhātāśrāvayanto ni viṣe ramadhvam ||
children.translated_text: Do not stand upon my friend's firm place; unheard, settle down in the poison.

children.text: asitasya taimātasya babhror apodakasya ca
children.translated_text: Of <s>Asita</s>, of <s>Taimāta</s>, of <s>Babhru</s>, and of <s>Apodaka</s>,

children.text: sātrāsāhasyāhaṃ manyor ava jyām iva dhanvano vi muñcāmi rathāṁ iva ||
children.translated_text: I unstring the wrath of the overpowering one as the bowstring from a bow, as one releases chariots.

children.text: āligī ca viligī ca pitā ca mātā ca
children.translated_text: <s>Āligī</s> and <s>Viligī</s>, father and mother too,

children.text: vidma vaḥ sarvato bandhv arasāḥ kiṃ kariṣyatha ||
children.translated_text: we know your kinship on every side; sapless ones, what will you do?

children.text: urugūlāyā duhitā jātā dāsy asiknyā
children.translated_text: The daughter of <s>Urugūlā</s>, born from the dark slave-woman,

children.text: prataṅkaṃ dadruṣīṇāṃ sarvāsām arasam viṣam ||
children.translated_text: has made the poison of all the scabby ones, of <s>Prataṅka</s>, sapless.

children.text: karṇā śvāvit tad abravīd girer avacarantikā
children.translated_text: The long-eared porcupine said this while descending from the mountain:

children.text: yāḥ kāś cemāḥ khanitrimās tāsām arasatamaṃ viṣam ||
children.translated_text: Whatever dug-up things these are, their poison is the most sapless of all.

children.text: tābuvaṃ na tābuvaṃ na ghet tvam asi tābuvam
children.translated_text: It is not <s>Tābuva</s>, not <s>Tābuva</s>; indeed, you are <s>Tābuva</s>.

children.text: tābuvenārasaṃ viṣam ||
children.translated_text: By <s>Tābuva</s> the poison is sapless.

children.text: tastuvaṃ na tastuvaṃ na ghet tvam asi tastuvam
children.translated_text: It is not <s>Tastuva</s>, not <s>Tastuva</s>; indeed, you are <s>Tastuva</s>.

children.text: tastuvenārasaṃ viṣam ||
children.translated_text: By <s>Tastuva</s> the poison is sapless.

children.text: Chapter 156
suparṇas tvānv avindat sūkaras tvākhanan nasā
children.translated_text: A fair-winged bird found you; a boar dug you up with its snout.

children.text: dipsauṣadhe tvaṃ dipsantam ava kṛtyākṛtaṃ jahi ||
children.translated_text: O harming herb, strike down the one who seeks to harm; strike down the maker of <s>kṛtyā</s> (hostile sorcery).

children.text: ava jahi yātudhānān ava kṛtyākṛtaṃ jahi
children.translated_text: Strike down the <s>yātudhānas</s> (sorcerous beings); strike down the maker of <s>kṛtyā</s>.

children.text: atho yo asmān dipsati tam u tvaṃ jahy oṣadhe ||
children.translated_text: And whoever seeks to harm us, strike him down too, O herb.

children.text: riśyasyeva parīśāsaṃ parikṛtya pari tvacaḥ
children.translated_text: Having cut around, as one cuts the binding of a deer, around from the skin,

children.text: kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte devā niṣkam iva prati muñcata ||
children.translated_text: O gods, fasten the <s>kṛtyā</s> upon the maker of the <s>kṛtyā</s>, like a <s>niṣka</s> (neck ornament).

children.text: punaḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte hastagṛhya parā ṇaya
children.translated_text: Take the <s>kṛtyā</s> back again to the maker of the <s>kṛtyā</s>, leading her by the hand.

children.text: samakṣam asmā ā dhehi yathā kṛtyākṛtam hanat ||
children.translated_text: Set her before him face to face, so that she may strike the maker of the <s>kṛtyā</s>.

children.text: kṛtyāḥ santu kṛtyākṛte śapathaḥ śapathīyate
children.translated_text: Let the <s>kṛtyās</s> belong to the maker of the <s>kṛtyā</s>; let the curse belong to the one who curses.

children.text: sukho ratha iva vartatāṃ kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like an easy-running chariot, let the <s>kṛtyā</s> roll back again to the maker of the <s>kṛtyā</s>.

children.text: yadi strī yadi vā pumān kṛtyāṃ cakāra pāpmane
children.translated_text: If a woman or a man made the <s>kṛtyā</s> for evil,

children.text: tām u tasmai nayāmasy aśvam ivāśvābhidhānyā ||
children.translated_text: we lead it to that very one as one leads a horse by a horse-bridle.

children.text: yadi vāsi devakṛtā yadi vā puruṣaiḥ kṛtā
children.translated_text: Whether you are made by a god or made by human beings,

children.text: tāṃ tvā punar ṇayāmasīndreṇa sayujā vayam ||
children.translated_text: we lead you back again, joined together with <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: agne pṛtanāṣāṭ pṛtanāḥ sahasva
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, conqueror of battle-lines, overcome the battle-lines.

children.text: punaḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte pratiharaṇena harāmasi ||
children.translated_text: With the act of returning, we carry the <s>kṛtyā</s> back to the maker of the <s>kṛtyā</s>.

children.text: kṛtavyadhani vidhya taṃ yaś cakāra tam ij jahi
children.translated_text: O piercer of what has been made, pierce the one who made it; strike that very one down.

children.text: na tvām acakruṣe vayaṃ vadhāya saṃ śiśīmahi ||
children.translated_text: We do not sharpen you for slaughter against one who did not make you.

children.text: putra iva pitaraṃ gaccha svaja ivābhiṣṭhito daśa
children.translated_text: Go like a son to his father, like a kinsman who has come near,

children.text: bandham ivāvakrāmī gaccha kṛtye kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like a bond that slips down; go, O <s>kṛtyā</s>, back again to the maker of the <s>kṛtyā</s>.

children.text: ud eṇīva vāraṇy abhiskandaṃ mṛgīva
children.translated_text: Like a doe leaping up from the wilderness, like a deer springing over,

children.text: kṛtyā kartāram ṛcchatu ||
children.translated_text: let the <s>kṛtyā</s> reach the doer.

children.text: iṣvā ṛjīyaḥ patatu dyāvāpṛthivī taṃ prati
children.translated_text: Let the arrow fly straighter toward him; let heaven and earth be against him.

children.text: sā taṃ mṛgam iva gṛhṇātu kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let that <s>kṛtyā</s> seize him like a wild beast, back again to the maker of the <s>kṛtyā</s>.

children.text: agnir ivaitu pratikūlam anukūlam ivodakam
children.translated_text: Let it go against him like fire, with the flow like water.

children.text: sukho ratha iva vartatāṃ kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like an easy-running chariot, let the <s>kṛtyā</s> roll back again to the maker of the <s>kṛtyā</s>.

children.text: Chapter 157
ekā ca me daśa ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: One and ten are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: dve ca me viṃśatiś ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: Two and twenty are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: tisraś ca me triṃśac ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: Three and thirty are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: catasraś ca me catvāriṃśac ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: Four and forty are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: pañca ca me pañcāśac ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: Five and fifty are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: ṣaṭ ca me ṣaṣṭiś ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: Six and sixty are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: sapta ca me saptatiś ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: Seven and seventy are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: aṣṭa ca me 'śītiś ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: Eight and eighty are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: nava ca me navatiś ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: Nine and ninety are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: daśa ca me śataṃ ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: Ten and a hundred are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: śataṃ ca me sahasraṃ cāpavaktāra oṣadhe
children.translated_text: A hundred and a thousand are my averters, O herb.

children.text: ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Truth-born, truth-bearing one, make sweetness, make honeyed sweetness for me.

children.text: Chapter 158
yady ekavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are one-bulled, release it; you are sapless.

children.text: yadi dvivṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are two-bulled, release it; you are sapless.

children.text: yadi trivṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are three-bulled, release it; you are sapless.

children.text: yadi caturvṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are four-bulled, release it; you are sapless.

children.text: yadi pañcavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are five-bulled, release it; you are sapless.

children.text: yadi ṣaḍvṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are six years old, you are one whose fluid is released.

children.text: yadi saptavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are seven years old, you are one whose fluid is released.

children.text: yady aṣṭavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are eight years old, you are one whose fluid is released.

children.text: yadi navavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are nine years old, you are one whose fluid is released.

children.text: yadi daśavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are ten years old, you are one whose fluid is released.

children.text: yady ekādaśo 'si so 'podako 'si ||
children.translated_text: If you are eleven years old, you are without water.

children.text: Chapter 159
te 'vadan prathamā brahmakilbiṣe 'kūpāraḥ salilo mātariśvā
children.translated_text: They spoke first in connection with guilt against sacred power: <s>Kūpāra</s>, <s>Salila</s>, and <s>Mātariśvan</s>.

children.text: vīḍuharās tapa ugraṃ mayobhūr āpo devīḥ prathamajā ṛtasya ||
children.translated_text: The removers of obstruction, fierce heat, the bringer of happiness, the divine waters, were first-born of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: somo rājā prathamo brahmajāyāṃ punaḥ prāyacchad ahṛṇīyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: King <s>Soma</s> was the first to give back the <s>brahmajāyā</s> (wife of the Brahmin), without being angered.

children.text: anvartitā varuṇo mitra āsīd agnir hotā hastagṛhyā nināya ||
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s> were followers; <s>Agni</s>, the hotṛ, led her by the hand.

children.text: hastenaiva grāhya ādhir asyā brahmajāyeti ced avocat
children.translated_text: The pledge concerning her is to be taken by the hand, if one says, "She is the <s>brahmajāyā</s>."

children.text: na dūtāya praheyā tastha eṣā tathā rāṣṭraṃ gupitaṃ kṣatriyasya ||
children.translated_text: She is not to be sent away to a messenger; in that way the kingdom of the kṣatriya stands protected.

children.text: yām āhus tārakaiṣā vikeśīti ducchunāṃ grāmam avapadyamānām
children.translated_text: Her whom they call <s>Tārakā</s>, this disheveled one, falling into a village of ill omens,

children.text: sā brahmajāyā vi dunoti rāṣṭraṃ yatra prāpādi śaśa ulkuṣīmān ||
children.translated_text: that <s>brahmajāyā</s> shakes apart the kingdom where a hare marked with sores has entered.

children.text: brahmacārī carati veviṣad viṣaḥ sa devānāṃ bhavaty ekam aṅgam
children.translated_text: The brahmacārin goes about, entering the clans; he becomes a single limb of the gods.

children.text: tena jāyām anv avindad bṛhaspatiḥ somena nītāṃ juhvaṃ na devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Through him <s>Bṛhaspati</s> found the wife led away by <s>Soma</s>, as the gods found the offering-ladle.

children.text: devā vā etasyām avadanta pūrve saptaṛṣayas tapasā ye niṣeduḥ
children.translated_text: The former gods spoke about her, and the seven seers who sat down through austerity:

children.text: bhīmā jāyā brāhmaṇasyāpanītā durdhāṃ dadhāti parame vyoman ||
children.translated_text: "Fearsome is the wife of a Brahmin when she has been carried off; she sets a hard-to-bear thing in the highest heaven."

children.text: ye garbhā avapadyante jagad yac cāpalupyate
children.translated_text: The embryos that miscarry, and whatever living thing is torn away,

children.text: vīrā ye tṛhyante mitho brahmajāyā hinasti tān ||
children.translated_text: the heroes who slaughter one another: the <s>brahmajāyā</s> injures them.

children.text: uta yat patayo daśa striyāḥ pūrve abrāhmaṇāḥ
children.translated_text: And even if a woman previously had ten husbands who were not Brahmins,

children.text: brahmā ceddhastam agrahīt sa eva patir ekadhā ||
children.translated_text: if a Brahmin has taken her hand, he alone is the husband, singly.

children.text: brāhmaṇa eva patir na rājanyo na vaiśyaḥ
children.translated_text: The Brahmin alone is the husband, not the royal man and not the Vaiśya.

children.text: tat sūryaḥ prabruvann eti pañcabhyo mānavebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Proclaiming this, the Sun goes to the five human peoples.

children.text: punar vai devā adaduḥ punar manuṣyā adaduḥ
children.translated_text: Again the gods gave her back; again human beings gave her back.

children.text: rājānaḥ satyaṃ gṛhṇānā brahmajāyāṃ punar daduḥ ||
children.translated_text: Kings, taking hold of truth, gave the <s>brahmajāyā</s> back again.

children.text: punardāya brahmajāyāṃ kṛtvā devair nikilbiṣam
children.translated_text: Having given back the <s>brahmajāyā</s>, having made themselves free from guilt together with the gods,

children.text: ūrjaṃ pṛthivyā bhaktvorugāyam upāsate ||
children.translated_text: having shared in the nourishment of the earth, they worship <s>Urugāya</s>.

children.text: nāsya jāyā śatavāhī kalyāṇī talpam ā śaye
children.translated_text: His auspicious wife, rich in a hundred supports, does not lie upon the bed

children.text: yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||
children.translated_text: in the kingdom where the <s>brahmajāyā</s> is detained through ignorance.

children.text: na vikarṇaḥ pṛthuśirās tasmin veśmani jāyate
children.translated_text: No split-eared, broad-headed child is born in that house

children.text: yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||
children.translated_text: in the kingdom where the <s>brahmajāyā</s> is detained through ignorance.

children.text: nāsya kṣattā niṣkagrīvaḥ sūnānām ety agrataḥ
children.translated_text: His chamberlain, with a gold ornament at his neck, does not go at the head of his sons

children.text: yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||
children.translated_text: in the kingdom where the <s>brahmajāyā</s> is detained through ignorance.

children.text: nāsya śvetaḥ kṛṣṇakarṇo dhuri yukto mahīyate
children.translated_text: His white animal with black ears, yoked at the pole, is not honored

children.text: yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||
children.translated_text: in the kingdom where the <s>brahmajāyā</s> is detained through ignorance.

children.text: nāsya kṣetre puṣkariṇī nāṇḍīkaṃ jāyate bisam
children.translated_text: In his field no lotus-pond appears, nor does a reed-rhizome grow

children.text: yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||
children.translated_text: in the kingdom where the <s>brahmajāyā</s> is detained through ignorance.

children.text: nāsmai pṛśniṃ vi duhanti ye 'syā doham upāsate
children.translated_text: They do not milk the speckled cow for him, those who wait upon her milking,

children.text: yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||
children.translated_text: in the kingdom where the <s>brahmajāyā</s> is detained through ignorance.

children.text: nāsya dhenuḥ kalyāṇī nānaḍvānt sahate dhuram
children.translated_text: His fine cow does not prosper, nor does his ox endure the yoke,

children.text: vijānir yatra brāhmaṇo rātriṃ vasati pāpayā ||
children.translated_text: where a Brahmin, deprived of his wife, spends the night with evil.

children.text: Chapter 160
naitāṃ te devā adadus tubhyaṃ nṛpate attave
children.translated_text: The gods did not give this to you, O lord of men, for you to eat.

children.text: mā brāhmaṇasya rājanya gāṃ jighatso anādyām ||
children.translated_text: Do not, O royal man, wish to eat the Brahmin's cow, which must not be eaten.

children.text: akṣadrugdho rājanyaḥ pāpa ātmaparājitaḥ
children.translated_text: The royal man, injured at play, sinful, defeated by himself,

children.text: sa brāhmaṇasya gām adyād adya jīvāni mā śvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: would eat the Brahmin's cow, thinking, "Let me live today, not tomorrow."

children.text: āviṣṭitāghaviṣā pṛdākūr iva carmaṇā
children.translated_text: Filled with the poison of sin, like a snake with its skin,

children.text: sā brāhmaṇasya rājanya tṛṣṭaiṣā gaur anādyā ||
children.translated_text: that cow of the Brahmin, O royal man, is sharp; this cow is not to be eaten.

children.text: nir vai kṣatraṃ nayati hanti varco 'gnir ivārabdho vi dunoti sarvam
children.translated_text: It surely leads royal power away; it kills splendor. Like fire when kindled, it shakes everything apart.

children.text: yo brāhmaṇaṃ manyate annam eva sa viṣasya pibati taimātasya ||
children.translated_text: Whoever regards a Brahmin as mere food drinks the poison of <s>Taimāta</s>.

children.text: ya enaṃ hanti mṛduṃ manyamāno devapīyur dhanakāmo na cittāt
children.translated_text: He who kills him, thinking him soft, a god-reviler seeking wealth, not in his right mind,

children.text: saṃ tasyendro hṛdaye 'gnim inddhe ubhe enaṃ dviṣṭo nabhasī carantam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> kindles fire in that man's heart; both heavenly spaces hate him as he moves through the midspace.

children.text: na brāhmaṇo hiṃsitavyo 'gniḥ priyatanor iva
children.translated_text: A Brahmin must not be harmed; he is like fire for one dear in body.

children.text: somo hy asya dāyāda indro asyābhiśastipāḥ ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Soma</s> is his heir, and <s>Indra</s> is the protector against his curse.

children.text: śatāpāṣṭhāṃ ni girati tāṃ na śaknoti niḥkhidam
children.translated_text: He swallows a hundred-hooked thing; he cannot pull it out,

children.text: annaṃ yo brahmaṇām malvaḥ svādv admīti manyate ||
children.translated_text: the fool who thinks, "I am eating sweet food," when it is the food of Brahmins.

children.text: jihvā jyā bhavati kulmalaṃ vāṅ nāḍīkā dantās tapasābhidigdhāḥ
children.translated_text: Their tongue becomes the bowstring, speech the bow-cord, the channels the teeth, smeared with austerity.

children.text: tebhir brahmā vidhyati devapīyūn hṛdbalair dhanurbhir devajūtaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With these the Brahmin pierces the god-revilers, with heart-strong bows driven by the gods.

children.text: tīkṣṇeṣavo brāhmaṇā hetimanto yām asyanti śaravyāṃ na sā mṛṣā
children.translated_text: Brahmins have sharp arrows and weapons; the missile that they shoot is not false.

children.text: anuhāya tapasā manyunā cota dūrād ava bhindanty enam ||
children.translated_text: Pursuing him with austerity and anger, they split him open even from afar.

children.text: ye sahasram arājann āsan daśaśatā uta
children.translated_text: Those who were a thousand, O king, and also ten hundreds,

children.text: te brāhmaṇasya gāṃ jagdhvā vaitahavyāḥ parābhavan ||
children.translated_text: those <s>Vaitahavyas</s>, after eating the Brahmin's cow, went to ruin.

children.text: gaur eva tān hanyamānā vaitahavyāṁ avātirat
children.translated_text: The cow herself, while being harmed, swept those <s>Vaitahavyas</s> away,

children.text: ye kesaraprābandhāyāś caramājām apeciran ||
children.translated_text: who cut off the last she-goat of <s>Kesaraprābandhā</s>.

children.text: ekaśataṃ tā janatā yā bhūmir vyadhūnuta
children.translated_text: Those people were one hundred and one whom the earth shook off.

children.text: prajāṃ hiṃsitvā brāhmaṇīm asaṃbhavyaṃ parābhavan ||
children.translated_text: Having harmed Brahmin offspring, they perished beyond recovery.

children.text: devapīyuś carati martyeṣu garagīrṇo bhavaty asthibhūyān
children.translated_text: A god-reviler goes about among mortals; having swallowed poison, he becomes mostly bone,

children.text: yo brāhmaṇaṃ devabandhuṃ hinasti na sa pitṛyāṇam apy eti lokam ||
children.translated_text: he who harms a Brahmin, the kinsman of the gods; he does not reach even the world on the path of the fathers.

children.text: agnir vai naḥ padavāyaḥ somo dāyāda ucyate
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is indeed our tracker; <s>Soma</s> is called the heir.

children.text: hantābhiśastendras tathā tad vedhaso viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is the slayer of the accursed killer; so the makers know this.

children.text: iṣur iva digdhā nṛpate pṛdākūr iva gopate
children.translated_text: Like a poisoned arrow, O lord of men, like a snake, O protector of cows,

children.text: sā brāhmaṇasyeṣur ghorā tayā vidhyati pīyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: that terrible arrow belongs to the Brahmin; with it he pierces the malicious one.

children.text: Chapter 161
atimātram avardhanta nod iva divam aspṛśan
children.translated_text: They grew beyond measure; like reeds they touched the sky.

children.text: bhṛguṃ hiṃsitvā sṛñjayā vaitahavyāḥ parābhavan ||
children.translated_text: Having harmed <s>Bhṛgu</s>, the <s>Sṛñjayas</s>, the <s>Vaitahavyas</s>, were defeated.

children.text: ye bṛhatsāmānam āṅgirasam ārpayan brāhmaṇaṃ janāḥ
children.translated_text: Those people who delivered up the Brahmin <s>Bṛhatsāman Āṅgirasa</s>,

children.text: petvas teṣām ubhayādam avis tokāny āvayat ||
children.translated_text: a sheep that devoured on both sides attacked their offspring.

children.text: ye brāhmaṇaṃ pratyaṣṭhīvan ye vāsmiñchulkam īṣire
children.translated_text: Those who spat at a Brahmin, or who sought a price from him,

children.text: asnas te madhye kulyāyāḥ keśān khādanta āsate ||
children.translated_text: sit in the middle of a channel, eating hair in blood.

children.text: brahmagavī pacyamānā yāvat sābhi vijaṅgahe
children.translated_text: As long as the <s>brahmagavī</s> (Brahmin's cow) is being cooked and moves about against them,

children.text: tejo rāṣṭrasya nir hanti na vīro jāyate vṛṣā ||
children.translated_text: she drives the splendor out of the kingdom; no vigorous hero is born.

children.text: krūram asyā āśasanaṃ tṛṣṭaṃ piśitam asyate
children.translated_text: Cruel is the slaughtering of her; her carved flesh is eaten.

children.text: kṣīraṃ yad asyāḥ pīyate tad vai pitṛṣu kilbiṣam ||
children.translated_text: When her milk is drunk, that indeed is guilt against the Fathers.

children.text: ugro rājā manyamāno brāhmaṇaṃ yo jighatsati
children.translated_text: The fierce king, thinking himself mighty, who wants to devour a Brahmin,

children.text: parā tat sicyate rāṣṭraṃ brāhmaṇo yatra jīyate ||
children.translated_text: that kingdom is poured away, where a Brahmin is overpowered.

children.text: aṣṭāpadī caturakṣī catuḥśrotrā caturhanuḥ
children.translated_text: Eight-footed, four-eyed, four-eared, four-jawed,

children.text: dvyāsyā dvijihvā bhūtvā sā rāṣṭram ava dhūnute brahmajyasya ||
children.translated_text: two-mouthed and two-tongued, she becomes so and shakes down the kingdom of the <s>brahmajya</s> (Brahmin-oppressor).

children.text: tad vai rāṣṭram ā sravati nāvaṃ bhinnām ivodakam
children.translated_text: That kingdom leaks away like water into a broken boat.

children.text: brahmāṇaṃ yatra hiṃsanti tad rāṣṭraṃ hanti ducchunā ||
children.translated_text: Where they injure a Brahmin, that kingdom is struck by misfortune.

children.text: taṃ vṛkṣā apa sedhanti chāyāṃ no mopa gā iti
children.translated_text: The trees drive him away, saying, 'Do not come to our shade,'

children.text: yo brāhmaṇasya sad dhanam abhi nārada manyate ||
children.translated_text: the man who covets a Brahmin's good property, O <s>Nārada</s>.

children.text: viṣam etad devakṛtaṃ rājā varuṇo 'bravīt
children.translated_text: 'This is poison made by the gods,' king <s>Varuṇa</s> said:

children.text: na brāhmaṇasya gāṃ jagdhvā rāṣṭre jāgāra kaścana ||
children.translated_text: 'No one, after eating a Brahmin's cow, has kept watch in his kingdom.'

children.text: navaiva tā navatayo yā bhūmir vyadhūnuta
children.translated_text: Those nineties, nine times over, which the earth shook off,

children.text: prajāṃ hiṃsitvā brāhmaṇīm asaṃbhavyaṃ parābhavan ||
children.translated_text: having harmed Brahmin offspring, they were defeated in an impossible way.

children.text: yām mṛtāyānubadhnanti kūdyaṃ padayopanīm
children.translated_text: The covering which they fasten onto a dead man, the mat brought up with the foot,

children.text: tad vai brahmajya te devā upastaraṇam abruvan ||
children.translated_text: that, O <s>brahmajya</s> (Brahmin-oppressor), the gods called your under-bedding.

children.text: aśrūṇi kṛpamānasya yāni jītasya vāvṛtuḥ
children.translated_text: The tears that flowed from the lamenting, defeated man,

children.text: taṃ vai brahmajya te devā apāṃ bhāgam adhārayan ||
children.translated_text: that, O <s>brahmajya</s> (Brahmin-oppressor), the gods assigned as your share of the waters.

children.text: yena mṛtaṃ snapayanti śmaśrūṇi yenondate
children.translated_text: That with which they bathe the dead, that with which they moisten the beard,

children.text: taṃ vai brahmajya te devā apāṃ bhāgam adhārayan ||
children.translated_text: that, O <s>brahmajya</s> (Brahmin-oppressor), the gods assigned as your share of the waters.

children.text: na varṣaṃ maitrāvaruṇaṃ brahmajyam abhi varṣati
children.translated_text: The rain of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> does not rain upon the <s>brahmajya</s> (Brahmin-oppressor).

children.text: nāsmai samitiḥ kalpate na mitraṃ nayate vaśam ||
children.translated_text: The assembly does not suit him, nor does he bring a friend under his control.

children.text: Chapter 162
uccairghoṣo dundubhiḥ satvanāyan vānaspatyaḥ saṃbhṛta usriyābhiḥ
children.translated_text: The loudly roaring <s>Dundubhi</s> (war drum), going with the warriors, wooden, put together with cowhides,

children.text: vācaṃ kṣuṇuvāno damayant sapatnānt siṃha iva jeṣyann abhi taṃstanīhi ||
children.translated_text: crushing out speech and subduing rivals, thunder against them like a lion about to conquer.

children.text: siṃha ivāstānīd druvayo vibaddho 'bhikrandann ṛṣabho vāsitām iva
children.translated_text: Roar like a lion, firmly bound; bellow like a bull toward a cow in heat.

children.text: vṛṣā tvaṃ vadhrayas te sapatnā aindras te śuṣmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are the bull; your rivals are geldings; your fury is <s>Indra</s>'s, overcoming attacks.

children.text: vṛṣeva yūthe sahasā vidāno gavyann abhi ruva saṃdhanājit
children.translated_text: Like a bull in the herd, discovering by force, desiring cattle, roar toward them, winner of the contest.

children.text: śucā vidhya hṛdayaṃ pareṣāṃ hitvā grāmān pracyutā yantu śatravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Pierce the hearts of the enemies with flame; let the foes abandon their villages and go driven away.

children.text: saṃjayan pṛtanā ūrdhvamāyur gṛhyā gṛhṇāno bahudhā vi cakṣva
children.translated_text: Conquering battles, prolonging life, seizing what is to be seized, look out in many directions.

children.text: daivīṃ vācaṃ dundubha ā gurasva vedhāḥ śatrūṇām upa bharasva vedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Utter divine speech, O <s>Dundubhi</s>; as a wise disposer, bring inspired knowledge against the enemies.

children.text: dundubher vācaṃ prayatāṃ vadantīm āśṛṇvatī nāthitā ghoṣabuddhā
children.translated_text: Hearing the <s>Dundubhi</s>'s speech, uttered with intent, speaking, made known by its roar,

children.text: nārī putraṃ dhāvatu hastagṛhyāmitrī bhītā samare vadhānām ||
children.translated_text: let the enemy woman, afraid in the battle of slayings, run to her son, taking him by the hand.

children.text: pūrvo dundubhe pra vadāsi vācaṃ bhūmyāḥ pṛṣṭhe vada rocamānaḥ
children.translated_text: First, O <s>Dundubhi</s>, you speak forth speech; on the back of the earth, speak, shining.

children.text: amitrasenām abhijañjabhāno dyumad vada dundubhe sūnṛtāvat ||
children.translated_text: Crushing the enemy army, speak brilliantly, O <s>Dundubhi</s>, rich in good utterance.

children.text: antareme nabhasī ghoṣo astu pṛthak te dhvanayo yantu śībham
children.translated_text: Let your roar be between these two worlds; let your sounds go separately and swiftly.

children.text: abhi kranda stanayotpipānaḥ ślokakṛn mitratūryāya svardhī ||
children.translated_text: Cry out; thunder as you rise up, making renown, wise for the overcoming of foes.

children.text: dhībhiḥ kṛtaḥ pra vadāti vācam ud dharṣaya satvanām āyudhāni
children.translated_text: Made by inspired thoughts, it speaks speech; raise up the warriors' weapons.

children.text: indramedī satvano ni hvayasva mitrair amitrāṁ ava jaṅghanīhi ||
children.translated_text: Calling on <s>Indra</s>, summon the warriors; with friends, beat down the enemies.

children.text: saṃkrandanaḥ pravado dhṛṣṇuṣeṇaḥ pravedakṛd bahudhā grāmaghoṣī
children.translated_text: Caller-together, speaker-forth, with bold army, maker of proclamation, sounding through the villages in many ways,

children.text: śriyo vanvano vayunāni vidvān kīrtim bahubhyo vi hara dvirāje ||
children.translated_text: winning splendors, knowing stratagems, carry fame abroad to many, O brightly ruling one.

children.text: śreyaḥketo vasujit sahīyānt saṃgrāmajit saṃśito brahmaṇāsi
children.translated_text: Banner of good fortune, winner of wealth, stronger, battle-winning, sharpened by <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), you are.

children.text: aṃśūn iva grāvādhiṣavaṇe adrir gavyan dundubhe'dhi nṛtya vedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a pressing stone on the pressing board over the Soma stalks, desiring cattle, O <s>Dundubhi</s>, dance over them, O wise one.

children.text: śatrūṣāṇ nīṣād abhimātiṣāho gaveṣaṇaḥ sahamāna udbhit
children.translated_text: Scorcher of foes, beater-down, overcomer of attacks, seeker of cattle, enduring one, breaker-through,

children.text: vāgvīva mantraṃ pra bharasva vācam sāṃgrāmajityāyeṣam ud vadeha ||
children.translated_text: like a voice bringing forth a mantra, bring forth speech; utter this impulse for victory in battle.

children.text: acyutacyut samado gamiṣṭho mṛdho jetā puraetāyodhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Unfallen, making others fall, exultant, swiftest in going, winner of battles, foremost in war,

children.text: indreṇa gupto vidathā nicikyaddhṛddyotano dviṣatāṃ yāhi śībham ||
children.translated_text: guarded by <s>Indra</s>, discerning the assemblies, kindling the heart, go swiftly against the haters.

children.text: Chapter 163
vihṛdayaṃ vaimanasyaṃ vadāmitreṣu dundubhe
children.translated_text: Speak heartlessness and dejection among the enemies, O <s>Dundubhi</s>.

children.text: vidveṣaṃ kaśmaśaṃ bhayam amitreṣu ni dadhmasy ava enān dundubhe jahi ||
children.translated_text: Hatred, confusion, and fear we set down among the enemies; strike them down, O <s>Dundubhi</s>.

children.text: udvepamānā manasā cakṣuṣā hṛdayena ca
children.translated_text: Trembling in mind, with eye and heart,

children.text: dhāvantu bibhyato 'mitrāḥ pratrāsenājye hute ||
children.translated_text: let the frightened enemies run in terror when the ghee has been offered.

children.text: vānaspatyaḥ saṃbhṛta usriyābhir viśvagotryaḥ
children.translated_text: Wooden, put together with cowhides, belonging to all clans,

children.text: pratrāsam amitrebhyo vadājyenābhighāritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: speak terror to the enemies, after being sprinkled with ghee.

children.text: yathā mṛgāḥ saṃvijanta āraṇyāḥ puruṣād adhi
children.translated_text: As forest animals tremble before a man,

children.text: eva tvaṃ dundubhe 'mitrān abhi kranda pra trāsayātho cittāni mohaya ||
children.translated_text: so, O <s>Dundubhi</s>, cry out against the enemies, terrify them, and bewilder their minds.

children.text: yathā vṛkād ajāvayo dhāvanti bahu bibhyatīḥ
children.translated_text: As goats and sheep run from a wolf, very much afraid,

children.text: eva tvaṃ dundubhe 'mitrān abhi kranda pra trāsayātho cittāni mohaya ||
children.translated_text: so, O <s>Dundubhi</s>, cry out against the enemies, terrify them, and bewilder their minds.

children.text: yathā śyenāt patatriṇaḥ saṃvijante ahardivi siṃhasya stanathor yathā
children.translated_text: As birds tremble before a falcon in broad day, as at the roar of a lion,

children.text: eva tvaṃ dundubhe 'mitrān abhi kranda pra trāsayātho cittāni mohaya ||
children.translated_text: So do you, O kettledrum, cry out against the enemies; frighten them, and then bewilder their minds.

children.text: parāmitrān dundubhinā hariṇasyājinena ca
children.translated_text: With the kettledrum and with the hide of the antelope, drive the enemies away;

children.text: sarve devā atitrasan ye saṃgrāmasyeṣate ||
children.translated_text: all the gods who have power over battle have terrified them.

children.text: yair indraḥ prakrīḍate padghoṣaiś chāyayā saha
children.translated_text: With those foot-noises with which <s>Indra</s> plays, together with his shadow,

children.text: tair amitrās trasantu no 'mī ye yanty anīkaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let those enemies of ours tremble, those who come troop by troop against the battle-front.

children.text: jyāghoṣā dundubhayo 'bhi krośantu yā diśaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the twanging of bowstrings and the kettledrums shout toward the quarters,

children.text: senāḥ parājitā yatīr amitrāṇām anīkaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as the defeated armies of the enemies go away, front by front.

children.text: āditya cakṣur ā datsva marīcayo 'nu dhāvata
children.translated_text: O <s>Āditya</s>, take up sight; O rays, run after them;

children.text: patsaṅginīr ā sajantu vigate bāhuvīrye ||
children.translated_text: let foot-snares fasten on them when their arm-strength has departed.

children.text: yūyam ugrā marutaḥ pṛśnimātara indreṇa yujā pra mṛṇīta śatrūn
children.translated_text: You fierce <s>Maruts</s>, sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>, with <s>Indra</s> as your ally, crush the enemies;

children.text: somo rājā varuṇo rājā mahādeva uta mṛtyur indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: so too <s>Soma</s> the king, <s>Varuṇa</s> the king, <s>Mahādeva</s>, <s>Mṛtyu</s>, and <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: etā devasenāḥ sūryaketavaḥ sacetasaḥ
children.translated_text: May these divine armies, whose banner is the sun and whose minds are united,

children.text: amitrān no jayantu svāhā ||
children.translated_text: conquer our enemies for us. Svāhā.

children.text: Chapter 164
agnis takmānam apa bādhatām itaḥ somo grāvā varuṇaḥ pūtadakṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s> drive <s>takman</s> (fever) away from here; let <s>Soma</s>, the pressing-stone, and <s>Varuṇa</s> of purified skill do so;

children.text: vedir barhiḥ samidhaḥ śośucānā apa dveṣāṃsy amuyā bhavantu ||
children.translated_text: let the altar, the <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass), and the blazing kindling-sticks turn hatreds away from that man.

children.text: ayaṃ yo viśvān haritān kṛṇoṣy ucchocayann agnir ivābhidunvan
children.translated_text: This one, O <s>takman</s>, who makes all people yellow, scorching them and shaking them like fire,

children.text: adhā hi takmann araso hi bhūyā adhā nyaṅṅ adharān vā parehi ||
children.translated_text: then indeed, O <s>takman</s>, become sapless; then go downward, lower, or away.

children.text: yaḥ paruṣaḥ pāruṣeyo 'vadhvaṃsa ivāruṇaḥ
children.translated_text: He who is harsh, born of harshness, ruddy like one fallen in ruin,

children.text: takmānaṃ viśvadhāvīryādharāñcaṃ parā suvā ||
children.translated_text: send that <s>takman</s>, with all his force, downward and away.

children.text: adharāñcam pra hiṇomi namaḥ kṛtvā takmane
children.translated_text: I send him downward, having made homage to <s>takman</s>;

children.text: śakambharasya muṣṭihā punar etu mahāvṛṣān ||
children.translated_text: let the fist-striker of <s>Śakambhara</s> return again to the <s>Mahāvṛṣas</s>.

children.text: oko asya mūjavanta oko asya mahāvṛṣāḥ
children.translated_text: His home is among the <s>Mūjavants</s>; his home is among the <s>Mahāvṛṣas</s>;

children.text: yāvaj jātas takmaṃs tāvān asi balhikeṣu nyocaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: as far as you are born, O <s>takman</s>, so far you have moved about among the <s>Balhikas</s>.

children.text: takman vyāla vi gada vyaṅga bhūri yāvaya
children.translated_text: O <s>takman</s>, move away like a snake; disperse; go apart limb by limb; drive far away in abundance.

children.text: dāsīṃ niṣṭakvarīm iccha tām vajreṇa sam arpaya ||
children.translated_text: Seek a shivering slave woman; strike her with the thunderbolt.

children.text: takman mūjavato gaccha balhikān vā parastarām
children.translated_text: O <s>takman</s>, go to the <s>Mūjavants</s>, or beyond to the <s>Balhikas</s>;

children.text: śūdrām iccha prapharvyaṃ tāṃ takman vīva dhūnuhi ||
children.translated_text: seek a <s>Śūdra</s> woman, one bent forward; shake her violently, O <s>takman</s>.

children.text: mahāvṛṣān mūjavato bandhv addhi paretya
children.translated_text: Having gone away, eat your kinsman among the <s>Mahāvṛṣas</s> and the <s>Mūjavants</s>;

children.text: praitāni takmane brūmo anyakṣetrāṇi vā imā ||
children.translated_text: we speak these things to <s>takman</s>; these are other fields for him.

children.text: anyakṣetre na ramase vaśī san mṛḍayāsi naḥ
children.translated_text: You do not delight in another field; being brought under control, show us mercy.

children.text: abhūd u prārthas takmā sa gamiṣyati balhikān ||
children.translated_text: The advance of <s>takman</s> has begun; he will go to the <s>Balhikas</s>.

children.text: yat tvaṃ śīto 'tho rūraḥ saha kāsāvepayaḥ
children.translated_text: When you are cold, and when you are burning, accompanied by cough and trembling,

children.text: bhīmās te takman hetayas tābhiḥ sma pari vṛṅgdhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: terrible are your weapons, O <s>takman</s>; with them, spare us and pass around us.

children.text: mā smaitānt sakhīn kuruthā balāsaṃ kāsam udyugam
children.translated_text: Do not make these your friends: <s>balāsa</s> (consumption), cough, and convulsion;

children.text: mā smāto'rvāṅ aiḥ punas tat tvā takmann upa bruve ||
children.translated_text: do not come back here again from there; this I say to you, O <s>takman</s>.

children.text: takman bhrātrā balāsena svasrā kāsikayā saha
children.translated_text: O <s>takman</s>, with your brother <s>Balāsa</s>, and with your sister Cough,

children.text: pāpmā bhrātṛvyeṇa saha gacchāmum araṇaṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: with <s>Pāpmā</s>, your hostile kinsman, go to that alien people.

children.text: tṛtīyakaṃ vitṛtīyaṃ sadandim uta śāradam
children.translated_text: The third-day fever, the intermittent third-day fever, the continuous one, and the autumnal one,

children.text: takmānaṃ śītaṃ rūraṃ graiṣmaṃ nāśaya vārṣikam ||
children.translated_text: the cold, burning, summer, and rainy-season <s>takman</s>: make them disappear.

children.text: gandhāribhyo mūjavadbhyo 'ṅgebhyo magadhebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: From the <s>Gandhāris</s>, from the <s>Mūjavants</s>, from the <s>Aṅgas</s>, and from the <s>Magadhas</s>,

children.text: praiṣyan janam iva śevadhiṃ takmānaṃ pari dadmasi ||
children.translated_text: as one sends a treasure to a people, we hand <s>takman</s> over.

children.text: Chapter 165
ote me dyāvāpṛthivī otā devī sarasvatī
children.translated_text: May <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, help me; may the goddess <s>Sarasvatī</s> help me;

children.text: otau ma indraś cāgniś ca krimiṃ jambhayatām iti ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> both help me: let them crush the worm.

children.text: asyendra kumārasya krimīn dhanapate jahi
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, lord of wealth, slay the worms of this boy;

children.text: hatā viśvā arātaya ugreṇa vacasā mama ||
children.translated_text: all hostile powers are slain by my fierce utterance.

children.text: yo akṣyau parisarpati yo nāse parisarpati
children.translated_text: The one that crawls around the eyes, the one that crawls around the nose,

children.text: datāṃ yo madhyaṃ gacchati taṃ krimiṃ jambhayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: the one that goes to the middle of the teeth: that worm we crush.

children.text: sarūpau dvau virūpau dvau kṛṣṇau dvau rohitau dvau
children.translated_text: Two alike, two unlike, two black, two red,

children.text: babhruś ca babhrukarṇaś ca gṛdhraḥ kokaś ca te hatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the brown one and the brown-eared one, the vulture and the koka: those are slain.

children.text: ye krimayaḥ śitikakṣā ye kṛṣṇāḥ śitibāhavaḥ
children.translated_text: The worms that are white-flanked, those that are black, those with white forearms,

children.text: ye ke ca viśvarūpās tān krimīn jambhayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: and whatever ones are of every form: those worms we crush.

children.text: ut purastāt sūrya eti viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā
children.translated_text: The sun rises in the east, seen by all, slayer of the unseen,

children.text: dṛṣṭāṃś ca ghnann adṛṣṭāṃś ca sarvāṃś ca pramṛṇan krimīn ||
children.translated_text: killing the seen and the unseen, crushing all the worms.

children.text: yevāṣāsaḥ kaṣkaṣāsa ejatkāḥ śipavitnukāḥ
children.translated_text: The yevāṣas, the kaṣkaṣas, the quivering ones, and the śipavitnukas,

children.text: dṛṣṭaś ca hanyatāṃ krimir utādṛṣṭaś ca hanyatām ||
children.translated_text: let the visible worm be slain, and let the invisible one also be slain.

children.text: hato yevāṣaḥ krimīṇāṃ hato nadanimota
children.translated_text: The yevāṣa among the worms is slain, and the nadanima too is slain;

children.text: sarvān ni maṣmaṣākaraṃ dṛṣadā khalvāṁ iva ||
children.translated_text: I have mashed them all to bits, as with a grinding-stone in a mortar.

children.text: triśīrṣāṇaṃ trikakudaṃ krimiṃ sāraṅgam arjunam
children.translated_text: The three-headed, three-humped worm, the speckled one, the pale one,

children.text: śṛṇāmy asya pṛṣṭīr api vṛścāmi yacchiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: I crush its ribs; I cut off its head.

children.text: atrivad vaḥ krimayo hanmi kaṇvavaj jamadagnivat
children.translated_text: Like <s>Atri</s> I slay you worms, like <s>Kaṇva</s>, like <s>Jamadagni</s>;

children.text: agastyasya brahmaṇā saṃ pinaṣmy ahaṃ krimīn ||
children.translated_text: with the <s>brahman</s> (sacred utterance) of <s>Agastya</s> I thoroughly crush the worms.

children.text: hato rājā krimīṇām utaiṣāṃ sthapatir hataḥ
children.translated_text: Slain is the king of the worms, and slain is their chief;

children.text: hato hatamātā krimir hatabhrātā hatasvasā ||
children.translated_text: slain is the worm whose mother is slain, whose brother is slain, whose sister is slain.

children.text: hatāso asya veśaso hatāsaḥ pariveśasaḥ
children.translated_text: Slain are its neighbors; slain are those around its neighbors;

children.text: atho ye kṣullakā iva sarve te krimayo hatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and those that are like little ones: all those worms are slain.

children.text: sarveṣāṃ ca krimīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ ca krimīnām
children.translated_text: Of all the male worms and of all the female worms,

children.text: bhinadmy aśmanā śiro dahāmy agninā mukham ||
children.translated_text: I split the head with a stone; I burn the mouth with fire.

children.translated_text: May <s>Savitṛ</s>, lord of impellings, protect me

children.translated_text: in this altar-work, in this intention, in this blessing, in this invocation of the gods. Svāhā.

children.text: marutaḥ parvatānām adhipatayas te māvantu

children.translated_text: In this <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), in this rite, in this priestly charge, in this established basis, in this

children.translated_text: <s>Mṛtyu</s>, lord of creatures, may he protect me.

children.translated_text: <s>Yama</s>, lord of the Fathers, may he protect me.

children.translated_text: In this <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), in this rite, in this priestly charge, in this established basis, in this

children.translated_text: thought, in this intention, in this blessing, in this invocation of the gods: <s>svāhā</s>.

children.translated_text: The Fathers who are farther away, may they protect me.

children.translated_text: Then the nearer fathers, may they protect me.

children.text: Chapter 167
parvatād divo yoner aṅgādaṅgāt samābhṛtam
children.translated_text: Brought together from the mountain, from heaven's womb, from limb to limb,

children.text: śepo garbhasya retodhāḥ sarau parṇam ivā dadhat ||
children.translated_text: the male member, seed-holder of the embryo, has set itself down like a leaf upon the shaft.

children.text: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī bhūtānāṃ garbham ādadhe
children.translated_text: Just as this great earth has taken the embryo of beings into herself,

children.text: evā dadhāmi te garbhaṃ tasmai tvām avase huve ||
children.translated_text: so I place an embryo in you; for that I call upon you for help.

children.text: garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati
children.translated_text: Place an embryo, O <s>Sinīvālī</s>; place an embryo, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: garbhaṃ te aśvinobhā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
children.translated_text: May the two <s>Aśvins</s>, lotus-garlanded, place an embryo in you.

children.text: garbhaṃ te mitrāvaruṇau garbham devo bṛhaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> place an embryo in you; may the god <s>Bṛhaspati</s> place an embryo.

children.text: garbhaṃ ta indraś cāgniś ca garbhaṃ dhātā dadhātu te ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> place an embryo in you; may <s>Dhātṛ</s> place an embryo in you.

children.text: viṣṇur yoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu
children.translated_text: May <s>Viṣṇu</s> prepare the womb; may <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> fashion the forms.

children.text: ā siñcatu prajāpatir dhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Prajāpati</s> pour in; may <s>Dhātṛ</s> place an embryo in you.

children.text: yad veda rājā varuṇo yad vā devī sarasvatī
children.translated_text: What king <s>Varuṇa</s> knows, or what the goddess <s>Sarasvatī</s> knows,

children.text: yad indro vṛtrahā veda tad garbhakaraṇaṃ piba ||
children.translated_text: what <s>Indra</s>, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, knows: drink that conception-making power.

children.text: garbho asy oṣadhīnāṃ garbho vanaspatīnām
children.translated_text: He is the embryo of the herbs, the embryo of the forest trees,

children.text: garbho viśvasya bhūtasya so agne garbham eha dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the embryo of every being; O <s>Agni</s>, place that embryo here.

children.text: adhi skanda vīrayasva garbham ā dhehi yonyām
children.translated_text: Mount up; show virility; place the embryo in the womb.

children.text: vṛṣāsi vṛṣṇyāvan prajāyai tvā nayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: You are a bull, rich in bull-like power; we lead you on for offspring.

children.text: vi jihīṣva bārhatsāme garbhas te yonim ā śayām
children.translated_text: Open wide, O one connected with the <s>Bārhatsāman</s>; your embryo has lain down in the womb.

children.text: aduṣ ṭe devāḥ putraṃ somapā ubhayāvinam ||
