children.translated_text: The gods who drink <s>Soma</s> have given you a son, one possessing both powers.

children.text: dhātaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Dhātṛ</s>, with the finest form, in the two loins of this woman,

children.text: pumāṃsaṃ putram ā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||
children.translated_text: place a male son, to be born in the tenth month.

children.text: tvaṣṭaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, with the finest form, in the two loins of this woman,

children.text: pumāṃsaṃ putram ā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||
children.translated_text: place a male son, to be born in the tenth month.

children.text: savitaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Savitṛ</s>, with the finest form, in the two loins of this woman,

children.text: pumāṃsaṃ putram ā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||
children.translated_text: place a male son, to be born in the tenth month.

children.text: prajāpate śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Prajāpati</s>, with the most excellent form, in this woman, in her cow-giving power,

children.text: pumāṃsaṃ putram ā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||
children.translated_text: place a male son, to be born in the tenth month.

children.text: Chapter 168
yajūṃṣi yajñe samidhaḥ svāhāgniḥ pravidvān iha vo yunaktu ||
children.translated_text: The <s>yajus</s> formulas, the kindling-sticks in the sacrifice, svāhā: may <s>Agni</s>, knowing well, yoke you here.

children.text: yunaktu devaḥ savitā prajānann asmin yajñe mahiṣaḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, knowing his creatures, the mighty one, yoke them in this sacrifice: svāhā.

children.text: indra ukthāmadāny asmin yajñe pravidvān yunaktu suyujaḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, gladdened by praises, knowing well in this sacrifice, yoke the well-yoked ones: svāhā.

children.text: praiṣā yajñe nividaḥ svāhā śiṣṭāḥ patnībhir vahateha yuktāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The directions and invocatory formulas in the sacrifice, svāhā; disciplined and yoked here, they carry on together with the wives.

children.text: chandāṃsi yajñe marutaḥ svāhā māteva putraṃ pipṛteha yuktāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The metres in the sacrifice, the <s>Maruts</s>, svāhā; yoked here, they sustain it like a mother her son.

children.text: eyam agan barhiṣā prokṣaṇībhir yajñaṃ tanvānāditiḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Aditi</s> has come with the sacrificial grass and the sprinkling waters, extending the sacrifice: svāhā.

children.text: viṣṇur yunaktu bahudhā tapāṃsy asmin yajñe suyujaḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Viṣṇu</s> yoke the ascetic powers in many ways in this sacrifice, the well-yoked ones: svāhā.

children.text: tvaṣṭā yunaktu bahudhā nu rūpā asmin yajñe yunaktu suyujaḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> yoke the forms in many ways; may he yoke the well-yoked ones in this sacrifice: svāhā.

children.text: bhago yunaktvāśiṣo nv asmā asmin yajñe pravidvān yunaktu suyujaḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Bhaga</s>, knowing well, yoke blessings for this one; may he yoke the well-yoked ones in this sacrifice: svāhā.

children.text: somo yunaktu bahudhā payāṃsy asmin yajñe suyujaḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Soma</s> yoke the draughts of milk in many ways in this sacrifice, the well-yoked ones: svāhā.

children.text: indro yunaktu bahudhā vīryāṇy asmin yajñe suyujaḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> yoke the powers of strength in many ways in this sacrifice, the well-yoked ones: svāhā.

children.text: aśvinā brahmaṇā yātam arvāñcau vaṣaṭkāreṇa yajñaṃ vardhayantau
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, come hither with sacred formulation, increasing the sacrifice with the vaṣaṭ-call.

children.text: bṛhaspate brahmaṇā yāhy arvāṅ yajño ayaṃ svar idaṃ yajamānāya svāhā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, come hither with sacred formulation; this sacrifice, this heavenly light, is for the sacrificer: svāhā.

children.text: Chapter 169
ūrdhvā asya samidho bhavanty ūrdhvā śukrā śocīṃṣy agneḥ
children.translated_text: Upward rise his kindling-sticks; upward are the bright flames of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: dyumattamā supratīkaḥ sasūnus tanūnapād asuro bhūripāṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Most radiant, fair-faced, with offspring, <s>Tanūnapāt</s>, the divine lord, is rich-handed.

children.text: devo deveṣu devaḥ patho anakti madhvā ghṛtena ||
children.translated_text: The god, a god among the gods, anoints the paths with honey and ghee.

children.text: madhvā yajñam nakṣati praiṇāno narāśaṃso agniḥ sukṛd devaḥ savitā viśvavāraḥ ||
children.translated_text: With honey, <s>Agni</s> <s>Narāśaṃsa</s>, praised and advancing, reaches the sacrifice; the skilful god <s>Savitṛ</s> is all-desired.

children.text: acchāyam eti śavasā ghṛtā cid īḍāno vahnir namasā ||
children.translated_text: The flame comes toward us with might; even with ghee, being praised, it comes with homage.

children.text: agniḥ sruco adhvareṣu prayakṣu sa yakṣad asya mahimānam agneḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> attends to the ladles at the rites and offerings; may he worship the greatness of this <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tarī mandrāsu prayakṣu vasavaś cātiṣṭhan vasudhātaraś ca ||
children.translated_text: The three have stood among the pleasant offerings, the <s>Vasus</s> and the bearers of treasure.

children.text: dvāro devīr anv asya viśve vrataṃ rakṣanti viśvahā ||
children.translated_text: The divine doors, all together, guard his ordinance at all times.

children.text: uruvyacasāgner dhāmnā patyamāne
children.translated_text: With wide expanse, as the stations of <s>Agni</s> are being ruled over,

children.text: ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktemaṃ yajñam avatām adhvaram naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Dawn and Night, well-milking nearby, worship; let them protect this sacrifice, this rite of ours.

children.text: daivā hotāra ūrdhvam adhvaraṃ no 'gner jihvayābhi gṛṇata gṛṇatā naḥ sviṣṭaye
children.translated_text: Let the divine Hotars raise our rite upward with <s>Agni</s>'s tongue; praise, praise us for a well-offered sacrifice.

children.text: tisro devīr barhir edaṃ sadantām iḍā sarasvatī mahī bhāratī gṛṇānā ||
children.translated_text: Let the three goddesses sit down on this sacrificial grass: <s>Iḍā</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, great <s>Mahī</s> <s>Bhāratī</s>, being praised.

children.text: tan nas turīpam adbhutaṃ purukṣu
children.translated_text: For us may that wonderful <s>Turīpa</s>, rich in cattle,

children.text: deva tvaṣṭā rāyas poṣaṃ vi ṣya nābhim asya ||
children.translated_text: O god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, distribute wealth and nourishment, the navel of this one.

children.text: vanaspate 'va sṛjā rarāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: O forest-lord, release it, bestowing favor.

children.text: tmanā devebhyo agnir havyaṃ śamitā svadayatu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s>, the appeaser, by himself make the oblation tasty for the gods.

children.text: agne svāhā kṛṇuhi jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, svāhā, perform it, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: indrāya yajñaṃ viśve devā havir idaṃ juṣantām ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s> is the sacrifice; may all the gods enjoy this oblation.

children.text: Chapter 170
nava prāṇān navabhiḥ saṃ mimīte dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya
children.translated_text: He measures out the nine breaths with nine, for long life, for a hundred autumns.

children.text: harite trīṇi rajate trīṇy ayasi trīṇi tapasāviṣṭitāni ||
children.translated_text: Three in the yellow metal, three in silver, three in iron are fixed by fervor.

children.text: agniḥ sūryaś candramā bhūmir āpo dyaur antarikṣaṃ pradiśo diśaś ca
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the sun, the moon, earth, the waters, heaven, the midspace, the intermediate directions and the directions,

children.text: ārtavā ṛtubhiḥ saṃvidānā anena mā trivṛtā pārayantu ||
children.translated_text: the seasonal powers, agreeing with the seasons, may they carry me across by this threefold one.

children.text: trayaḥ poṣās trivṛti śrayantām anaktu pūṣā payasā ghṛtena
children.translated_text: Let the three nourishments rest in the threefold one; let <s>Pūṣan</s> anoint it with milk and ghee.

children.text: annasya bhūmā puruṣasya bhūmā bhūmā paśūnāṃ ta iha śrayantām ||
children.translated_text: May abundance of food, abundance of man, and abundance of cattle rest here upon you.

children.text: imam ādityā vasunā sam ukṣatemam agne vardhaya vavṛdhānaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the <s>Ādityas</s> sprinkle this one with wealth; O <s>Agni</s>, make this growing one increase.

children.text: imam indra saṃ sṛja vīryeṇāsmin trivṛcchrayatāṃ poṣayiṣṇu ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, join this one with heroic power; in this one let the nourishing threefold amulet rest.

children.text: bhūmiṣ ṭvā pātu haritena viśvabhṛd agniḥ pipartv ayasā sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: May earth protect you with the yellow metal; may all-sustaining <s>Agni</s>, together with iron, carry you across.

children.text: vīrudbhiṣ ṭe arjunaṃ saṃvidānaṃ dakṣaṃ dadhātu sumanasyamānam ||
children.translated_text: Together with the plants, may the white metal, being in agreement with you, place skill in you as it becomes well-disposed.

children.text: tredhā jātam janmanedaṃ hiraṇyam agner ekaṃ priyatamaṃ babhūva somasyaikaṃ hiṃsitasya parāpatat
children.translated_text: This gold was born threefold by birth: one part became dearest to <s>Agni</s>; one part of wounded <s>Soma</s> fell away.

children.text: apām ekaṃ vedhasāṃ reta āhus tat te hiraṇyaṃ trivṛd astv āyuṣe ||
children.translated_text: One part they call the seed of the waters and of the ordainers; let that gold be threefold for your life.

children.text: tryāyuṣaṃ jamadagneḥ kaśyapasya tryāyuṣam
children.translated_text: The threefold life-span of <s>Jamadagni</s>, the threefold life-span of <s>Kaśyapa</s>,

children.text: tredhāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ trīṇy āyūṃṣi te 'karam ||
children.translated_text: the threefold vision of immortality: three life-spans I have made for you.

children.text: trayaḥ suparṇās trivṛtā yad āyann ekākṣaram abhisaṃbhūya śakrāḥ
children.translated_text: When the three fair-winged ones went with the threefold one, the strong ones becoming united in a single syllable,

children.text: praty auhan mṛtyum amṛtena sākam antardadhānā duritāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: they drove death away together with immortality, hiding all misfortunes.

children.text: divas tvā pātu haritaṃ madhyāt tvā pātv arjunam
children.translated_text: May the yellow one protect you from heaven; may the white one protect you from the middle region.

children.text: bhūmyā ayasmayaṃ pātu prāgād devapurā ayam ||
children.translated_text: May the iron one protect you from the earth; this divine fortress has gone forth.

children.text: imās tisro devapurās tās tvā rakṣantu sarvataḥ
children.translated_text: These three divine fortresses, let them protect you on every side.

children.text: tās tvaṃ bibhrad varcasvy uttaro dviṣatāṃ bhava ||
children.translated_text: Wearing them, be brilliant; be superior to those who hate you.

children.text: puraṃ devānām amṛtaṃ hiraṇyam ya ābedhe prathamo devo agre
children.translated_text: The immortal gold, the fortress of the gods, which the first god fastened on in the beginning,

children.text: tasmai namo daśa prācīḥ kṛṇomy anu manyatāṃ trivṛd ābadhe me ||
children.translated_text: to him I make obeisance in the ten eastern directions; may the threefold amulet approve my binding.

children.text: ā tvā cṛtatv aryamā pūṣā bṛhaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, and <s>Bṛhaspati</s> fasten you on.

children.text: aharjātasya yan nāma tena tvāti cṛtāmasi ||
children.translated_text: With the name of the day-born one, with that we fasten you on.

children.text: ṛtubhiṣ ṭvārtavair āyuṣe varcase tvā
children.translated_text: With the seasons and the seasonal powers I fasten you for life, and for brilliance.

children.text: saṃvatsarasya tejasā tena saṃhanu kṛṇmasi ||
children.translated_text: With the radiance of the year, with that we make you firm.

children.text: ghṛtād ulluptam madhunā samaktaṃ bhūmidṛṃham acyutam pārayiṣṇu
children.translated_text: Smeared from ghee, anointed with honey, earth-firm, unfailing, carrying across,

children.text: bhindat sapatnān adharāṃś ca kṛṇvad ā mā roha mahate saubhagāya ||
children.translated_text: splitting rivals and making them lower, mount upon me for great good fortune.

children.text: Chapter 171
purastād yukto vaha jātavedo 'gne viddhi kriyamāṇam yathedam
children.translated_text: Harnessed in front, carry it, O <s>Jātavedas</s> <s>Agni</s>; know what is being done in this way.

children.text: tvaṃ bhiṣag bheṣajasyāsi kartā tvayā gām aśvaṃ puruṣaṃ sanema ||
children.translated_text: You are the physician; you are the maker of the remedy. Through you may we obtain cow, horse, and man.

children.text: tathā tad agne kṛṇu jātavedo viśvebhir devaiḥ saha saṃvidānaḥ
children.translated_text: So make that so, O <s>Agni</s> <s>Jātavedas</s>, acting in accord with all the gods.

children.text: yo no dideva yatamo jaghāsa yathā so asya paridhiṣ patāti ||
children.translated_text: Whichever one has sported against us, whichever one has devoured, may he fall around this man in that way.

children.text: yathā so asya paridhiṣ patāti tathā tad agne kṛṇu jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: As he falls around this man, so make that so, O <s>Agni</s> <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: viśvebhir devair saha saṃvidānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: acting in accord with all the gods.

children.text: akṣyau ni vidhya hṛdayaṃ ni vidhya jihvāṃ ni tṛnddhi pra dato mṛṇīhi
children.translated_text: Pierce his eyes; pierce his heart. Cut off his tongue; crush his teeth.

children.text: piśāco asya yatamo jaghāsāgne yaviṣṭha prati śṛṇīhi ||
children.translated_text: Whichever <s>piśāca</s> (ghoul) has devoured this man, O youngest <s>Agni</s>, split him apart in return.

children.text: yad asya hṛtaṃ vihṛtaṃ yat parābhṛtam ātmano jagdhaṃ yatamat piśācaiḥ
children.translated_text: What has been stolen from him, carried away, borne off, what of himself has been eaten by <s>piśācas</s>,

children.text: tad agne vidvān punar ā bhara tvaṃ śarīre māṃsam asum erayāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: knowing that, O <s>Agni</s>, bring it back again. Let us set flesh and life-breath in his body.

children.text: āme supakve śabale vipakve yo mā piśāco aśane dadambha
children.translated_text: In raw food, in well-cooked food, in variegated food, in badly cooked food, whichever <s>piśāca</s> has deceived me in eating,

children.text: tad ātmanā prajayā piśācā vi yātayantām agado 'yam astu ||
children.translated_text: let the <s>piśācas</s>, with themselves and their offspring, drive that away. Let this man be free from poison.

children.text: kṣīre mā manthe yatamo dadambhākṛṣṭapacye aśane dhānye yaḥ
children.translated_text: In milk, in curds, whichever one has deceived me, and the one in uncultivated cooked food, in food, in grain,

children.text: tad ātmanā prajayā piśācā vi yātayantām agado 'yam astu ||
children.translated_text: let the <s>piśācas</s>, with themselves and their offspring, drive that away. Let this man be free from poison.

children.text: apāṃ mā pāne yatamo dadambha kravyād yātūnām śayane śayānam
children.translated_text: In drinking water, whichever one has deceived me, the flesh-eater of the <s>yātus</s> while I lay lying on the bed,

children.text: tad ātmanā prajayā piśācā vi yātayantām agado 'yam astu ||
children.translated_text: let the <s>piśācas</s>, with themselves and their offspring, drive that away. Let this man be free from poison.

children.text: divā mā naktaṃ yatamo dadambha kravyād yātūnām śayane śayānam
children.translated_text: By day or by night, whichever one has deceived me, the flesh-eater of the <s>yātus</s> while I lay lying on the bed,

children.text: tad ātmanā prajayā piśācā vi yātayantām agado 'yam astu ||
children.translated_text: let the <s>piśācas</s>, with themselves and their offspring, drive that away. Let this man be free from poison.

children.text: kravyādam agne rudhiraṃ piśācaṃ manohanaṃ jahi jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> <s>Jātavedas</s>, slay the flesh-eating, bloody <s>piśāca</s>, the mind-stealer.

children.text: tam indro vājī vajreṇa hantu chinattu somaḥ śiro asya dhṛṣṇuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let swift <s>Indra</s> strike him with the thunderbolt; let <s>Soma</s> cut off his bold head.

children.text: sanād agne mṛṇasi yātudhānān na tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ
children.translated_text: From of old, O <s>Agni</s>, you crush the <s>yātudhānas</s> (sorcerous demons); the <s>rakṣases</s> have not conquered you in battles.

children.text: sahamūrān anu daha kravyādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Burn after the overbold ones, the flesh-eaters; let none escape your divine missile.

children.text: samāhara jātavedo yad dhṛtaṃ yat parābhṛtam
children.translated_text: Gather together, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, what has been stolen, what has been carried away.

children.text: gātrāṇy asya vardhantām aṃśur ivā pyāyatām ayam ||
children.translated_text: Let his limbs grow strong; like a Soma shoot, let this man swell with fullness.

children.text: somasyeva jātavedo aṃśur ā pyāyatām ayam
children.translated_text: Like the shoot of Soma, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, let this man swell with fullness.

children.text: agne virapśinaṃ medhyam ayakṣmaṃ kṛṇu jīvatu ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, make him ample, pure, free from <s>yakṣma</s> (wasting disease); let him live.

children.text: etās te agne samidhaḥ piśācajambhanīḥ
children.translated_text: These are your kindling sticks, O <s>Agni</s>, crushers of <s>piśācas</s>.

children.text: tās tvaṃ juṣasva prati cainā gṛhāṇa jātavedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Accept them and receive them in return, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: tārṣṭāghīr agne samidhaḥ prati gṛhṇāhy arciṣā
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, receive with your flame the kindling sticks that strike away distress.

children.text: jahātu kravyād rūpaṃ yo asya māṃsaṃ jihīrṣati ||
children.translated_text: Let the flesh-eater who wants to seize his flesh abandon that form.

children.text: Chapter 172
āvatas ta āvataḥ parāvatas ta āvataḥ
children.translated_text: From nearby you have aided him; from far away you have aided him.

children.text: ihaiva bhava mā nu gā mā pūrvān anu gāḥ pitṝn asuṃ badhnāmi te dṛḍham ||
children.translated_text: Be right here. Do not go away; do not follow the former Fathers. I bind your life-breath firmly to you.

children.text: yat tvābhiceruḥ puruṣaḥ svo yad araṇo janaḥ
children.translated_text: If a man has practiced hostile sorcery against you, whether his own or an alien person,

children.text: unmocanapramocane ubhe vācā vadāmi te ||
children.translated_text: I speak both release and complete release to you with my voice.

children.text: yad dudrohitha śepiṣe striyai puṃse acittyā
children.translated_text: If, unthinkingly, you have wronged or cursed a woman or a man,

children.text: unmocanapramocane ubhe vācā vadāmi te ||
children.translated_text: I speak both release and complete release to you with my voice.

children.text: yat enaso mātṛkṛtāccheṣe pitṛkṛtāc ca yat
children.translated_text: If you lie under sin done by your mother, or what was done by your father,

children.text: unmocanapramocane ubhe vācā vadāmi te ||
children.translated_text: I speak both release and complete release to you with my voice.

children.text: yat te mātā yat te pitā jāmir bhrātā ca sarjataḥ
children.translated_text: What your mother, what your father, your kinswoman and your brother discharge against you,

children.text: pratyak sevasva bheṣajaṃ jaradaṣṭiṃ kṛṇomi tvā ||
children.translated_text: turn directly to the remedy. I make you one who reaches old age.

children.text: ihaidhi puruṣa sarveṇa manasā saha
children.translated_text: Come here, O man, together with your whole mind.

children.text: dūtau yamasya mānu gā adhi jīvapurā ihi ||
children.translated_text: Do not follow the two messengers of <s>Yama</s>; come here to the cities of the living.

children.text: anuhūtaḥ punar ehi vidvān udayanaṃ pathaḥ
children.translated_text: Called back, come again, knowing the path of rising up,

children.text: ārohaṇam ākramaṇaṃ jīvato jīvato 'yanam ||
children.translated_text: the ascent, the step upward, the course of the living, of the living.

children.text: mā bibher na mariṣyasi jaradaṣṭiṃ kṛṇomi tvā
children.translated_text: Do not be afraid; you will not die. I make you one who reaches old age.

children.text: nir avocam ahaṃ yakṣmam aṅgebhyo aṅgajvaraṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: I have spoken out <s>yakṣma</s> (wasting disease) from your limbs, and limb-fever from your limbs.

children.text: aṅgabhedo aṅgajvaro yaś ca te hṛdayāmayaḥ
children.translated_text: The breaking of the limbs, the fever of the limbs, and whatever heart-disease is yours,

children.text: yakṣmaḥ śyena iva prāpaptad vacā sāḍhaḥ parastarām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>yakṣma</s> (wasting disease) has flown far away like a falcon, overcome by the <s>vacā</s> herb, beyond.

children.text: ṛṣī bodhapratībodhāv asvapno yaś ca jāgṛviḥ
children.translated_text: The two seer-powers, Awakening and Reawakening, and Sleeplessness, which is wakeful,

children.text: tau te prāṇasya goptārau divā naktaṃ ca jāgṛtām ||
children.translated_text: let those two, guardians of your life-breath, keep watch by day and by night.

children.text: ayam agnir upasadya iha sūrya ud etu te
children.translated_text: Let this <s>Agni</s>, fit to be approached, be here; let the sun rise for you here.

children.text: udehi mṛtyor gambhīrāt kṛṣṇāc cit tamasas pari ||
children.translated_text: Rise up from deep death, even from black darkness.

children.text: namo yamāya namo astu mṛtyave namaḥ pitṛbhya uta ye nayanti
children.translated_text: Homage to <s>Yama</s>; homage be to <s>Mṛtyu</s> (Death); homage to the Fathers and to those who lead away.

children.text: utpāraṇasya yo veda tam agniṃ puro dadhe 'smā ariṣṭatātaye ||
children.translated_text: I set before us, for our freedom from injury, that <s>Agni</s> who knows the drawing out.

children.text: aitu prāṇa aitu mana aitu cakṣur atho balam
children.translated_text: Let his breath come; let his mind come; let his sight come, and also his strength.

children.text: śarīram asya sam vidāṃ tat padbhyāṃ prati tiṣṭhatu ||
children.translated_text: Let his body come together; let it stand firm upon its feet.

children.text: prāṇenāgne cakṣuṣā saṃ sṛjemaṃ sam īraya tanvā saṃ balena
children.translated_text: With breath, O <s>Agni</s>, with sight, join this man together; stir him together with body and with strength.

children.text: vetthāmṛtasya mā nu gān mā nu bhūmigṛho bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: You know immortality. Let him not go away; let him not become a dweller in the earth.

children.text: mā te prāṇa upa dasan mo apāno 'pi dhāyi te
children.translated_text: Let your breath not fail; let your <s>apāna</s> (downward breath) not be laid aside.

children.text: sūryas tvādhipatir mṛtyor udāyacchatu raśmibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Sūrya</s>, your overlord, raise you up from death with his rays.

children.text: iyam antar vadati jihvā baddhā paniṣpadā
children.translated_text: This tongue, bound within, speaks with indistinct muttering.

children.text: tvayā yakṣmam nir avocaṃ śataṃ ropīś ca takmanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By you I have spoken out <s>yakṣma</s> (wasting disease) and a hundred eruptions of <s>takman</s> (fever).

children.text: ayaṃ lokaḥ priyatamo devānām aparājitaḥ
children.translated_text: This world, most dear to the gods, is unconquered.

children.text: yasmai tvam iha mṛtyave diṣṭaḥ puruṣa jajñiṣe
children.translated_text: For whatever death here you, O man, were allotted and born,

children.text: sa ca tvānu hvayāmasi mā purā jaraso mṛthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: from that too we call you back. Do not die before old age.

children.text: Chapter 173
yāṃ te cakrur āme pātre yāṃ cakrur miśradhānye
children.translated_text: The <s>kṛtyā</s> (witchcraft) that they made for you in a raw vessel, that they made in mixed grain,

children.text: āme māṃse kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>kṛtyā</s> (witchcraft) that they made in raw flesh, that I bring back again against them.

children.text: yāṃ te cakruḥ kṛkavākāv aje vā yāṃ kurīriṇi
children.translated_text: The <s>kṛtyā</s> (witchcraft) that they made for you in a cock or in a goat, that they made in a crested bird,

children.text: avyāṃ te kṛtyāṃ yām cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>kṛtyā</s> (witchcraft) that they made for you in a sheep, that I bring back again against them.

children.text: yāṃ te cakrur ekaśaphe paśūnām ubhayādati
children.translated_text: The one that they made for you among one-hoofed animals, among the animals that bite with both jaws...

children.text: gardabhe kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām ||
children.translated_text: The <s>kṛtyā</s> (hostile spell) which they made in a donkey: I carry that back again.

children.text: yāṃ te cakrur amūlāyāṃ valagaṃ vā narācyām
children.translated_text: The one which they made for you in the rootless plant, or the <s>valaga</s> (buried charm) in the reed,

children.text: kṣetre te kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>kṛtyā</s> which they made for you in the field: I carry that back again.

children.text: yāṃ te cakrur gārhapatye pūrvāgnāv uta duścitaḥ
children.translated_text: The one which they made for you at the household fire, at the former fire, and what was ill-planned,

children.text: śālāyāṃ kṛtyāṃ yām cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>kṛtyā</s> which they made in the hall: I carry that back again.

children.text: yāṃ te cakruḥ sabhāyāṃ yām cakrur adhidevane
children.translated_text: The one which they made for you in the assembly, the one they made at the gaming-place,

children.text: akṣeṣu kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>kṛtyā</s> which they made among the dice: I carry that back again.

children.text: yāṃ te cakruḥ senāyāṃ yāṃ cakrur iṣvāyudhe
children.translated_text: The one which they made for you in the army, the one they made upon arrow and weapon,

children.text: dundubhau kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>kṛtyā</s> which they made in the war drum: I carry that back again.

children.text: yāṃ te kṛtyām kūpe 'vadadhuḥ śmaśāne vā nicakhnuḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>kṛtyā</s> which they set down for you in a well, or buried in the cremation ground,

children.text: sadmani kṛtyām yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>kṛtyā</s> which they made in the dwelling: I carry that back again.

children.text: yāṃ te cakruḥ puruṣāsthe agnau saṃkasuke ca yām
children.translated_text: The one which they made for you in a man's bone, in fire, and in the destructive thing,

children.text: mrokaṃ nirdāhaṃ kravyādaṃ punaḥ prati harāmi tām ||
children.translated_text: the crushing, burning, flesh-eating one: I carry that back again.

children.text: apathenā jabhāraināṃ tāṃ pathetaḥ pra hiṇmasi
children.translated_text: By a wrong path they have brought this one; by your path we send it forth.

children.text: adhīro maryādhīrebhyaḥ saṃ jabhārācittyā ||
children.translated_text: The senseless mortal gathered it together from the senseless, unknowingly.

children.text: yaś cakāra na śaśāka kartuṃ śaśre pādam aṅgurim
children.translated_text: He who made it was not able to make it; he injured his foot and finger.

children.text: cakāra bhadram asmabhyam abhago bhagavadbhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The luckless one made good fortune for us, who possess fortune.

children.text: kṛtyākṛtaṃ valaginaṃ mūlinaṃ śapatheyyam
children.translated_text: The maker of <s>kṛtyā</s>, the <s>valaga</s>-worker, the root-worker, the curser:

children.text: indras taṃ hantu mahatā vadhenāgnir vidhyatv astayā ||
children.translated_text: let <s>Indra</s> strike him with a great blow; let <s>Agni</s> pierce him with an arrow.

children.text: Chapter 174
doṣo gāya bṛhad gāya dyumad dhehi
children.translated_text: Sing in the evening; sing the lofty chant; set down radiance.

children.text: ātharvaṇa stuhi devaṃ savitāram ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Ātharvaṇa</s>, praise the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: tam u ṣṭuhi yo antaḥ sindhau sūnuḥ
children.translated_text: Praise that one, the young son who is within the river,

children.text: satyasya yuvānam adroghavācaṃ suśevam ||
children.translated_text: of truth, speaking without deceit, gracious.

children.text: sa ghā no devaḥ savitā sāviṣad amṛtāni bhūri
children.translated_text: May that god <s>Savitṛ</s> impel for us many immortal things,

children.text: ubhe suṣṭutī sugātave ||
children.translated_text: both well-praised hymns, for an easy path.

children.text: Chapter 175
indrāya somam ṛtvijaḥ sunotā ca dhāvata
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>, O officiating priests, press Soma and hurry.

children.text: stotur yo vacaḥ śṛṇavaddhavaṃ ca me ||
children.translated_text: May he hear the praiser's word and my call.

children.text: ā yaṃ viśantīndavo vayo na vṛkṣam andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: The drops enter this Soma-drink like birds entering a tree.

children.text: virapśin vi mṛdho jahi rakṣasvinīḥ ||
children.translated_text: O powerful one, scatter the hostile forces; strike down the demon-possessed ones.

children.text: sunotā somapāvne somam indrāya vajriṇe
children.translated_text: Press Soma for the Soma-drinker, for <s>Indra</s> the wielder of the thunderbolt.

children.text: yuvā jeteśānaḥ sa puruṣṭutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Young, conquering, ruling, he is much-praised.

children.text: Chapter 176
pātaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇāditiḥ pāntu marutaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, and <s>Aditi</s> protect us; may the <s>Maruts</s> protect us.

children.text: apāṃ napāt sindhavaḥ sapta pātana pātu no viṣṇur uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, seven rivers, protect us; may <s>Viṣṇu</s> and heaven also protect us.

children.text: pātāṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī abhiṣṭaye pātu grāvā pātu somo no aṃhasaḥ
children.translated_text: May heaven and earth protect us for aid; may the pressing stone protect us; may Soma protect us from distress.

children.text: pātu no devī subhagā sarasvatī pātv agniḥ śivā ye asya pāyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the blessed goddess <s>Sarasvatī</s> protect us; may <s>Agni</s> protect us, and the auspicious guardians who are his.

children.text: pātām no devāśvinā śubhas patī uṣāsānaktota na uruṣyatām
children.translated_text: May the divine <s>Aśvins</s>, lords of brightness, protect us; may dawn and night guard us widely.

children.text: apāṃ napād abhihrutī gayasya cid deva tvaṣṭar vardhaya sarvatātaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, turn away injury even from the household; O god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, increase us for every protection.

children.text: Chapter 177
tvaṣṭā me daivyaṃ vacaḥ parjanyo brahmaṇas patiḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Parjanya</s>, and <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> protect my divine speech.

children.text: putrair bhrātṛbhir aditir nu pātu no duṣṭaraṃ trāyamāṇaṃ sahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Aditi</s>, with sons and brothers, protect us now, delivering us from the hard-to-cross hostile force.

children.text: aṃśo bhago varuṇo mitro aryamāditiḥ pāntu marutaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Aṃśa</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, and the <s>Maruts</s> protect us.

children.text: apa tasya dveṣo gamed abhihruto yāvayacchatrum antitam ||
children.translated_text: Let his hatred go away; ward off the deceiver, the nearest enemy.

children.text: dhiye sam aśvinā prāvataṃ na uruṣyā ṇa urujmann aprayucchan
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, help our thought; guard us, O wide-moving ones, unfailing.

children.text: dyauṣ pitar yāvaya ducchunā yā ||
children.translated_text: O father Heaven, drive away ill fortune.

children.text: Chapter 178
ud enam uttaraṃ nayāgne ghṛtenāhuta
children.translated_text: Raise him upward, O <s>Agni</s>, offered to with ghee.

children.text: sam enaṃ varcasā sṛja prajayā ca bahuṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Join him with brilliance, and make him abundant with offspring.

children.text: indremaṃ prataraṃ kṛdhi sajātānām asad vaśī
children.translated_text: Through <s>Indra</s>, make this man stronger; let him become ruler over his kinsmen.

children.text: rāyas poṣeṇa saṃ sṛja jīvātave jarase naya ||
children.translated_text: Join him with increase of wealth; lead him to life and old age.

children.text: yasya kṛṇmo havir gṛhe tam agne vardhayā tvam
children.translated_text: The man in whose house we make the oblation, him, O <s>Agni</s>, do you increase.

children.text: tasmai somo adhi bravad ayaṃ ca brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: For him may Soma speak in favor, and this <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> too.

children.text: Chapter 179
yo 'smān brahmaṇaspate 'devo abhimanyate
children.translated_text: Whoever, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, being ungodly, is hostile to us,

children.text: sarvaṃ tam randhayāsi me yajamānāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: make all of him subject to me, the sacrificer who presses Soma.

children.text: yo naḥ soma suśaṃsino duḥśaṃsa ādideśati
children.translated_text: Whoever, O Soma, ill-speaking, attacks us who speak good praise,

children.text: vajreṇāsya mukhe jahi sa sampiṣṭo apāyati ||
children.translated_text: strike him in the mouth with the thunderbolt; crushed, let him go away.

children.text: yo naḥ somābhidāsati sanābhir yaś ca niṣṭyaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever assaults us, O Soma, whether he is a kinsman or an outsider,

children.text: apa tasya balaṃ tira mahīva dyaur vadhatmanā ||
children.translated_text: drive away his strength, as great heaven does with its deadly weapon.

children.text: Chapter 180
yena somāditiḥ pathā mitrā vā yanty adruhaḥ
children.translated_text: By the path by which, O Soma, <s>Aditi</s> and deceitless <s>Mitra</s> go,

children.text: tenā no 'vasā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come to us by that path with aid.

children.text: yena soma sāhantyāsurān randhayāsi naḥ
children.translated_text: By that strength with which, O Soma, you overcome the Asuras and make them subject to us,

children.text: tenā no adhi vocata ||
children.translated_text: speak in favor of us with that.

children.text: yena devā asurāṇām ojāṃsy avṛṇīdhvam
children.translated_text: By that with which, O gods, you deprived the Asuras of their powers,

children.text: tenā naḥ śarma yacchata ||
children.translated_text: grant us shelter with that.

children.text: Chapter 181
yathā vṛkṣaṃ libujā samantaṃ pariṣasvaje
children.translated_text: As a creeper embraces a tree all around,

children.text: evā pari ṣvajasva māṃ yathā māṃ kāminy aso yathā man nāpagā asaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so embrace me, so that you may be one desiring me, so that you may not go away from me.

children.text: yathā suparṇaḥ prapatan pakṣau nihanti bhūmyām
children.translated_text: As the flying eagle, swooping down, strikes its wings upon the earth,

children.text: evā ni hanmi te mano yathā māṃ kāminy aso yathā man nāpagā asaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so I strike down your mind, so that you may be one desiring me, so that you may not go away from me.

children.text: yatheme dyāvāpṛthivī sadyaḥ paryeti sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: As the sun at once goes around these heaven and earth,

children.text: evā pary emi te mano yathā māṃ kāminy aso yathā man nāpagā asaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so I go around your mind, so that you may be one desiring me, so that you may not go away from me.

children.text: Chapter 182
vāñcha me tanvaṃ pādau vāñchākṣyau vāñcha sakthyau
children.translated_text: Long for my body; long for my feet; long for my eyes; long for my thighs.

children.text: akṣyau vṛṣaṇyantyāḥ keśā māṃ te kāmena śuṣyantu ||
children.translated_text: Let the eyes and hair of the woman desiring a man dry up with desire for me.

children.text: mama tvā doṣaṇiśriṣaṃ kṛṇomi hṛdayaśriṣam
children.translated_text: I make you one clinging to my arm, one clinging to my heart,

children.text: yathā mama kratāv aso mama cittam upāyasi ||
children.translated_text: so that you may be in my will and may come to my thought.

children.text: yāsāṃ nābhir ārehaṇaṃ hṛdi saṃvananaṃ kṛtam
children.translated_text: Those whose navel is ascent, whose winning-over is made in the heart,

children.text: gāvo ghṛtasya mātaro 'mūṃ saṃ vānayantu me ||
children.translated_text: let the cows, mothers of ghee, win that woman over for me.

children.text: Chapter 183
pṛthivyai śrotrāya vanaspatibhyo 'gnaye 'dhipataye svāhā ||
children.translated_text: To the earth, to hearing, to the forest trees, to <s>Agni</s> as overlord: svāhā.

children.text: prāṇāyāntarikṣāya vayobhyo vāyave 'dhipataye svāhā ||
children.translated_text: To breath, to the midspace, to the birds, to <s>Vāyu</s> as overlord: svāhā.

children.text: dive cakṣuṣe nakṣatrebhyaḥ sūryāyādhipataye svāhā ||
children.translated_text: To heaven, to sight, to the stars, to <s>Sūrya</s> as overlord: svāhā.

children.text: Chapter 184
śamīm aśvattha ārūḍhas tatra puṃsuvanaṃ kṛtam
children.translated_text: The <s>aśvattha</s> has mounted the <s>śamī</s>; there the rite for producing a male child was performed.

children.text: tad vai putrasya vedanaṃ tat strīṣv ā bharāmasi ||
children.translated_text: That indeed is the obtaining of a son; that we bring among women.

children.text: puṃsi vai reto bhavati tat striyām anu ṣicyate
children.translated_text: In the male, indeed, semen exists; it is poured into the woman.

children.text: tad vai putrasya vedanaṃ tat prajāpatir abravīt ||
children.translated_text: That indeed is the obtaining of a son; so <s>Prajāpati</s> said.

children.text: prajāpatir anumatiḥ sinīvāly acīkﾱpat
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s>, <s>Anumati</s>, and <s>Sinīvālī</s> fashioned it,

children.text: straiṣūyam anyatra dadhat pumāṃsam u dadhat iha ||
children.translated_text: placing femaleness elsewhere and placing a male here.

children.text: Chapter 185
pari dyām iva sūryo 'hīnāṃ janimāgamam
children.translated_text: As <s>Sūrya</s> surrounds heaven, I have gone round the birth of the serpents.

children.text: rātrī jagad ivānyaddhaṃsāt tenā te vāraye viṣam ||
children.translated_text: As night surrounds the moving world, by that I ward off your poison.

children.text: yad brahmabhir yad ṛṣibhir yad devair viditaṃ purā
children.translated_text: Whatever was known of old by the brahmans, by the seers, and by the gods,

children.text: yad bhūtaṃ bhavyam āsanvat tenā te vāraye viṣam ||
children.translated_text: whatever has been and whatever is to be, by that I ward off your poison.

children.text: madhvā pṛñce nadyaḥ parvatā girayo madhu
children.translated_text: With honey I mix the rivers; the mountains and hills are honey.

children.text: madhu paruṣṇī śīpālā śam āsne astu śaṃ hṛde ||
children.translated_text: Honey is the <s>Paruṣṇī</s>, <s>Śīpālā</s>; may there be well-being for the mouth and well-being for the heart.

children.text: Chapter 186
namo devavadhebhyo namo rājavadhebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Homage to the divine slayings; homage to the royal slayings.

children.text: atho ye viśyānāṃ vadhās tebhyo mṛtyo namo 'stu te ||
children.translated_text: And those slayings that belong to the common folk: to them, O <s>Mṛtyu</s>, homage be to you.

children.text: namas te adhivākāya parāvākāya te namaḥ
children.translated_text: Homage to your near speech; homage to your distant speech.

children.text: sumatyai mṛtyo te namo durmatyai te idaṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Homage to your good intent, O <s>Mṛtyu</s>; this homage is to your bad intent.

children.text: namas te yātudhānebhyo namas te bheṣajebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Homage to your sorcerers; homage to your remedies.

children.text: namas te mṛtyo mūlebhyo brāhmaṇebhya idaṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Homage to your roots, O <s>Mṛtyu</s>; this homage is to the brahmans.

children.text: Chapter 187
asthisraṃsaṃ parusraṃsam āsthitam hṛdayāmayam
children.translated_text: Bone-wasting, joint-wasting, established disease of the heart,

children.text: balāsaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayāṅgeṣṭhā yaś ca parvasu ||
children.translated_text: <s>balāsa</s> (wasting disease), all of it, destroy in the limbs and whatever is in the joints.

children.text: nir balāsaṃ balāsinaḥ kṣiṇomi muṣkaraṃ yathā
children.translated_text: I drive <s>balāsa</s> out of the one afflicted with <s>balāsa</s>, as one removes a <s>muṣkara</s>.

children.text: chinadmy asya bandhanaṃ mūlam urvārvā iva ||
children.translated_text: I cut its bond, its root, like a cucumber from its stem.

children.text: nir balāsetaḥ pra patāśuṅgaḥ śiśuko yathā
children.translated_text: Fly out from here without <s>balāsa</s>, like a small young thing from a horn,

children.text: atho ita iva hāyano 'pa drāhy avīrahā ||
children.translated_text: and from here, like a yearling, run away, not killing men.

children.text: Chapter 188
uttamo asy oṣadhīnāṃ tava vṛkṣā upastayaḥ
children.translated_text: You are the highest of herbs; the trees are your supports.

children.text: upastir astu so 'smākaṃ yo asmāṁ abhidāsati ||
children.translated_text: May that support be ours, the one that attacks us.

children.text: sabandhuś cāsabandhuś ca yo asmāṁ abhidāsati
children.translated_text: Both he with kin and he without kin, whoever attacks us,

children.text: teṣāṃ sā vṛkṣāṇām ivāhaṃ bhūyāsam uttamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: among them may I become the highest, as among trees.

children.text: yathā soma oṣadhīnām uttamo haviṣāṃ kṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: As <s>Soma</s> was made the highest of herbs and of oblations,

children.text: talāśā vṛkṣāṇām ivāhaṃ bhūyāsam uttamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like the <s>talāśā</s> among trees, may I become the highest.

children.text: Chapter 189
ābayo anābayo rasas ta ugra ābayo
children.translated_text: O <s>Ābaya</s> and <s>Anābaya</s>, your sap is fierce, O <s>Ābaya</s>.

children.text: ā te karambham admasi ||
children.translated_text: We eat your porridge here.

children.text: vihahlo nāma te pitā madāvatī nāma te mātā
children.translated_text: Your father is named <s>Vihahla</s>; your mother is named <s>Madāvatī</s>.

children.text: sa hina tvam asi yas tvam ātmānam āvayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore you are such, you who have swollen yourself.

children.text: tauvilike 'velayāvāyam ailaba ailayīt
children.translated_text: <s>Tauvilikā</s>, <s>Avelayāvāya</s>, <s>Ailaba</s>, <s>Ailayīt</s>,

children.text: babhruś ca babhrukarṇaś cāpehi nirāla ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Babhru</s> and <s>Babhrukarṇa</s>: go away, depart, O <s>Nirāla</s>.

children.text: alasālāsi pūrva silāñjālāsy uttarā
children.translated_text: You are <s>Alasālā</s> in front; you are <s>Silāñjālā</s> behind.

children.text: nīlāgalasāla ||
children.translated_text: <s>Nīlāgalasāla</s>.

children.text: Chapter 190
yatheyam pṛthivī mahī bhūtānāṃ garbham ādadhe
children.translated_text: As this broad earth has received the embryo of beings,

children.text: evā te dhriyatāṃ garbho anu sūtuṃ savitave ||
children.translated_text: so may your embryo be held until delivery, for bringing forth.

children.text: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī dādhāremān vanaspatīn
children.translated_text: As this broad earth has held these forest trees,

children.text: evā te dhriyatāṃ garbho anu sūtuṃ savitave ||
children.translated_text: so may your embryo be held until delivery, for bringing forth.

children.text: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī dādhāra parvatān girīn
children.translated_text: As this broad earth has held the mountains and hills,

children.text: evā te dhriyatāṃ garbho anu sūtuṃ savitave ||
children.translated_text: so may your embryo be held until delivery, for bringing forth.

children.text: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī dādhāra viṣṭhitaṃ jagat
children.translated_text: As this broad earth has held the outspread world,

children.text: evā te dhriyatāṃ garbho anu sūtuṃ savitave ||
children.translated_text: so may your embryo be held until delivery, for bringing forth.

children.text: Chapter 191
īrṣyāyā dhrājiṃ prathamāṃ prathamasyā utāparām
children.translated_text: The first blaze of jealousy, and the later one after the first,

children.text: agniṃ hṛdayyaṃ śokaṃ taṃ te nir vāpayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: that fire, the heart-born grief, we extinguish from you.

children.text: yathā bhūmir mṛtamanā mṛtān mṛtamanastarā
children.translated_text: As the earth is dead-minded, more dead-minded than the dead,

children.text: yathota mamruṣo mana everṣyor mṛtaṃ manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and as the mind of one who has died is dead, so is the mind of the jealous one dead.

children.text: ado yat te hṛdi śritaṃ manaskaṃ patayiṣṇukam
children.translated_text: That little mind of yours, lodged in your heart and ready to fly away,

children.text: tatas ta īrṣyāṃ muñcāmi nir ūṣmāṇaṃ dṛter iva ||
children.translated_text: from there I release jealousy from you, like heat from a skin-bag.

children.text: Chapter 192
punantu mā devajanāḥ punantu manavo dhiyā
children.translated_text: May the divine folk purify me; may the <s>Manus</s> purify me with thought.

children.text: punantu viśvā bhūtāni pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
children.translated_text: May all beings purify me; may <s>Pavamāna</s> purify me.

children.text: pavamānaḥ punātu mā kratve dakṣāya jīvase
children.translated_text: May <s>Pavamāna</s> purify me for resolve, for skill, and for life,

children.text: atho ariṣṭatātaye ||
children.translated_text: and also for freedom from harm.

children.text: ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca
children.translated_text: With both, O god <s>Savitṛ</s>, with the purifier and with the impulse,

children.text: asmān punīhi cakṣase ||
children.translated_text: purify us for sight.

children.text: Chapter 193
agner ivāsya dahata eti śuṣmiṇa uteva matto vilapann apāyati
children.translated_text: Like one burning from fire, he comes in his force, and like a madman he goes away lamenting.

children.text: anyam asmad icchatu kaṃcid avratas tapurvadhāya namo astu takmane ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>takman</s> seek someone else away from us; homage be to him whose weapon burns.

children.text: namo rudrāya namo astu takmane namo rājñe varuṇāya tviṣīmate
children.translated_text: Homage to <s>Rudra</s>; homage be to <s>takman</s>; homage to king <s>Varuṇa</s>, full of brilliance.

children.text: namo dive namaḥ pṛthivyai nama oṣadhībhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Homage to heaven; homage to earth; homage to the herbs.

children.text: ayaṃ yo abhiśocayiṣṇur viśvā rūpāṇi haritā kṛṇoṣi
children.translated_text: You here who are intent on burning, who make all forms yellow-green,

children.text: tasmai te 'ruṇāya babhrave namaḥ kṛṇomi vanyāya takmane ||
children.translated_text: to you, reddish and tawny, I pay homage, to the wild <s>takman</s>.

children.text: Chapter 194
imā yās tisraḥ pṛthivīs tāsāṃ ha bhūmir uttamā
children.translated_text: These three earths: of them the ground is the highest.

children.text: tāsām adhi tvaco ahaṃ bheṣajaṃ sam u jagrabham ||
children.translated_text: From their surface I have gathered up the medicine.

children.text: śreṣṭham asi bheṣajānāṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ vīrudhānām
children.translated_text: You are the best of remedies, the most excellent of plants,

children.text: somo bhaga iva yāmeṣu deveṣu varuṇo yathā ||
children.translated_text: as <s>Soma</s> is among the divine portions, as <s>Varuṇa</s> is among the gods.

children.text: revatīr anādhṛṣaḥ siṣāsavaḥ siṣāsatha
children.translated_text: Rich, unassailable ones, eager to win, may you win.

children.text: uta stha keśadṛṃhaṇīr atho ha keśavardhanīḥ ||
children.translated_text: And you are hair-strengtheners, and also hair-growers.

children.text: Chapter 195
kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇā apo vasānā divam ut patanti
children.translated_text: The dark track: the tawny, fair-winged ones, clothed in waters, fly up to heaven.

children.text: ta āvavṛtrant sadanād ṛtasyād id ghṛtena pṛthivīṃ vy ūduḥ ||
children.translated_text: They have turned back from the seat of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); from there, with ghee, they have moistened the earth.

children.text: payasvatīḥ kṛṇuthāpa oṣadhīḥ śivā yad ejathā maruto rukmavakṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: Make the waters and herbs rich in milk and auspicious when you stir, O gold-chested <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: ūrjaṃ ca tatra sumatiṃ ca pinvata yatrā naro marutaḥ siñcathā madhu ||
children.translated_text: Swell nourishment and good favor there, where, O men, O <s>Maruts</s>, you pour honey.

children.text: udapruto marutas tāṃ iyarta vṛṣṭir yā viśvā nivatas pṛṇāti
children.translated_text: O water-filled <s>Maruts</s>, set in motion that rain which fills all low places.

children.text: ejāti glahā kanyeva tunnairuṃ tundānā patyeva jāyā ||
children.translated_text: It moves, like a maiden with blows, thrusting like a wife toward her husband.

children.text: Chapter 196
sasruṣīs tad apaso divā naktaṃ ca sasruṣīḥ
children.translated_text: Those waters flow by day and by night; they flow.

children.text: vareṇyakratur aham apo devīr upa hvaye ||
children.translated_text: With excellent resolve, I call upon the divine waters.

children.text: otā āpaḥ karmaṇyā muñcantv itaḥ praṇītaye
children.translated_text: May the waters, fit for the rite, release us from here for forward-leading;

children.text: sadyaḥ kṛṇvantv etave ||
children.translated_text: may they at once make us ready to go.

children.text: devasya savituḥ save karma kṛṇvantu mānuṣāḥ
children.translated_text: At the impulse of the divine <s>Savitṛ</s>, let human beings perform the rite;

children.text: śaṃ no bhavantv apa oṣadhīḥ śivāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the waters and the plants be auspicious and gracious to us.

children.text: Chapter 197
himavataḥ pra sravanti sindhau samaha saṅgamaḥ
children.translated_text: From the Himalaya they stream forth; in the <s>Sindhu</s> is their common confluence.

children.text: āpo ha mahyaṃ tad devīr dadan hṛddyotabheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: May those divine waters give me that medicine which lights up the heart.

children.text: yan me akṣyor ādidyota pārṣṇyoḥ prapadoś ca yat
children.translated_text: Whatever burning has come into my eyes, and whatever is in my heels and forefeet,

children.text: āpas tat sarvaṃ niṣ karan bhiṣajāṃ subhiṣaktamāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the waters remove all that, the best healers among physicians.

children.text: sindhupatnīḥ sindhurājñīḥ sarvā yā nadya sthana
children.translated_text: Wives of the <s>Sindhu</s>, queens of the <s>Sindhu</s>, all you rivers that are,

children.text: datta nas tasya bheṣajaṃ tenā vo bhunajāmahai ||
children.translated_text: give us that remedy; with it may we partake of you.

children.text: Chapter 198
pañca ca yāḥ pañcāśac ca saṃyanti manyā abhi
children.translated_text: The five and the fifty that gather about the neck,

children.text: itas tāḥ sarvā naśyantu vākā apacitām iva ||
children.translated_text: let all of them vanish from here, like apacit swellings.

children.text: sapta ca yāḥ saptatiś ca saṃyanti graivyā abhi
children.translated_text: The seven and the seventy that gather about the nape,

children.text: itas tāḥ sarvā naśyantu vākā apacitām iva ||
children.translated_text: let all of them vanish from here, like apacit swellings.

children.text: nava ca yā navatiś ca saṃyanti skandhyā abhi
children.translated_text: The nine and the ninety that gather about the shoulders,

children.text: itas tāḥ sarvā naśyantu vākā apacitām iva ||
children.translated_text: let all of them vanish from here, like apacit swellings.

children.text: Chapter 199
ava mā pāpmant sṛja vaśī san mṛḍayāsi naḥ
children.translated_text: Release me from evil, O evil one; being subject to control, be gracious to us.

children.text: ā mā bhadrasya loke pāpman dhehy avihrutam ||
children.translated_text: Set me, O evil, uninjured in the world of what is auspicious.

children.text: yo naḥ pāpman na jahāsi tam u tvā jahimo vayam
children.translated_text: If you, O evil, do not abandon us, then we abandon you.

children.text: pathām anu vyāvartane 'nyaṃ pāpmānu padyatām ||
children.translated_text: At the turning of the paths, let another fall into evil.

children.text: anyatrāsman ny ucyatu sahasrākṣo amartyaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the thousand-eyed immortal one be set down elsewhere than upon us;

children.text: yaṃ dveṣāma tam ṛcchatu yam u dviṣmas tam ij jahi ||
children.translated_text: let him reach the one whom we hate, and strike the one who hates us.

children.text: Chapter 200
devāḥ kapota iṣito yad icchan dūto nirṛtyā idam ājagāma
children.translated_text: O gods, when the dispatched pigeon, seeking something, came here as the messenger of <s>Nirṛti</s>,

children.text: tasmā arcāma kṛṇavāma niṣkṛtiṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
children.translated_text: for it we perform worship and make expiation; may there be well-being for our two-footed and well-being for our four-footed.

children.text: śivaḥ kapota iṣito no astv anāgā devāḥ śakuno gṛhaṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: May the dispatched pigeon be auspicious for us, guiltless; O gods, may the bird be harmless to our house.

children.text: agnir hi vipro juṣatām havir naḥ pari hetiḥ pakṣiṇī no vṛṇaktu ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Agni</s>, the inspired priest, should accept our oblation; let the winged missile pass around us.

children.text: hetiḥ pakṣiṇī na dabhāty asmān āṣṭrī padaṃ kṛṇute agnidhāne
children.translated_text: May the winged missile not harm us; may the carrion-eater place its foot in the fireplace.

children.text: śivo gobhya uta puruṣebhyo no astu mā no devā iha hiṃsīt kapota ||
children.translated_text: May it be auspicious for our cattle and also for our men; O gods, let the pigeon not injure us here.

children.text: Chapter 201
ṛcā kapotaṃ nudata praṇodam iṣaṃ madantaḥ pari gāṃ nayāmaḥ
children.translated_text: With a verse drive the pigeon away, drive it forth; rejoicing in nourishment, we lead the cow around.

children.text: saṃlobhayanto duritā padāni hitvā na ūrjaṃ pra padāt pathiṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Enticing away the footprints of misfortune, having left us, may the best finder of paths go forth to nourishment.

children.text: parīme 'gnim arṣata parīme gām aneṣata
children.translated_text: These have flowed around <s>Agni</s>; these have led the cow around.

children.text: deveṣv akrata śravaḥ ka imāṁ ā dadharṣati ||
children.translated_text: They have made fame among the gods; who dares this?

children.text: yaḥ prathamaḥ pravatam āsasāda bahubhyaḥ panthām anupaspaśānaḥ
children.translated_text: He who first sat down upon the slope, not looking out a path for many,

children.text: yo 'syeśe dvipado yaś catuṣpadas tasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave ||
children.translated_text: who rules this two-footed and four-footed world, to that <s>Yama</s>, to Death, let there be homage.

children.text: Chapter 202
amūn hetiḥ patatriṇī ny etu yad ulūko vadati mogham etat
children.translated_text: Let the flying missile go down upon those others; what the owl says is vain,

children.text: yad vā kapota padam agnau kṛṇoti ||
children.translated_text: or what the pigeon makes as a footprint in the fire.

children.text: yau te dūtau nirṛta idam eto 'prahitau prahitau vā gṛhaṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: Those two messengers of yours, O <s>Nirṛti</s>, who have come here to our house, whether unsent or sent,

children.text: kapotolūkābhyām apadaṃ tad astu ||
children.translated_text: through the pigeon and the owl, let that be without footing.

children.text: avairahatyāyedam ā papatyāt suvīratāyā idam ā sasadyāt
children.translated_text: May this fly down for freedom from slaughter by enemies; may this settle here for possession of good heroes.

children.text: parāṅ eva parā vada parācīm anu saṃvatam
children.translated_text: Speak away, only away; speak in the opposite direction, following a reversed course.

children.text: yathā yamasya tvā gṛhe 'rasaṃ praticākaśān ābhūkaṃ praticākaśān ||
children.translated_text: Just as in the house of <s>Yama</s> I behold you sapless, I behold you abject.

children.text: Chapter 203
devā imaṃ madhunā saṃyutaṃ yavaṃ sarasvatyām adhi maṇāv acarkṛṣuḥ
children.translated_text: The gods have anointed this barley, joined with honey, upon the jewel in <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: indra āsīt sīrapatiḥ śatakratuḥ kīnāśā āsan marutaḥ sudānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the hundred-powered, was lord of the plough; the generous <s>Maruts</s> were the ploughmen.

children.text: yas te mado 'vakeśo vikeśo yenābhihasyaṃ puruṣaṃ kṛṇoṣi
children.translated_text: That intoxication of yours, hair-loosening and hair-scattering, by which you make a man laughable,

children.text: ārāt tvad anyā vanāni vṛkṣi tvaṃ śami śatavalśā vi roha ||
children.translated_text: may other woods cut themselves off far from you; you, O <s>Śamī</s>, with a hundred shoots, grow forth.

children.text: bṛhatpalāśe subhage varṣavṛddha ṛtāvari
children.translated_text: O broad-leaved, fortunate one, increased by rain, faithful to order,

children.text: māteva putrebhyo mṛḍa keśebhyaḥ śami ||
children.translated_text: like a mother to her sons, be gracious to the hair, O <s>Śamī</s>.

children.text: Chapter 204
āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnir akramīd asadan mātaram puraḥ
children.translated_text: This dappled cow has stepped forth; she has sat before her mother,

children.text: pitaram ca prayant svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and she goes on toward her father, heaven.

children.text: antaś carati rocanā asya prāṇād apānataḥ
children.translated_text: Within his shining realms he moves, from breathing out and breathing in;

children.text: vy akhyan mahiṣaḥ svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the buffalo has looked abroad over heaven.

children.text: triṃśad dhāmā vi rājati vāk pataṅgo aśiśriyat
children.translated_text: With thirty stations he shines forth; winged speech has settled down,

children.text: prati vastor ahar dyubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: at every dawn, with the days of heaven.

children.text: Chapter 205
antardāve juhuta sv etad yātudhānakṣayaṇaṃ ghṛtena
children.translated_text: Offer this in the inner forest with ghee, this destroyer of sorcerers.

children.text: ārād rakṣāṃsi prati daha tvam agne na no gṛhāṇām upa tītapāsi ||
children.translated_text: Burn the rakṣases from afar with your flame, O <s>Agni</s>; do not scorch near our houses.

children.text: rudro vo grīvā aśarait piśācāḥ pṛṣṭīr vo 'pi śṛṇātu yātudhānāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Rudra</s> has loosened your necks, O piśācas; may he also break your backs, O sorcerers.

children.text: vīrud vo viśvatovīryā yamena sam ajīgamat ||
children.translated_text: The herb of all-sided power has brought you together with <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: abhayaṃ mitrāvaruṇāv ihāstu no 'rciṣāttriṇo nudataṃ pratīcaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> give us fearlessness here; drive back the flame-eaters.

children.text: mā jñātāraṃ mā pratiṣṭhāṃ vidanta mitho vighnānā upa yantu mṛtyum ||
children.translated_text: Let them not find one who knows us, nor a footing; obstructing one another, let them go to death.

children.text: Chapter 206
yasyedam ā rajo yujas tuje janā navaṃ svaḥ
children.translated_text: This broad realm belongs to him, who yokes the expanse, for the swift people and the new heaven;

children.text: indrasya rantyaṃ bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: it is the great delight of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: nādhṛṣa ā dadhṛṣate dhṛṣāṇo dhṛṣitaḥ śavaḥ
children.translated_text: The unassailable one is not assailed; assailing, assailed is his power.

children.text: purā yathā vyathiḥ śrava indrasya nādhṛṣe śavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As of old, when fame was shaken, so is the unassailable power of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sa no dadātu tāṃ rayim uruṃ piśaṅgasaṃdṛśam
children.translated_text: May he give us that wealth, broad and tawny to behold,

children.text: indraḥ patis tuviṣṭamo janeṣv ā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the lord, most mighty among people.

children.text: Chapter 207
prāgnaye vācam īraya vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām
children.translated_text: Send forth speech to <s>Agni</s>, the bull of the settlements;

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he carry us across beyond our haters.

children.text: yo rakṣāṃsi nijūrvaty agnis tigmena śociṣā
children.translated_text: The <s>Agni</s> who subdues the rakṣases with sharp flame,

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he carry us across beyond our haters.

children.text: yaḥ parasyāḥ parāvatas tiro dhanvātirocate
children.translated_text: He who shines across the wilderness from the farther distance,

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he carry us across beyond our haters.

children.text: yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati
children.translated_text: He who looks over all beings with all-seeing powers and beholds them together,

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he carry us across beyond our haters.

children.text: yo asya pāre rajasaḥ śukro agnir ajāyata
children.translated_text: The bright <s>Agni</s> who was born beyond this expanse,

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he carry us across beyond our haters.

children.text: Chapter 208
vaiśvānaro na ūtaya ā pra yātu parāvataḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Vaiśvānara</s> come here from afar for our aids;

children.text: agnir naḥ suṣṭutīr upa ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Agni</s> come near to our well-spoken praises.

children.text: vaiśvānaro na āgamad imaṃ yajñaṃ sajūr upa
children.translated_text: <s>Vaiśvānara</s> has come to this sacrifice in accord;

children.text: agnir uktheṣv aṃhasu ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has come near to the hymns amid our distresses.

children.text: vaiśvānaro 'ṅgirasāṃ stomam ukthaṃ ca cākﾱpat
children.translated_text: <s>Vaiśvānara</s> attended to the praise and the hymn of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>;

children.text: aiṣu dyumnaṃ svar yamat ||
children.translated_text: among these he apportioned splendor and heavenly light.

children.text: Chapter 209
ṛtāvānaṃ vaiśvānaram ṛtasya jyotiṣas patim
children.translated_text: We seek <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, keeper of truth, lord of the light of truth,

children.text: ajasraṃ gharmam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: the unfailing heat.

children.text: sa viśvā prati cākﾱpa ṛtūṃr ut sṛjate vaśī
children.translated_text: He, powerful, has attended to all things and sends forth the seasons;

children.text: yajñasya vaya uttiran ||
children.translated_text: may we cross beyond the span of the sacrifice.

children.text: agniḥ pareṣu dhāmasu kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, desire of what has been and what will be, in the highest stations,

children.text: samrād eko vi rājati ||
children.translated_text: alone shines forth as sovereign king.

children.text: Chapter 210
upa prāgāt sahasrākṣo yuktvā śapatho ratham
children.translated_text: The thousand-eyed curse has come near, having yoked its chariot,

children.text: śaptāram anvichan mama vṛka ivāvimato gṛham ||
children.translated_text: seeking out my curser like a wolf seeking the house of one unprotected.

children.text: pari ṇo vṛṅgdhi śapatha hradam agnir ivā dahan
children.translated_text: Turn away around us, O curse, burning like fire around a pool;

children.text: śaptāram atra no jahi divo vṛkṣam ivāśaniḥ ||
children.translated_text: strike down our curser here, like lightning from heaven striking a tree.

children.text: yo naḥ śapād aśapataḥ śapato yaś ca naḥ śapāt
children.translated_text: Whoever curses us when we have not cursed, and whoever curses us when we curse,

children.text: śune peṣṭram ivāvakṣāmaṃ taṃ praty asyāmi mṛtyave ||
children.translated_text: I cast him forth to death like a crushing-stone for a dog.

children.text: Chapter 211
siṃhe vyāghra uta yā pṛdākau tviṣir agnau brāhmaṇe sūrye yā
children.translated_text: The fiery brilliance that is in lion, tiger, and serpent, in fire, in the brahmin, and in the sun,

children.text: indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā ||
children.translated_text: the blessed goddess who gave birth to <s>Indra</s>, may she come to us, united with splendor.

children.text: yā hastini dvīpini yā hiraṇye tviṣir apsu goṣu yā puruṣeṣu
children.translated_text: The fiery brilliance that is in elephant and panther, in gold, in waters, in cows, and in men,

children.text: indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā ||
children.translated_text: the blessed goddess who gave birth to <s>Indra</s>, may she come to us, united with splendor.

children.text: rathe akṣeṣv ṛṣabhasya vāje vāte parjanye varuṇasya śuṣme
children.translated_text: In the chariot, in the axles, in the bull's vigor, in the wind, in <s>Parjanya</s>, in <s>Varuṇa</s>'s might,

children.text: indram yā devī subhagā jajāna sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā ||
children.translated_text: the goddess who gave birth to <s>Indra</s>, may she come to us, united with splendor.

children.text: rājanye dundubhāv āyatāyām aśvasya vāje puruṣasya māyau
children.translated_text: In the noble warrior, in the stretched war-drum, in the horse's vigor, in a man's wondrous power,

children.text: indram yā devī subhagā jajāna sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā ||
children.translated_text: the goddess who gave birth to <s>Indra</s>, may she come to us, united with splendor.

children.text: Chapter 212
yaśo havir vardhatām indrajūtaṃ sahasravīryaṃ subhṛtaṃ sahaskṛtam
children.translated_text: May fame, the oblation impelled by <s>Indra</s>, grow, possessed of a thousand powers, well sustained and made strong;

children.text: prasarsrāṇam anu dīrghāya cakṣase haviṣmantaṃ mā vardhaya jyeṣṭhatātaye ||
children.translated_text: flowing forth for long sight, rich in oblation, increase me for preeminence.

children.text: acchā na indraṃ yaśasaṃ yaśobhir yaśasvinaṃ namasānā vidhema
children.translated_text: With acts of homage and with fame, let us worship <s>Indra</s>, the famous, the fame-bearing one;

children.text: sa no rāsva rāṣṭram indrajūtaṃ tasya te rātau yaśasaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: grant us the kingdom impelled by <s>Indra</s>; in your giving may we be possessed of fame.

children.text: yaśā indro yaśā agnir yaśāḥ somo ajāyata
children.translated_text: As fame <s>Indra</s> was born; as fame <s>Agni</s>, as fame <s>Soma</s> came into being;

children.text: yaśā viśvasya bhūtasya aham asmi yaśastamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as the fame of every creature, I am the most famous.

children.text: Chapter 213
abhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ihāstu no 'bhayaṃ somaḥ savitā naḥ kṛṇotu
children.translated_text: May heaven and earth be fearlessness for us here; may <s>Soma</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s> make fearlessness for us;

children.text: abhayaṃ no 'stūrv antarikṣaṃ saptarṣīṇāṃ ca haviṣābhayaṃ no astu ||
children.translated_text: may the wide midspace be fearlessness for us, and may there be fearlessness for us through the oblation of the <s>Seven Seers</s>.

children.text: asmai grāmāya pradiśaś catasra ūrjaṃ subhūtaṃ svasti savitā naḥ kṛṇotu
children.translated_text: For this village and the four directions, may <s>Savitṛ</s> make nourishment, good being, and welfare for us;

children.text: aśatrv indro abhayaṃ naḥ kṛṇotv anyatra rājñām abhi yātu manyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Indra</s> make us without enemies and fearless; let the wrath of kings go elsewhere.

children.text: anamitraṃ no adharād anamitraṃ na uttarāt
children.translated_text: Let there be no enemy for us from below, no enemy for us from above;

children.text: indrānamitraṃ naḥ paścād anamitraṃ puras kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, make us without enemies from behind and without enemies in front.

children.text: Chapter 214
manase cetase dhiya ākūtaya uta cittaye
children.translated_text: To mind, to consciousness, to thought, to intentions, and also to awareness,

children.text: matyai śrutāya cakṣase vidhema haviṣā vayam ||
children.translated_text: to understanding, hearing, and sight, we worship with oblation.

children.text: apānāya vyānāya prāṇāya bhūridhāyase
children.translated_text: To the downward breath, the diffused breath, and the vital breath, to the one who bears abundance,

children.text: sarasvatyā uruvyace vidhema haviṣā vayam ||
children.translated_text: to wide-moving <s>Sarasvatī</s>, we worship with oblation.

children.text: mā no hāsiṣur ṛṣayo daivyā ye tanūpā ye nas tanvas tanūjāḥ
children.translated_text: May the divine seers not abandon us, those body-protectors who are born of our body;

children.text: amartyā martyāṁ abhi naḥ sacadhvam āyur dhatta prataraṃ jīvase naḥ ||
children.translated_text: immortal ones, attend upon us mortals; set life farther onward for us, so that we may live.

children.text: Chapter 215
ava jyām iva dhanvano manyuṃ tanomi te hṛdaḥ
children.translated_text: Like the bowstring from a bow, I stretch the anger away from your heart,

children.text: yathā saṃmanasau bhūtvā sakhāyāv iva sacāvahai ||
children.translated_text: so that, having become of one mind, we two may associate like friends.

children.text: sakhāyāv iva sacāvahā ava manyuṃ tanomi te
children.translated_text: May we two associate like friends; I stretch the anger away from you;

children.text: adhas te aśmano manyum upāsyāmasi yo guruḥ ||
children.translated_text: beneath you, under a stone, we place that heavy anger.

children.text: abhi tiṣṭhāmi te manyuṃ pārṣṇyā prapadena ca
children.translated_text: I stand upon your anger with heel and with forefoot,

children.text: yathāvaśo na vādiṣo mama cittam upāyasi ||
children.translated_text: so that, not speaking against my will, you may come into my thought.

children.text: Chapter 216
ayaṃ darbho vimanyukaḥ svāya cāraṇāya ca
children.translated_text: This darbha grass removes anger, both for one's own conduct and for another's;

children.text: manyor vimanyukasyāyaṃ manyuśamana ucyate ||
children.translated_text: this is called the anger-appeaser of anger bereft of anger.

children.text: ayaṃ yo bhūrimūlaḥ samudram avatiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: This one of many roots stands down to the ocean;

children.text: darbhaḥ pṛthivyā utthito manyuśamana ucyate ||
children.translated_text: the darbha that has risen from the earth is called the anger-appeaser.

children.text: vi te hanavyāṃ śaraṇiṃ vi te mukhyāṃ nayāmasi
children.translated_text: I draw apart the hinge of your jaw; I draw apart what is in your mouth,

children.text: yathāvaśo na vādiṣo mama cittam upāyasi ||
children.translated_text: so that, not speaking against my will, you may come into my thought.

children.text: Chapter 217
asthād dyaur asthāt pṛthivy asthād viśvam idaṃ jagat
children.translated_text: Heaven has stood still, earth has stood still, this whole moving world has stood still;

children.text: asthur vṛkṣā ūrdhvasvapnās tiṣṭhād rogo ayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: the trees, sleeping upright, have stood still; let this disease of yours stand still.

children.text: śataṃ yā bheṣajāni te sahasraṃ saṃgatāni ca
children.translated_text: A hundred remedies are yours, and a thousand that are gathered together;

children.text: śreṣṭham āsrāvabheṣajaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ roganāśanam ||
children.translated_text: the best remedy for discharge, the most excellent destroyer of disease.

children.text: rudrasya mūtram asy amṛtasya nābhiḥ
children.translated_text: You are the urine of <s>Rudra</s>, the navel of immortality;

children.text: viṣāṇakā nāma vā asi pitṝṇāṃ mūlād utthitā vātīkṛtanāśanī ||
children.translated_text: or you are named <s>Viṣāṇakā</s>, risen from the root of the Fathers, destroyer of what is caused by wind.

children.text: Chapter 218
paro 'pehi manaspāpa kim aśastāni śaṃsasi
children.translated_text: Go away, evil thought of the mind; why do you speak inauspicious things?

children.text: parehi na tvā kāmaye vṛkṣāṁ vanāni saṃ cara gṛheṣu goṣu me manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Go away; I do not desire you. Roam among trees and forests; my mind is on houses and cattle.

children.text: avaśasā niḥśasā yat parāśasopārima jāgrato yat svapantaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever by helpless utterance, by bad utterance, by hostile speech, whatever while waking or while sleeping,

children.text: agnir viśvāny apa duṣkṛtāny ajuṣṭāny āre asmad dadhātu ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Agni</s> set all evil deeds, unwelcome things, far away from us.

children.text: yad indra brahmaṇaspate 'pi mṛṣā carāmasi
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, we act falsely at all,

children.text: pracetā na āṅgiraso duritāt pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the wise <s>Āṅgirasa</s> protect us from misfortune and from distress.

children.text: Chapter 219
yo na jīvo 'si na mṛto devānām amṛtagarbho 'si svapna
children.translated_text: You who are neither alive nor dead, you are the deathless embryo of the gods, O <s>Svapna</s>;

children.text: varuṇānī te mātā yamaḥ pitārarur nāmāsi ||
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇānī</s> is your mother, <s>Yama</s> your father; your name is <s>Araru</s>.

children.text: vidma te svapna janitraṃ devajāmīnāṃ putro 'si yamasya karaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: We know your birthplace, O <s>Svapna</s>: you are the son of the divine sisters, the instrument of <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: antako 'si mṛtyur asi taṃ tvā svapna tathā saṃ vidma sa naḥ svapna duṣvapnyāt pāhi ||
children.translated_text: You are the ender; you are death. Thus, O dream, we understand you. O dream, protect us from bad dreams.

children.text: yathā kalāṃ yathā śaphaṃ yatharṇaṃ saṃnayanti
children.translated_text: As they gather up a portion, as a hoof, as a debt,

children.text: evā duṣvapnyaṃ sarvaṃ dviṣate saṃ nayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: so we convey every bad dream to the hater.

children.text: Chapter 220
agniḥ prātaḥsavane pātv asmān vaiśvānaro viśvakṛd viśvaśaṃbhūḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> protect us at the morning pressing, <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, all-making and all-beneficent.

children.text: sa naḥ pāvako draviṇe dadhātv āyuṣmantaḥ sahabhakṣāḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: May he, the purifier, place wealth in us; may we be long-lived and share the feast together.

children.text: viśve devā maruta indro asmān asmin dvitīye savane na jahyuḥ
children.translated_text: May all the gods, the <s>Maruts</s>, and <s>Indra</s> not abandon us at this second pressing.

children.text: āyuṣmantaḥ priyam eṣāṃ vadanto vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma ||
children.translated_text: Long-lived and speaking what is dear to them, may we be in the good favor of the gods.

children.text: idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ kavīnām ṛtena ye camasam airayanta
children.translated_text: This is the third pressing of the sages, who, in accordance with truth, set the cup in motion.

children.text: te saudhanvanāḥ svar ānaśānāḥ sviṣṭiṃ no abhi vasyo nayantu ||
children.translated_text: May those <s>Saudhanvanas</s>, attaining heaven, lead our well-performed rite toward better fortune.

children.text: Chapter 221
śyeno 'si gāyatrachandā anu tvā rabhe
children.translated_text: You are a falcon, having the <s>Gāyatrī</s> meter; I take hold after you.

children.text: svasti mā saṃ vahāsya yajñasyodṛci svāhā ||
children.translated_text: Carry me safely at the completion of this sacrifice: svāhā.

children.text: ṛbhur asi jagacchandā anu tvā rabhe
children.translated_text: You are <s>Ṛbhu</s>, having the <s>Jagatī</s> meter; I take hold after you.

children.text: svasti mā saṃ vahāsya yajñasyodṛci svāhā ||
children.translated_text: Carry me safely at the completion of this sacrifice: svāhā.

children.text: vṛṣāsi triṣṭupchandā anu tvā rabhe
children.translated_text: You are a bull, having the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> meter; I take hold after you.

children.text: svasti mā saṃ vahāsya yajñasyodṛci svāhā ||
children.translated_text: Carry me safely at the completion of this sacrifice: svāhā.

children.text: Chapter 222
nahi te agne tanvaḥ krūram ānaṃśa martyaḥ
children.translated_text: For no mortal, O <s>Agni</s>, has reached the terrible force of your body.

children.text: kapir babhasti tejanaṃ svaṃ jarāyu gaur iva ||
children.translated_text: The monkey bites the goad, like a cow its own afterbirth.

children.text: meṣa iva vai saṃ ca vi corv acyase yad uttaradrāv uparaś ca khādataḥ
children.translated_text: Like a ram, indeed, you move together and apart broadly, when the upper and the lower eat.

children.text: śīrṣṇā śiro 'psasāpso ardayann aṃśūn babhasti haritebhir āsabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With head against head, crushing the fluids, he gnaws the fibers with his tawny mouths.

children.text: suparṇā vācam akratopa dyavy ākhare kṛṣṇā iṣirā anartiṣuḥ
children.translated_text: The well-winged ones made speech; near heaven, at the axle, the black, eager ones danced.

children.text: ni yan niyanti uparasya niṣkṛtiṃ purū reto dadhire sūryaśritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When they lead down to the removal of what is above, they placed abundant seed, resting on the sun.

children.text: Chapter 223
hataṃ tardaṃ samaṅkam ākhum aśvinā chintaṃ śiro api pṛṣṭīḥ śṛṇītam
children.translated_text: Slay the <s>tarda</s>, the <s>samaṅka</s>, and the mouse, O <s>Aśvins</s>; cut off the head and crush the ribs too.

children.text: yavān ned adān api nahyataṃ mukham athābhayaṃ kṛṇutaṃ dhānyāya ||
children.translated_text: Bind up their mouths, lest they eat the barley; then make the grain free from fear.

children.text: tarda hai pataṅga hai jabhya hā upakvasa
children.translated_text: O <s>tarda</s>, O winged one, O <s>jabhya</s>, O <s>upakvasa</s>, strike!

children.text: brahmevāsaṃsthitaṃ havir anadanta imān yavān ahiṃsanto apodita ||
children.translated_text: Like an oblation set in sacred utterance, go away from these barley grains without eating and without harming them.

children.text: tardāpate vaghāpate tṛṣṭajambhā ā śṛṇota me
children.translated_text: O lord of the <s>tarda</s>, O lord of the <s>vaghā</s>, with crushed jaws, listen to me.

children.text: ya āraṇyā vyadvarā ye ke ca stha vyadvarās tānt sarvān jambhayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: Those that are wild hole-makers, and whatever hole-makers there are, all those we make gape and fall powerless.

children.text: Chapter 224
vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa pratyaṅ somo ati drutaḥ
children.translated_text: Purified by the purifier of <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Soma</s> has rushed onward,

children.text: indrasya yujaḥ sakhā ||
children.translated_text: the yokemate and friend of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: āpo asmān mātaraḥ sūdayantu ghṛtena no ghṛtapvaḥ punantu
children.translated_text: May the waters, our mothers, refresh us; may the ghee-purifying ones purify us with ghee.

children.text: viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devīr ud id ābhyaḥ śucir ā pūta emi ||
