children.translated_text: For the divine ones carry away every impurity; from them I rise cleansed and pure.

children.text: yat kiṃ cedaṃ varuṇa daivye jane 'bhidrohaṃ manuṣyāś caranti
children.translated_text: Whatever treachery this is, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, that human beings practice among the divine people,

children.text: acittyā cet tava dharma yuyopima mā nas tasmād enaso deva rīriṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: if through lack of thought we have violated your <s>dharma</s> (sacred law), O god, do not harm us because of that sin.

children.text: Chapter 225
ut sūryo diva eti puro rakṣāṃsi nijūrvan
children.translated_text: The sun rises from heaven in front, driving down the demons;

children.text: ādityaḥ parvatebhyo viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Āditya</s>, from the mountains, all-seeing and slayer of the unseen.

children.text: ni gāvo goṣṭhe asadan ni mṛgāso avikṣata
children.translated_text: The cows have settled in the cow-stall; the wild beasts have withdrawn.

children.text: ny ūrmayo nadīnāṃ ny adṛṣṭā alipsata ||
children.translated_text: The waves of the rivers have subsided; the unseen ones have slipped away.

children.text: āyurdadaṃ vipaścitaṃ śrutāṃ kaṇvasya vīrudham
children.translated_text: I have brought the life-giving, wise, renowned herb of <s>Kaṇva</s>,

children.text: ābhāriṣaṃ viśvabheṣajīm asyādṛṣṭān ni śamayat ||
children.translated_text: the all-healing one; let it quiet the unseen harms from this person.

children.text: Chapter 226
dyauś ca ma idaṃ pṛthivī ca pracetasau śukro bṛhan dakṣiṇayā pipartu
children.translated_text: May Heaven and Earth, both wise, protect this bright, great thing for me with the sacrificial gift.

children.text: anu svadhā cikitāṃ somo agnir vāyur naḥ pātu savitā bhagaś ca ||
children.translated_text: According to svadhā, may <s>Soma</s> and <s>Agni</s> be mindful; may <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s> protect us.

children.text: punaḥ prāṇaḥ punar ātmā na aitu punaś cakṣuḥ punar asur na aitu
children.translated_text: May breath return; may the self return to us; may sight return; may vital force return.

children.text: vaiśvānaro no adabdhas tanūpā antas tiṣṭhāti duritāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, uninjured, protector of the body, stand within us against all misfortunes.

children.text: saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tanūbhir aganmahi manasā saṃ śivena
children.translated_text: We have come together with splendor, with sap, with bodies, and with an auspicious mind.

children.text: tvaṣṭā no atra varīyaḥ kṛṇotv anu no mārṣṭu tanvo yad viriṣṭam ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> make what is better for us here; may he wipe away from our body whatever has been injured.

children.text: Chapter 227
idaṃ tad yuja uttaram indraṃ śumbhāmy aṣṭaye
children.translated_text: This indeed is the higher one of the pair; I adorn <s>Indra</s> for help.

children.text: asya kṣatraṃ śriyaṃ mahīṃ vṛṣṭir iva vardhayā tṛṇam ||
children.translated_text: Increase his dominion and his great splendor, as rain increases the grass.

children.text: asmai kṣatram agnīṣomāv asmai dhārayataṃ rayim
children.translated_text: For this man, O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, for this man sustain dominion and wealth.

children.text: imaṃ rāṣṭrasyābhīvarge kṛṇutam yuja uttaram ||
children.translated_text: Make this man, in the encompassing of the kingdom, the higher one of the pair.

children.text: sabandhuś cāsabandhuś ca yo asmāṁ abhidāsati
children.translated_text: The kinsman and the non-kinsman, whoever plots against us,

children.text: sarvaṃ taṃ randhayāsi me yajamānāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: all him you make subject to me, the sacrificer who presses <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 228
ye panthāno bahavo devayānā antarā dyāvāpṛthivī saṃcaranti
children.translated_text: The many god-going paths that move between heaven and earth,

children.text: teṣām ajyāniṃ yatamo vahāti tasmai mā devāḥ pari datteha sarve ||
children.translated_text: whichever of them carries freedom from loss, to that path let all the gods here hand me over.

children.text: grīṣmo hemantaḥ śiśiro vasantaḥ śarad varṣāḥ svite no dadhāta
children.translated_text: Summer, winter, the cold season, spring, autumn, and the rains: place well-being in us.

children.text: ā no goṣu bhajatā prajāyāṃ nivāta id vaḥ śaraṇe syāma ||
children.translated_text: Assign us a share among cattle and offspring; may we be in your windless shelter.

children.text: idāvatsarāya parivatsarāya saṃvatsarāya kṛṇutā bṛhan namaḥ
children.translated_text: For the <s>Idāvatsara</s>, the <s>Parivatsara</s>, and the <s>Saṃvatsara</s>, make great homage.

children.text: teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyānām api bhadre saumanase syāma ||
children.translated_text: May we be in the good favor and auspicious graciousness of those worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 229
mā no devā ahir vadhīt satokānt sahapuruṣān
children.translated_text: May the serpent, O gods, not kill us, together with our children and our men.

children.text: saṃyataṃ na vi ṣparad vyāttaṃ na saṃ yaman namo devajanebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the bound one not burst apart; may the gaping one not close upon us. Homage to the divine beings.

children.text: namo 'stv asitāya namas tiraścirājaye
children.translated_text: Homage be to the black one; homage to the cross-striped one.

children.text: svajāya babhrave namo namo devajanebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Homage to the self-born brown one; homage, homage to the divine beings.

children.text: saṃ te hanmi datā dataḥ sam u te hanvā hanū
children.translated_text: I strike your tooth together with tooth; I also strike your two jaws together with jaws.

children.text: saṃ te jihvayā jihvāṃ sam v āsnāha āsyam ||
children.translated_text: I strike your tongue together with tongue, your mouth together with mouth.

children.text: Chapter 230
idam id vā u bheṣajam idaṃ rudrasya bheṣajam
children.translated_text: This indeed is the medicine; this is <s>Rudra</s>'s medicine,

children.text: yeneṣum ekatejanāṃ śataśalyām apabravat ||
children.translated_text: by which he drove away the one-pointed, hundred-barbed arrow.

children.text: jālāṣeṇābhi ṣiñcata jālāṣeṇopa siñcata
children.translated_text: Sprinkle with <s>jālāṣa</s>; pour over with <s>jālāṣa</s>.

children.text: jālāṣam ugraṃ bheṣajaṃ tena no mṛḍa jīvase ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jālāṣa</s> is a fierce medicine; with it be gracious to us for life.

children.text: śaṃ ca no mayaś ca no mā ca naḥ kiṃ canāmamat
children.translated_text: May blessing and delight be ours; may nothing at all be lacking or hostile to us.

children.text: kṣamā rapo viśvaṃ no astu bheṣajaṃ sarvaṃ no astu bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: May forbearance and the waters be medicine for us; may everything be medicine for us.

children.text: Chapter 231
yaśasaṃ mendro maghavān kṛṇotu yaśasaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe ime
children.translated_text: May bountiful <s>Indra</s> make me famed; may these two, heaven and earth, make me famed.

children.text: yaśasaṃ mā devaḥ savitā kṛṇotu priyo dātur dakṣiṇāyā iha syām ||
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Savitṛ</s> make me famed; may I be dear here to the giver of the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift).

children.text: yathendro dyāvāpṛthivyor yaśasvān yathāpa oṣadhīṣu yaśasvatīḥ
children.translated_text: As <s>Indra</s> is glorious in heaven and earth, as the waters are glorious among the plants,

children.text: evā viśveṣu deveṣu vayaṃ sarveṣu yaśasaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: so among all the gods, among all, may we be possessed of fame.

children.text: yaśā indro yaśā agnir yaśāḥ somo ajāyata
children.translated_text: Fame was born as <s>Indra</s>, fame as <s>Agni</s>, fame as <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: yaśā viśvasya bhūtasyāham asmi yaśastamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I am the fame of every being, the most famed of all.

children.text: Chapter 232
anaḍudbhyas tvaṃ prathamaṃ dhenubhyas tvam arundhati
children.translated_text: You are first among the oxen; you are among the cows, O <s>Arundhatī</s>.

children.text: adhenave vayase śarma yaccha catuṣpade ||
children.translated_text: Grant shelter to the milkless cow, to the young creature, and to the four-footed one.

children.text: śarma yacchatv oṣadhiḥ saha devīr arundhatī
children.translated_text: Let the plants together with the divine <s>Arundhatī</s> grant shelter.

children.text: karat payasvantaṃ goṣṭham ayakṣmāṁ uta pūruṣān ||
children.translated_text: Let her make the cow-pen full of milk, and the men free from disease.

children.text: viśvarūpāṃ subhagām acchāvadāmi jīvalām
children.translated_text: I call hither the many-formed, fortunate, kindly speaking, life-giving one.

children.text: sā no rudrasyāstāṃ hetiṃ dūraṃ nayatu gobhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May she carry <s>Rudra</s>'s missile far away from our cattle.

children.text: Chapter 233
ayam ā yāty aryamā purastād viṣitastupaḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Aryaman</s> comes from the east, with loosened topknot,

children.text: asyā icchann agruvai patim uta jāyām ajānaye ||
children.translated_text: seeking a desired husband for this unmarried girl, and a wife for the unmarried man.

children.text: aśramad iyam aryamann anyāsāṃ samanaṃ yatī
children.translated_text: This woman has wearied herself, O <s>Aryaman</s>, going to the assembly of others.

children.text: aṅgo nv aryamann asyā anyāḥ samanam āyati ||
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Aryaman</s>, let the other women come to her assembly.

children.text: dhātā dādhāra pṛthivīm dhātā dyām uta sūryam
children.translated_text: <s>Dhātṛ</s> upheld the earth; <s>Dhātṛ</s> upheld heaven and the sun.

children.text: dhātāsyā agruvai patim dadhātu pratikāmyam ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Dhātṛ</s> assign to this unmarried girl a husband according to her desire.

children.text: Chapter 234
mahyam āpo madhumad erayantāṃ mahyaṃ sūro abharaj jyotiṣe kam
children.translated_text: For me may the waters send forth sweetness; for me the sun has brought light.

children.text: mahyaṃ devā uta viśve tapojā mahyaṃ devaḥ savitā vyaco dhāt ||
children.translated_text: For me may the gods, all those born of fervor, and for me the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, establish wide space.

children.text: ahaṃ viveca pṛthivīm uta dyām aham ṛtūṃr ajanayaṃ sapta sākam
children.translated_text: I have set apart earth and heaven; I have generated the seasons, the seven together.

children.text: ahaṃ satyam anṛtaṃ yad vadāmy ahaṃ daivīṃ pari vācam viśaś ca ||
children.translated_text: I speak what is true and what is untrue; I encompass divine speech and the peoples.

children.text: ahaṃ jajāna pṛthivīm uta dyām aham ṛtūṃr ajanayaṃ sapta sindhūn
children.translated_text: I have generated earth and heaven; I have generated the seasons and the seven rivers.

children.text: ahaṃ satvam anṛtaṃ yad vadāmi yo agnīṣomāv ajuṣe sakhāyā ||
children.translated_text: I speak what is real and what is untrue, I who have chosen <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s> as friends.

children.text: Chapter 235
vaiśvānaro raśmibhir naḥ punātu vātaḥ prāṇeneṣiro nabhobhiḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Vaiśvānara</s> purify us with his rays; may <s>Vāta</s>, swift with breath, purify us through the spaces.

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivī payasā payasvatī ṛtāvarī yajñiye na punītām ||
children.translated_text: May heaven and earth, rich in milk, truth-keeping and fit for sacrifice, purify us with milk.

children.text: vaiśvānarīṃ sūnṛtām ā rabhadhvaṃ yasyā āśās tanvo vītapṛṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: Take hold of the kindly speech of <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, whose hopes are embodied and broad-backed.

children.text: tayā gṛṇantaḥ sadhamādeṣu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīnām ||
children.translated_text: Praising with it at the common feasts, may we become lords of riches.

children.text: vaiśvānarīṃ varcasa ā rabhadhvaṃ śuddhā bhavantaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ
children.translated_text: Take hold of the splendor of <s>Vaiśvānara</s>; become pure, bright, and cleansing.

children.text: iheḍayā sadhamādaṃ madanto jyok paśyema sūryam uccarantam ||
children.translated_text: Rejoicing here with <s>Iḍā</s> in the common feast, may we long behold the rising sun.

children.text: Chapter 236
yat te devī nirṛtir ābabandha dāma grīvāsv avimokyaṃ yat
children.translated_text: The bond that the goddess <s>Nirṛti</s> has fastened upon your necks, the unloosenable snare,

children.text: tat te vi ṣyāmy āyuṣe varcase balāyādomadam annam addhi prasūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that I untie for you, for life, brilliance, and strength; released, eat the food that gives vigor.

children.text: namo 'stu te nirṛte tigmatejo 'yasmayān vi cṛtā bandhapāśān
children.translated_text: Homage be to you, O <s>Nirṛti</s> of sharp splendor; cut apart the iron binding snares.

children.text: yamo mahyam punar it tvām dadāti tasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave ||
children.translated_text: <s>Yama</s> gives you back to me again; homage to that <s>Yama</s>, to death.

children.text: ayasmaye drupade bedhiṣa ihābhihito mṛtyubhir ye sahasram
children.translated_text: In an iron fetter you were bound here, encompassed by a thousand deaths.

children.text: yamena tvaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāna uttamaṃ nākam adhi rohayemam ||
children.translated_text: In agreement with <s>Yama</s> and the Fathers, may we raise this one to the highest heaven.

children.text: saṃ sam id yuvase vṛṣann agne viśvāny arya ā
children.translated_text: You kindle yourself fully, O strong <s>Agni</s>, for every noble good.

children.text: iḍas pade sam idhyase sa no vasūny ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: You are kindled at the seat of <s>Iḍā</s>; bring us treasures.

children.text: Chapter 237
saṃ jānīdhvaṃ saṃ pṛcyadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānatām
children.translated_text: Be united; speak together; let your minds know together.

children.text: devā bhāgaṃ yathā pūrve saṃjānānā upāsate ||
children.translated_text: As the gods of old, being of one accord, attend upon their portion.

children.text: samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānaṃ vrataṃ saha cittam eṣām
children.translated_text: Common is their counsel, common their assembly, common their vow, and their thought together.

children.text: samānena vo haviṣā juhomi samānaṃ ceto abhisaṃviśadhvam ||
children.translated_text: With a common oblation I sacrifice for you; enter into a common mind.

children.text: samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ
children.translated_text: Let your intention be common; let your hearts be common.

children.text: samānam astu vo manaḥ yathā vaḥ susahāsati ||
children.translated_text: Let your mind be common, so that it may be easy for you to live together.

children.text: Chapter 238
ava manyur avāyatāva bāhū manoyujā
children.translated_text: Let anger go down, let their arms go down, yoked by the mind.

children.text: parāśara tvaṃ teṣām parāñcaṃ śuṣmam ardayādhā no rayim ā kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Parāśara</s>, crush their forward force away, and then bring wealth to us.

children.text: nirhastebhyo nairhastam yaṃ devāḥ śarum asyatha
children.translated_text: From the handless ones I take handlessness, the missile which the gods cast at this one.

children.text: vṛścāmi śatrūṇāṃ bāhūn anena haviṣāham ||
children.translated_text: With this oblation I cut off the arms of the enemies.

children.text: indraś cakāra prathamaṃ nairhastam asurebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> first made handlessness for the Asuras.

children.text: jayantu satvāno mama sthireṇendreṇa medinā ||
children.translated_text: May my warriors conquer, with firm <s>Indra</s> as their ally.

children.text: Chapter 239
nirhastaḥ śatrur abhidāsann astu ye senābhir yudham āyanty asmān
children.translated_text: Let the attacking enemy be handless, those who come against us to battle with armies.

children.text: sam arpayendra mahatā vadhena drātv eṣām aghahāro vividdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, hand them over to a great blow; swiftly let their evil-bearer be pierced.

children.text: ātanvānā āyacchanto 'syanto ye ca dhāvatha
children.translated_text: You who are stretching bows, drawing them, shooting, and you who run,

children.text: nirhastāḥ śatravaḥ sthanendro vo 'dya parāśarīt ||
children.translated_text: stand handless, O enemies; <s>Indra</s> has crushed you today.

children.text: nirhastāḥ santu śatravo 'ṅgaiṣāṃ mlāpayāmasi
children.translated_text: Let the enemies be handless; we make their limbs wither.

children.text: athaiṣām indra vedāṃsi śataśo vi bhajāmahai ||
children.translated_text: Then, O <s>Indra</s>, let us divide their possessions by the hundreds.

children.text: Chapter 240
pari vartmāni sarvata indraḥ pūṣā ca sasratuḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s> run around all the roads on every side.

children.text: muhyantv adyāmūḥ senā amitrāṇāṃ parastarām ||
children.translated_text: Let those armies of the enemies today become bewildered, far away beyond us.

children.text: mūḍhā amitrāś caratāśīrṣāṇa ivāhayaḥ
children.translated_text: Bewildered enemies, move about like headless serpents.

children.text: teṣāṃ vo agnimūḍhānām indro hantu varaṃ varam ||
children.translated_text: Of them, bewildered by fire, may <s>Indra</s> strike down the best, one by one.

children.text: aiṣu nahya vṛṣājinaṃ hariṇasya bhiyaṃ kṛdhi
children.translated_text: Fasten the bull-hide upon them; make in them the terror of the deer.

children.text: parāṅ amitra eṣatv arvācī gaur upeṣatu ||
children.translated_text: Let the enemy go away turned backward; let the cow come near toward us.

children.text: Chapter 241
āyam agant savitā kṣureṇoṣṇena vāya udakenehi
children.translated_text: This <s>Savitṛ</s> has come with the razor; come here with warm air and with water.

children.text: ādityā rudrā vasava undantu sacetasaḥ somasya rājño vapata pracetasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, and <s>Vasus</s>, of one mind, moisten him; shave for King <s>Soma</s>, O wise ones.

children.text: aditiḥ śmaśru vapatv āpa undantu varcasā
children.translated_text: Let <s>Aditi</s> shave the beard; let the waters moisten him with brilliance.

children.text: cikitsatu prajāpatir dīrghāyutvāya cakṣase ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Prajāpati</s> tend him for long life and for sight.

children.text: yenāvapat savitā kṣureṇa somasya rājño varuṇasya vidvān
children.translated_text: With the razor with which <s>Savitṛ</s> shaved, knowing of King <s>Soma</s> and of <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: tena brahmāṇo vapatedam asya gomān aśvavān ayam astu prajāvān ||
children.translated_text: with that let the Brahmans shave this man; may he be rich in cows, rich in horses, and rich in offspring.

children.text: Chapter 242
girāv aragarāṭeṣu hiraṇye goṣu yad yaśaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever fame is on the mountain, in the rugged places, in gold, and in cows,

children.text: surāyāṃ sicyamānāyāṃ kīlāle madhu tan mayi ||
children.translated_text: whatever is in liquor as it is poured, in sweet drink and in honey, may that be in me.

children.text: aśvinā sāragheṇa mā madhunāṅktaṃ śubhas patī
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, lords of beauty, anoint me with honey from the bees,

children.text: yathā bhargasvatīṃ vācam āvadāni janāṁ anu ||
children.translated_text: so that I may speak among people with speech endowed with radiance.

children.text: mayi varco atho yaśo 'tho yajñasya yat payaḥ
children.translated_text: May brilliance be in me, and fame, and also whatever milk-like essence belongs to the sacrifice.

children.text: tan mayi prajāpatir divi dyām iva dṛṃhatu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Prajāpati</s> make that firm in me, as he makes heaven firm in the sky.

children.text: Chapter 243
yathā māṃsam yathā surā yathākṣā adhidevane
children.translated_text: As with meat, as with liquor, as with dice on the gaming board,

children.text: yathā puṃso vṛṣaṇyata striyāṃ nihanyate manaḥ
children.translated_text: as a man's lusting mind is fixed upon a woman,

children.text: evā te aghnye mano 'dhi vatse ni hanyatām ||
children.translated_text: so, O inviolable cow, may your mind be fixed upon the calf.

children.text: yathā hastī hastinyāḥ padena padam udyuje
children.translated_text: As an elephant fits its foot to the foot of an elephant-cow,

children.text: yathā puṃso vṛṣaṇyata striyāṃ nihanyate manaḥ
children.translated_text: as a man's lusting mind is fixed upon a woman,

children.text: evā te aghnye mano 'dhi vatse ni hanyatām ||
children.translated_text: so, O inviolable cow, may your mind be fixed upon the calf.

children.text: yathā pradhir yathopadhir yathā nabhyaṃ pradhāv adhi
children.translated_text: As the rim, as the felly, and as the hub are set upon the rim,

children.text: yathā puṃso vṛṣaṇyata striyāṃ nihanyate manaḥ
children.translated_text: as a man's lusting mind is fixed upon a woman,

children.text: evā te aghnye mano 'dhi vatse ni hanyatām ||
children.translated_text: so, O inviolable cow, may your mind be fixed upon the calf.

children.text: Chapter 244
yad annam admi bahudhā virūpaṃ hiraṇyam aśvam uta gām ajām avim
children.translated_text: Whatever food I eat, manifold and various, and whatever gold, horse, cow, goat, or sheep,

children.text: yad eva kiṃ ca pratijagrahāham agniṣ ṭaddhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: whatever at all I have accepted, may <s>Agni</s> as Hotṛ make that well-offered.

children.text: yan mā hutam ahutam ājagāma dattaṃ pitṛbhir anumataṃ manuṣyaiḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever has come to me as offered or unoffered, given with the Fathers' consent and by men,

children.text: yasmān me mana ud iva rārajīty agniṣ ṭaddhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: that by which my mind quivers upward, may <s>Agni</s> as Hotṛ make that well-offered.

children.text: yad annam admy anṛtena devā dāsyann adāsyann uta saṃgṛṇāmi
children.translated_text: Whatever food I eat with untruth, O gods, whether promising to give, not promising to give, or commending it,

children.text: vaiśvānarasya mahato mahimnā śivaṃ mahyaṃ madhumad astv annam ||
children.translated_text: by the greatness of mighty <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, may the food be auspicious and honey-sweet for me.

children.text: Chapter 245
yathāsitaḥ prathayate vaśāṁ anu vapūṃṣi kṛṇvann asurasya māyayā
children.translated_text: As the dark one spreads himself after the cow, making forms by the Asura's magic,

children.text: evā te śepaḥ sahasāyam arko 'ṅgenāṅgaṃ saṃsamakaṃ kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: so may your member, the forceful chant, make limb joined with limb.

children.text: yathā pasas tāyādaraṃ vātena sthūlabhaṃ kṛtam
children.translated_text: As a member, swollen by wind, has been made thick and distended,

children.text: yāvat parasvataḥ pasas tāvat te vardhatāṃ pasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as far as another's member extends, so far may your member increase.

children.text: yāvadaṅgīnaṃ pārasvataṃ hāstinaṃ gārdabham ca yat
children.translated_text: As large as the member of an elephant, of an ass, and also of a vigorous horse,

children.text: yāvad aśvasya vājinas tāvat te vardhatāṃ pasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so large may your member increase.

children.text: Chapter 246
eha yātu varuṇaḥ somo agnir bṛhaspatir vasubhir eha yātu
children.translated_text: Let <s>Varuṇa</s> come here, let <s>Soma</s>, <s>Agni</s>, and <s>Bṛhaspati</s> come here with the <s>Vasus</s>.

children.text: asya śriyam upasaṃyāta sarva ugrasya cettuḥ saṃmanasaḥ sajātāḥ ||
children.translated_text: All you kinsmen of one mind, come together to the prosperity of this fierce and discerning man.

children.text: yo vaḥ śuṣmo hṛdayeṣv antar ākūtir yā vo manasi praviṣṭā
children.translated_text: The force that is within your hearts, and the intention that has entered your minds,

children.text: tānt sīvayāmi haviṣā ghṛtena mayi sajātā ramatir vo astu ||
children.translated_text: those I sew together with an oblation of ghee; O kinsmen, may your delight rest in me.

children.text: ihaiva sta māpa yātādhy asmat pūṣā parastād apatham vaḥ kṛṇotu
children.translated_text: Stay right here; do not go away from us. May <s>Pūṣan</s> make the path away harmful for you.

children.text: vāstoṣpatir anu vo johavītu mayi sajātā ramatiḥ vo astu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Vāstoṣpati</s> call after you; O kinsmen, may your delight rest in me.

children.text: Chapter 247
saṃ vaḥ pṛcyantāṃ tanvaḥ saṃ manāṃsi sam u vratā
children.translated_text: Let your bodies be joined together, your minds together, and your vows together.

children.text: sam vo 'yam brahmaṇaspatir bhagaḥ saṃ vo ajīgamat ||
children.translated_text: May this <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> and <s>Bhaga</s> bring you together.

children.text: saṃjñapanaṃ vo manaso 'tho saṃjñapanam hṛdaḥ
children.translated_text: I bring about agreement in your mind, and also agreement in your heart.

children.text: atho bhagasya yacchrāntaṃ tena saṃjñapayāmi vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And with what belongs to <s>Bhaga</s>, though it has grown weary, with that I bring you to agreement.

children.text: yathādityā vasubhiḥ saṃbabhūvur marudbhir ugrā ahṛṇīyamānāḥ
children.translated_text: As the <s>Ādityas</s> became united with the <s>Vasus</s>, and the fierce ones with the <s>Maruts</s>, without anger,

children.text: evā triṇāmann ahṛṇīyamāna imān janānt saṃmanasas kṛdhīha ||
children.translated_text: so, O three-named one, without anger, make these people here of one mind.

children.text: Chapter 248
nir amuṃ nuda okasaḥ sapatno yaḥ pṛtanyati
children.translated_text: Drive that rival out from his dwelling, the one who seeks battle.

children.text: nairbādhyena haviṣendra enaṃ parāśarīt ||
children.translated_text: With the expelling oblation, let <s>Indra</s> thrust him far away.

children.text: paramāṃ taṃ parāvatam indro nudatu vṛtrahā
children.translated_text: To the farthest distance let <s>Indra</s>, the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, drive him,

children.text: yato na punar āyati śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: from where he will not return for everlasting years.

children.text: etu tisraḥ parāvata etu pañca janāṁ ati
children.translated_text: Let him go to the three far distances; let him go beyond the five peoples.

children.text: etu tisro 'ti rocanā yato na punar āyati
children.translated_text: Let him go beyond the three luminous realms, from where he will not return,

children.text: śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyo yāvat sūryo asad divi ||
children.translated_text: for everlasting years, as long as the sun shall be in heaven.

children.text: Chapter 249
ya enaṃ pariṣīdanti samādadhati cakṣase
children.translated_text: Those who sit around this one and kindle him for sight,

children.text: saṃpreddho agnir jihvābhir ud etu hṛdayād adhi ||
children.translated_text: let the fully kindled <s>Agni</s> rise up with his tongues from the heart.

children.text: agneḥ sāṃtapanasyāham āyuṣe padam ā rabhe
children.translated_text: For life I take hold of the step of <s>Agni Sāṃtapana</s>,

children.text: addhātir yasya paśyati dhūmam udyantam āsyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: the devourer whose smoke one sees rising from his mouth.

children.text: yo asya samidhaṃ veda kṣatriyeṇa samāhitām
children.translated_text: Whoever knows this firewood of his, laid down by a Kṣatriya,

children.text: nābhihvāre padaṃ ni dadhāti sa mṛtyave ||
children.translated_text: does not set his foot down in the navel-turning place for death.

children.text: nainaṃ ghnanti paryāyiṇo na sannāṁ ava gacchati
children.translated_text: The circling powers do not slay him, nor does he go down among the exhausted.

children.text: agner yaḥ kṣatriyo vidvān nāma gṛhṇāti āyuṣe ||
children.translated_text: The Kṣatriya who, knowing, takes the name of <s>Agni</s> does so for life.

children.text: Chapter 250
asthād dyaur asthāt pṛthivy asthād viśvam idaṃ jagat
children.translated_text: Heaven stood firm; earth stood firm; this whole moving world stood firm.

children.text: āsthāne parvatā asthu sthāmny aśvāṁ atiṣṭhipam ||
children.translated_text: The mountains stood in their places; in stability I have made the horses stand.

children.text: ya udānaṭ parāyaṇaṃ ya udānaṇ nyāyanam
children.translated_text: He who has set out on the far journey, and he who has set out on the near course,

children.text: āvartanam nivartanaṃ yo gopā api taṃ huve ||
children.translated_text: the one who turns back and returns, the cowherd too, him I call.

children.text: jātavedo ni vartaya śataṃ te santv āvṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Jātavedas</s>, turn him back; may you have a hundred turnings back.

children.text: sahasraṃ ta upāvṛtas tābhir naḥ punar ā kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: May you have a thousand returnings; with them bring us back again.

children.text: Chapter 251
tena bhūtena haviṣāyam ā pyāyatāṃ punaḥ
children.translated_text: By that real oblation may this man swell again.

children.text: jāyām yām asmā āvākṣus tām rasenābhi vardhatām ||
children.translated_text: The wife whom they have brought to him, may she increase him with sap.

children.text: abhi vardhatāṃ payasābhi rāṣṭreṇa vardhatām
children.translated_text: May she increase with milk; may she increase with dominion.

children.text: rayyā sahasravarcasemau stām anupakṣitau ||
children.translated_text: With wealth and thousandfold brilliance, may these two stand undiminished.

children.text: tvaṣṭā jāyām ajanayat tvaṣṭāsyai tvāṃ patim
children.translated_text: <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> generated the wife; <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> made you her husband.

children.text: tvaṣṭā sahasram āyūṃṣi dīrgham āyuḥ kṛṇotu vām ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> make for you two a thousand life-spans and long life.

children.text: Chapter 252
ayaṃ no nabhasas patiḥ saṃsphāno abhi rakṣatu
children.translated_text: May this lord of <s>Nabhas</s>, <s>Saṃsphāna</s>, protect us as he expands.

children.text: asamātim gṛheṣu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he protect us from want in our houses.

children.text: tvaṃ no nabhasas pate ūrjaṃ gṛheṣu dhāraya
children.translated_text: O lord of <s>Nabhas</s>, hold nourishment for us in our houses.

children.text: ā puṣṭam etv ā vasu ||
children.translated_text: Let fullness come to us; let wealth come to us.

children.text: deva saṃsphāna sahasrāpoṣasyeśiṣe
children.translated_text: O god <s>Saṃsphāna</s>, you rule over thousandfold increase.

children.text: tasya no rāsva tasya no dhehi tasya te bhaktivāṃsaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: Grant that to us; bestow that upon us; may we be devoted partakers of you.

children.text: Chapter 253
antarikṣeṇa patati viśvā bhūtāvacākaśat
children.translated_text: It flies through the midspace, looking out over all beings.

children.text: śuno divyasya yan mahas tenā te haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: With that greatness of the heavenly dog, with that oblation, we would serve you ritually.

children.text: ye trayaḥ kālakāñjā divi devā iva śritāḥ
children.translated_text: Those three <s>Kālakāñjas</s> who are lodged in heaven like gods,

children.text: tānt sarvān ahva ūtaye 'smā ariṣṭatātaye ||
children.translated_text: all of them I have called for aid, for freedom from injury for us.

children.text: apsu te janma divi te sadhasthaṃ samudre antar mahimā te pṛthivyām
children.translated_text: Your birth is in the waters; your seat is in heaven; your greatness is within the ocean and upon the earth.

children.text: śuno divyasya yan mahas tenā te haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: With that greatness of the heavenly dog, with that oblation, we would serve you ritually.

children.text: Chapter 254
yantāsi yachase hastāv apa rakṣāṃsi sedhasi
children.translated_text: You are the restrainer; you stretch out your hands; you drive the <s>rakṣases</s> away.

children.text: prajāṃ dhanaṃ ca gṛhṇānaḥ parihasto abhūd ayam ||
children.translated_text: Taking hold of offspring and wealth, this <s>parihasta</s> (encircling hand-amulet) has come into being.

children.text: parihasta vi dhāraya yoniṃ garbhāya dhātave
children.translated_text: O <s>parihasta</s>, hold the womb apart, so that an embryo may be placed there.

children.text: maryāde putram ā dhehi taṃ tvam ā gamayāgame ||
children.translated_text: At the boundary place a son; bring him here, coming and coming again.

children.text: yaṃ parihastam abibhar aditiḥ putrakāmyā
children.translated_text: The <s>parihasta</s> which <s>Aditi</s>, desiring a son, bore,

children.text: tvaṣṭā tam asyā ā badhnād yathā putraṃ janāditi ||
children.translated_text: that <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> bound upon this woman, so that she might give birth to a son.

children.text: Chapter 255
āgachata āgatasya nāma gṛhṇāmy āyataḥ
children.translated_text: Come; of the one who has come, of the one approaching, I take the name.

children.text: indrasya vṛtraghno vanve vāsavasya śatakratoḥ ||
children.translated_text: I seek the favor of <s>Indra</s>, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, of the <s>Vāsava</s>, the hundred-powered one.

children.text: yena sūryāṃ sāvitrīm aśvinohatuḥ pathā
children.translated_text: By the path on which the <s>Aśvins</s> carried <s>Sūryā Sāvitrī</s>,

children.text: tena mām abravīd bhago jayām ā vahatād iti ||
children.translated_text: by that path <s>Bhaga</s> said to me: 'Let him bring a wife here.'

children.text: yas te 'ṅkuśo vasudāno bṛhann indra hiraṇyayaḥ
children.translated_text: That goad of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, bestower of wealth, great and golden,

children.text: tenā janīyate jāyāṃ mahyaṃ dhehi śacīpate ||
children.translated_text: with that, O lord of power, place a wife here for me to be born into union.

children.text: Chapter 256
apacitaḥ pra patata suparṇo vasater iva
children.translated_text: Fall away, O swellings, like a bird from its nest.

children.text: sūryaḥ kṛṇotu bheṣajaṃ candramā vo 'pochatu ||
children.translated_text: Let the sun make a remedy; let the moon drive you away.

children.text: eny ekā śyeny ekā kṛṣṇaikā rohiṇī dve
children.translated_text: One is dappled, one hawk-colored, one black, and two are red.

children.text: sarvāsām agrabhaṃ nāmāvīraghnīr apetana ||
children.translated_text: I have seized the name of all of them; go away, not slaying men.

children.text: asūtikā rāmāyaṇy apacit pra patiṣyati
children.translated_text: The barren one, the dark one, the swelling, will fall away,

children.text: glaur itaḥ pra patiṣyati sa galunto naśiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: the tumor will fall away from here; that swelling will perish.

children.text: vīhi svām āhutiṃ juṣāṇo manasā svāhā manasā yad idaṃ juhomi ||
children.translated_text: Enjoy your own oblation, accepting it with the mind: svāhā to the mind, for what I offer with the mind.

children.text: Chapter 257
yasyās ta āsani ghore juhomy eṣāṃ baddhānām avasarjanāya kam
children.translated_text: To that dreadful seat of yours I make offering, for the release of these bound ones.

children.text: bhūmir iti tvābhipramanvate janā nirṛtir iti tvāhaṃ pari veda sarvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: People think of you as <s>Bhūmi</s>; I know you on every side as <s>Nirṛti</s>.

children.text: bhūte haviṣmatī bhavaiṣa te bhāgo yo asmāsu
children.translated_text: O being, become possessed of oblation; this is your share, the one that is among us.

children.text: muñcemān amūn enasaḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: Release this one and those others from guilt: svāhā.

children.text: evo ṣv asman nirṛte 'nehā tvam ayasmayān vi cṛtā bandhapāśān
children.translated_text: So now, O <s>Nirṛti</s>, without harming us, cut apart the iron binding snares.

children.text: yamo mahyaṃ punar it tvāṃ dadāti tasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave ||
children.translated_text: <s>Yama</s> gives you back to me again; homage to that <s>Yama</s>, to death.

children.text: ayasmaye drupade bedhiṣa ihābhihito mṛtyubhir ye sahasram
children.translated_text: In an iron fetter, in the wooden block, you were bound here, beset by a thousand deaths.

children.text: yamena tvaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāna uttamaṃ nākam adhi rohayemam ||
children.translated_text: In agreement with <s>Yama</s> and the Fathers, may we raise this one up to the highest heaven.

children.text: Chapter 258
varaṇo vārayātā ayaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>varaṇa</s> tree shall ward it off, this divine lord of the forest.

children.text: yakṣmo yo asminn āviṣṭas tam u devā avīvaran ||
children.translated_text: The <s>yakṣma</s> (wasting disease) that has entered this person: the gods have made it turn away.

children.text: indrasya vacasā vayaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya ca
children.translated_text: By the word of <s>Indra</s>, and by that of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vācā yakṣmaṃ te vārayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: by the speech of all the gods, we ward off your <s>yakṣma</s>.

children.text: yathā vṛtra imā āpas tastambha viśvadhā yatīḥ
children.translated_text: As <s>Vṛtra</s> held back these waters that went everywhere,

children.text: evā te agninā yakṣmaṃ vaiśvānareṇa vāraye ||
children.translated_text: so with <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s> I ward off your <s>yakṣma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 259
vṛṣendrasya vṛṣā divo vṛṣā pṛthivyā ayam
children.translated_text: A bull is this <s>Indra</s>; a bull of heaven and a bull of earth.

children.text: vṛṣā viśvasya bhūtasya tvam ekavṛṣo bhava ||
children.translated_text: You are the bull of every being; become the sole bull.

children.text: samudra īśe sravatām agniḥ pṛthivyā vaśī
children.translated_text: The ocean rules over flowing things; <s>Agni</s> is master of the earth.

children.text: candramā nakṣatrāṇām īśe tvam ekavṛṣo bhava ||
children.translated_text: The moon rules over the stars; you become the sole bull.

children.text: samrāḍ asy asurāṇāṃ kakun manuṣyānām
children.translated_text: You are sovereign of the <s>Asuras</s>, the summit of human beings.

children.text: devānām ardhabhāg asi tvam ekavṛṣo bhava ||
children.translated_text: You are the half-share of the gods; you become the sole bull.

children.text: Chapter 260
ā tvāhārṣam antar abhūr dhruvas tiṣṭhāvicācalat
children.translated_text: I have brought you here; you have entered within. Stand firm, unmoving.

children.text: viśas tvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvad rāṣṭram adhi bhraśat ||
children.translated_text: Let all the clans desire you; let the realm not slip away from you.

children.text: ihaivaidhi māpa cyoṣṭhāḥ parvata ivāvicācalat
children.translated_text: Grow right here; do not fall away, unmoving like a mountain.

children.text: indra iveha dhruvas tiṣṭheha rāṣṭram u dhāraya ||
children.translated_text: Stand firm here like <s>Indra</s>; uphold the realm here.

children.text: indra etam adīdharat dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣā
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has upheld this one, firm, with a firm oblation.

children.text: tasmai somo adhi bravad ayaṃ ca brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: To him <s>Soma</s> has spoken, and this <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> as well.

children.text: Chapter 261
dhruvā dyaur dhruvā pṛthivī dhruvaṃ viśvam idaṃ jagat
children.translated_text: Firm is heaven, firm is earth, firm is this whole moving world.

children.text: dhruvāsaḥ parvatā ime dhruvo rājā viśām ayam ||
children.translated_text: Firm are these mountains; firm is this king of the clans.

children.text: dhruvaṃ te rājā varuṇo dhruvam devo bṛhaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: Firm for you is King <s>Varuṇa</s>; firm is the god <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: dhruvaṃ ta indraś cāgniś ca rāṣṭraṃ dhārayatāṃ dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: Firmly may <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> uphold your realm, firm and steady.

children.text: dhruvo 'cyutaḥ pra mṛṇīhi śatrūn chatrūyato 'dharān pādayasva
children.translated_text: Firm and unfallen, crush the enemies; make those who act as enemies fall below.

children.text: sarvā diśaḥ saṃmanasaḥ sadhrīcīr dhruvāya te samitiḥ kalpatām iha ||
children.translated_text: Let all the quarters, of one mind and moving together, prepare the assembly here for your firmness.

children.text: Chapter 262
idaṃ yat preṇyaḥ śiro dattaṃ somena vṛṣṇyam
children.translated_text: This dear, virile head, given by <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: tataḥ pari prajātena hārdiṃ te śocayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: from that, born forth all around, we inflame your heart.

children.text: śocayāmasi te hārdiṃ śocayāmasi te manaḥ
children.translated_text: We inflame your heart; we inflame your mind.

children.text: vātaṃ dhūma iva sadhryaṅ mām evānv etu te manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As smoke follows the wind in the same direction, let your mind follow me alone.

children.text: mahyaṃ tvā mitrāvaruṇau mahyaṃ devī sarasvatī
children.translated_text: For me may <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, for me the goddess <s>Sarasvatī</s>,

children.text: mahyaṃ tvā madhyaṃ bhūmyā ubhāv antau sam asyatām ||
children.translated_text: for me the middle of the earth and both its ends cast you together.

children.text: Chapter 263
yāṃ te rudra iṣum āsyad aṅgebhyo hṛdayāya ca
children.translated_text: The arrow that <s>Rudra</s> shot at your limbs and at your heart,

children.text: idaṃ tām adya tvad vayaṃ viṣūcīṃ vi vṛhāmasi ||
children.translated_text: that very one we today tear out of you, turned away in all directions.

children.text: yās te śataṃ dhamanayo 'ṅgāny anu viṣṭhitāḥ
children.translated_text: Those hundred channels of yours that are spread through your limbs,

children.text: tāsāṃ te sarvāsām vayaṃ nir viṣāṇi hvayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: from all of them we call out the poisons for you.

children.text: namas te rudrāsyate namaḥ pratihitāyai
children.translated_text: Homage to you, O missile of <s>Rudra</s>; homage to you when set in place.

children.text: namo visṛjyamānāyai namo nipatitāyai ||
children.translated_text: Homage to you when being released; homage to you when fallen down.

children.text: Chapter 264
imaṃ yavam aṣṭāyogaiḥ ṣaḍyogebhir acarkṛṣuḥ
children.translated_text: They have worked this barley with eight yokes, with six yokes.

children.text: tenā te tanvo rapo 'pācīnam apa vyaye ||
children.translated_text: With it I unwind and drive downward the affliction of your body.

children.text: nyag vāto vāti nyak tapati sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: Downward the wind blows; downward the sun burns.

children.text: nīcīnam aghnyā duhe nyag bhavatu te rapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Downward the inviolate cow is milked; downward let your affliction become.

children.text: āpa id vā u bheṣajīr āpo amīvacātanīḥ
children.translated_text: The waters indeed are medicines; the waters drive away disease.

children.text: āpo viśvasya bheṣajīs tās te kṛṇvantu bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: The waters are medicines for all; let them make medicine for you.

children.text: Chapter 265
vātaraṃhā bhava vājin yujyamāna indrasya yāhi prasave manojavāḥ
children.translated_text: Be swift as wind, O racer, when yoked; go at the impulsion of <s>Indra</s>, swift as thought.

children.text: yuñjantu tvā maruto viśvavedasa ā te tvaṣṭā patsu javaṃ dadhātu ||
children.translated_text: Let the all-knowing <s>Maruts</s> yoke you; let <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> place speed in your feet.

children.text: javas te arvan nihito guhā yaḥ śyene vāte uta yo 'carat parīttaḥ
children.translated_text: The speed that is hidden in you, O runner, that which moved about in the eagle, in the wind, and afar,

children.text: tena tvaṃ vājin balavān balenājiṃ jaya samane pārayiṣṇuḥ ||
children.translated_text: with that speed, O racer, mighty with might, win the race in the contest, able to carry us across.

children.text: tanūṣṭe vājin tanvaṃ nayantī vāmam asmabhyaṃ dhāvatu śarma tubhyam
children.translated_text: May the power that guides your body, O racer, run favorably for us, bringing shelter for you.

children.text: ahruto maho dharuṇāya devo divīva jyotiḥ svam ā mimīyāt ||
children.translated_text: May the uninjured god measure out his own light, like a light in heaven, for the great support.

children.text: Chapter 266
yamo mṛtyur aghamāro nirṛtho babhruḥ śarvo 'stā nīlaśikhaṇḍaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Yama</s>, <s>Mṛtyu</s>, <s>Aghamāra</s>, <s>Nirṛti</s>, <s>Babhru</s>, <s>Śarva</s> the archer, the dark-crested one,

children.text: devajanāḥ senayottasthivāṃsas te asmākaṃ pari vṛñjantu vīrān ||
children.translated_text: and the divine beings who have risen up with an army: may they turn aside from our heroes.

children.text: manasā homair harasā ghṛtena śarvāyāstra uta rājñe bhavāya
children.translated_text: With mind, oblations, wrath, and ghee, to <s>Śarva</s> the archer and to King <s>Bhava</s>,

children.text: namasyebhyo nama ebhyaḥ kṛṇomy anyatrāsmad aghaviṣā nayantu ||
children.translated_text: I make homage to these worthy of homage; may they lead the evil-poison away from us elsewhere.

children.text: trāyadhvaṃ no aghaviṣābhyo vadhād viśve devā maruto viśvavedasaḥ
children.translated_text: Protect us from the evil-poisoned blow, all you gods, O all-knowing <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: agnīṣomā varuṇaḥ pūtadakṣā vātāparjanyayoḥ sumatau syāma ||
children.translated_text: May we be in the good favor of <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, of <s>Varuṇa</s> whose skill is purified, and of <s>Vāta</s> and <s>Parjanya</s>.

children.text: Chapter 267
saṃ vo manāṃsi saṃ vratā sam ākūtīr namāmasi
children.translated_text: Together your minds, together your vows, together your intentions we bow down.

children.text: amī ye vivratā sthana tān vaḥ saṃ namayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: Those of you here who stand divided in vow, those we make bow together for you.

children.text: ahaṃ gṛbhṇāmi manasā manāṃsi mama cittam anu cittebhirete
children.translated_text: With my mind I grasp the minds; these minds follow my thought.

children.text: mama vaśeṣu hṛdayāni vaḥ kṛṇomi mama yātam anuvartmāna eta ||
children.translated_text: I make your hearts subject to my powers; come here following after my path.

children.text: ote me dyāvāpṛthivī otā devī sarasvatī
children.translated_text: May heaven and earth aid me; may the goddess <s>Sarasvatī</s> aid me.

children.text: otau ma indraś cāgniś cardhyāsmedaṃ sarasvati ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> aid me; strengthen this for me, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: Chapter 268
aśvattho devasadanas tṛtīyasyām ito divi
children.translated_text: The aśvattha tree is the seat of the gods in the third heaven from here.

children.text: tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇam devāḥ kuṣṭham avanvata ||
children.translated_text: There is the sight of immortality; there the gods obtained kuṣṭha (costus).

children.text: hiraṇyayī naur acaraddhiraṇyabandhanā divi
children.translated_text: A golden boat moved in heaven, bound with golden fastenings.

children.text: tatrāmṛtasya puṣpaṃ devāḥ kuṣṭham avanvata ||
children.translated_text: There is the flower of immortality; there the gods obtained kuṣṭha (costus).

children.text: garbho asy oṣadhīnāṃ garbho himavatām uta
children.translated_text: It is the embryo of the plants, and also the embryo of the <s>Himavat</s> mountains.

children.text: garbho viśvasya bhūtasyemaṃ me agadaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: It is the embryo of every being; make this a remedy for me.

children.text: Chapter 269
yā oṣadhayaḥ somarājñīr bahvīḥ śatavicakṣaṇāḥ
children.translated_text: The herbs whose king is <s>Soma</s>, many, hundred-eyed,

children.text: bṛhaspatiprasūtās tā no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sent forth by <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, let them release us from distress.

children.text: muñcantu mā śapathyād atho varuṇyād uta
children.translated_text: Let them release me from a curse, and also from what belongs to <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: atho yamasya paḍvīśād viśvasmād devakilbiṣāt ||
children.translated_text: and from the fetter of <s>Yama</s>, from every offense against the gods.

children.text: yac cakṣuṣā manasā yac ca vācopārima jāgrato yat svapantaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever by eye, by mind, and whatever by speech we have overstepped while waking or sleeping,

children.text: somas tāni svadhayā naḥ punātu ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Soma</s> purify those things for us by his own power.

children.text: Chapter 270
abhibhūr yajño abhibhūr agnir abhibhūḥ somo abhibhūr indraḥ
children.translated_text: The sacrifice is overpowering; <s>Agni</s> is overpowering; <s>Soma</s> is overpowering; <s>Indra</s> is overpowering.

children.text: abhy ahaṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā yathāsāny evā vidhemāgnihotrā idaṃ haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: May I overcome all battles as I should; thus we serve the agnihotras: this is the oblation.

children.text: svadhāstu mitrāvaruṇā vipaścitā prajāvat kṣatraṃ madhuneha pinvatam
children.translated_text: May there be svadhā (ancestral offering), O wise <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; here swell the progeny-filled sovereignty with sweetness.

children.text: bādhethāṃ dūraṃ nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cid enaḥ pra mumuktam asmat ||
children.translated_text: Drive <s>Nirṛti</s> far away, turned from us; release from us even an offense that has been committed.

children.text: imaṃ vīram anu harṣadhvam ugram indraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam
children.translated_text: Rejoice after this fierce hero, O companions; join yourselves after <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: grāmajitaṃ gojitaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantam ajma pramṛṇantam ojasā ||
children.translated_text: He conquers villages, conquers cattle, has the thunderbolt in his arm, wins the course, and crushes with force.

children.text: Chapter 271
indro jayāti na parā jayātā adhirājo rājasu rājayātai
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> wins; he is not defeated; as overlord among kings may he rule.

children.text: carkṛtya īḍyo vandyaś copasadyo namasyo bhaveha ||
children.translated_text: Repeatedly active, worthy of praise, worthy of homage, and fit to be approached, may he be honored here.

children.text: tvam indrādhirājaḥ śravasyus tvaṃ bhūr abhibhūtir janānām
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, are overlord, seeking glory; you are the powerful supremacy over peoples.

children.text: tvaṃ daivīr viśa imā vi rājāyuṣmat kṣatram ajaraṃ te astu ||
children.translated_text: You rule over these divine clans; may your sovereignty be long-lived and undecaying.

children.text: prācyā diśas tvam indrāsi rājotodīcyā diśo vṛtrahaṃ chatruho 'si
children.translated_text: From the eastern direction you, O <s>Indra</s>, are king; and from the northern direction you are the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, the slayer of enemies.

children.text: yatra yanti srotyās taj jitaṃ te dakṣiṇato vṛṣabha eṣi havyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Where the streams go, that has been conquered by you; from the south, O bull, you come as one to be invoked.

children.text: Chapter 272
abhi tvendra varimataḥ purā tvāṃhūraṇāddhuve
children.translated_text: I call upon you, O <s>Indra</s>, from broad expanse, before the assault.

children.text: hvayāmy ugraṃ cettāraṃ puruṇāmānam ekajam ||
children.translated_text: I summon the fierce one, the attentive one, the much-named, the sole-born.

children.text: yo adya senyo vadho jighāṃsan na udīrate
children.translated_text: Whatever military blow is raised today against us with intent to kill,

children.text: indrasya tatra bāhū samantaṃ pari dadmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: there we set the arms of <s>Indra</s> all around.

children.text: pari dadma indrasya bāhū samantaṃ trātus trāyatāṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: We set the arms of <s>Indra</s> all around; may the protector protect us.

children.text: deva savitaḥ soma rājant sumanasaṃ mā kṛṇu svastaye ||
children.translated_text: O god <s>Savitṛ</s>, O King <s>Soma</s>, make me well-disposed for welfare.

children.text: Chapter 273
devā aduḥ sūryo dyaur adāt pṛthivy adāt
children.translated_text: The gods gave it, <s>Sūrya</s> gave it, heaven gave it, earth gave it.

children.text: tisraḥ sarasvatīr aduḥ sacittā viṣadūṣaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The three <s>Sarasvatīs</s>, of one mind, gave the poison-spoiling remedy.

children.text: yad vo devā upajīkā āsiñcan dhanvany udakam
children.translated_text: That water which, O gods, you poured upon the upajīkā insects in the desert,

children.text: tena devaprasūtenedaṃ dūṣayatā viṣam ||
children.translated_text: with that, impelled by the gods, spoil this poison.

children.text: asurāṇāṃ duhitāsi sā devānām asi svasā
children.translated_text: You are the daughter of the Asuras; you are the sister of the gods.

children.text: divas pṛthivyāḥ sambhūtā sā cakarthārasaṃ viṣam ||
children.translated_text: Born from heaven and earth, you have made the poison sapless.

children.text: Chapter 274
ā vṛṣāyasva śvasihi vardhasva prathayasva ca
children.translated_text: Become bull-like; breathe strongly; grow and spread out.

children.text: yathāṅgaṃ vardhatāṃ śepas tena yoṣitam ij jahi ||
children.translated_text: Let the member grow limb by limb; with it strike the woman.

children.text: yena kṛśaṃ vājayanti yena hinvanty āturam
children.translated_text: With that by which they invigorate the lean man, by which they impel the sick man,

children.text: tenāsya brahmaṇaspate dhanur ivā tānayā pasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with that, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, stretch this one's penis like a bow.

children.text: āhaṃ tanomi te paso adhi jyām iva dhanvani
children.translated_text: I stretch out your penis upon you, like a bowstring on a bow.

children.text: kramasvarśa iva rohitam anavaglāyatā sadā ||
children.translated_text: Step forward like a stag to the red one, never drooping, always.

children.text: Chapter 275
yathāyaṃ vāho aśvinā samaiti saṃ ca vartate
children.translated_text: As this draught animal, O <s>Aśvins</s>, comes together and turns together,

children.text: evā mām abhi te manaḥ samaitu saṃ ca vartatām ||
children.translated_text: so may your mind come together around me and turn together.

children.text: āhaṃ khidāmi te mano rājāśvaḥ pṛṣṭyām iva
children.translated_text: I agitate your mind, like a king's horse on the back.

children.text: reṣmachinnam yathā tṛṇaṃ mayi te veṣṭatāṃ manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like grass cut from its root, may your mind wind itself around me.

children.text: āñjanasya madughasya kuṣṭhasya naladasya ca
children.translated_text: From āñjana (collyrium), from madugha, from kuṣṭha (costus), and from nalada (spikenard),

children.text: turo bhagasya hastābhyām anurodhanam ud bhare ||
children.translated_text: with the hands of swift <s>Bhaga</s>, I bring forth anurodhana (means of winning favor).

children.text: Chapter 276
saṃdānaṃ vo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃdānaṃ savitā karat
children.translated_text: May <s>Bṛhaspati</s> make a binding for you; may <s>Savitṛ</s> make a binding.

children.text: saṃdānaṃ mitro aryamā saṃdānaṃ bhago aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, and the <s>Aśvins</s> make a binding.

children.text: sam paramānt sam avamān atho saṃ dyāmi madhyamān
children.translated_text: I bind together the highest, I bind together the lowest, and also I bind together the middle ones.

children.text: indras tān pary ahār dāmnā tān agne saṃ dyā tvam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has enclosed them with a bond; do you bind them together, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: amī ye yudham āyanti ketūn kṛtvānīkaśaḥ
children.translated_text: Those yonder who come to battle, setting up their banners in battle lines,

children.text: indras tān pary ahār dāmnā tān agne saṃ dyā tvam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has enclosed them with a bond; do you bind them together, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: Chapter 277
ādānena saṃdānenāmitrān ā dyāmasi
children.translated_text: By taking and by binding we bind the enemies here.

children.text: apānā ye caiṣāṃ prāṇā asunāsūnt sam achidan ||
children.translated_text: We have cut off their downward breaths, their breaths, and their life from life.

children.text: idam ādānam akaraṃ tapasendreṇa saṃśitam
children.translated_text: I have made this taking, sharpened by fervor and by <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: amitrā ye 'tra naḥ santi tān agna ā dyā tvam ||
children.translated_text: Those enemies who are here against us, bind them here, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: ainān dyatām indrāgnī somo rājā ca medinau
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> bind them, and king <s>Soma</s>, both firmly.

children.text: indro marutvān ādānam amitrebhyaḥ kṛṇotu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, make a taking for us from the enemies.

children.text: Chapter 278
yathā mano manasketaiḥ parāpataty āśumat
children.translated_text: As the mind flies away swiftly with the movements of thought,

children.text: evā tvaṃ kāse pra pata manaso 'nu pravāyyam ||
children.translated_text: so do you, O cough, fly away, following the course of the mind.

children.text: yathā bāṇaḥ susaṃśitaḥ parāpataty āśumat
children.translated_text: As a well-sharpened arrow flies away swiftly,

children.text: evā tvaṃ kāse pra pata pṛthivyā anu saṃvatam ||
children.translated_text: so do you, O cough, fly away along the expanse of the earth.

children.text: yathā sūryasya raśmayaḥ parāpatanty āśumat
children.translated_text: As the rays of the sun fly away swiftly,

children.text: evā tvaṃ kāse pra pata samudrasyānu vikṣaram ||
children.translated_text: so do you, O cough, fly away along the outflow of the ocean.

children.text: Chapter 279
āyane te parāyaṇe dūrvā rohantu puṣpiṇīḥ
children.translated_text: On your coming and your going, let flowering dūrvā grasses grow.

children.text: utso vā tatra jāyatām hrado vā puṇḍarīkavān ||
children.translated_text: Or let a spring be born there, or a pond filled with lotuses.

children.text: apām idaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam
children.translated_text: This is the descent of the waters, the resting place of the ocean.

children.text: madhye hradasya no gṛhāḥ parācīnā mukhā kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Our houses are in the middle of the pond; make their mouths turned away.

children.text: himasya tvā jarāyuṇā śāle pari vyayāmasi
children.translated_text: With the caul of snow we wrap you around, O house.

children.text: śītahradā hi no bhuvo 'gniṣ kṛṇotu bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: For you have become a cold pond for us; let <s>Agni</s> make a remedy.

children.text: Chapter 280
viśvajit trāyamāṇāyai mā pari dehi
children.translated_text: O <s>Viśvajit</s>, give me over to <s>Trāyamāṇā</s>.

children.text: trāyamāṇe dvipāc ca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yac ca naḥ svam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Trāyamāṇā</s>, protect for us everything two-footed and four-footed, and whatever is our own.

children.text: trāyamāṇe viśvajite mā pari dehi
children.translated_text: O <s>Trāyamāṇā</s>, give me over to <s>Viśvajit</s>.

children.text: viśvajid dvipāc ca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yac ca naḥ svam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Viśvajit</s>, protect for us everything two-footed and four-footed, and whatever is our own.

children.text: viśvajit kalyāṇyai mā pari dehi
children.translated_text: O <s>Viśvajit</s>, give me over to <s>Kalyāṇī</s>.

children.text: kalyāṇi dvipāc ca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yac ca naḥ svam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Kalyāṇī</s>, protect for us everything two-footed and four-footed, and whatever is our own.

children.text: kalyāṇi sarvavide mā pari dehi
children.translated_text: O <s>Kalyāṇī</s>, give me over to <s>Sarvavid</s>.

children.text: sarvavid dvipāc ca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yac ca naḥ svam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Sarvavid</s>, protect for us everything two-footed and four-footed, and whatever is our own.

children.text: Chapter 281
tvaṃ no medhe prathamā gobhir aśvebhir ā gahi
children.translated_text: Come to us first, O <s>Medhā</s>, with cows and horses.

children.text: tvaṃ sūryasya raśmibhis tvam no asi yajñiyā ||
children.translated_text: You are with the rays of the sun; you are fit for sacrifice for us.

children.text: medhām ahaṃ prathamāṃ brahmaṇvatīṃ brahmajūtām ṛṣiṣṭutām
children.translated_text: I call to aid the first <s>Medhā</s>, endowed with sacred formulation, impelled by sacred formulation, praised by seers,

children.text: prapītāṃ brahmacāribhir devānām avase huve ||
children.translated_text: drunk in by brahmacārins, for the help of the gods.

children.text: yāṃ medhām ṛbhavo vidur yāṃ medhām asurā viduḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Medhā</s> which the <s>Ṛbhus</s> know, the <s>Medhā</s> which the <s>Asuras</s> know,

children.text: ṛṣayo bhadrāṃ medhāṃ yāṃ vidus tāṃ mayy ā veśayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: the auspicious <s>Medhā</s> which the seers know: that we cause to enter into me.

children.text: yām ṛṣayo bhūtakṛto medhāṃ medhāvino viduḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Medhā</s> which the seers, makers of beings, the wise ones, know,

children.text: tayā mām adya medhayāgne medhāvinaṃ kṛṇu ||
children.translated_text: with that <s>Medhā</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, make me wise today.

children.text: medhāṃ sāyaṃ medhāṃ prātar medhāṃ madhyandinaṃ pari
children.translated_text: <s>Medhā</s> in the evening, <s>Medhā</s> in the morning, <s>Medhā</s> around midday:

children.text: medhāṃ sūryasya raśmibhir vacasā veśayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we cause <s>Medhā</s> to enter with speech and with the rays of the sun.

children.text: Chapter 282
pippalī kṣiptabheṣajy utātividdhabheṣajī
children.translated_text: <s>Pippalī</s> is a remedy for the stricken, and also a remedy for the deeply pierced.

children.text: tāṃ devāḥ sam akalpayann iyaṃ jīvitavā alam ||
children.translated_text: The gods prepared her; this one is fully able to restore life.

children.text: pippalyaḥ sam avadantāyatīr jananād adhi
children.translated_text: The <s>Pippalī</s> plants spoke together as they came forth from their birth.

children.text: yaṃ jīvam aśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The living man whom we shall reach will not be harmed.

children.text: asurās tvā ny akhanan devās tvod avapan punaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Asuras</s> dug you down; the gods planted you up again.

children.text: vātīkṛtasya bheṣajīm atho kṣiptasya bheṣajīm ||
children.translated_text: You are a remedy for one made ill by wind, and also a remedy for one stricken.

children.text: Chapter 283
pratno hi kam īḍyo adhvareṣu sanāc ca hotā navyaś ca satsi
children.translated_text: For of old you are indeed worthy of praise at the sacrifices; from ancient time you have been the Hotṛ, and now you are new.

children.text: svām cāgne tanvaṃ piprāyasvāsmabhyaṃ ca saubhagam ā yajasva ||
children.translated_text: Gladden your own body, O <s>Agni</s>, and sacrifice good fortune here for us.

children.text: jyeṣṭhaghnyāṃ jāto vicṛtor yamasya mūlabarhaṇāt pari pāhy enam
children.translated_text: Born under Jyeṣṭhaghni, protect this hero from <s>Yama</s>'s tearing apart and from uprooting.

children.text: aty enam neṣad duritāni viśvā dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya ||
children.translated_text: May he lead him beyond all misfortunes, to long life, to a hundred autumns.

children.text: vyāghre 'hny ajaniṣṭa vīro nakṣatrajā jāyamānaḥ suvīraḥ
children.translated_text: On the tiger day the hero was born, born under the constellation, being born heroic.

children.text: sa mā vadhīt pitaraṃ vardhamāno mā mātaraṃ pra minīj janitrīm ||
children.translated_text: As he grows, may he not kill his father; may he not harm his mother, his birth-giver.

children.text: Chapter 284
imam me agne puruṣam mumugdhy ayaṃ yo baddhaḥ suyato lālapīti
children.translated_text: Release this man of mine, O <s>Agni</s>, this one who is bound, well fastened, and muttering.

children.text: ato 'dhi te kṛṇavad bhāgadheyaṃ yadānunmadito 'sati ||
children.translated_text: From now on he will make your allotted share, when he has become free of madness.

children.text: agniṣ ṭe ni śamayatu yadi te mana udyutam
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s> quiet it for you, if your mind has been excited.

children.text: kṛṇomi vidvān bheṣajaṃ yathānunmadito 'sasi ||
children.translated_text: Knowing, I make the remedy, so that you may be free of madness.

children.text: devainasād unmaditam unmattam rakṣasas pari
children.translated_text: The one maddened by an offense against the gods, mad through a <s>Rakṣas</s>,

children.text: kṛṇomi vidvān bheṣajaṃ yadānunmadito 'sati ||
children.translated_text: knowing, I make the remedy, so that he may be free of madness.

children.text: punas tvā dur apsarasaḥ punar indraḥ punar bhagaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the <s>Apsarases</s> restore you; let <s>Indra</s> restore you; let <s>Bhaga</s> restore you.

children.text: punas tvā dur viśve devā yathānunmadito 'sasi ||
children.translated_text: Let all the gods restore you, so that you may be free of madness.

children.text: Chapter 285
mā jyeṣṭhaṃ vadhīd ayam agna eṣām mūlabarhaṇāt pari pāhy enam
children.translated_text: Let this one not kill the eldest, O <s>Agni</s>; protect him from uprooting.

children.text: sa grāhyāḥ pāśān vi cṛta prajānan tubhyaṃ devā anu jānantu viśve ||
children.translated_text: Knowing, cut apart the snares of <s>Grāhī</s>; may all the gods grant approval to you.

children.text: un muñca pāśāṃs tvam agna eṣāṃ trayas tribhir utsitā yebhir āsan
children.translated_text: Unloose the snares of these people, O <s>Agni</s>, the three with the three by which they were set up.

children.text: sa grāhyāḥ pāśān vi cṛta prajānan pitāputrau mātaraṃ muñca sarvān ||
children.translated_text: Knowing, cut apart the snares of <s>Grāhī</s>; release father and sons, mother, and all.

children.text: yebhiḥ pāśaiḥ parivitto vibaddho 'ṅge aṅga ārpita utsitaś ca
children.translated_text: By the snares with which he is surrounded and bound, fastened limb by limb and set up,

children.text: vi te mucyantāṃ vimuco hi santi bhrūṇaghni pūṣan duritāni mṛkṣva ||
children.translated_text: may they be loosened from you, for there are releasers; O <s>Pūṣan</s>, wipe away the misfortunes of embryo-killing.

children.text: Chapter 286
trite devā amṛjataitad enas trita enan manuṣyeṣu mamṛje
children.translated_text: The gods wiped away this sin upon <s>Trita</s>; <s>Trita</s> wiped it away among human beings.

children.text: tato yadi tvā grāhir ānaśe tāṃ te devā brahmaṇā nāśayantu ||
children.translated_text: Then, if <s>Grāhī</s> has reached you, may the gods destroy her for you with sacred formulation.

children.text: marīcīr dhūmān pra viśānu pāpmann udārān gacchota vā nīhārān
children.translated_text: Enter the rays and the fumes, O evil; go to the high places, or else to the mists.

children.text: nadīnāṃ phenāṁ anu tān vi naśya bhrūṇaghni pūṣan duritāni mṛkṣva ||
children.translated_text: After them, vanish into the foam of the rivers; O slayer of the embryo, O <s>Pūṣan</s>, wipe away the evils.

children.text: dvādaśadhā nihitaṃ tritasyāpamṛṣṭam manuṣyainasāni
children.translated_text: What was placed twelvefold for <s>Trita</s>, wiped away from human sins,

children.text: tato yadi tvā grāhir ānaśe tāṃ te devā brahmaṇā nāśayantu ||
children.translated_text: from there, if the seizer has reached you, let the gods destroy that for you by the sacred formula.

children.text: Chapter 287
yad devā devaheḍanaṃ devāsaś cakṛma vayam
children.translated_text: Whatever offense against the gods, O gods, we gods' servants have committed,

children.text: ādityās tasmān no yūyamṛtasyartena muñcata ||
children.translated_text: from that, O <s>Ādityas</s>, do you release us by the truth of truth.

children.text: ṛtasyartenādityā yajatrā muñcateha naḥ
children.translated_text: By the truth of truth, O worshipful <s>Ādityas</s>, release us here,

children.text: yajñaṃ yad yajñavāhasaḥ śikṣanto nopaśekima ||
children.translated_text: if, O bearers of sacrifice, while learning we have not approached the sacrifice properly.

children.text: medasvatā yajamānāḥ srucājyāni juhvataḥ
children.translated_text: As sacrificers offering ghee with a fat-filled ladle,

children.text: akāmā viśve vo devāḥ śikṣanto nopa śekima ||
children.translated_text: O all gods, without desire, while learning, we have not approached you properly.

children.text: Chapter 288
yad vidvāṃso yad avidvāṃsa enāṃsi cakṛmā vayam
children.translated_text: Whatever sins we have committed, knowing or unknowing,

children.text: yūyaṃ nas tasmān muñcata viśve devāḥ sajoṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: from that release us, all you gods, joined in accord.

children.text: yadi jāgrad yadi svapann ena enasyo 'karam
children.translated_text: If waking or if sleeping I have committed sin belonging to sin,

children.text: bhūtaṃ mā tasmād bhavyaṃ ca drupadād iva muñcatām ||
children.translated_text: let what has been and what will be release me from that, as from a wooden post.

children.text: drupadād iva mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snātvā malād iva
children.translated_text: Being released as from a wooden post, as a sweating man after bathing is released from dirt,

children.text: pūtaṃ pavitreṇevājyaṃ viśve śumbhantu mainasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: purified as ghee by a filter, may all the gods cleanse me from sin.

children.text: Chapter 289
yad yāmaṃ cakrur nikhananto agre kārṣīvaṇā annavido na vidyayā
children.translated_text: Whatever course they made at first, digging, like ploughmen who know food but not knowledge,

children.text: vaivasvate rājani taj juhomy atha yajñiyaṃ madhumad astu no 'nnam ||
children.translated_text: that I pour as an oblation to King <s>Vaivasvata</s>; then may our sacrificial food be honey-sweet.

children.text: vaivasvataḥ kṛṇavad bhāgadheyaṃ madhubhāgo madhunā saṃ sṛjāti
children.translated_text: May <s>Vaivasvata</s> make the allotted share; the honey-shared one mixes it with honey.

children.text: mātur yad ena iṣitaṃ na āgan yad vā pitā 'parāddho jihīḍe ||
children.translated_text: Whatever sin came to us, sent by the mother, or whatever the father, having done wrong, was angry about,

children.text: yadīdaṃ mātur yadi pitur naḥ pari bhrātuḥ putrāc cetasa ena āgan
children.translated_text: if this sin came upon us from mother, or from father, or from brother, or from son, through thought,

children.text: yāvanto asmān pitaraḥ sacante teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ śivo astu manyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: as many fathers as attend us, of all of them may the anger be auspicious.

children.text: Chapter 290
apamityam apratīttaṃ yad asmi yamasya yena balinā carāmi
children.translated_text: What I owe, what is unpaid, with what tribute to <s>Yama</s> I go about,

children.text: idaṃ tad agne anṛṇo bhavāmi tvaṃ pāśān vicṛtaṃ vettha sarvān ||
children.translated_text: of that, O <s>Agni</s>, here I become free from debt; you know all the loosened snares.

children.text: ihaiva santaḥ prati dadma enaj jīvā jīvebhyo ni harāma enat
children.translated_text: Here, while still living, we give back this sin; living, we carry it away from the living.

children.text: apamitya dhānyaṃ yajjaghāsāham idaṃ tad agne anṛṇo bhavāmi ||
children.translated_text: What grain I have eaten as unpaid debt, of that, O <s>Agni</s>, here I become free from debt.

children.text: anṛṇā asminn anṛṇāḥ parasmin tṛtīye loke anṛṇāḥ syāma
children.translated_text: May we be free from debt in this world, free from debt in the other, free from debt in the third world.

children.text: ye devayānāḥ pitṛyāṇaś ca lokāḥ sarvān patho anṛṇā ā kṣiyema ||
children.translated_text: The worlds that are the paths of the gods and the paths of the Fathers: may we dwell on all paths free from debt.

children.text: Chapter 291
yaddhastābhyāṃ cakṛma kilbiṣāṇy akṣāṇāṃ gaṇam upalipsamānāḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever faults we committed with our hands, seeking to gain the company of dice,

children.text: ugraṃpaśye ugrajitau tad adyāpsarasāv anu dattām ṛṇaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O fierce-seeing and fierce-conquering <s>Apsarases</s>, today give that debt back to us.

children.text: ugraṃpaśye rāṣṭrabhṛt kilbiṣāṇi yad akṣavṛttam anu dattam na etat
children.translated_text: O fierce-seeing <s>Rāṣṭrabhṛt</s>, the faults that arose from the play of dice: give that back to us.

children.text: ṛṇān no narṇamertsamāno yamasya loke adhirajjur āyat ||
children.translated_text: May not the debt, as we seek to escape debt, stretch out as a hanging rope in the world of <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: yasmā ṛṇaṃ yasya jāyām upaimi yaṃ yācamāno abhyaimi devāḥ
children.translated_text: He to whom I owe a debt, whose wife I approach, whom, begging, I approach, O gods,

children.text: te vācaṃ vādiṣur mottarāṃ mad devapatnī apsarasāv adhītam ||
children.translated_text: let them speak a word, not one superior to mine; O divine wives, O <s>Apsarases</s>, heed this.

children.text: Chapter 292
yad adīvyann ṛṇam ahaṃ kṛṇomy adāsyann agne uta saṃgṛṇāmi
children.translated_text: If, while gambling, I make a debt that I shall not pay, O <s>Agni</s>, or if I acknowledge it,

children.text: vaiśvānaro no adhipā vasiṣṭha ud in nayāti sukṛtasya lokam ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, our protector and best guardian, lead us upward to the world of good deeds.

children.text: vaiśvānarāya prati vedayāmi yadi ṛṇaṃ saṃgaro devatāsu
children.translated_text: I announce to <s>Vaiśvānara</s> if there is a debt, a pledge among the deities.

children.text: sa etān pāśān vicṛtam veda sarvān atha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||
children.translated_text: He knows all these loosened snares; then may we come together with what has been cooked.

children.text: vaiśvānaraḥ pavitā mā punātu yat saṃgaram abhidhāvāmy āśām
children.translated_text: May <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the purifier, purify me when I run toward a pledged hope.

children.text: anājānan manasā yācamāno yat tatraino apa tat suvāmi ||
children.translated_text: Begging in mind without understanding, whatever sin is there, I send that away.

children.text: Chapter 293
yad antarikṣaṃ pṛthivīm uta dyām yan mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā jihiṃsima
children.translated_text: Whatever injury we have done to the atmosphere, to earth, to heaven, or to mother or father,

children.text: ayaṃ tasmād gārhapatyo no agnir ud in nayāti sukṛtasya lokam ||
children.translated_text: from that may this household fire, our <s>Agni</s>, lead us upward to the world of good deeds.

children.text: bhūmir mātāditir no janitraṃ bhrātāntarikṣam abhiśastyā naḥ
children.translated_text: Earth is our mother, <s>Aditi</s> our birth-giver; the atmosphere is our brother, away from imprecation.

children.text: dyaur naḥ pitā pitryācchaṃ bhavāti jāmim ṛtvā māva patsi lokāt ||
children.translated_text: May heaven, our father, be gracious to us with fatherly favor; having reached our kin, may I not fall from the world.

children.text: yatrā suhārdaḥ sukṛto madanti vihāya rogaṃ tanvaḥ svāyāḥ
children.translated_text: Where the good-hearted and good-working rejoice, having left behind the sickness of their own body,

children.text: aśloṇā aṅgair ahrutāḥ svarge tatra paśyema pitarau ca putrān ||
children.translated_text: not lame in their limbs, not crooked, in heaven, there may we see our parents and our children.

children.text: Chapter 294
viṣāṇā pāśān vi ṣyādhy asmad ya uttamā adhamā vāruṇā ye
children.translated_text: Loosen the horns, loosen from us the snares, those highest and lowest snares of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: duṣvapnyaṃ duritaṃ ni ṣvāsmad atha gacchema sukṛtasya lokam ||
children.translated_text: Drive away from us bad dreams and evil; then may we go to the world of good deeds.

children.text: yad dāruṇi badhyase yacca rajjvāṃ yad bhūmyāṃ badhyase yacca vācā
children.translated_text: Whatever you are bound with in wood, and whatever in ropes, whatever you are bound with on earth, and whatever by speech,

children.text: ayaṃ tasmād gārhapatyo no agnir ud in nayāti sukṛtasya lokam ||
children.translated_text: from that may this household fire, our <s>Agni</s>, lead us upward to the world of good deeds.

children.text: udagātāṃ bhagavatī vicṛtau nāma tārake
children.translated_text: The blessed pair of stars called the Loosened Ones have risen upward.

children.text: prehāmṛtasya yacchatāṃ praitu baddhakamocanam ||
children.translated_text: Let them grant a share of immortality here; let the release of the bound one go forth.

children.text: vi jihīṣva lokam kṛṇu bandhān muñcāsi baddhakam
children.translated_text: Shake yourself free; make a world; release the bound one from the bonds.

children.text: yonyā iva pracyuto garbhaḥ pathaḥ sarvāṁ anu kṣiya ||
children.translated_text: Like an embryo fallen from the womb, dwell along all the paths.

children.text: Chapter 295
etaṃ bhāgaṃ pari dadāmi vidvān viśvakarman prathamajā ṛtasya
children.translated_text: Knowing, I hand over this share, O <s>Viśvakarman</s>, first-born of truth.

children.text: asmābhir dattaṃ jarasaḥ parastād achinnaṃ tantum anu saṃ tarema ||
children.translated_text: By what has been given by us beyond old age, may we cross over along an unbroken thread.

children.text: tataṃ tantum anv eke taranti yeṣāṃ dattaṃ pitryam āyanena
children.translated_text: Some cross over along the stretched thread, those for whom the ancestral gift has been made on the journey.

children.text: abandhv eke dadataḥ prayacchanto dātuṃ cecchikṣāntsa svarga eva ||
children.translated_text: Others, giving without kinsmen, presenting gifts, desiring to give, are indeed in heaven.

children.text: anvārabhethām anusaṃrabhethām etaṃ lokaṃ śraddadhānāḥ sacante
children.translated_text: Take hold after, cling after; the faithful attend this world.

children.text: yad vāṃ pakvaṃ pariviṣṭam agnau tasya guptaye dampatī saṃ śrayethām ||
children.translated_text: For the guarding of what is cooked for you and set around the fire, O married pair, take refuge together.

children.text: yajñam yantaṃ manasā bṛhantam anvārohāmi tapasā sayoniḥ
children.translated_text: With my mind I mount the sacrifice as it goes, the great one; with fervor I mount it, sharing the same womb.

children.text: upahūtā agne jarasaḥ parastāt tṛtīye nāke sadhamādaṃ madema ||
children.translated_text: Summoned, O <s>Agni</s>, beyond old age, may we rejoice in common delight in the third heaven.

children.text: śuddhāḥ pūtā yoṣito yajñiyā imā brahmaṇāṃ hasteṣu prapṛthak sādayāmi
children.translated_text: Pure, purified, fit for sacrifice, these women I set down separately in the hands of the brahmans.

children.text: yatkāma idaṃ abhiṣiñcāmi vo 'haṃ indro marutvāntsa dadātu tan me ||
children.translated_text: Whatever desire I have as I sprinkle you with this, may <s>Indra</s>, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, grant that to me.

children.text: Chapter 296
etaṃ sadhasthāḥ pari vo dadāmi yaṃ śevadhim āvahāj jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: O you who sit together, I give over to you this treasure which <s>Jātavedas</s> has brought here.

children.text: anvāgantā yajamānaḥ svasti taṃ sma jānīta parame vyoman ||
children.translated_text: The sacrificer shall come after it with well-being; know it in the highest heaven.

children.text: jānīta smainaṃ parame vyoman devāḥ sadhasthā vida lokam atra
children.translated_text: Know him in the highest heaven, O gods; O you who sit together, find a place here.

children.text: anvāgantā yajamānaḥ svastīṣṭāpūrtaṃ sma kṛṇutāvir asmai ||
children.translated_text: The sacrificer shall come after it with well-being; make the <s>iṣṭāpūrta</s> (sacrifice and charitable works) manifest for him.

children.text: devāḥ pitaraḥ pitaro devāḥ
children.translated_text: The gods are the Fathers; the Fathers are the gods.

children.text: yo asmi so asmi ||
children.translated_text: Who I am, that I am.

children.text: sa pacāmi sa dadāmi
children.translated_text: As such I cook; as such I give.

children.text: sa yaje sa dattān mā yūṣam ||
