children.translated_text: As such I sacrifice; do not deprive me of the things given.

children.text: nāke rājan prati tiṣṭha tatraitat prati tiṣṭhatu
children.translated_text: Stand firm in heaven, O king; let this stand firm there.

children.text: viddhi pūrtasya no rājant sa deva sumanā bhava ||
children.translated_text: Know our work of <s>pūrta</s> (charitable merit), O king; O god, be kindly disposed.

children.text: Chapter 297
divo nu mām bṛhato antarikṣād apāṃ stoko abhy apaptad rasena
children.translated_text: From the broad heaven, from the atmosphere, a drop of the waters has fallen upon me with its sap.

children.text: sam indriyena payasāham agne chandobhir yajñaiḥ sukṛtāṃ kṛtena ||
children.translated_text: Together with power and milk, O <s>Agni</s>, I am joined with meters, sacrifices, and the deed of the well-doers.

children.text: yadi vṛkṣād abhyapaptat phalaṃ tad yady antarikṣāt sa u vāyur eva
children.translated_text: If a fruit has fallen from a tree, that is it; if from the atmosphere, then it is indeed the wind.

children.text: yatrāspṛkṣat tanvo yacca vāsasa āpo nudantu nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Where it touched my body and where it touched my garment, let the waters drive ruin far away.

children.text: abhyañjanaṃ surabhi sā samṛddhir hiraṇyaṃ varcas tad u pūtrimam eva
children.translated_text: The fragrant ointment is prosperity; gold is brilliance, and that indeed is offspring.

children.text: sarvā pavitrā vitatādhy asmat tan mā tārīn nirṛtir mo arātiḥ ||
children.translated_text: All purifiers are stretched out over us; let ruin not cross over me, nor hostility.

children.text: Chapter 298
vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ
children.translated_text: O lord of the forest, be firm-limbed; be our companion, carrying us across, rich in heroes.

children.text: gobhiḥ saṃnaddho asi vīḍayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni ||
children.translated_text: You are bound together with cows; make yourself firm. Let the one mounted on you conquer the things to be conquered.

children.text: divas pṛthivyāḥ pary oja udbhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ pary ābhṛtaṃ sahaḥ
children.translated_text: Strength has been drawn up from heaven and earth; force has been brought from the forest-trees.

children.text: apām ojmānaṃ pari gobhir āvṛtam indrasya vajraṃ haviṣā rathaṃ yaja ||
children.translated_text: The vigor of the waters is enclosed by cows; with oblation sacrifice the chariot, the thunderbolt of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: indrasyaujo marutām anīkaṃ mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ
children.translated_text: The might of <s>Indra</s>, the front line of the <s>Maruts</s>, the womb of <s>Mitra</s>, the navel of <s>Varuṇa</s>:

children.text: sa imāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya ||
children.translated_text: accepting this oblation-giving of ours, O divine chariot, receive the oblations.

children.text: Chapter 299
upa śvāsaya pṛthivīm uta dyāṃ purutrā te vanvatāṃ viṣṭhitam jagat
children.translated_text: Make earth breathe near, and heaven too; in many places let the spread-out world bow to you.

children.text: sa dundubhe sajūr indreṇa devair dūrād davīyo apa sedha śatrūn ||
children.translated_text: O war drum, together with <s>Indra</s> and the gods, drive the enemies away farther than far.

children.text: ā krandaya balam ojo na ā dhā abhi ṣṭana duritā bādhamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Make a cry; place strength and vigor in us; thunder forth, driving away misfortunes.

children.text: apa sedha dundubhe ducchunām ita indrasya muṣṭir asi vīḍayasva ||
children.translated_text: Drive away ill omen from here, O war drum; you are <s>Indra</s>'s fist, make yourself firm.

children.text: prāmūṃ jayābhīme jayantu ketumad dundubhir vāvadītu
children.translated_text: Let this fearsome one win forth; let the bannered war drum speak aloud.

children.text: sam aśvaparṇāḥ patantu no naro 'smākam indra rathino jayantu ||
children.translated_text: Let our men with horse-winged steeds fly together; O <s>Indra</s>, let our chariot-fighters win.

children.text: Chapter 300
vidradhasya balāsasya lohitasya vanaspate
children.translated_text: O lord of the forest, against abscess, against <s>balāsa</s> disease, against the red one,

children.text: visalpakasyauṣadhe mocchiṣaḥ piśitaṃ cana ||
children.translated_text: O herb, against <s>visalpaka</s> eruption, leave not even a bit of flesh remaining.

children.text: yau te balāsa tiṣṭhataḥ kakṣe muṣkāv apaśritau
children.translated_text: O <s>balāsa</s>, those two of yours that stand in the armpit, the testicles set apart,

children.text: vedāhaṃ tasya bheṣajaṃ cīpudrur abhicakṣaṇam ||
children.translated_text: I know the remedy for that: the observant cīpudru tree.

children.text: yo aṅgyo yaḥ karṇyo yo akṣyor visalpakaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>visalpaka</s> that is in the limbs, that is in the ears, that is in the eyes,

children.text: vi vṛhāmo visalpakaṃ vidradhaṃ hṛdayāmayam
children.translated_text: we tear out the <s>visalpaka</s>, the abscess, the heart-disease;

children.text: parā tam ajñātam yakṣmam adharāñcaṃ suvāmasi ||
children.translated_text: that unknown wasting sickness we send away downward and far off.

children.text: Chapter 301
śakadhūmaṃ nakṣatrāṇi yad rājānam akurvata
children.translated_text: When the stars made <s>Śakadhūma</s> their king,

children.text: bhadrāham asmai prāyacchan idaṃ rāṣṭram asād iti ||
children.translated_text: they gave auspicious day to him, saying, 'This kingdom has been seated.'

children.text: bhadrāhaṃ no madhyaṃdine bhadrāhaṃ sāyam astu naḥ
children.translated_text: May there be auspicious day for us at midday; may there be auspicious day for us in the evening.

children.text: bhadrāhaṃ no ahnāṃ prātā rātrī bhadrāham astu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May there be auspicious day for us at the morning of the days; may there be auspicious day for us at night.

children.text: ahorātrābhyāṃ nakṣatrebhyaḥ sūryācandramasābhyām
children.translated_text: By day and night, by the stars, by sun and moon,

children.text: bhadrāham asmabhyaṃ rājañchakadhūma tvaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: O king <s>Śakadhūma</s>, make auspicious day for us.

children.text: yo no bhadrāham akaraḥ sāyaṃ naktam atho divā
children.translated_text: You who have made auspicious day for us in the evening, at night, and also by day,

children.text: tasmai te nakṣatrarāja śakadhūma sadā namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: to you, O star-king <s>Śakadhūma</s>, there is always homage.

children.text: Chapter 302
bhagena mā śāṃśapena sākam indreṇa medinā
children.translated_text: With <s>Bhaga</s>, with the śāṃśapa tree, with powerful <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: kṛṇomi bhaginaṃ māpa drāntv arātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I make myself fortunate; let hostilities run away.

children.text: yena vṛkṣāṁ abhyabhavo bhagena varcasā saha
children.translated_text: By that <s>Bhaga</s> with brilliance by which you overcame the trees,

children.text: tena mā bhaginaṃ kṛṇv apa drāntv arātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by that make me fortunate; let hostilities run away.

children.text: yo andho yaḥ punaḥsaro bhago vṛkṣeṣv āhitaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhaga</s> that is blind, that returns again, that is placed in the trees,

children.text: tena mā bhaginaṃ kṛṇv apa drāntv arātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by that make me fortunate; let hostilities run away.

children.text: Chapter 303
rathajitāṃ rāthajiteyīnām apsarasām ayaṃ smaraḥ
children.translated_text: This is the desire of the chariot-winning <s>Apsarases</s>, of the descendants of chariot-winners.

children.text: devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaram asau mām anu śocatu ||
children.translated_text: O gods, send forth desire; let that person burn with longing for me.

children.text: asau me smaratād iti priyo me smaratād iti
children.translated_text: 'Let that person remember me; let the beloved remember me'--

children.text: devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaram asau mām anu śocatu ||
children.translated_text: O gods, send forth desire; let that person burn with longing for me.

children.text: yathā mama smarād asau nāmuṣyāhaṃ kadācana
children.translated_text: As that person may remember me, and I may never remember that one,

children.text: devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaram asau mām anu śocatu ||
children.translated_text: O gods, send forth desire; let that person burn with longing for me.

children.text: un mādayata maruta ud antarikṣa mādaya
children.translated_text: Drive that one mad, O <s>Maruts</s>; O atmosphere, drive that one mad.

children.text: agna un mādayā tvam asau mām anu śocatu ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you drive that one mad; let that person burn with longing for me.

children.text: Chapter 304
ni śīrṣato ni pattata ādhyo ni tirāmi te
children.translated_text: From the head downward, downward let them fall; the cares I thrust downward for you.

children.text: devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaram asau mām anu śocatu ||
children.translated_text: O gods, send forth desire; let that person burn with longing for me.

children.text: anumate 'nv idaṃ manyasvākūte sam idaṃ namaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Anumatī</s>, approve this; O Intention, to this there is reverence.

children.text: devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaram asau mām anu śocatu ||
children.translated_text: O gods, send forth desire; let that person burn with longing for me.

children.text: yad dhāvasi triyojanaṃ pañcayojanam āśvinam
children.translated_text: When you run three yojanas, five yojanas, O one belonging to the <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: tatas tvaṃ punar āyasi putrāṇāṃ no asaḥ pitā ||
children.translated_text: from there you come back again; be the father of our sons.

children.text: Chapter 305
yaṃ devāḥ smaram asiñcann apsv antaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā
children.translated_text: The desire which the gods poured into the waters, blazing within, together with care,

children.text: taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: that I heat for you by the law of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: yaṃ viśve devāḥ smaram asiñcann apsv antaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā
children.translated_text: The desire which all the gods poured into the waters, blazing within, together with care,

children.text: taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: that I heat for you by the law of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: yam indrāṇī smaram asiñcad apsv antaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā
children.translated_text: The desire which <s>Indrāṇī</s> poured into the waters, blazing within, together with care,

children.text: taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: That I heat for you by the <s>dharma</s> of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: yam indrāgnī smaram asiñcatām apsv antaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā
children.translated_text: The passion which <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> poured into the waters, blazing within, together with intention,

children.text: taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: that I heat for you by the <s>dharma</s> of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: yam mitrāvaruṇau smaram asiñcatām apsv antaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā
children.translated_text: The passion which <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> poured into the waters, blazing within, together with intention,

children.text: taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: that I heat for you by the <s>dharma</s> of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: Chapter 306
ya imāṃ devo mekhalām ābabandha yaḥ saṃnanāha ya u no yuyoja
children.translated_text: The god who bound on this girdle, who fastened it, who yoked it for us,

children.text: yasya devasya praśiṣā carāmaḥ sa pāram icchāt sa u no vi muñcāt ||
children.translated_text: the god under whose command we move: may he seek the farther shore, and may he release us.

children.text: āhutāsy abhihuta ṛṣīṇām asy āyudham
children.translated_text: You are offered, you are fully offered; you are the weapon of the seers.

children.text: pūrvā vratasya prāśnatī vīraghnī bhava mekhale ||
children.translated_text: Tasting first of the vow, become a slayer of heroes for me, O girdle.

children.text: mṛtyor ahaṃ brahmacārī yad asmi niryācan bhūtāt puruṣaṃ yamāya
children.translated_text: Since I am a <s>brahmacārin</s> (vowed student) of death, driving the man from the living being to <s>Yama</s>,

children.text: tam ahaṃ brahmaṇā tapasā śrameṇānayainaṃ mekhalayā sināmi ||
children.translated_text: I bind him with <s>brahman</s>, with austerity, with toil, with this girdle.

children.text: śraddhāyā duhitā tapaso 'dhi jātā svasa ṛṣīṇāṃ bhūtakṛtāṃ babhūva
children.translated_text: Born from faith, sprung from austerity, she became the sister of the seers who made beings.

children.text: sā no mekhale matim ā dhehi medhām atho no dhehi tapa indriyaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: May that girdle place thought and intelligence in us; moreover place austerity and vital power in us.

children.text: yāṃ tvā pūrve bhūtakṛta ṛṣayaḥ paribedhire
children.translated_text: You whom the ancient seers, makers of beings, bound around themselves,

children.text: sā tvaṃ pari ṣvajasva māṃ dīrghāyutvāya mekhale ||
children.translated_text: may you embrace me all around for long life, O girdle.

children.text: Chapter 307
ayaṃ vajras tarpayatām ṛtasyāvāsya rāṣṭram apa hantu jīvitam
children.translated_text: May this thunderbolt satisfy <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); may it strike down his realm, away with his life.

children.text: śṛṇātu grīvāḥ pra śṛṇātūṣṇihā vṛtrasyeva śacīpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let it break the necks, let it break the upper neck-bones, like <s>Śacīpati</s> did to <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: adharo'dhara uttarebhyo gūḍhaḥ pṛthivyā mot sṛpat
children.translated_text: Lower than the lower, hidden from those above, let him not creep up from the earth.

children.text: vajreṇāvahataḥ śayām ||
children.translated_text: Struck down by the thunderbolt, may I lie over him.

children.text: yo jināti tam anviccha yo jināti tam ij jahi
children.translated_text: Seek after the one who conquers; strike precisely the one who conquers.

children.text: jinato vajra tvaṃ sīmantam anvañcam anu pātaya ||
children.translated_text: O thunderbolt, make the boundary-line of the conquering one fall after him, following along.

children.text: Chapter 308
yad aśnāmi balaṃ kurva itthaṃ vajram ā dade
children.translated_text: When I eat, making strength, in this way I take up the thunderbolt,

children.text: skandhān amuṣya śātayan vṛtrasyeva śacīpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: shattering that man's shoulders, like <s>Śacīpati</s> did to <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: yat pibāmi saṃ pibāmi samudra iva saṃpibaḥ
children.translated_text: What I drink, I drink up completely; drink up completely like the ocean.

children.text: prāṇān amuṣya sampāya saṃ pibāmo amuṃ vayam ||
children.translated_text: Having drunk up that man's breaths, we drink him up completely.

children.text: yad girāmi saṃ girāmi samudra iva saṃgiraḥ
children.translated_text: What I swallow, I swallow up completely; swallow up completely like the ocean.

children.text: prāṇān amuṣya saṃgīrya saṃ girāmo amum vayam ||
children.translated_text: Having swallowed up that man's breaths, we swallow him up completely.

children.text: Chapter 309
devī devyām adhi jātā pṛthivyām asy oṣadhe
children.translated_text: O herb, goddess born upon the divine earth,

children.text: tāṃ tvā nitatni keśebhyo dṛṃhaṇāya khanāmasi ||
children.translated_text: we dig you up, O spreading one, from the hairs, for firm fixing.

children.text: dṛṃha pratnān janayājātān jātān u varṣīyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Make firm the old ones; generate those not yet born; make the born ones ever longer.

children.text: yas te keśo 'vapadyate samūlo yaś ca vṛścate
children.translated_text: The hair of yours that falls out, root and all, and that which is cut off,

children.text: idaṃ taṃ viśvabheṣajyābhi ṣiñcāmi vīrudhā ||
children.translated_text: I sprinkle that here with the all-healing plant.

children.text: Chapter 310
yāṃ jamadagnir akhanad duhitre keśavardhanīm
children.translated_text: The hair-growing plant which <s>Jamadagni</s> dug up for his daughter,

children.text: tāṃ vītahavya ābharad asitasya gṛhebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vītahavya</s> brought that from the houses of <s>Asita</s>.

children.text: abhīśunā meyā āsan vyāmenānumeyāḥ
children.translated_text: They were measured by the rein, measured again by the span.

children.text: keśā naḍā iva vardhantāṃ śīrṣṇas te asitāḥ pari ||
children.translated_text: May your black hairs grow around your head like reeds.

children.text: dṛṃha mūlam āgraṃ yaccha vi madhyaṃ yāmayauṣadhe
children.translated_text: Strengthen the root, stretch the tip, extend the middle, O herb.

children.text: keśā naḍā iva vardhantām śīrṣṇas te asitāḥ pari ||
children.translated_text: May your black hairs grow around your head like reeds.

children.text: Chapter 311
tvaṃ vīrudhāṃ śreṣṭhatamābhiśrutāsy oṣadhe
children.translated_text: You are famed as the very best of plants, O herb.

children.text: imaṃ me adya puruṣaṃ klībam opaśinaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Make this man of mine today impotent and without virility.

children.text: klībaṃ kṛdhy opaśinam atho kurīriṇaṃ kṛdhi
children.translated_text: Make him impotent, make him without virility; further, make him wearing a woman's head-dress.

children.text: athāsyendro grāvabhyām ubhe bhinattv āṇḍyau ||
children.translated_text: Then let <s>Indra</s> split both his testicles with the pressing-stones.

children.text: klība klībaṃ tvākaraṃ vadhre vadhriṃ tvākaram arasārasaṃ tvākaram
children.translated_text: O impotent one, I have made you impotent; O castrated one, I have made you castrated; O sapless one, I have made you sapless.

children.text: kurīram asya śīrṣaṇi kumbaṃ cādhinidadhmasi ||
children.translated_text: We set a woman's hair-net on his head and a pot as well.

children.text: ye te nāḍyau devakṛte yayos tiṣṭhati vṛṣṇyam
children.translated_text: Those two channels of yours, made by the gods, in which manly power stands,

children.text: te te bhinadmi śamyayāmuṣyā adhi muṣkayoḥ ||
children.translated_text: I split them for you with a peg, upon that man's testicles.

children.text: yathā naḍam kaśipune striyo bhindanty aśmanā
children.translated_text: As women split a reed with a stone for a mat,

children.text: evā bhinadmi te śepo 'muṣyā adhi muṣkayoḥ ||
children.translated_text: so I split your penis upon that man's testicles.

children.text: Chapter 312
nyastikā rurohitha subhagaṃkaraṇī mama
children.translated_text: You have grown up, O low-growing plant, my maker of good fortune.

children.text: śataṃ tava pratānās trayastriṃśan nitānāḥ
children.translated_text: A hundred are your shoots, thirty-three your rootlets.

children.text: tayā sahasraparṇyā hṛdayaṃ śoṣayāmi te ||
children.translated_text: With that thousand-leaved one I dry up your heart.

children.text: śuṣyatu mayi te hṛdayam atho śuṣyatv āsyam
children.translated_text: May your heart dry up toward me, and may your mouth dry up.

children.text: atho ni śuṣya māṃ kāmenātho śuṣkāsyā cara ||
children.translated_text: Then dry up for me with desire; then go about dry-mouthed.

children.text: saṃvananī samuṣyalā babhru kalyāṇi saṃ nuda
children.translated_text: O uniting one, O inflaming one, tawny, auspicious one, drive together.

children.text: amūṃ ca māṃ ca saṃ nuda samānaṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Drive that woman and me together; make our heart the same.

children.text: yathodakam apapuṣo 'paśuṣyaty āsyam
children.translated_text: As the mouth of one without flowers dries up for water,

children.text: evā ni śuṣya māṃ kāmenātho śuṣkāsyā cara ||
children.translated_text: so dry up for me with desire; then go about dry-mouthed.

children.text: yathā nakulo vicchidya saṃdadhāty ahiṃ punaḥ
children.translated_text: As the mongoose, having cut apart the snake, joins it together again,

children.text: evā kāmasya vicchinnaṃ saṃ dhehi vīryāvati ||
children.translated_text: so join together what has been cut off from desire, O powerful one.

children.text: Chapter 313
yau vyāghrāv avarūḍhau jighatsataḥ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca
children.translated_text: Those two tigers that have descended and wish to devour father and mother,

children.text: tau dantau brahmaṇaspate śivau kṛṇu jātavedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: make those two teeth auspicious, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: vrīhim attaṃ yavam attam atho māṣam atho tilam
children.translated_text: Eat rice, eat barley, and also beans and sesame.

children.text: eṣa vāṃ bhāgo nihito ratnadheyāya dantau mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ pitaram mātaraṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: This share of yours has been set down for the treasure-bestowal; O teeth, do not harm father and mother.

children.text: upahūtau sayujau syonau dantau sumaṅgalau
children.translated_text: Called here, yoked together, kindly, auspicious teeth,

children.text: anyatra vāṃ ghoraṃ tanvaḥ paraitu dantau mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: let your terrible part go away elsewhere from the body; O teeth, do not harm father and mother.

children.text: Chapter 314
vāyur enāḥ samākarat tvaṣṭā poṣāya dhriyatām
children.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> has brought these together; let <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> hold them for nourishment.

children.text: indra ābhyo adhi bravad rudro bhūmne cikitsatu ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s> speak over them; let <s>Rudra</s> heal them for abundance.

children.text: lohitena svadhitinā mithunaṃ karṇayoḥ kṛdhi
children.translated_text: With the red knife make a pair on the ears.

children.text: akartām aśvinā lakṣma tad astu prajayā bahu ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Aśvins</s> have made the mark; let it be rich in offspring.

children.text: yathā cakrur devāsurā yathā manuṣyā uta
children.translated_text: As the gods and <s>Asuras</s> made it, and as human beings too,

children.text: evā sahasrapoṣāya kṛṇutaṃ lakṣmāśvinā ||
children.translated_text: so make the mark for thousandfold prosperity, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: Chapter 315
ucchrayasva bahur bhava svena mahasā yava
children.translated_text: Rise high, become abundant by your own greatness, O barley.

children.text: mṛṇīhi viśvā pātrāṇi mā tvā divyāśanir vadhīt ||
children.translated_text: Crush all vessels; let not the heavenly thunderbolt slay you.

children.text: āśṛṇvantaṃ yavaṃ devaṃ yatra tvācchāvadāmasi
children.translated_text: The divine barley that hears us, there where we speak to you...

children.text: tad ucchrayasva dyaur iva samudra ivaidhy akṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Rise up high, like heaven; thrive, inexhaustible like the ocean.

children.text: akṣitās ta upasado 'kṣitāḥ santu rāśayaḥ
children.translated_text: May your approaches be inexhaustible; may your heaps be inexhaustible.

children.text: pṛṇanto akṣitāḥ santv attāraḥ santv akṣitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May those who fill you be inexhaustible; may the eaters be inexhaustible.

children.text: Chapter 316
dhītī vā ye anayan vāco agraṃ manasā vā ye 'vadann ṛtāni
children.translated_text: Those who by inspired thought brought speech to the forefront, or who with the mind spoke the truths,

children.text: tṛtīyena brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānās turīyeṇāmanvata nāma dhenoḥ ||
children.translated_text: growing strong by the third <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), with the fourth they perceived the name of the cow.

children.text: sa veda putraḥ pitaraṃ sa mātaraṃ sa sūnur bhuvat sa bhuvat punarmaghaḥ
children.translated_text: That son knows the father and the mother; he became a son, he became bounteous again.

children.text: sa dyām aurṇod antarikṣaṃ svaḥ sa idaṃ viśvam abhavat sa ābhavat ||
children.translated_text: He covered heaven, the atmosphere, and the heavenly light; he became this whole world, he came into being.

children.text: Chapter 317
atharvāṇaṃ pitaraṃ devabandhuṃ mātur garbhaṃ pitur asuṃ yuvānam
children.translated_text: Of <s>Atharvan</s>, the father, kinsman of the gods, the mother's embryo and the father's young life-breath,

children.text: ya imaṃ yajñam manasā ciketa pra ṇo vocas tam iheha bravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he who has perceived this sacrifice with his mind: proclaim him to us; speak of him here and here.

children.text: Chapter 318
ayā viṣṭhā janayan karvarāṇi sa hi ghṛṇir urur varāya gātuḥ
children.translated_text: With this station, generating the dark forms, for he is glowing and broad, a path for the chosen boon,

children.text: sa pratyudaid dharuṇaṃ madhvo agraṃ svayā tanvā tanvam airayata ||
children.translated_text: he rose back to the support, to the first of honey; with his own body he set body in motion.

children.text: Chapter 319
ekayā ca daśabhiś cā suhūte dvābhyām iṣṭaye viṃśatyā ca
children.translated_text: With one and with ten, O well-invoked one, with two for refreshment and with twenty,

children.text: tisṛbhiś ca vahase triṃśatā ca viyugbhir vāya iha tā vi muñca ||
children.translated_text: with three and with thirty you carry them; O <s>Vāyu</s>, release those teams here.

children.text: Chapter 320
yajñena yajñam ayajanta devās tāni dharmāṇi prathamāny āsan
children.translated_text: By sacrifice the gods sacrificed to sacrifice; those were the first <s>dharmas</s> (sacred ordinances).

children.text: te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those powers reached the heaven where the former gods, the <s>Sādhyas</s>, are.

children.text: yajño babhūva sa ā babhūva sa pra jajñe sa u vāvṛdhe punaḥ
children.translated_text: The sacrifice came into being, it came forth, it was born, and again it grew.

children.text: sa devānām adhipatir babhūva so asmāsu draviṇam ā dadhātu ||
children.translated_text: It became the lord of the gods; may it set wealth among us.

children.text: yad devā devān haviṣā 'yajantāmartyān manasā martyena
children.translated_text: When the gods worshipped the gods, the immortals, with oblation, with a mortal mind,

children.text: madema tatra parame vyoman paśyema tad uditau sūryasya ||
children.translated_text: may we rejoice there in the highest heaven; may we see that at the rising of the sun.

children.text: yat puruṣeṇa haviṣā yajñaṃ devā atanvata
children.translated_text: When, with <s>Puruṣa</s> as the oblation, the gods extended the sacrifice,

children.text: asti nu tasmād ojīyo yad vihavyenejire ||
children.translated_text: is there anything stronger than that, by which they sacrificed with the call for offering?

children.text: mugdhā devā uta śunā 'yajantota gor aṅgaiḥ purudhā 'yajanta
children.translated_text: The bewildered gods sacrificed even with a dog, and with the limbs of a cow they sacrificed in many ways.

children.text: ya imaṃ yajñaṃ manasā ciketa pra ṇo vocas tam iheha bravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who has perceived this sacrifice with his mind: proclaim him to us; speak of him here and here.

children.text: Chapter 321
aditir dyaur aditir antarikṣam aditir mātā sa pitā sa putraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Aditi</s> is heaven; <s>Aditi</s> is the atmosphere; <s>Aditi</s> is mother, father, and son.

children.text: viśve devā aditiḥ pañca janā aditir jātam aditir janitvam ||
children.translated_text: All the gods are <s>Aditi</s>; the five peoples are <s>Aditi</s>; <s>Aditi</s> is what has been born and the power of birth.

children.text: mahīm ū ṣu mātaraṃ suvratānām ṛtasya patnīm avase havāmahe
children.translated_text: We call for aid upon the great mother of those of good vows, the wife of truth.

children.text: tuvikṣatrām ajarantīm urūcīṃ suśarmāṇam aditiṃ supraṇītim ||
children.translated_text: Upon <s>Aditi</s>, strong in dominion, unaging, broad, of good shelter and good guidance.

children.text: sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dyām anehasaṃ suśarmāṇam aditiṃ supraṇītim
children.translated_text: May we mount for welfare the well-protecting earth and heaven, the sinless, good-sheltering, well-guiding <s>Aditi</s>,

children.text: daivīṃ nāvaṃ svaritrām anāgaso asravantīm ā ruhemā svastaye ||
children.translated_text: the divine boat, well-oared, guiltless, and not leaking.

children.text: vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīm aditiṃ nāma vacasā karāmahe
children.translated_text: Now, at the impulse of strength, we make the great mother, <s>Aditi</s> by name, with speech,

children.text: yasyā upastha urv antarikṣaṃ sā naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ ni yacchāt ||
children.translated_text: in whose wide lap is the atmosphere; may she grant us shelter with threefold protection.

children.text: Chapter 322
diteḥ putrāṇām aditer akāriṣam ava devānāṃ bṛhatām anarmaṇām
children.translated_text: I have made a hymn for the sons of <s>Diti</s>, for <s>Aditi</s>, and for the great, unweakened gods.

children.text: teṣāṃ hi dhāma gabhiṣak samudriyaṃ nainān namasā paro asti kaścana ||
children.translated_text: For their seat is very deep and oceanic; no one at all is beyond them in reverent homage.

children.text: Chapter 323
bhadrād adhi śreyaḥ prehi bṛhaspatiḥ puraetā te astu
children.translated_text: Go forth from the auspicious to the better; may <s>Bṛhaspati</s> be your guide in front.

children.text: athemam asyā vara ā pṛthivyā āreśatruṃ kṛṇuhi sarvavīram ||
children.translated_text: Then, in the chosen space of this earth, make this one free from enemies and rich in all heroes.

children.text: Chapter 324
prapathe pathām ajaniṣṭa pūṣā prapathe divaḥ prapathe pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: On the forward path of paths <s>Pūṣan</s> was born, on the forward path of heaven, on the forward path of earth.

children.text: ubhe abhi priyatame sadhasthe ā ca parā ca carati prajānan ||
children.translated_text: He moves both toward and away from the two dearest seats, knowing them.

children.text: pūṣemā āśā anu veda sarvāḥ so asmāṁ abhayatamena neṣat
children.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s> knows all these directions; may he lead us by the safest way.

children.text: svastidā āghṛṇiḥ sarvavīro 'prayucchan pura etu prajānan ||
children.translated_text: Bestower of welfare, glowing, rich in all heroes, never failing, let him go before, knowing.

children.text: pūṣan tava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadācana
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, under your vow may we never be harmed.

children.text: stotāras ta iha smasi ||
children.translated_text: We are your singers here.

children.text: pari pūṣā parastāddhastaṃ dadhātu dakṣiṇam
children.translated_text: Let <s>Pūṣan</s> place his right hand around us from afar.

children.text: punar no naṣṭam ājatu saṃ naṣṭena gamemahi ||
children.translated_text: Let him bring back to us what was lost; may we come together with what was lost.

children.text: Chapter 325
yas te stanaḥ śaśayur yo mayobhūr yaḥ sumnayuḥ suhavo yaḥ sudatraḥ
children.translated_text: That breast of yours which lies ready, which brings delight, which is gracious, easy to invoke, and generous,

children.text: yena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi sarasvati tam iha dhātave kaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with which you nourish all desirable things, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>, appoint that here for support.

children.text: Chapter 326
yas te pṛthu stanayitnur ya ṛṣvo daivaḥ ketur viśvam ābhūṣatīdam
children.translated_text: That broad thunder of yours, that lofty divine signal, adorns all this.

children.text: mā no vadhīr vidyutā deva sasyaṃ mota vadhī raśmibhiḥ sūryasya ||
children.translated_text: Do not strike our crop with lightning, O god, nor strike it with the rays of the sun.

children.text: Chapter 327
sabhā ca mā samitiś cāvatāṃ prajāpater duhitarau saṃvidāne
children.translated_text: May the assembly and the council, the two daughters of <s>Prajāpati</s>, agreeing together, protect me.

children.text: yenā saṃgacchā upa mā sa śikṣāccāru vadāni pitaraḥ saṃgateṣu ||
children.translated_text: May the one by whom I come together instruct me; may I speak beautifully, O Fathers, in gatherings.

children.text: vidma te sabhe nāma nariṣṭā nāma vā asi
children.translated_text: We know your name, O assembly: you are named <s>Nariṣṭā</s>.

children.text: ye te ke ca sabhāsadas te me santu savācasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whatever assembly-sitters are yours, may they be of one speech with me.

children.text: eṣām ahaṃ samāsīnānāṃ varco vijñānam ā dade
children.translated_text: I take to myself the splendor and discernment of these men seated together.

children.text: asyāḥ sarvasyāḥ saṃsado mām indra bhaginaṃ kṛṇu ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, make me fortunate in all this council.

children.text: yad vo manaḥ parāgataṃ yad baddham iha veha vā
children.translated_text: Whatever mind of yours has gone away, whatever is bound here or elsewhere,

children.text: tad va ā vartayāmasi mayi vo ramatāṃ manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we turn that back for you; let your mind take delight in me.

children.text: Chapter 328
yathā sūryo nakṣatrāṇām udyaṃs tejāṃsy ādade
children.translated_text: As the sun, rising, takes the lights of the stars,

children.text: evā strīṇāṃ ca puṃsāṃ ca dviṣatāṃ varca ā dade ||
children.translated_text: so I take the splendor of women and men who hate me.

children.text: yāvanto mā sapatnānām āyantaṃ pratipaśyatha
children.translated_text: As many of my rivals as see me approaching,

children.text: udyant sūrya iva suptānāṃ dviṣatām varca ā dade ||
children.translated_text: rising like the sun among sleepers, I take the splendor of those who hate me.

children.text: Chapter 329
abhi tyaṃ devaṃ savitāram oṇyoḥ kavikratum
children.translated_text: I praise that god <s>Savitṛ</s>, of inspired resolve, from both sides.

children.text: arcāmi satyasavaṃ ratnadhām abhi priyaṃ matim ||
children.translated_text: I praise the true impeller, the giver of treasure, the dear thought.

children.text: ūrdhvā yasyāmatir bhā adidyutat savīmani
children.translated_text: His upward intention shone with radiance at the impelling.

children.text: hiraṇyapāṇir amimīta sukratuḥ kṛpāt svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The golden-handed one, of good wisdom, measured out the heavenly light through his favor.

children.text: sāvīr hi deva prathamāya pitre varṣmāṇam asmai varimāṇam asmai
children.translated_text: For you are strong, O god, for the first father: stature for him, breadth for him.

children.text: athāsmabhyaṃ savitar vāryāṇi divodiva ā suvā bhūri paśvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, O <s>Savitar</s>, send forth for us desirable goods day after day, abundant in cattle.

children.text: damūnā devaḥ savitā vareṇyo dadhad ratnaṃ pitṛbhya āyūṃṣi
children.translated_text: The household god <s>Savitar</s>, worthy to be chosen, placing treasure and life-spans for the Fathers,

children.text: pibāt somaṃ mamadad enam iṣṭe parijmā cit kramate asya dharmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: let him drink Soma; let him rejoice in this at the sacrifice. Even the encircling one moves within his <s>dharma</s> (sacred order).

children.text: Chapter 330
tāṃ savitaḥ satyasavāṃ sucitrām āhaṃ vṛṇe sumatiṃ viśvavārām
children.translated_text: O <s>Savitar</s>, I choose that truthful-impelled, beautifully bright good favor, desirable to all,

children.text: yām asya kaṇvo aduhat prapīnāṃ sahasradhārāṃ mahiṣo bhagāya ||
children.translated_text: which <s>Kaṇva</s> milked, full and thousand-streamed, the great buffalo, for <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: Chapter 331
bṛhaspate savitar vardhayainaṃ jyotayainaṃ mahate saubhagāya
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, O <s>Savitar</s>, increase him; make him shine for great good fortune.

children.text: saṃśitaṃ cit saṃtaraṃ saṃ śiśādhi viśva enam anu madantu devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sharpen even the sharpened one still more; whet him. Let all the gods rejoice in him.

children.text: Chapter 332
dhātā dadhātu no rayim īśāno jagataspatiḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Dhātṛ</s> bestow wealth on us, the sovereign lord of the moving world;

children.text: sa naḥ pūrṇena yacchatu ||
children.translated_text: may he grant it to us in full measure.

children.text: dhātā dadhātu dāśuṣe prācīṃ jīvātum akṣitām
children.translated_text: May <s>Dhātṛ</s> bestow on the worshipper an eastward, imperishable way of life.

children.text: vayam devasya dhīmahi sumatiṃ viśvarādhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: We would hold in mind the good favor of the god whose bounty is universal.

children.text: dhātā viśvā vāryā dadhātu prajākāmāya dāśuṣe duroṇe
children.translated_text: May <s>Dhātṛ</s> place all desirable things in the house for the worshipper who desires offspring.

children.text: tasmai devā amṛtaṃ saṃ vyayantu viśve devā aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: For him may the immortal gods, all the gods together with <s>Aditi</s>, spread immortality around.

children.text: dhātā rātiḥ savitedaṃ juṣantāṃ prajāpatir nidhipatir no agniḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Dhātṛ</s>, <s>Rāti</s>, <s>Savitar</s>, <s>Prajāpati</s>, the lord of treasures, and our <s>Agni</s> accept this.

children.text: tvaṣṭā viṣṇuḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇo yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhātu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, agreeing with offspring, place wealth for the sacrificer.

children.text: Chapter 333
pra nabhasva pṛthivi bhinddhīdaṃ divyaṃ nabhaḥ
children.translated_text: Open out, O earth; split open this heavenly cloud.

children.text: udno divyasya no dhātar īśāno vi ṣyā dṛtim ||
children.translated_text: From the heavenly water, O <s>Dhātṛ</s>, sovereign one, open the water-skin for us.

children.text: na ghraṃs tatāpa na himo jaghāna pra nabhatāṃ pṛthivī jīradānuḥ
children.translated_text: Heat has not scorched it, nor has frost struck it; let the life-giving earth open out.

children.text: āpaś cid asmai ghṛtam it kṣaranti yatra somaḥ sadam it tatra bhadram ||
children.translated_text: Even the waters flow with ghee for him; where Soma is always present, there is blessing.

children.text: Chapter 334
prajāpatir janayati prajā imā dhātā dadhātu sumanasyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> generates these creatures; may <s>Dhātṛ</s>, well-disposed, bestow,

children.text: saṃjānānāḥ saṃmanasaḥ sayonayo mayi puṣṭaṃ puṣṭapatir dadhātu ||
children.translated_text: with those of common understanding, common mind, and common womb, nourishment in me; may the lord of nourishment bestow it.

children.text: Chapter 335
anv adya no 'numatir yajñaṃ deveṣu manyatām
children.translated_text: May <s>Anumati</s> today approve our sacrifice among the gods.

children.text: agniś ca havyavāhano bhavatāṃ dāśuṣe mama ||
children.translated_text: And may <s>Agni</s>, the carrier of oblations, be favorable to me, the worshipper.

children.text: anv id anumate tvaṃ maṃsase śaṃ ca nas kṛdhi
children.translated_text: O <s>Anumati</s>, approve this; bring welfare to us.

children.text: juṣasva havyam āhutaṃ prajāṃ devi rarāsva naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Accept the offered oblation; O goddess, grant us offspring.

children.text: anu manyatām anumanyamānaḥ prajāvantaṃ rayim akṣīyamāṇam
children.translated_text: May the consenting one consent to imperishable wealth rich in offspring.

children.text: tasya vayaṃ heḍasi māpi bhūma sumṛḍīke asya sumatau syāma ||
children.translated_text: May we not come under his anger; may we be in his gracious kindness and good favor.

children.text: yat te nāma suhavaṃ supraṇīte 'numate anumataṃ sudānu
children.translated_text: That name of yours, easy to invoke and well-guiding, O <s>Anumati</s>, approved and bountiful,

children.text: tenā no yajñaṃ pipṛhi viśvavāre rayiṃ no dhehi subhage suvīram ||
children.translated_text: with that sustain our sacrifice, O all-desired one; place wealth for us, O fortunate one, rich in good heroes.

children.text: emaṃ yajñam anumatir jagāma sukṣetratāyai suvīratāyai sujātam
children.translated_text: <s>Anumati</s> has come to this well-born sacrifice for good fields and good heroes.

children.text: bhadrā hy asyāḥ pramatir babhūva semam yajñam avatu devagopā ||
children.translated_text: For her intention has become auspicious; may she, guarded by the gods, protect this sacrifice.

children.text: anumatiḥ sarvam idaṃ babhūva yat tiṣṭhati carati yad u ca viśvam ejati
children.translated_text: <s>Anumati</s> has become all this: what stands, what moves, and whatever in the whole world stirs.

children.text: tasyās te devi sumatau syāmānumate anu hi maṃsase naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we be in that good favor of yours, O goddess; O <s>Anumati</s>, indeed approve us.

children.text: Chapter 336
sameta viśve vacasā patiṃ diva eko vibhūr atithir janānām
children.translated_text: Come together, all of you, with speech to the lord of heaven, the one pervading guest of peoples.

children.text: sa pūrvyo nūtanam āvivāsat taṃ vartanir anu vāvṛta ekam it puru ||
children.translated_text: Ancient, he has attended upon the new; many have turned after that one track.

children.text: Chapter 337
ayaṃ sahasram ā no dṛśe kavīnāṃ matir jyotir vidharmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: This thought of the seers, a thousandfold light, is for our sight in the sacred order.

children.text: bradhnaḥ samīcīr uṣasaḥ sam airayan
children.translated_text: The ruddy one has set the dawns moving together.

children.text: arepasaḥ sacetasaḥ svasare manyumattamāś cite goḥ ||
children.translated_text: The guiltless, mindful sisters, most forceful in spirit, are in the sight of the cow.

children.text: Chapter 338
dauṣvapnyam daurjīvityaṃ rakṣo abhvam arāyyaḥ
children.translated_text: Bad dreaming, bad living, the demon, the monstrous thing, and the ungenerous foes,

children.text: durṇāmnīḥ sarvā durvācas tā asman nāśayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: all ill-named and ill-spoken things: these we destroy away from us.

children.text: Chapter 339
yan na indro akhanad yad agnir viśve devā maruto yat svarkāḥ
children.translated_text: What <s>Indra</s> dug out for us, what <s>Agni</s>, what all the gods, the <s>Maruts</s>, and the heaven-bright ones dug out,

children.text: tad asmabhyaṃ savitā satyadharmā prajāpatir anumatir ni yacchāt ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Savitar</s> of true <s>dharma</s> (sacred order), <s>Prajāpati</s>, and <s>Anumati</s> assign that to us.

children.text: Chapter 340
yayor ojasā skabhitā rajāṃsi yau vīryair vīratamā śaviṣṭhā
children.translated_text: By the might of those two the realms are propped up; those two are strongest and most heroic through their powers.

children.text: yau patyete apratītau sahobhir viṣṇum agan varuṇaṃ pūrvahūtiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those two rule with irresistible forces; the first invocation has gone to <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: yasyedaṃ pradiśi yad virocate pra cānati vi ca caṣṭe śacībhiḥ
children.translated_text: Of whom this shines forth in the regions, and who breathes forward and looks about with his powers,

children.text: purā devasya dharmaṇā sahobhir viṣṇum agan varuṇaṃ pūrvahūtiḥ ||
children.translated_text: by the ancient <s>dharma</s> (sacred order) of the god, with powers, the first invocation has gone to <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: Chapter 341
viṣṇor nu kaṃ pra vocaṃ vīryāṇi yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṃsi
children.translated_text: Now I shall proclaim the heroic deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, who measured out the earthly realms,

children.text: yo askabhāyad uttaraṃ sadhasthaṃ vicakramāṇas tredhorugāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who propped up the upper seat, the wide-striding one, stepping in three ways.

children.text: pra tad viṣṇu stavate vīryāṇi mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: That heroic power of <s>Viṣṇu</s> is praised, like a fearsome wild beast roaming where it will, dwelling in the mountains.

children.text: parāvata ā jagamyāt parasyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he come here from the farthest distance.

children.text: yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣv adhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: In whose three broad strides all the worlds dwell,

children.text: uru viṣṇo vi kramasvoru kṣayāya nas kṛdhi
children.translated_text: stride widely, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>; make broad space for our dwelling.

children.text: ghṛtam ghṛtayone piba prapra yajñapatiṃ tira ||
children.translated_text: Drink the ghee, O ghee-born one; carry the lord of sacrifice onward and onward.

children.text: idaṃ viṣṇur vi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padā
children.translated_text: This <s>Viṣṇu</s> strode forth; in three ways he set down his steps.

children.text: samūḍham asya pāṃsure ||
children.translated_text: His step is hidden in the dust.

children.text: trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇur gopā adābhyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the guardian who cannot be deceived, strode out three steps.

children.text: ito dharmāṇi dhārayan ||
children.translated_text: From here he upholds the <s>dharmas</s> (sacred ordinances).

children.text: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe
children.translated_text: Behold the deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, from where he has looked upon the vows.

children.text: indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā ||
children.translated_text: He is the fitting friend of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired ones always behold that highest station of <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: divīva cakṣur ātatam ||
children.translated_text: spread out like an eye in heaven.

children.text: divo viṣṇa uta pṛthivyā maho viṣṇa uror antarikṣāt
children.translated_text: From heaven, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and from earth, O great <s>Viṣṇu</s>, from the wide atmosphere,

children.text: hastau pṛṇasva bahubhir vasavyair āprayaccha dakṣiṇād ota savyāt ||
children.translated_text: fill your hands with many treasures; stretch them out from the right and from the left.

children.text: Chapter 342
iḍaivāsmāṁ anu vastāṃ vratena yasyāḥ pade punate devayantaḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Iḍā</s> attend upon us by the vow, she at whose footprint those serving the gods purify themselves.

children.text: ghṛtapadī śakvarī somapṛṣṭhopa yajñam asthita vaiśvadevī ||
children.translated_text: Ghee-footed, strong, with Soma on her back, belonging to all the gods, she has taken her place by the sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 343
vedaḥ svastir drughaṇaḥ svastiḥ paraśur vediḥ paraśur naḥ svasti
children.translated_text: The ritual grass-bundle is welfare; the wooden mallet is welfare; the axe and the altar are welfare; the axe is welfare for us.

children.text: haviṣkṛto yajñiyā yajñakāmās te devāso yajñam imaṃ juṣantām ||
children.translated_text: May the gods, made partakers of the oblation, fit for sacrifice and desiring sacrifice, enjoy this sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 344
agnāviṣṇū mahi tad vāṃ mahitvam pātho ghṛtasya guhyasya nāma
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, great indeed is that greatness of yours: you two drink the ghee, the secret name.

children.text: dame dame sapta ratnā dadhānau prati vāṃ jihvā ghṛtam ā caraṇyāt ||
children.translated_text: In every house you two place the seven jewels; let the tongue proceed toward you with ghee.

children.text: agnāviṣṇū mahi dhāma priyam vāṃ vītho ghṛtasya guhyā juṣāṇau
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, great is the dear station of yours, as you two enjoy the secret ghee.

children.text: dame dame suṣṭutyā vāvṛdhānau prati vāṃ jihvā ghṛtam uc caraṇyāt ||
children.translated_text: Growing in every house through good praise, let the tongue proceed upward toward you with ghee.

children.text: Chapter 345
svāktaṃ me dyāvāpṛthivī svāktaṃ mitro akar ayam
children.translated_text: Well invoked for me are Heaven and Earth; well invoked has <s>Mitra</s> made this for me.

children.text: svāktaṃ me brahmaṇaspatiḥ svāktaṃ savitā karat ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> make it well invoked for me; may <s>Savitṛ</s> make it well invoked.

children.text: Chapter 346
indrotibhir bahulābhir no adya yāvacchreṣṭhābhir maghavañchūra jinva
children.translated_text: With manifold aids today, O bountiful heroic <s>Indra</s>, quicken us with those that are best.

children.text: yo no dveṣṭy adharaḥ sas padīṣṭa yam u dviṣmas tam u prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: May the one who hates us fall below; and the one whom we hate, may breath abandon him.

children.text: Chapter 347
upa priyaṃ panipnatam yuvānam āhutīvṛdham
children.translated_text: We have approached the dear youthful one, increased by oblations,

children.text: aganma bibhrato namo dīrgham āyuḥ kṛṇotu me ||
children.translated_text: bearing homage; may he make long life for me.

children.text: Chapter 348
saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ saṃ pūṣā saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: May the <s>Maruts</s> sprinkle me together; may <s>Pūṣan</s>, may <s>Bṛhaspati</s> sprinkle me together.

children.text: saṃ māyam agniḥ siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca dīrgham āyuḥ kṛṇotu me ||
children.translated_text: May this <s>Agni</s> sprinkle me together with offspring and with wealth; may he make long life for me.

children.text: Chapter 349
agne jātān pra ṇudā me sapatnān praty ajātān jātavedo nudasva
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, drive away my rivals who have been born; O <s>Jātavedas</s>, drive away those not yet born.

children.text: adhaspadaṃ kṛṇuṣva ye pṛtanyavo 'nāgasas te vayam aditaye syāma ||
children.translated_text: Put beneath the feet those who are hostile in battle; may we, guiltless, belong to <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: Chapter 350
prānyānt sapatnānt sahasā sahasva praty ajātān jātavedo nudasva
children.translated_text: Overpower the other rivals by force; O <s>Jātavedas</s>, drive away those not yet born.

children.text: idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pipṛhi saubhagāya viśva enam anu madantu devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect this kingdom for good fortune; may all the gods rejoice over it.

children.text: imā yās te śataṃ hirāḥ sahasraṃ dhamanīr uta
children.translated_text: These hundred veins of yours, and also the thousand channels,

children.text: tāsāṃ te sarvāsām aham aśmanā bilam apy adhām ||
children.translated_text: of all those I have closed the opening with a stone.

children.text: paraṃ yoner avaraṃ te kṛṇomi mā tvā prajābhi bhūn mota sūtuḥ
children.translated_text: I make what is below higher than your womb; let offspring not come to you, nor birth.

children.text: asvaṃ tvāprajasaṃ kṛṇomy aśmānaṃ te apidhānam kṛṇomi ||
children.translated_text: I make you without offspring; I make a stone your covering.

children.text: Chapter 351
akṣyau nau madhusaṃkāśe anīkam nau samañjanam
children.translated_text: May our two eyes have the appearance of honey; may our two faces be anointed together.

children.text: antaḥ kṛṇuṣva māṃ hṛdi mana in nau sahāsati ||
children.translated_text: Put me within your heart; let the mind be together in us two.

children.text: Chapter 352
abhi tvā manujātena dadhāmi mama vāsasā
children.translated_text: With a human-born charm I place you under my own garment,

children.text: yathā 'so mama kevalo nānyāsāṃ kīrtayāś cana ||
children.translated_text: so that you may be mine alone, and not even speak the names of other women.

children.text: Chapter 353
idam khanāmi bheṣajaṃ māṃpaśyam abhirorudam
children.translated_text: I dig up this remedy, 'look-at-me,' that makes one cry out for me,

children.text: parāyato nivartanam āyataḥ pratinandanam ||
children.translated_text: the turning back of one going away, the welcoming of one who comes.

children.text: yenā nicakra āsurīndraṃ devebhyas pari
children.translated_text: With that by which the <s>Asurī</s> drew <s>Indra</s> down from the gods,

children.text: tenā ni kurve tvām ahaṃ yathā te 'sāni supriyā ||
children.translated_text: with that I draw you down, so that I may be very dear to you.

children.text: pratīcī somam asi pratīcī uta sūryam
children.translated_text: You face <s>Soma</s>; you face also the Sun.

children.text: pratīcī viśvān devān tāṃ tvācchāvadāmasi ||
children.translated_text: You face all the gods; to you we speak here.

children.text: ahaṃ vadāmi net tvaṃ sabhāyām aha tvaṃ vada
children.translated_text: I speak, not you, in the assembly; now you speak as I say.

children.text: mamed asas tvaṃ kevalo nānyāsāṃ kīrtayāś cana ||
children.translated_text: You shall be mine alone, and not even speak the names of other women.

children.text: yadi vāsi tirojanaṃ yadi vā nadyastiraḥ
children.translated_text: Whether you are beyond people, or whether you are across the rivers,

children.text: iyaṃ ha mahyaṃ tvām oṣadhir baddhveva nyānayat ||
children.translated_text: this herb has brought you down to me as if bound.

children.text: Chapter 354
divyaṃ suparṇaṃ payasaṃ bṛhantam apāṃ garbhaṃ vṛṣabham oṣadhīnām
children.translated_text: May the divine fair-winged one, rich in milk, great, the embryo of the waters and bull of the plants,

children.text: abhīpato vṛṣṭyā tarpayantam ā no goṣṭhe rayiṣṭhāṃ sthāpayāti ||
children.translated_text: satisfying with rain as he descends, establish richest wealth in our cattle-stall.

children.text: Chapter 355
yasya vrataṃ paśavo yanti sarve yasya vrata upatiṣṭhanta āpaḥ
children.translated_text: He whose ordinance all cattle follow, at whose ordinance the waters stand near,

children.text: yasya vrate puṣṭapatir niviṣṭas taṃ sarasvantam avase havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: in whose ordinance the lord of increase is established: that <s>Sarasvant</s> we call for aid.

children.text: ā pratyañcaṃ dāśuṣe dāśvāṃsaṃ sarasvantaṃ puṣṭapatiṃ rayiṣṭhām
children.translated_text: Toward the generous worshipper may generous <s>Sarasvant</s>, lord of increase and richest in wealth, come near,

children.text: rāyas poṣaṃ śravasyuṃ vasānā iha sadanaṃ rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: clothed in the growth of wealth and seeking renown, here to the seat of riches.

children.text: Chapter 356
ati dhanvāny aty apas tatarda śyeno nṛcakṣā avasānadarśaḥ
children.translated_text: Across the dry lands, across the waters, the eagle has pierced through, seeing men and looking down upon dwellings.

children.text: taran viśvāny avarā rajāṃsīndreṇa sakhyā śiva ā jagamyāt ||
children.translated_text: Crossing all the lower realms, may he come to us auspiciously through friendship with <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: śyeno nṛcakṣā divyaḥ suparṇaḥ sahasrapācchatayonir vayodhāḥ
children.translated_text: The eagle, seeing men, heavenly, fair-winged, thousand-footed, hundred-wombed, giver of life,

children.text: sa no ni yacchād vasu yat parābhṛtam asmākam astu pitṛṣu svadhāvat ||
children.translated_text: may he bring down for us the wealth that has been carried far away; let it be ours among the fathers, rich in <s>svadhā</s> (ancestral offering).

children.text: Chapter 357
somārudrā vi vṛhataṃ viṣūcīm amīvā yā no gayam āviveśa
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s>, tear apart and scatter the disease that has entered our household.

children.text: bādhethāṃ dūraṃ nirṛtim parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cid enaḥ pra mumuktam asmat ||
children.translated_text: Drive ruin far away in distant directions; release from us even the sin that has been committed.

children.text: somārudrā yuvam etāny asmad viśvā tanūṣu bheṣajāni dhattam
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s>, place in our bodies all these remedies that are ours.

children.text: ava syataṃ muñcataṃ yan no asat tanūṣu baddhaṃ kṛtam eno asmat ||
children.translated_text: Loosen and release whatever sin committed by us has been bound in our bodies.

children.text: Chapter 358
śivās ta ekā aśivās ta ekāḥ sarvā bibharṣi sumanasyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: One of your voices is auspicious, one of yours is inauspicious; favorably minded, you bear them all.

children.text: tisro vāco nihitā antar asmin tāsām ekā vi papātānu ghoṣam ||
children.translated_text: Three voices are set within him; of them one has flown forth after the sound.

children.text: Chapter 359
ubhā jigyathur na parā jayethe na parā jigye kataraś canainayoḥ
children.translated_text: You both conquered; you are not defeated. Neither of the two of you was defeated.

children.text: indraś ca viṣṇo yad apaspṛdhethāṃ tredhā sahasraṃ vi tad airayethām ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s> contended, you two sent forth the thousand in threefold form.

children.text: Chapter 360
janād viśvajanīnāt sindhutas pary ābhṛtam
children.translated_text: From the people, from all peoples, from beyond the river it was brought,

children.text: dūrāt tvā manya udbhṛtam īrṣyāyā nāma bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: from far away, I think, you were brought: the remedy named for jealousy.

children.text: agner ivāsya dahato dāvasya dahataḥ pṛthak
children.translated_text: As of a burning fire, as of a burning forest fire, each apart,

children.text: etām etasyerṣyām udnāgnim iva śamaya ||
children.translated_text: so quench this jealousy of his with water, like a fire.

children.text: Chapter 361
sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke yā devānām asi svasā
children.translated_text: O <s>Sinīvālī</s>, broad-hipped one, you who are the sister of the gods,

children.text: juṣasva havyam āhutaṃ prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: enjoy the oblation that has been offered; O goddess, assign offspring to us.

children.text: yā subāhuḥ svaṅguriḥ suṣūmā bahusūvarī
children.translated_text: She who is fair-armed, fair-fingered, easy in childbirth, bearing many children,

children.text: tasyai viśpatnyai haviḥ sinīvālyai juhotana ||
children.translated_text: to her, the mistress of the people, to <s>Sinīvālī</s>, offer the oblation.

children.text: yā viśpatnīndram asi pratīcī sahasrastukābhiyantī devī
children.translated_text: You who are mistress of the people, facing <s>Indra</s>, thousand-tressed, approaching as a goddess,

children.text: viṣṇoḥ patni tubhyaṃ rātā havīṃṣi patiṃ devi rādhase codayasva ||
children.translated_text: O wife of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the oblations have been given to you; O goddess, impel the husband toward bounty.

children.text: Chapter 362
kuhūṃ devīṃ sukṛtaṃ vidmanāpasam asmin yajñe suhavā johavīmi
children.translated_text: I repeatedly call in this sacrifice the goddess <s>Kuhū</s>, well-working and skilled in her task.

children.text: sā no rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ ni yacchād dadātu vīram śatadāyam ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: May she allot to us that wealth desired by all; may she give a hero worthy of a hundred gifts and of praise.

children.text: kuhūr devānām amṛtasya patnī havyā no asya haviṣo juṣeta
children.translated_text: May <s>Kuhū</s>, wife of the gods and of the immortal one, enjoy our offerings of this oblation.

children.text: śṛṇotu yajñam uśatī no adya rāyas poṣaṃ cikituṣī dadhātu ||
children.translated_text: Eager, let her hear our sacrifice today; knowing well, let her bestow increase of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 363
rākām ahaṃ suhavā suṣṭutī huve śṛṇotu naḥ subhagā bodhatu tmanā
children.translated_text: I call on <s>Rākā</s>, easy to invoke, with excellent praise; let the fortunate one hear us and attend with her own self.

children.text: sīvyatv apaḥ sūcyāchidyamānayā dadātu vīraṃ śatadāyam ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: Let her sew up the work with an unbroken needle; let her give a hero worthy of a hundred gifts and of praise.

children.text: yās te rāke sumatayaḥ supeśaso yābhir dadāsi dāśuṣe vasūni
children.translated_text: Those fair and gracious favors of yours, O <s>Rākā</s>, by which you give goods to the worshipper,

children.text: tābhir no adya sumanā upāgahi sahasrāpoṣam subhage rarāṇā ||
children.translated_text: with those come to us today, well-disposed, O fortunate one, gladly bestowing thousandfold nourishment.

children.text: Chapter 364
devānāṃ patnīr uśatīr avantu naḥ prāvantu nas tujaye vājasātaye
children.translated_text: May the wives of the gods, eager, help us; may they protect us for offspring and for the winning of strength.

children.text: yāḥ pārthivāso yā apām api vrate tā no devīḥ suhavāḥ śarma yacchantu ||
children.translated_text: Those who are earthly and those who are also in the ordinance of the waters, may those goddesses, easy to invoke, grant us shelter.

children.text: uta gnā vyantu devapatnīr indrāṇy agnāyy aśvinī rāṭ
children.translated_text: And may the divine women, the gods' wives, come: <s>Indrāṇī</s>, <s>Agnāyī</s>, and the queenly <s>Aśvinī</s>.

children.text: ā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu vyantu devīr ya ṛtur janīnām ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Rodasī</s> and <s>Varuṇānī</s> hear; let the goddesses come, those who are the season of women.

children.text: Chapter 365
yathā vṛkṣam aśanir viśvāhā hanty aprati
children.translated_text: As lightning strikes a tree every day, irresistibly,

children.text: evāham adya kitavān akṣair badhyāsam aprati ||
children.translated_text: so may I today bind the gamblers with the dice, irresistibly.

children.text: turāṇām aturāṇāṃ viśām avarjuṣīṇām
children.translated_text: Of the swift and the unswift, of the clans that are not favorable,

children.text: samaitu viśvato bhago antarhastaṃ kṛtaṃ mama ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Bhaga</s> come together from every side into my inner hand, together with my winning throw.

children.text: īḍe agniṃ svāvasuṃ namobhir iha prasakto vi cayat kṛtaṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Agni</s>, rich in good possessions, with reverences; joined here, may he discern our winning throw.

children.text: rathair iva pra bhare vājayadbhiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ marutāṃ stomam ṛdhyām ||
children.translated_text: As with chariots that carry forward in competition, may I make the praise of the <s>Maruts</s> prosper to the right.

children.text: vayaṃ jayema tvayā yujā vṛtam asmākam aṃśam ud ava bhare bhare
children.translated_text: May we win, yoked with you, what is enclosed; in each contest may I bring up our share.

children.text: asmabhyam indra varīyaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi pra śatrūṇāṃ maghavan vṛṣṇyā ruja ||
children.translated_text: For us, O <s>Indra</s>, make the better way easy; O bountiful one, shatter the manly force of the enemies.

children.text: ajaiṣaṃ tvā saṃlikhitam ajaiṣam uta saṃrudham
children.translated_text: I have conquered you, marked down together; I have conquered also what was held shut.

children.text: aviṃ vṛko yathā mathad evā mathnāmi te kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: As a wolf would shake a sheep, so I shake your winning throw.

children.text: uta prahām atidīvā jayati kṛtam iva śvaghnī vi cinoti kāle
children.translated_text: And the one who throws beyond wins with the forward cast; like one who kills dogs, he chooses the winning throw at the proper time.

children.text: yo devakāmo na dhanam ruṇaddhi sam it taṃ rāyaḥ sṛjati svadhābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The man who desires the gods and does not hold back wealth, for him riches release themselves by their own powers.

children.text: gobhiṣ ṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena vā kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśve
children.translated_text: With cows may we cross over this evil-minded distress, and with barley, hunger, O much-invoked one, all of us.

children.text: vayaṃ rājasu prathamā dhanāny ariṣṭāso vṛjanībhir jayema ||
children.translated_text: May we, unharmed, be first among kings and win riches with our bands of men.

children.text: kṛtaṃ me dakṣiṇe haste jayo me savya āhitaḥ
children.translated_text: The winning throw is in my right hand; victory is set in my left.

children.text: gojid bhūyāsam aśvajid dhanaṃjayo hiraṇyajit ||
children.translated_text: May I become a winner of cows, a winner of horses, a winner of wealth, a winner of gold.

children.text: akṣāḥ phalavatīm dyuvaṃ datta gāṃ kṣīriṇīm iva
children.translated_text: O dice, give a fruitful gaming board, like a milk-giving cow.

children.text: saṃ mā kṛtasya dhārayā dhanuḥ snāvneva nahyata ||
children.translated_text: Bind me with the stream of the winning throw, as a bow is bound with a sinew.

children.text: Chapter 366
bṛhaspatir naḥ pari pātu paścād utottarasmād adharād aghāyoḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Bṛhaspati</s> protect us from behind, and also from the north and below, from the evil-doer.

children.text: indraḥ purastād uta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varīyaḥ kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, from the front and from the middle, make wider room for us, a friend for his friends.

children.text: Chapter 367
saṃjñānaṃ naḥ svebhiḥ saṃjñānam araṇebhiḥ
children.translated_text: Let there be common understanding for us with our own people, common understanding with strangers.

children.text: saṃjñānam aśvinā yuvam ihāsmāsu ni yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: O two <s>Aśvins</s>, establish common understanding here among us.

children.text: saṃ jānāmahai manasā saṃ cikitvā mā yutsmahi manasā daivyena
children.translated_text: May we know together in mind, may we understand together; let us not contend with a divine mind.

children.text: mā ghoṣā ut sthur bahule vinirhate meṣuḥ paptad indrasyāhany āgate ||
children.translated_text: Let no shouts rise up in the great slaughter; let no arrow fall when the day of <s>Indra</s> has come.

children.text: Chapter 368
amutrabhūyād adhi yad yamasya bṛhaspate abhiśaster amuñcaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever yonder belongs under the power of <s>Yama</s>, O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, you have released from the curse.

children.text: praty auhatām aśvinā mṛtyum asmad devānām agne bhiṣajā śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the two <s>Aśvins</s> drive death back from us; O <s>Agni</s>, do so with the healing powers of the gods.

children.text: saṃ krāmataṃ mā jahītaṃ śarīraṃ prāṇāpānau te sayujāv iha stām
children.translated_text: Come together; do not abandon the body. May your <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s>, yoked together, remain here.

children.text: śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamāno 'gniṣ ṭe gopā adhipā vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Live a hundred autumns, growing greater; <s>Agni</s> is your guardian, your overlord, the most excellent.

children.text: āyur yat te atihitaṃ parācair apānaḥ prāṇaḥ punar ā tāv itām
children.translated_text: The life of yours that has been set far away by those turned away, let <s>apāna</s> and <s>prāṇa</s>, those two, come back here.

children.text: agniṣ ṭad āhār nirṛter upasthāt tad ātmani punar ā veśayāmi te ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has brought that from the lap of <s>Nirṛti</s>; I make it enter back again into your own self.

children.text: memaṃ prāṇo hāsīn mo apāno 'vahāya parā gāt
children.translated_text: Let <s>prāṇa</s> not leave this man; let <s>apāna</s> not go away, abandoning him.

children.text: saptarṣibhya enaṃ pari dadāmi te enaṃ svasti jarase vahantu ||
children.translated_text: I hand him over to the seven seers; let them carry him safely to old age.

children.text: pra viśataṃ prāṇāpānāvanaḍvāhāviva vrajam
children.translated_text: Enter, <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s>, like two draught oxen entering a stall.

children.text: ayaṃ jarimnaḥ śevadhir ariṣṭa iha vardhatām ||
children.translated_text: May this treasure-house of old age grow here, unharmed.

children.text: ā te prāṇaṃ suvāmasi parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te
children.translated_text: We call your <s>prāṇa</s> hither; I drive your wasting disease away from you.

children.text: āyur no viśvato dadhad ayam agnir vareṇyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May this excellent <s>Agni</s> set life for us on every side.

children.text: ud vayaṃ tamasas pari rohanto nākam uttamam
children.translated_text: Rising up beyond the darkness, we have mounted to the highest heaven.

children.text: devaṃ devatrā sūryam aganma jyotir uttamam ||
children.translated_text: We have reached the god <s>Sūrya</s> among the gods, the highest light.

children.text: Chapter 369
ṛcaṃ sāma yajāmahe yābhyāṃ karmāṇi kurvate
children.translated_text: We worship <s>Ṛc</s> and <s>Sāman</s>, by which the rites are performed.

children.text: ete sadasi rājato yajñaṃ deveṣu yacchataḥ ||
children.translated_text: These two, ruling in the assembly-seat, convey the sacrifice among the gods.

children.text: ṛcaṃ sāma yad aprākṣaṃ havir ojo yajur balam
children.translated_text: When I have questioned <s>Ṛc</s>, <s>Sāman</s>, oblation, vigor, <s>Yajus</s>, and strength,

children.text: eṣa mā tasmān mā hiṃsīd vedaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ śacīpate ||
children.translated_text: let this <s>Veda</s>, when questioned, not harm me because of that, O lord of power.

children.text: Chapter 370
ye te panthāno 'va divo yebhir viśvam airayaḥ
children.translated_text: Those paths of yours down from heaven, by which you have set the whole world in motion,

children.text: tebhiḥ sumnayā dhehi no vaso ||
children.translated_text: by those, with favor, place us in well-being, O good one.

children.text: Chapter 371
tiraścirājer asitāt pṛdākoḥ pari saṃbhṛtam
children.translated_text: The poison gathered from the cross-striped, black, speckled creature,

children.text: tat kaṅkaparvaṇo viṣam iyaṃ vīrud anīnaśat ||
children.translated_text: that poison of the jointed <s>Kaṅka</s> this plant has made disappear.

children.text: iyaṃ vīrun madhujātā madhuścun madhulā madhūḥ
children.translated_text: This plant is honey-born, honey-dripping, honeyed, full of honey.

children.text: sā vihrutasya bheṣajy atho maśakajambhanī ||
children.translated_text: It is the remedy for the twisted one, and also the crusher of the mosquito.

children.text: yato daṣṭaṃ yato dhītaṃ tatas te nir hvayāmasi
children.translated_text: From where it has bitten, from where it has been injected, from there we call out your poison,

children.text: arbhasya tṛpradaṃśino maśakasyārasaṃ viṣam ||
children.translated_text: the sapless poison of the small, sharply biting mosquito.

children.text: ayaṃ yo vakro viparur vyaṅgo mukhāni vakrā vṛjinā kṛṇoṣi
children.translated_text: This one, crooked, misshapen, deformed: you make mouths crooked and distorted.

children.text: tāni tvaṃ brahmaṇaspate iṣīkām iva saṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, bend together like a reed-stalk.

children.text: arasasya śarkoṭasya nīcīnasyopasarpataḥ
children.translated_text: Of the sapless <s>Śarkoṭa</s>, creeping downward as it approaches,

children.text: viṣaṃ hy asyādiṣy atho enam ajījabham ||
children.translated_text: I have indeed consumed its poison; moreover I have made it numb.

children.text: na te bāhvor balam asti na śīrṣe nota madhyataḥ
children.translated_text: There is no strength in your arms, nor in your head, nor also in your middle.

children.text: atha kiṃ pāpayāmuyā pucche bibharṣy arbhakam ||
children.translated_text: Then why, O wicked one, do you carry the little one in your tail?

children.text: adanti tvā pipīlikā vi vṛścanti mayūryaḥ
children.translated_text: The ants eat you; the peahens tear you apart.

children.text: sarve bhala bravātha śārkoṭam arasaṃ viṣam ||
children.translated_text: All of you declare the <s>śārkoṭa</s> poison to be sapless poison.

children.text: ya ubhābhyāṃ praharasi pucchena cāsyena ca
children.translated_text: You who strike with both, with tail and with mouth,

children.text: āsye na te viṣaṃ kim u te puchadhāv asat ||
children.translated_text: there is no poison in your mouth; what, then, might there be in your tail?

children.text: Chapter 372
yad āśasā vadato me vicukṣubhe yad yācamānasya carato janāṁ anu
children.translated_text: What was shaken loose from me when I spoke with hope, when I went about among people as a petitioner,

children.text: yad ātmani tanvo me viriṣṭaṃ sarasvatī tad ā pṛṇad ghṛtena ||
children.translated_text: whatever was injured in my self and body, may <s>Sarasvatī</s> fill that up with ghee.

children.text: sapta kṣaranti śiśave marutvate pitre putrāso apy avīvṛtann ṛtāni
children.translated_text: Seven streams flow for the child accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>; the sons have turned the sacred truths back to the father.

children.text: ubhe id asyobhe asya rājata ubhe yatete ubhe asya puṣyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Both, indeed both, belong to him and rule; both strive, both make him prosper.

children.text: Chapter 373
indrāvaruṇā sutapāv imaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ pibataṃ madyaṃ dhṛtavratau
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, drinkers of the pressed Soma, drink this pressed Soma, the intoxicating drink, O you of firm vows.

children.text: yuvo ratho adhvaro devavītaye prati svasaram upa yātu pītaye ||
children.translated_text: May your chariot come to the rite, to the divine feast, toward its sister for drinking.

children.text: indrāvaruṇā madhumattamasya vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, O vigorous ones, may you be invigorated by this bull-like Soma, most full of sweetness.

children.text: idaṃ vām andhaḥ pariṣiktam āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayethām ||
children.translated_text: Sitting down upon this strewn grass, delight in this draught poured out for you.

children.text: Chapter 374
yo naḥ śapād aśapataḥ śapato yaś ca naḥ śapāt
children.translated_text: Whoever curses us without being cursed, and whoever curses us when cursed,

children.text: vṛkṣa iva vidyutā hata ā mūlād anu śuṣyatu ||
children.translated_text: let him dry up from the root like a tree struck by lightning.

children.text: Chapter 375
ūrjaṃ bibhrad vasuvaniḥ sumedhā aghoreṇa cakṣuṣā mitriyeṇa
children.translated_text: Bearing nourishment, winning wealth, wise, with a friendly eye that is not terrible,

children.text: gṛhān aimi sumanā vandamāno ramadhvam mā bibhīta mat ||
children.translated_text: I come to the houses, well-minded and paying homage; take delight, do not be afraid of me.

children.text: ime gṛhā mayobhuva ūrjasvantaḥ payasvantaḥ
children.translated_text: These houses are joy-bringing, full of strength and full of milk.

children.text: pūrṇā vāmena tiṣṭhantas te no jānantv āyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Standing full of what is lovely, may they know us as we come.

children.text: yeṣām adhyeti pravasan yeṣu saumanaso bahuḥ
children.translated_text: Those in which one dwells while away from home, those in which there is much good-mindedness,

children.text: gṛhān upa hvayāmahe te no jānantv āyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: we call upon the houses; may they know us as we come.

children.text: upahūtā bhūridhanāḥ sakhāyaḥ svādusaṃmudaḥ
children.translated_text: Called here, rich in wealth, friends, sweetly rejoicing,

children.text: akṣudhyā atṛṣyā sta gṛhā māsmad bibhītana ||
children.translated_text: be free from hunger and free from thirst, O houses; do not fear us.

children.text: upahūtā iha gāva upahūtā ajāvayaḥ
children.translated_text: The cows have been called here; the goats and sheep have been called here.

children.text: atho annasya kīlāla upahūto gṛheṣu ||
children.translated_text: And the rich essence of food has been called here into the houses.

children.text: sūnṛtāvantaḥ subhagā irāvanto hasāmudāḥ
children.translated_text: Possessing pleasant speech, fortunate, rich in refreshment, laughing with joy,

children.text: atṛṣyā akṣudhyā sta gṛhā māsmad bibhītana ||
children.translated_text: be free from thirst and free from hunger, O houses; do not fear us.

children.text: ihaiva sta mānu gāta viśvā rūpāṇi puṣyata
children.translated_text: Remain right here; do not go away after him; foster all forms.

children.text: aiṣyāmi bhadreṇā saha bhūyāṃso bhavatā mayā ||
children.translated_text: I shall come together with good fortune; may you become more numerous with me.

children.text: Chapter 376
yad agne tapasā tapa upatapyāmahe tapaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with the heat with which we heat ourselves, we undergo heat.

children.text: priyāḥ śrutasya bhūyāsmāyuṣmantaḥ sumedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we become dear to sacred learning, long-lived and wise.

children.text: agne tapas tapyāmaha upa tapyāmahe tapaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, we heat ourselves with heat; we undergo heat.

children.text: śrutāni śṛṇvantaḥ vayam āyuṣmantaḥ sumedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Hearing what has been heard, may we be long-lived and wise.

children.text: Chapter 377
ayam agniḥ satpatir vṛddhavṛṣṇo rathīva pattīn ajayat purohitaḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s>, true lord, grown in virility, like a charioteer has conquered the foot-soldiers, the household priest.

children.text: nābhā pṛthivyāṃ nihito davidyutad adhaspadaṃ kṛṇutāṃ ye pṛtanyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set in the navel of the earth, flashing brightly, may he put beneath his feet those who are hostile.

children.text: Chapter 378
pṛtanājitaṃ sahamānam agnim ukthair havāmahe paramāt sadhasthāt
children.translated_text: With hymns we call <s>Agni</s>, battle-winning and overpowering, from the highest seat.

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati durgāṇi viśvā kṣāmad devo 'ti duritāny agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Agni</s> carry us across all strongholds; may <s>Agni</s> carry us beyond hardships.

children.text: Chapter 379
idaṃ yat kṛṣṇaḥ śakunir abhiniṣpatann apīpatat
children.translated_text: This, that the black bird, flying down upon us, made fall,

children.text: āpo mā tasmāt sarvasmād duritāt pāntv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the waters protect me from all that evil and distress.

children.text: idaṃ yat kṛṣṇaḥ śakunir avāmṛkṣan nirṛte te mukhena
children.translated_text: This, that the black bird touched down, O <s>Nirṛti</s>, with your mouth,

children.text: agnir mā tasmād enaso gārhapatyaḥ pra muñcatu ||
children.translated_text: from that offence may <s>Agni</s> the Gārhapatya fire release me.

children.text: Chapter 380
pratīcīnaphalo hi tvam apāmārga rurohitha
children.translated_text: For you have grown up, O <s>apāmārga</s>, bearing fruit turned backward.

children.text: sarvān macchapathāṁ adhi varīyo yavayā itaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drive away from here all curses against me, with greater power.

children.text: yad duṣkṛtaṃ yac chamalaṃ yad vā cerima pāpayā
children.translated_text: Whatever wrong-doing, whatever impurity, or whatever we have done through wickedness,

children.text: tvayā tad viśvatomukhāpāmārgāpa mṛjmahe ||
children.translated_text: with you, O all-faced <s>apāmārga</s>, we wipe that away.

children.text: śyāvadatā kunakhinā baṇḍena yat sahāsima
children.translated_text: What we have endured together with the black-toothed, bad-nailed, impotent man,

children.text: apāmārga tvayā vayaṃ sarvaṃ tad apa mṛjmahe ||
children.translated_text: O <s>apāmārga</s>, with you we wipe all that away.

children.text: Chapter 381
yady antarikṣe yadi vāta āsa yadi vṛkṣeṣu yadi volapeṣu
children.translated_text: If it was in the midspace, or if it was in the wind, if in the trees or in the shrubs,

children.text: yad asravan paśava udyamānaṃ tad brāhmaṇaṃ punar asmān upaitu ||
children.translated_text: whatever sacred power flowed away as the cattle were being driven, may that <s>brahman</s> return to us again.

children.text: Chapter 382
punar maitv indriyaṃ punar ātmā draviṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca
children.translated_text: May strength return to me, may the self return, and wealth and <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: punar agnayo dhiṣṇyā yathāsthāma kalpayantām ihaiva ||
children.translated_text: May the sacred fires on their hearths set us again in our proper place, right here.

children.text: Chapter 383
sarasvati vrateṣu te divyeṣu devi dhāmasu
children.translated_text: O <s>Sarasvatī</s>, among your vows, in your divine abodes, O goddess,

children.text: juṣasva havyam āhutaṃ prajām devi rarāsva naḥ ||
children.translated_text: accept the offered oblation; O goddess, bestow offspring upon us.

children.text: idaṃ te havyaṃ ghṛtavat sarasvatīdaṃ pitṝṇāṃ havir āsyaṃ yat
children.translated_text: This oblation of yours, rich in ghee, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>; this oblation is the mouth of the Fathers.

children.text: imāni ta uditā śaṃtamāni tebhir vayaṃ madhumantaḥ syāma ||
