children.translated_text: These most peaceful utterances of yours have been spoken; through them may we become full of sweetness.

children.text: śivā naḥ śaṃtamā bhava sumṛḍīkā sarasvati
children.translated_text: Be auspicious and most peaceful for us, kindly gracious, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: mā te yuyoma saṃdṛśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we not be separated from the sight of you.

children.text: Chapter 384
śaṃ no vāto vātu śaṃ nas tapatu sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: May the wind blow blessing for us; may the sun warm us with blessing.

children.text: ahāni śaṃ bhavantu naḥ śaṃ rātrī prati dhīyatāṃ
children.translated_text: May the days be blessings for us; may the night be set down as blessing.

children.text: śaṃ uṣā no vy ucchatu ||
children.translated_text: May the dawn shine forth for us with blessing.

children.text: Chapter 385
yat kiṃ cāsau manasā yac ca vācā yajñair juhoti haviṣā yajuṣā
children.translated_text: Whatever that man offers with mind and whatever with speech, with sacrifices, oblation, and sacrificial formula,

children.text: tan mṛtyunā nirṛtiḥ saṃvidānā purā satyād āhutiṃ hantv asya ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Nirṛti</s>, in league with Death, strike down his offering before it reaches truth.

children.text: yātudhānā nirṛtir ād u rakṣas te asya ghnantv anṛtena satyam
children.translated_text: May the <s>Yātudhānas</s>, <s>Nirṛti</s>, and the <s>Rakṣases</s> kill his truth with falsehood.

children.text: indreṣitā devā ājyam asya mathnantu mā tat saṃ pādi yad asau juhoti ||
children.translated_text: Sent by <s>Indra</s>, may the gods churn away his ghee; may what that man offers not succeed.

children.text: ajirādhirājau śyenau saṃpātināv iva
children.translated_text: Like two swift overlords, two falcons flying together,

children.text: ājyaṃ pṛtanyato hatāṃ yo naḥ kaścābhyaghāyati ||
children.translated_text: let them strike down the ghee of the enemy, whoever has plotted against us.

children.text: apāñcau ta ubhau bāhū apinahyāmy āsyam
children.translated_text: I bind down both your arms, turned away, and your mouth.

children.text: agner devasya manyunā tena te 'vadhiṣaṃ haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: By the wrath of the god <s>Agni</s>, with that I have struck down your oblation.

children.text: apinahyāmi te bāhū apinahyāmy āsyam
children.translated_text: I bind down your arms; I bind down your mouth.

children.text: agner ghorasya manyunā tena 'vadhiṣaṃ haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: By the wrath of terrible <s>Agni</s>, with that I have struck down your oblation.

children.text: Chapter 386
pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi
children.translated_text: Around you, O <s>Agni</s>, we set a stronghold; we meditate upon the inspired one of might.

children.text: dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ dive dive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Day after day, the stone-colored one, the smiter of the breaker's possession.

children.text: Chapter 387
ut tiṣṭhatāva paśyatendrasya bhāgam ṛtviyam
children.translated_text: Stand up; look upon <s>Indra</s>'s proper ritual share.

children.text: yadi śrātam juhotana yady aśrātaṃ mamattana ||
children.translated_text: If it is cooked, offer it; if it is uncooked, take delight in it.

children.text: śrātam havir o ṣv indra pra yāhi jagāma sūro adhvano vi madhyam
children.translated_text: The oblation is cooked; O <s>Indra</s>, go forth here. The sun has gone on its road and has measured out the middle of the path.

children.text: pari tvāsate nidhibhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kulapā na vrājapatim carantam ||
children.translated_text: Friends sit around you with treasures, like protectors of the household attending the moving lord of the fold.

children.text: śrātaṃ manya ūdhani śrātam agnau suśṛtaṃ manye tad ṛtaṃ navīyaḥ
children.translated_text: I think it cooked in the udder, cooked in the fire; well cooked, I think, is that newer truth.

children.text: mādhyandinasya savanasya dadhnaḥ pibendra vajrin purukṛj juṣāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drink the curds of the midday pressing, O <s>Indra</s> the thunderbolt-bearer, much-working one, taking pleasure in them.

children.text: Chapter 388
samiddho agnir vṛṣaṇā rathī divas tapto gharmo duhyate vām iṣe madhu
children.translated_text: The kindled <s>Agni</s>, bull and chariot-fighter, is from heaven; the heated <s>gharma</s> (hot milk offering) is milked for you two as honey for nourishment.

children.text: vayaṃ hi vāṃ purudamāso aśvinā havāmahe sadhamādeṣu kāravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For we, the poets rich in many gifts, call upon you two, O <s>Aśvins</s>, in the shared rites.

children.text: samiddho agnir aśvinā tapto vāṃ gharma ā gatam
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is kindled, O <s>Aśvins</s>; the <s>gharma</s> has been heated for you. Come here.

children.text: duhyante nūnaṃ vṛṣaṇeha dhenavo dasrā madanti vedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now the cows are being milked here for you, O bulls; the wondrous wise ones rejoice.

children.text: svāhākṛtaḥ śucir deveṣu yajño yo aśvinoś camaso devapānaḥ
children.translated_text: The sacrifice made with svāhā is pure among the gods, the cup of divine drinking for the two <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: tam u viśve amṛtāso juṣāṇā gandharvasya praty āsnā rihanti ||
children.translated_text: All the immortals, enjoying it, lick it with their mouths near the <s>Gandharva</s>.

children.text: yad usriyāsv āhutaṃ ghṛtaṃ payo 'yaṃ sa vām aśvinā bhāga ā gatam
children.translated_text: That ghee and milk which has been offered among the cows: this is your share, O <s>Aśvins</s>; come to it.

children.text: mādhvī dhartārā vidathasya satpatī taptaṃ gharmaṃ pibatam divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sweet supporters of the sacred gathering, true lords, drink the heated <s>gharma</s> from heaven.

children.text: tapto vāṃ gharmo nakṣatu svahotā pra vām adhvaryuś caratu payasvān
children.translated_text: May the heated <s>gharma</s>, well offered, reach you two; may the milk-rich <s>Adhvaryu</s> move forward for you.

children.text: madhor dugdhasyāśvinā tanāyā vītaṃ pātaṃ payasa usriyāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, enjoy and drink the milk of the cow, the offspring of sweet milk.

children.text: upa drava payasā godhug oṣam ā gharme siñca paya usriyāyāḥ
children.translated_text: Run up with milk, O milker of cows; quickly pour the cow's milk into the <s>gharma</s>.

children.text: vi nākam akhyat savitā vareṇyo 'nuprayāṇam uṣaso vi rājati ||
children.translated_text: The excellent <s>Savitar</s> has looked across the vault; he shines after the departure of dawn.

children.text: upa hvaye sudughāṃ dhenum etāṃ suhasto godhug uta dohad enām
children.translated_text: I call upon this good-milking cow; let the skillful-handed milker also milk her.

children.text: śreṣṭhaṃ savaṃ savitā sāviṣan no 'bhīddho gharmas tad u ṣu pra vocat ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Savitar</s> impel for us the best pressing; the kindled <s>gharma</s> has now proclaimed it.

children.text: hiṃkṛṇvatī vasupatnī vasūnāṃ vatsam icchantī manasā nyāgan
children.translated_text: Lowing, mistress of goods, seeking her calf in mind, she has come near.

children.text: duhām aśvibhyāṃ payo aghnyeyaṃ sā vardhatāṃ mahate saubhagāya ||
children.translated_text: Let this inviolate cow yield milk for the <s>Aśvins</s>; may she grow for great good fortune.

children.text: juṣṭo damūnā atithir duroṇa imaṃ no yajñam upa yāhi vidvān
children.translated_text: Accepted household guardian, guest in the dwelling, come knowingly to this sacrifice of ours.

children.text: viśvā agne abhiyujo vihatya śatrūyatām ā bharā bhojanāni ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, having struck down all attackers, bring us the foods of those who act as enemies.

children.text: agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnāny uttamāni santu
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, strengthen us for great good fortune; may your highest splendors be ours.

children.text: saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamam ā kṛṇuṣva śatrūyatām abhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: Make household union well controlled; stand above the great powers of those who act as enemies.

children.text: sūyavasād bhagavatī hi bhūyā adhā vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma
children.translated_text: May the blessed one come from good pasture; then may we be blessed.

children.text: addhi tṛṇam aghnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddham udakam ācarantī ||
children.translated_text: Eat the grass, O inviolate one, all-giving; drink the pure water as you move about.

children.text: Chapter 389
apacitāṃ lohinīnāṃ kṛṣṇā māteti śuśruma
children.translated_text: Of the red <s>apacits</s> (swellings), we have heard that the black one is the mother.

children.text: muner devasya mūlena sarvā vidhyāmi tā aham ||
children.translated_text: With the root of the divine <s>Muni</s>, I pierce all of them.

children.text: vidhyāmy āsāṃ prathamāṃ vidhyāmi uta madhyamām
children.translated_text: I pierce the first of these; I pierce also the middle one.

children.text: idaṃ jaghanyām āsām ā chinadmi stukām iva ||
children.translated_text: This last one among them I cut off like a tuft.

children.text: tvāṣṭreṇāhaṃ vacasā vi ta īrṣyām amīmadam
children.translated_text: With <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>'s utterance I have driven your jealousy away.

children.text: atho yo manyuṣ ṭe pate tam u te śamayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: And whatever anger of yours is directed toward your husband, that too we pacify for you.

children.text: vratena tvaṃ vratapate samakto viśvāhā sumanā dīdihīha
children.translated_text: Anointed by the vow, O lord of the vow, shine here every day with a kindly mind.

children.text: taṃ tvā vayaṃ jātavedaḥ samiddhaṃ prajāvanta upa sadema sarve ||
children.translated_text: May we all, rich in offspring, approach you, O kindled <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: Chapter 390
prajāvatīḥ sūyavase ruśantīḥ śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ
children.translated_text: Rich in offspring, in good pasture, shining, drinking pure waters at a good watering-place,

children.text: mā va stena īśata māghaśaṃsaḥ pari vo rudrasya hetir vṛṇaktu ||
children.translated_text: may no thief or evil-speaker gain power over you; may <s>Rudra</s>'s missile pass around you.

children.text: padajñā stha ramatayaḥ saṃhitā viśvanāmnīḥ
children.translated_text: You are path-knowing, delight-bringing, joined together, bearing all names.

children.text: upa mā devīr devebhir eta
children.translated_text: Come near me, divine ones, together with the gods.

children.text: imaṃ goṣṭham idaṃ sado ghṛtenāsmānt sam ukṣata ||
children.translated_text: Sprinkle this cattle-pen, this seat, and us with ghee.

children.text: Chapter 391
ā susrasaḥ susraso asatībhyo asattarāḥ
children.translated_text: Flowing well, very well-flowing, more unreal than the unreal ones,

children.text: sehor arasatarā lavaṇād vikledīyasīḥ ||
children.translated_text: more sapless than sehor, wetter than salt.

children.text: yā graivyā apacito 'tho yā upapakṣyāḥ
children.translated_text: Those <s>apacits</s> that are on the neck, and those that are under the armpits,

children.text: vijāmni yā apacitaḥ svayaṃsrasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: those <s>apacits</s> born apart, self-oozing, in their separate birth,

children.text: yaḥ kīkasāḥ praśṛṇāti talīdyam avatiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: the <s>jāyānya</s> (disease) that breaks the ribs and settles in the lower part,

children.text: nirāstaṃ sarvaṃ jāyānyam yaḥ kaś ca kakudi śritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: all <s>jāyānya</s>, whatever is lodged on the hump or shoulder, is driven out.

children.text: pakṣī jāyānyaḥ patati sa ā viśati pūruṣam
children.translated_text: The winged <s>jāyānya</s> flies and enters the person.

children.text: tad akṣitasya bheṣajam ubhayoḥ sukṣatasya ca ||
children.translated_text: That is the remedy for the uninjured and for both who are well injured.

children.text: vidma vai te jāyānya jānaṃ yato jāyānya jāyase
children.translated_text: We know your birth, O <s>jāyānya</s>; we know from where you are born, O <s>jāyānya</s>.

children.text: kathaṃ ha tatra tvam hano yasya kṛṇmo havir gṛhe ||
children.translated_text: How will you kill there, in the house of the one for whom we make an oblation?

children.text: dhṛṣat piba kalaśe somam indra vṛtrahā śūra samare vasūnām
children.translated_text: Boldly drink <s>Soma</s> in the pitcher, O <s>Indra</s>, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, hero in the contest for goods.

children.text: mādhyandine savana ā vṛṣasva rayiṣṭhāno rayim asmāsu dhehi ||
children.translated_text: At the midday pressing, grow strong; as the richest, place wealth among us.

children.text: Chapter 392
sāṃtapanā idaṃ havir marutas taj jujuṣṭana
children.translated_text: O heat-bringing <s>Maruts</s>, this is the oblation; take pleasure in it.

children.text: asmākotī riśādasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O crushers of foes, be our aid.

children.text: yo no marto maruto durhṛṇāyus tiraś cittāni vasavo jighāṃsati
children.translated_text: Whatever mortal, O <s>Maruts</s>, with malicious life and perverse thoughts seeks to kill us, O <s>Vasus</s>,

children.text: druhaḥ pāśān prati muñcatāṃ sas tapiṣṭhena tapasā hantanā tam ||
children.translated_text: set loose against him the snares of treachery; strike him down with the hottest heat.

children.text: samvatsarīṇā marutaḥ svarkā urukṣayāḥ sagaṇā mānuṣāsaḥ
children.translated_text: O yearly <s>Maruts</s>, heaven-bright, wide-dwelling, together with your troop, human among men,

children.text: te asmat pāśān pra muñcantv enasas sāṃtapanā matsarā mādayiṣṇavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may they release us from the snares of sin, the heat-bringing, exhilarating, gladdening ones.

children.text: Chapter 393
vi te muñcāmi raśanāṃ vi yoktraṃ vi niyojanam
children.translated_text: I unfasten your rope, your yoke-strap, and your harnessing.

children.text: ihaiva tvam ajasra edhy agne ||
children.translated_text: Here alone, unceasing, grow strong, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: asmai kṣatrāṇi dhārayantam agne yunajmi tvā brahmaṇā daivyena
children.translated_text: For this one, O <s>Agni</s>, as he upholds powers of rule, I yoke you with divine <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation).

children.text: dīdihy asmabhyaṃ draviṇeha bhadraṃ premaṃ voco havirdām devatāsu ||
children.translated_text: Shine here for us with auspicious wealth; speak this forward among the deities, O oblation-bearer.

children.text: Chapter 394
yat te devā akṛṇvan bhāgadheyam amāvāsye saṃvasanto mahitvā
children.translated_text: That share which the gods, dwelling together on the new-moon night, made for you by their greatness,

children.text: tenā no yajñaṃ pipṛhi viśvavāre rayiṃ no dhehi subhage suvīram ||
children.translated_text: By that, sustain our sacrifice, O all-desired one; place wealth for us, O fortunate one, rich in good heroes.

children.text: aham evāsmy amāvāsyā mām ā vasanti sukṛto mayīme
children.translated_text: I myself am <s>Amāvāsyā</s>; the well-doers come to me, these ones within me.

children.text: mayi devā ubhaye sādhyāś cendrajyeṣṭhāḥ sam agacchanta sarve ||
children.translated_text: In me both groups of gods, the <s>Sādhyas</s> and all those headed by <s>Indra</s>, have come together.

children.text: āgan rātrī saṃgamanī vasūnām ūrjaṃ puṣṭaṃ vasv āveśayantī
children.translated_text: Night has come, the gatherer of treasures, bringing strength and nourishment, making wealth enter.

children.text: amāvāsyāyai haviṣā vidhemorjaṃ duhānā payasā na āgan ||
children.translated_text: Let us worship <s>Amāvāsyā</s> with oblation; milking strength, she has come to us with milk.

children.text: amāvāsye na tvad etāny anyo viśvā rūpāṇi paribhūr jajāna
children.translated_text: O <s>Amāvāsyā</s>, no one other than you has encompassed and generated all these forms.

children.text: yatkāmās te juhumas tan no astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: Whatever desires we sacrifice to you for, let that be ours; may we be lords of riches.

children.text: Chapter 395
pūrṇā paścāduta pūrṇā purastādunmadhyataḥ paurṇamāsī jigāya
children.translated_text: Full behind and full in front, from the middle <s>Paurṇamāsī</s>, the full-moon night, has arisen victorious.

children.text: tasyāṃ devaiḥ saṃvasanto mahitvā nākasya pṛṣṭhe sam iṣā madema ||
children.translated_text: Dwelling with the gods in her, through greatness, may we rejoice with refreshment on the back of heaven.

children.text: vṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vayaṃ paurṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe
children.translated_text: We sacrifice to <s>Paurṇamāsa</s>, the bull, the prize-winning one.

children.text: sa no dadātv akṣitāṃ rayim anupadasvatīm ||
children.translated_text: May he give us inexhaustible wealth that does not slip away.

children.text: prajāpate na tvad etāny anyo viśvā rūpāṇi paribhūr jajāna
children.translated_text: O <s>Prajāpati</s>, no one other than you has encompassed and generated all these forms.

children.text: yatkāmās te juhumas tan no astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: Whatever desires we sacrifice to you for, let that be ours; may we be lords of riches.

children.text: paurṇamāsī prathamā yajñiyāsīd ahnāṃ rātrīṇām atiśarvareṣu
children.translated_text: <s>Paurṇamāsī</s> was the first one worthy of sacrifice among days and nights, among the very dark nights.

children.text: ye tvām yajñair yajñiye ardhayanty amī te nāke sukṛtaḥ praviṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who strengthen you, O worthy one, with sacrifices: those well-doers have entered heaven.

children.text: Chapter 396
pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau śiśū krīḍantau pari yāto 'rṇavam
children.translated_text: These two move before and after by their wondrous power; like two children playing, they go around the ocean.

children.text: viśvānyo bhuvanā vicaṣṭa ṛtūṃr anyo vidadhaj jāyase navaḥ ||
children.translated_text: One beholds all beings; the other, arranging the seasons, is born anew.

children.text: navonavo bhavasi jāyamāno 'hnāṃ ketur uṣasām eṣy agram
children.translated_text: New again and again you become as you are born; the sign of the days, you go to the front of the dawns.

children.text: bhāgaṃ devebhyo vi dadhāsy āyan pra candramas tirase dīrgham āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: As you come, you apportion a share for the gods; O <s>Candramas</s>, you extend long life.

children.text: somasyāṃśo yudhāṃ pate 'nūno nāma vā asi
children.translated_text: You are a portion of <s>Soma</s>, O lord of battles, or your name is <s>Anūna</s>, the undiminished.

children.text: anūnam darśa mā kṛdhi prajayā ca dhanena ca ||
children.translated_text: Make us undiminished, O <s>Darśa</s>, in offspring and in wealth.

children.text: darśo 'si darśato 'si samagro 'si samantaḥ
children.translated_text: You are <s>Darśa</s>; you are visible; you are whole; you are complete on every side.

children.text: samagraḥ samanto bhūyāsaṃ gobhir aśvaiḥ prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena ||
children.translated_text: May I become whole and complete on every side with cows, horses, offspring, cattle, houses, and wealth.

children.text: yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas tasya tvaṃ prāṇenā pyāyasva
children.translated_text: Whoever hates us, and whomever we hate, with his breath may you increase yourself.

children.text: ā vayaṃ pyāsiṣīmahi gobhir aśvaiḥ prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena ||
children.translated_text: May we increase with cows, horses, offspring, cattle, houses, and wealth.

children.text: yaṃ devā aṃśum āpyāyayanti yam akṣitam akṣitā bhakṣayanti
children.translated_text: That portion which the gods cause to swell, which the inexhaustible ones consume as inexhaustible,

children.text: tenāsmān indro varuṇo bṛhaspatir ā pyāyayantu bhuvanasya gopāḥ ||
children.translated_text: with that may <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the guardians of the world, cause us to swell.

children.text: Chapter 397
abhy arcata suṣṭutiṃ gavyam ājim asmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta
children.translated_text: Sing forth a fine praise, a cow-winning contest; place auspicious treasures among us.

children.text: imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumat pavantām ||
children.translated_text: Lead this sacrifice to our deity; may streams of ghee flow sweetly.

children.text: mayy agre agniṃ gṛhṇāmi saha kṣatreṇa varcasā balena
children.translated_text: In myself, first, I take hold of <s>Agni</s>, together with dominion, brilliance, and strength.

children.text: mayi prajāṃ mayy āyur dadhāmi svāhā mayy agnim ||
children.translated_text: In myself I place offspring; in myself I place life. Svāhā; in myself I place <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: ihaivāgne adhi dhārayā rayim mā tvā ni kran pūrvacittā nikāriṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Here itself, O <s>Agni</s>, hold wealth firmly; may the plotting destroyers not bring you down.

children.text: kṣatreṇāgne suyamam astu tubhyam upasattā vardhatāṃ te aniṣṭṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With dominion, O <s>Agni</s>, let there be good control for you; may your worshipper grow, unharmed.

children.text: anv agnir uṣasām agram akhyad anv ahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, <s>Jātavedas</s>, first beheld the beginning of the dawns, and then the days.

children.text: anu sūrya uṣaso anu raśmīn anu dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: After the sun, after the dawns, after the rays, he entered heaven and earth.

children.text: praty agnir uṣasām agram akhyat prati ahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, <s>Jātavedas</s>, first looked toward the beginning of the dawns, toward the days.

children.text: prati sūryasya purudhā ca raśmīn prati dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatāna ||
children.translated_text: Toward the many rays of the sun, toward heaven and earth, he stretched himself out.

children.text: ghṛtaṃ te agne divye sadhasthe ghṛtena tvāṃ manur adyā samindhe
children.translated_text: Ghee is yours, O <s>Agni</s>, in the heavenly seat; with ghee <s>Manu</s> kindles you today.

children.text: ghṛtaṃ te devīr naptya ā vahantu ghṛtaṃ tubhyaṃ duhratāṃ gāvo agne ||
children.translated_text: Let the divine waters bring ghee to you; let the cows milk ghee for you, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: Chapter 398
apsu te rājan varuṇa gṛho hiraṇyayo mitaḥ
children.translated_text: In the waters, O king <s>Varuṇa</s>, your golden house is measured out.

children.text: tato dhṛtavrato rājā sarvā dāmāni muñcatu ||
children.translated_text: From there may the king, firm in his vow, release all bonds.

children.text: dāmno dāmno rājann ito varuṇa muñca naḥ
children.translated_text: From every bond, O king <s>Varuṇa</s>, release us from here.

children.text: yad āpo aghnyā iti varuṇeti yad ūcima tato varuṇa muñca naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Because we said, 'O waters, O inviolate ones,' and because we said, 'O <s>Varuṇa</s>,' from that release us, O <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: ud uttamaṃ varuṇa pāśam asmad avādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya
children.translated_text: Lift off from us the highest noose, O <s>Varuṇa</s>; loosen down the lowest, and unfasten the middle one.

children.text: adhā vayam āditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma ||
children.translated_text: Then, O <s>Āditya</s>, under your vow, may we be sinless for <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: prāsmat pāśān varuṇa muñca sarvān ya uttamā adhamā vāruṇā ye
children.translated_text: Release from us all the nooses of <s>Varuṇa</s>, those highest and those lowest that belong to <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: duṣvapnyaṃ duritaṃ niṣvāsmad atha gacchema sukṛtasya lokam ||
children.translated_text: Drive away bad dreaming and evil from us; then may we go to the world of good deed.

children.text: Chapter 399
anādhṛṣyo jātavedā amartyo virāḍ agne kṣatrabhṛd dīdihīha
children.translated_text: Invincible <s>Jātavedas</s>, immortal and sovereign, O <s>Agni</s>, bearer of dominion, shine here.

children.text: viśvā amīvāḥ pramuñcan mānuṣībhiḥ śivābhir adya paripāhi no gayam ||
children.translated_text: Releasing all diseases by auspicious human aids, protect our household today.

children.text: indra kṣatram abhi vāmam ojo 'jāyathā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, you were born as dominion, desirable force, O bull of peoples.

children.text: apānudo janam amitrayantam uruṃ devebhyo akṛṇor u lokam ||
children.translated_text: Driving away the man who acts as an enemy, you made a broad space for the gods.

children.text: mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jagamyāt parasyāḥ
children.translated_text: Like a fearsome beast, roaming where it will, dwelling in the mountains, may he come from the farthest distance beyond.

children.text: sṛkaṃ saṃśāya pavim indra tigmaṃ vi śatrūn tāḍhi vi mṛdho nudasva ||
children.translated_text: Sharpening the hooked weapon and the keen missile, O <s>Indra</s>, strike the enemies apart; drive the hostile attacks apart.

children.text: Chapter 400
tyam ū ṣu vājinaṃ devajūtaṃ sahovānaṃ tarutāraṃ rathānām
children.translated_text: That swift steed, urged by the gods, powerful, overcoming chariots,

children.text: ariṣṭanemiṃ pṛtanājim āśuṃ svastaye tārkṣyam ihā huvema ||
children.translated_text: with unharmed wheel-rim, quick in battle, let us call <s>Tārkṣya</s> here for welfare.

children.text: Chapter 401
trātāram indram avitāram indraṃ have have suhavaṃ śūram indram
children.translated_text: I call <s>Indra</s> the protector, <s>Indra</s> the helper, <s>Indra</s> the easily invoked hero at every call.

children.text: huve nu śakraṃ puruhūtam indraṃ svasti na indro maghavān kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: Now I call <s>Śakra</s>, the much-invoked <s>Indra</s>; may <s>Indra</s> <s>Maghavan</s> make welfare for us.

children.text: Chapter 402
yo agnau rudro yo apsv antar ya oṣadhīr vīrudha āviveśa
children.translated_text: The <s>Rudra</s> who is in <s>Agni</s>, who is within the waters, who has entered the herbs and plants,

children.text: ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni cākﾱpe tasmai rudrāya namo astv agnaye ||
children.translated_text: who has fashioned all these beings: to that <s>Rudra</s>, to <s>Agni</s>, let there be homage.

children.text: Chapter 403
apehy arir asy arir vā asi viṣe viṣam apṛkthā viṣam id vā apṛkthāḥ
children.translated_text: Go away, enemy! You are his enemy, or you are an enemy. O poison, you have mixed poison with poison; indeed, you have mixed poison.

children.text: ahim evābhyapehi taṃ jahi ||
children.translated_text: Go straight against that serpent; strike it down.

children.text: Chapter 404
apo divyā acāyiṣam rasena sam apṛkṣmahi
children.translated_text: I have gone to the heavenly waters; we have mingled with their essence.

children.text: payasvān agna āgamaṃ tam mā saṃ sṛja varcasā ||
children.translated_text: Rich in nourishment, O <s>Agni</s>, I have come; join me with splendor.

children.text: saṃ māgne varcasā sṛja saṃ prajayā sam āyuṣā
children.translated_text: Join me, O <s>Agni</s>, with splendor; join me with offspring and with length of life.

children.text: vidyur me asya devā indro vidyāt saha ṛṣibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the gods know this of me; may <s>Indra</s> know it together with the seers.

children.text: idam āpaḥ pra vahatāvadyaṃ ca malaṃ ca yat
children.translated_text: Carry away from here, O waters, whatever offence and whatever impurity there is,

children.text: yac cābhidudrohānṛtaṃ yac ca śepe abhīruṇam ||
children.translated_text: and whatever treachery or falsehood there has been, and whatever curse I have uttered in fear.

children.text: edho 'sy edhiṣīya samid asi sam edhiṣīya
children.translated_text: You are fuel; may I become kindled. You are a kindling-stick; may I be fully kindled.

children.text: tejo 'si tejo mayi dhehi ||
children.translated_text: You are brilliance; place brilliance in me.

children.text: Chapter 405
api vṛśca purāṇavad vratater iva guṣpitam
children.translated_text: Cut it off, as in the old manner, like the knotted growth of a creeper.

children.text: ojo dāsasya dambhaya ||
children.translated_text: Crush the strength of the <s>Dāsa</s>.

children.text: vayaṃ tad asya saṃbhṛtaṃ vasv indrena vi bhajāmahai
children.translated_text: We divide among ourselves that wealth of his, gathered together, with <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: mlāpayāmi bhrajaḥ śibhraṃ varuṇasya vratena te ||
children.translated_text: By the vow of <s>Varuṇa</s> I make your brightness and your gleaming force wither.

children.text: yathā śepo apāyātai strīṣu cāsad anāvayāḥ
children.translated_text: As the male organ has gone away and among women has become without emission,

children.text: avasthasya kladīvataḥ śāṅkurasya nitodinaḥ
children.translated_text: of the flaccid one standing still, moist, piercing like a thorn,

children.text: yad ātatam ava tat tanu yad uttataṃ ni tat tanu ||
children.translated_text: what is stretched out, loosen that; what is raised up, lay that down.

children.text: Chapter 406
indraḥ sutrāmā svavāṁ avobhiḥ sumṛḍīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, good protector, strong in himself, gracious with his aids, all-knowing, be kindly disposed.

children.text: bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ naḥ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: May he drive away hatred; may he make us fearless. May we be lords of excellent heroic strength.

children.text: Chapter 407
sa sutrāmā svavāṁ indro asmad ārāc cid dveṣaḥ sanutar yuyotu
children.translated_text: May that good protector, self-strong <s>Indra</s>, keep hatred far away from us, even from afar.

children.text: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma ||
children.translated_text: May we be within the good favor and blessed kindness of that worshipful one.

children.text: Chapter 408
indreṇa manyunā vayam abhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ
children.translated_text: With the wrath of <s>Indra</s> may we overcome those who fight against us,

children.text: ghnanto vṛtrāṇy aprati ||
children.translated_text: striking down obstacles, unopposed.

children.text: Chapter 409
dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣāva somaṃ nayāmasi
children.translated_text: With a firm oblation we lead Soma firmly onward.

children.text: yathā na indraḥ kevalīr viśaḥ saṃmanasas karat ||
children.translated_text: So may <s>Indra</s> make our peoples unanimous and belonging to him alone.

children.text: Chapter 410
ud asya śyāvau vithurau gṛdhrau dyām iva petatuḥ
children.translated_text: His two dark, trembling vultures have flown upward, as if to heaven,

children.text: ucchocanapraśocanāv asyocchocanau hṛdaḥ ||
children.translated_text: burning upward and burning forth, the burning pains of his heart.

children.text: aham enāv ud atiṣṭhipaṃ gāvau śrāntasadāv iva
children.translated_text: I have made these two stand up, like two oxen resting when weary,

children.text: kurkurāv iva kūjantāv udavantau vṛkāv iva ||
children.translated_text: yelping like two dogs, flowing like two wolves at the water.

children.text: ātodinau nitodināv atho saṃtodināv uta
children.translated_text: Piercing, sharply piercing, and also completely piercing,

children.text: api nahyāmy asya meḍhraṃ ya itaḥ strī pumān jabhāra ||
children.translated_text: I bind fast the penis of the one, whether woman or man, who has carried it away from here.

children.text: Chapter 411
asadan gāvaḥ sadane 'paptad vasatiṃ vayaḥ
children.translated_text: The cows have sat down in their stall; the birds have flown to their dwelling.

children.text: āsthāne parvatā asthuḥ sthāmni vṛkkāv atiṣṭhipam ||
children.translated_text: The mountains have stood in their place; I have made the two kidneys stand in their station.

children.text: Chapter 412
yad adya tvā prayati yajñe asmin hotaś cikitvann avṛṇīmahīha
children.translated_text: When today, at the start of this sacrifice, O knowing <s>Hotṛ</s>, we have chosen you here,

children.text: dhruvam ayo dhruvam utā śaviṣṭha pravidvān yajñam upa yāhi somam ||
children.translated_text: firm is the iron, firm too, O mightiest one; knowing well, approach the sacrifice, the Soma.

children.text: sam indra no manasā neṣa gobhiḥ saṃ sūribhir harivant saṃ svastyā
children.translated_text: Lead us together, O <s>Indra</s>, with mind, with cows, together with patrons, O bay-horsed one, together with well-being,

children.text: saṃ brahmaṇā devahitaṃ yad asti saṃ devānāṃ sumatau yajñiyānām ||
children.translated_text: together with the sacred formulation that is established by the gods, together in the good favor of the worshipful gods.

children.text: yān āvaha uśato deva devāṃs tān preraya sve agne sadhasthe
children.translated_text: The gods whom you bring here, O god, when they desire, impel them in your own seat, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: jakṣivāṃsaḥ papivāṃso madhūny asmai dhatta vasavo vasūni ||
children.translated_text: Having eaten and drunk the sweet offerings, bestow riches on this man, O <s>Vasus</s>.

children.text: sugā vo devāḥ sadanā akarma ya ājagma savane mā juṣāṇāḥ
children.translated_text: We have made your seats easy, O gods, you who have come to the pressing, gladly accepting.

children.text: vahamānā bharamāṇāḥ svā vasūni vasuṃ gharmaṃ divam ā rohatānu ||
children.translated_text: Carrying and bearing your own goods, ascend to heaven, carrying the good hot offering.

children.text: yajña yajñaṃ gaccha yajñapatiṃ gaccha
children.translated_text: O sacrifice, go to the sacrifice; go to the lord of sacrifice.

children.text: svāṃ yoniṃ gaccha svāhā ||
children.translated_text: Go to your own womb. Svāhā!

children.text: eṣa te yajño yajñapate sahasūktavākaḥ
children.translated_text: This is your sacrifice, O lord of sacrifice, accompanied by the recitation of a thousand hymns,

children.text: suvīryaḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: rich in heroic strength. Svāhā!

children.text: vaṣaḍḍhutebhyo vaṣaḍ ahutebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Vaṣaṭ to those for whom the oblation has been poured; vaṣaṭ to those for whom it has not been poured.

children.text: devā gātuvido gātuṃ vittvā gātum ita ||
children.translated_text: O gods who know the path, having found the path, go by the path.

children.text: manasas pata imaṃ no divi deveṣu yajñam
children.translated_text: O lord of the mind, this sacrifice of ours among the gods in heaven,

children.text: svāhā divi svāhā pṛthivyāṃ svāhāntarikṣe svāhā vāte dhāṃ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: svāhā in heaven, svāhā on earth, svāhā in the midspace, svāhā in the wind, svāhā in the domain.

children.text: Chapter 413
saṃ barhir aktaṃ haviṣā ghṛtena sam indreṇa vasunā saṃ marudbhiḥ
children.translated_text: May the strewn sacred grass, anointed with oblation and ghee, be united with <s>Indra</s>, with wealth, with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: saṃ devair viśvadevebhir aktam indraṃ gacchatu haviḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: Anointed together with the gods, with all the gods, may the oblation go to <s>Indra</s>. Svāhā!

children.text: Chapter 414
pari stṛṇīhi pari dhehi vediṃ mā jāmiṃ moṣīr amuyā śayānām
children.translated_text: Strew all around; enclose the altar. Do not steal the sister lying there.

children.text: hotṛṣadanam haritaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ niṣkā ete yajamānasya loke ||
children.translated_text: These golden necklaces are the green-gold seat of the <s>Hotṛ</s> in the world of the sacrificer.

children.text: Chapter 415
paryāvarte duṣvapnyāt pāpāt svapnyād abhūtyāḥ
children.translated_text: I turn away from a bad dream, from an evil dream, from misfortune.

children.text: brahmāham antaraṃ kṛṇve parā svapnamukhāḥ śucaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I, a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, make a barrier; let the burning griefs whose faces are dreams go far away.

children.text: Chapter 416
yat svapne annam aśnāmi na prātar adhigamyate
children.translated_text: The food that I eat in a dream and that is not obtained in the morning,

children.text: sarvaṃ tad astu me śivaṃ nahi tad dṛśyate divā ||
children.translated_text: may all that be auspicious for me, for it is not seen by day.

children.text: Chapter 417
namaskṛtya dyāvāpṛthivībhyām antarikṣāya mṛtyave
children.translated_text: Having paid homage to heaven and earth, to the midspace, and to death,

children.text: mekṣyāmy ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan mā mā hiṃsiṣur īśvarāḥ ||
children.translated_text: I shall urinate standing upright; may the powerful ones not harm me.

children.text: Chapter 418
ko asyā no druho 'vadyavatyā un neṣyati kṣatriyo vasya icchan
children.translated_text: Who among us will lead upward out of this harmful treachery, a ruler seeking good?

children.text: ko yajñakāmaḥ ka u pūrtikāmaḥ ko deveṣu vanute dīrgham āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Who desires sacrifice? Who desires works of merit? Who wins long life among the gods?

children.text: Chapter 419
kaḥ pṛśniṃ dhenuṃ varuṇena dattām atharvane sudughāṃ nityavatsām
children.translated_text: Who, accepting the dappled milch-cow given by <s>Varuṇa</s> to <s>Atharvan</s>, easy to milk and always with calf,

children.text: bṛhaspatinā sakhyaṃ juṣāṇo yathāvaśaṃ tanvaḥ kalpayāti ||
children.translated_text: and enjoying friendship with <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, will dispose his own body according to his will?

children.text: Chapter 420
apakrāman pauruṣeyād vṛṇāno daivyaṃ vacaḥ
children.translated_text: Turning away from human speech, choosing the divine word,

children.text: praṇītīr abhyāvartasva viśvebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: turn back to the guidances, together with all your friends.

children.text: Chapter 421
yad asmṛti cakṛma kiṃcid agna upārima caraṇe jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever lapse of memory we have committed, anything, O <s>Agni</s>, whatever we have approached in our conduct, O <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: tataḥ pāhi tvaṃ naḥ pracetaḥ śubhe sakhibhyo amṛtatvam astu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: from that protect us, O discerning one. May there be good for our friends; may immortality be ours.

children.text: Chapter 422
ava divas tārayanti sapta sūryasya raśmayaḥ
children.translated_text: Down from heaven the seven rays of the sun carry across.

children.text: āpaḥ samudriyā dhārās tāste śalyam asisrasan ||
children.translated_text: The waters, the sea-born streams, have made that dart flow away from you.

children.text: Chapter 423
yo na stāyad dipsati yo na āviḥ svo vidvān araṇo vā no agne
children.translated_text: Whoever stealthily harms us, whoever seeks to deceive us openly, whether his own, knowing, or a stranger to us, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: pratīcy etv araṇī datvatī tān maiṣām agne vāstu bhūn mo apatyam ||
children.translated_text: let the toothed fire-sticks come against them. O <s>Agni</s>, let neither their dwelling nor their offspring exist.

children.text: yo naḥ suptān jāgrato vābhidāsāt tiṣṭhato vā carato jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever attacks us while sleeping or waking, while standing or walking, O <s>Jātavedas</s>...

children.text: vaiśvānareṇa sayujā sajoṣās tān pratīco nirdaha jātavedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Together with <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, in alliance and in accord, burn them down as they turn away, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: Chapter 424
idam ugrāya babhrave namo yo akṣeṣu tanūvaśī
children.translated_text: This reverence is for the fierce brown one, who has self-mastery among the dice.

children.text: ghṛtena kaliṃ śikṣāmi sa no mṛḍātīdṛśe ||
children.translated_text: With ghee I discipline <s>Kali</s>; may he be gracious to us in such a matter.

children.text: ghṛtam apsarābhyo vaha tvam agne pāṃsūn akṣebhyaḥ sikatā apaś ca
children.translated_text: Carry the ghee to the <s>Apsarases</s>, O <s>Agni</s>; carry dust to the dice, and sand and waters.

children.text: yathābhagaṃ havyadātiṃ juṣāṇā madanti devā ubhayāni havyā ||
children.translated_text: Accepting their allotted oblation, may both classes of gods rejoice in the offerings.

children.text: apsarasaḥ sadhamādaṃ madanti havirdhānam antarā sūryaṃ ca
children.translated_text: The <s>Apsarases</s> rejoice in common revel, between the oblation-holder and the sun.

children.text: tā me hastau saṃ sṛjantu ghṛtena sapatnaṃ me kitavam randhayantu ||
children.translated_text: May they join my two hands with ghee; may they make my rival, the gambler, subject to me.

children.text: ādinavaṃ pratidīvne ghṛtenāsmāṁ abhikṣara
children.translated_text: With ghee sprinkle upon us the winning cast against the counter-player.

children.text: vṛkṣam ivāśanyā jahi yo asmān pratidīvyati ||
children.translated_text: Like a tree with a thunderbolt, strike down the one who plays against us.

children.text: yo no dyuve dhanam idaṃ cakāra yo akṣāṇāṃ glahanaṃ śeṣaṇaṃ ca
children.translated_text: The one who made this wealth for our gambling, who made the casting of the dice and the remainder to be won,

children.text: sa no devo havir idaṃ juṣāṇo gandharvebhiḥ sadhamādaṃ madema ||
children.translated_text: may that god, accepting this oblation of ours, let us rejoice in common revel with the <s>Gandharvas</s>.

children.text: saṃvasava iti vo nāmadheyam ugraṃpaśyā rāṣṭrabhṛto hy akṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Your name is <s>Saṃvasavaḥ</s>; terrible to behold, the dice are sustainers of dominion.

children.text: tebhyo va indavo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: To them, to you, with drops of Soma and with oblation, we would pay worship; may we be lords of riches.

children.text: devān yan nāthito huve brahmacaryaṃ yad ūṣima
children.translated_text: When, distressed, I call upon the gods, and the sacred discipline that we have practiced,

children.text: akṣān yad babhrūn ālabhe te no mṛḍantv īdṛśe ||
children.translated_text: when I take up the brown dice, may they be gracious to us in such a matter.

children.text: Chapter 425
agna indraś ca dāśuṣe hato vṛtrāṇy aprati
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s>, for the worshipper strike down the enemies that cannot resist.

children.text: ubhā hi vṛtrahantamā ||
children.translated_text: For you two are the greatest slayers of obstruction.

children.text: yābhyām ajayant svar agra eva yāv ātasthatur bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: With whom they won heaven at the very beginning, and who two took their stand over all beings,

children.text: pra carṣaṇīvṛṣaṇā vajrabāhū agnim indram vṛtrahaṇā huve 'ham ||
children.translated_text: I call <s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s>, the vigorous lords of peoples, thunderbolt-armed, slayers of obstruction.

children.text: upa tvā devo agrabhīc camasena bṛhaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: The god <s>Bṛhaspati</s> has grasped you with the cup.

children.text: indra gīrbhir na ā viśa yajamānāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, enter us through the songs, for the sacrificing Soma-presser.

children.text: Chapter 426
indrasya kukṣir asi somadhāna ātmā devānām uta mānuṣāṇām
children.translated_text: You are <s>Indra</s>'s belly, the Soma-vessel, the self of gods and of human beings.

children.text: iha prajā janaya yās ta āsu yā anyatreha tās te ramantām ||
children.translated_text: Generate here the offspring that are yours among these; let those of yours that are elsewhere delight here.

children.text: Chapter 427
śumbhanī dyāvāpṛthivī antisumne mahivrate
children.translated_text: Heaven and Earth, beautifying, near with favor, mighty in ordinance,

children.text: āpaḥ sapta susruvur devīs tā no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the seven divine waters have flowed forth; may they release us from distress.

children.text: muñcantu mā śapathyād atho varuṇyād uta
children.translated_text: May they release me from a curse, and also from what belongs to <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: atho yamasya paḍvīśād viśvasmād devakilbiṣāt ||
children.translated_text: and also from <s>Yama</s>'s fetter, from every offence against the gods.

children.text: Chapter 428
tṛṣṭike tṛṣṭavandana ud amūṃ chinddhi tṛṣṭike
children.translated_text: O <s>Tṛṣṭikā</s>, O praised-by-the-tṛṣṭa one, cut that one off, O <s>Tṛṣṭikā</s>,

children.text: yathā kṛtadviṣṭāso 'muṣmai śepyāvate ||
children.translated_text: so that the haters of the deed may be for that man with the diseased organ.

children.text: tṛṣṭāsi tṛṣṭikā viṣā viṣātaky asi
children.translated_text: You are tṛṣṭā, tṛṣṭikā, poison; you are a poison-causing one.

children.text: parivṛktā yathāsasy ṛṣabhasya vaśeva ||
children.translated_text: May you be turned away, as you are like the cow of a bull.

children.text: Chapter 429
ā te dade vakṣaṇābhya ā te 'haṃ hṛdayād dade
children.translated_text: I take from your breasts; I take from your heart.

children.text: ā te mukhasya saṅkāśāt sarvaṃ te varca ā dade ||
children.translated_text: From the appearance of your mouth I take all your brilliance.

children.text: preto yantu vyādhyaḥ prānudhyāḥ pro aśastayaḥ
children.translated_text: Let diseases go away from here, let hostile thoughts go forward, let ill-speaking go forth.

children.text: agnī rakṣasvinīr hantu somo hantu durasyatīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s> kill the female demons; let <s>Soma</s> kill the ill-willed ones.

children.text: Chapter 430
pra patetaḥ pāpi lakṣmi naśyetaḥ prāmutaḥ pata
children.translated_text: Fly away from here, evil <s>Lakṣmī</s>; perish from here; fall away from there.

children.text: ayasmayenāṅkena dviṣate tvā sajāmasi ||
children.translated_text: With an iron hook we fasten you to the one who hates us.

children.text: yā mā lakṣmīḥ patayālūr ajuṣṭābhicaskanda vandaneva vṛkṣam
children.translated_text: The <s>Lakṣmī</s> that is mine, falling upon me and unwelcome, has climbed on me like a creeper on a tree.

children.text: anyatrāsmat savitas tām ito dhā hiraṇyahasto vasu no rarāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set her elsewhere than upon us, O <s>Savitṛ</s>, while you, golden-handed, bestow wealth on us.

children.text: ekaśataṃ lakṣmyo martyasya sākaṃ tanvā januṣo 'dhi jātāḥ
children.translated_text: One hundred and one <s>Lakṣmīs</s> of a mortal are born together with the body from birth.

children.text: tāsāṃ pāpiṣṭhā nir itaḥ pra hiṇmaḥ śivā asmabhyaṃ jātavedo niyaccha ||
children.translated_text: The most evil of them we send away from here; the auspicious ones, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, assign to us.

children.text: etā enā vyākaraṃ khile gā viṣṭhitā iva
children.translated_text: These I have separated out, like cows scattered in a waste place.

children.text: ramantāṃ puṇyā lakṣmīr yāḥ pāpīs tā anīnaśam ||
children.translated_text: May the meritorious <s>Lakṣmīs</s> remain; those that are evil I have made disappear.

children.text: Chapter 431
namo rūrāya cyavanāya nodanāya dhṛṣṇave
children.translated_text: Homage to the roaring one, the shaking one, the driving one, the bold one.

children.text: namaḥ śītāya pūrvakāmakṛtvane ||
children.translated_text: Homage to the cold one, the one who works according to an earlier desire.

children.text: yo anyedyur ubhayadyur abhyetīmaṃ maṇḍūkam
children.translated_text: The one who comes on alternate days or on both days against this frog,

children.text: abhy etv avrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: let that vowless one come upon it.

children.text: Chapter 432
ā mandrair indra haribhir yāhi mayūraromabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Indra</s>, with your pleasant bay steeds, with peacock-feathered ones.

children.text: mā tvā kecid vi yaman viṃ na pāśino 'ti dhanveva tāṁ ihi ||
children.translated_text: Let no noose-bearers restrain you; go past them as over a desert.

children.text: Chapter 433
marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmi somas tvā rājāmṛtenānu vastām
children.translated_text: I cover your vital spots with armor; may king <s>Soma</s> clothe you with immortality.

children.text: uror varīyo varuṇas te kṛṇotu jayantaṃ tvānu devā madantu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> make wide room wider than your breast; may the gods rejoice over you as one who conquers.

children.text: Chapter 434
antakāya mṛtyave namaḥ prāṇā apānā iha te ramantām
children.translated_text: Homage to <s>Antaka</s>, to <s>Mṛtyu</s>; let your breaths and lower breaths remain here.

children.text: ihāyam astu puruṣaḥ sahāsunā sūryasya bhāge amṛtasya loke ||
children.translated_text: Let this man be here together with life-breath, in the portion of the sun, in the world of immortality.

children.text: ud enaṃ bhago agrabhīd ud enaṃ somo aṃśumān
children.translated_text: <s>Bhaga</s> has lifted him up; <s>Soma</s>, rich in rays, has lifted him up.

children.text: ud enaṃ maruto devā ud indrāgnī svastaye ||
children.translated_text: The divine <s>Maruts</s> have lifted him up; <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> have lifted him up for well-being.

children.text: iha te 'sur iha prāṇa ihāyur iha te manaḥ
children.translated_text: Here is your life-spirit, here your breath, here your lifespan, here your mind.

children.text: ut tvā nirṛtyāḥ pāśebhyo daivyā vācā bharāmasi ||
children.translated_text: With divine speech we raise you up from the bonds of <s>Nirṛti</s>.

children.text: ut krāmātaḥ puruṣa māva patthā mṛtyoḥ paḍvīśam avamuñcamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Rise up from here, O man; do not fall down, as you free yourself from the fetter of <s>Mṛtyu</s>.

children.text: mā chitthā asmāllokād agneḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not cut yourself off from this world, from the sight of <s>Agni</s> and the sun.

children.text: tubhyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ mātariśvā tubhyaṃ varṣantv amṛtāny āpaḥ
children.translated_text: For you let <s>Mātariśvan</s>, the wind, blow; for you let the immortal waters rain.

children.text: sūryas te tanve śaṃ tapāti tvām mṛtyur dayatāṃ mā pra meṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the sun warm your body auspiciously; may <s>Mṛtyu</s> pity you; do not perish.

children.text: udyānaṃ te puruṣa nāvayānaṃ jīvātuṃ te dakṣatātiṃ kṛṇomi
children.translated_text: Your ascent, O man, not your descent, I make into life and capability for you.

children.text: ā hi rohemam amṛtaṃ sukhaṃ ratham atha jivrir vidatham ā vadāsi ||
children.translated_text: Climb up now onto this immortal, pleasant chariot; then, though aged, you will speak in the assembly.

children.text: mā te manas tatra gān mā tiro bhūn mā jīvebhyaḥ pra mado mānu gāḥ pitṝn
children.translated_text: Let your mind not go there; let it not vanish away; do not be careless of the living; do not follow the Fathers.

children.text: viśve devā abhi rakṣantu tveha ||
children.translated_text: May all the gods protect you here.

children.text: mā gatānām ā dīdhīthā ye nayanti parāvatam
children.translated_text: Do not think upon those who have gone, who lead away to the far distance.

children.text: ā roha tamaso jyotir ehy ā te hastau rabhāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Ascend from darkness to light; come here; we take hold of your two hands.

children.text: śyāmaś ca tvā mā śabalaś ca preṣitau yamasya yau pathirakṣī śvānau
children.translated_text: Let not <s>Śyāma</s> and <s>Śabala</s>, the two sent by <s>Yama</s>, the two dogs guarding the path, seize you.

children.text: arvāṅ ehi mā vi dīdhyo mātra tiṣṭhaḥ parāṅmanāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come hither; do not wander off; do not stand there with your mind turned away.

children.text: maitaṃ panthām anu gā bhīma eṣa yena pūrvaṃ neyatha taṃ bravīmi
children.translated_text: Do not go along this path; this one is terrible. I tell you that by which they formerly led you.

children.text: tama etat puruṣa mā pra patthā bhayaṃ parastād abhayaṃ te arvāk ||
children.translated_text: Do not set out upon that darkness, O man; fear lies beyond, but fearlessness is here on this side for you.

children.text: rakṣantu tvāgnayo ye apsv antā rakṣatu tvā manuṣyā yam indhate
children.translated_text: Let the fires that are within the waters protect you; let the fire that men kindle protect you.

children.text: vaiśvānaro rakṣatu jātavedā divyas tvā mā pra dhāg vidyutā saha ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, <s>Jātavedas</s>, protect you; let not the heavenly one burn you together with lightning.

children.text: mā tvā kravyād abhi maṃstārāt saṃkasukāc cara rakṣatu tvā dyau rakṣatu
children.translated_text: Let not the flesh-eater think upon you; move away from the one who dries up. Let heaven protect you; let

children.text: pṛthivī sūryaś ca tvā rakṣatāṃ candramāś ca
children.translated_text: earth protect you; and let the sun and the moon protect you.

children.text: antarikṣaṃ rakṣatu devahetyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the midspace protect you from the missile of the gods.

children.text: bodhaś ca tvā pratibodhaś ca rakṣatām asvapnaś ca tvānavadrāṇaś ca rakṣatām
children.translated_text: Let waking and awakening protect you; let sleeplessness and freedom from slumber protect you.

children.text: gopāyaṃś ca tvā jāgṛviś ca rakṣatām ||
children.translated_text: Let guardianship and the wakeful one protect you.

children.text: te tvā rakṣantu te tvā gopāyantu tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā ||
children.translated_text: May they protect you; may they guard you. Homage to them; svāhā to them.

children.text: jīvebhyas tvā samude vāyur indro dhātā dadhātu savitā trāyamāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: For the living let <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Dhātṛ</s>, and protecting <s>Savitṛ</s> place you in the ocean.

children.text: mā tvā prāṇo balaṃ hāsīd asuṃ te 'nu hvayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: Let not breath and strength abandon you; we call your life-breath back after you.

children.text: mā tvā jambhaḥ saṃhanur mā tamo vidan mā jihvā barhiḥ pramayuḥ kathā syāḥ
children.translated_text: Let not the jaw, the crusher, nor darkness find you; let not the tongue, the sacred grass, or destruction reach you. How could you perish?

children.text: ut tvādityā vasavo bharantūd indrāgnī svastaye ||
children.translated_text: Let the <s>Ādityas</s> and <s>Vasus</s> carry you up; let <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> carry you up for well-being.

children.text: ut tvā dyaur ut pṛthivy ut prajāpatir agrabhīt
children.translated_text: Heaven has lifted you up; earth has lifted you up; <s>Prajāpati</s> has lifted you up.

children.text: ut tvā mṛtyor oṣadhayaḥ somarājñīr apīparan ||
children.translated_text: The herbs whose king is <s>Soma</s> have carried you away from death.

children.text: ayaṃ devā ihaivāstv ayaṃ māmutra gād itaḥ
children.translated_text: Let this man remain right here among the gods; let him not go from here to that world.

children.text: imaṃ sahasravīryeṇa mṛtyor ut pārayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: With thousandfold power we carry this man up out of death.

children.text: ut tvā mṛtyor apīparaṃ saṃ dhamantu vayodhasaḥ
children.translated_text: I have carried you up out of death; let the givers of life-breath blow together upon you.

children.text: mā tvā vyastakeśyo mā tvāgharudo rudan ||
children.translated_text: Let no women with loosened hair and no howling lamenters weep over you.

children.text: āhārṣam avidaṃ tvā punar āgāḥ punarṇavaḥ
children.translated_text: I have brought you; I have found you. You have come back again, renewed.

children.text: sarvāṅga sarvaṃ te cakṣuḥ sarvam āyuś ca te 'vidam ||
children.translated_text: With all your limbs, all your sight, and all your lifetime, I have found you again.

children.text: vy avāt te jyotir abhūd apa tvat tamo akramīt
children.translated_text: The light has become manifest for you; the darkness has gone away from you.

children.text: apa tvan mṛtyuṃ nirṛtim apa yakṣmaṃ ni dadhmasi ||
children.translated_text: From you we set aside death, <s>Nirṛti</s> (dissolution), and <s>yakṣma</s> (consumptive disease).

children.text: Chapter 435
ā rabhasvemām amṛtasya śnuṣṭim achidyamānā jaradaṣṭir astu te
children.translated_text: Take hold of this immortal support; let your old age, with unbroken teeth, be yours.

children.text: asuṃ ta āyuḥ punar ā bharāmi rajas tamo mopa gā mā pra meṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: I bring back to you life-breath and lifetime; do not go to dust and darkness, do not disappear from me.

children.text: jīvatāṃ jyotir abhyehy arvāṅ ā tvā harāmi śataśāradāya
children.translated_text: Come here toward the light of the living; I bring you here for a hundred autumns.

children.text: avamuñcan mṛtyupāśān aśastiṃ drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ te dadhāmi ||
children.translated_text: Releasing the snares of death and misfortune, I set a longer, broader lifetime for you.

children.text: vātāt te prāṇam avidaṃ sūryāc cakṣur ahaṃ tava
children.translated_text: From the wind I have found your breath; from the sun I have found your sight.

children.text: yat te manas tvayi tad dhārayāmi saṃvitsvāṅgair vada jihvayālapan ||
children.translated_text: Whatever mind of yours is within you, I hold that fast; be conscious with your limbs, speaking with your tongue.

children.text: prāṇena tvā dvipadāṃ catuṣpadām agnim iva jātam abhi saṃ dhamāmi
children.translated_text: With the breath of bipeds and quadrupeds I blow upon you as upon a newly born fire.

children.text: namas te mṛtyo cakṣuṣe namaḥ prāṇāya te 'karam ||
children.translated_text: Homage to your eye, O <s>Mṛtyu</s>; homage I have made to your breath.

children.text: ayaṃ jīvatu mā mṛtemaṃ sam īrayāmasi
children.translated_text: Let this man live; let him not die. We set him in motion again.

children.text: kṛṇomy asmai bheṣajaṃ mṛtyo mā puruṣaṃ vadhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: I make a remedy for him; O <s>Mṛtyu</s>, do not kill the man.

children.text: jīvalāṃ naghāriṣāṃ jīvantīm oṣadhīm aham
children.translated_text: I here call the living herb, not injuring, alive,

children.text: trāyamāṇāṃ sahamānāṃ sahasvatīm iha huve 'smā ariṣṭatātaye ||
children.translated_text: protecting, overpowering, mighty, for this man's freedom from harm.

children.text: adhi brūhi mā rabhathāḥ sṛjemaṃ tavaiva sant sarvahāyā ihāstu
children.translated_text: Speak on his behalf; do not seize him. Release this man; though he belongs to you, let him live here through all his years.

children.text: bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ śarma yacchatam apasidhya duritaṃ dhattam āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bhava</s> and <s>Śarva</s>, be gracious; grant shelter. Driving away misfortune, bestow life.

children.text: asmai mṛtyo adhi brūhīmaṃ dayasvod ito 'yam etu
children.translated_text: O <s>Mṛtyu</s>, speak on behalf of this man; have mercy on him. Let him come away from here.

children.text: ariṣṭaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ suśruj jarasā śatahāyana ātmanā bhujam aśnutām ||
children.translated_text: Uninjured, whole-limbed, easy to release, may he attain enjoyment with his self in old age, a man of a hundred years.

children.text: devānāṃ hetiḥ pari tvā vṛṇaktu pārayāmi tvā rajasa ut tvā mṛtyor apīparam
children.translated_text: Let the missile of the gods turn aside around you. I carry you across the airy realm; I have carried you up out of death.

children.text: ārād agniṃ kravyādaṃ nirūhaṃ jīvātave te paridhiṃ dadhāmi ||
children.translated_text: I remove far away <s>Agni</s> the flesh-eater; for your living I set a boundary around you.

children.text: yat te niyānaṃ rajasaṃ mṛtyo anavadharṣyam
children.translated_text: Whatever your unassailable departure into the airy realm is, O <s>Mṛtyu</s>,

children.text: patha imaṃ tasmād rakṣanto brahmāsmai varma kṛṇmasi ||
children.translated_text: guarding this path from it, we make <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation) a shield for him.

children.text: kṛṇomi te prāṇāpānau jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ dīrgham āyuḥ svasti
children.translated_text: I make for you the in-breath and out-breath, old age, death, long life, and well-being.

children.text: vaivasvatena prahitān yamadūtāṃś carato 'pa sedhāmi sarvān ||
children.translated_text: I drive away all the messengers of <s>Yama</s>, sent by <s>Vaivasvata</s>, as they move about.

children.text: ārād arātiṃ nirṛtiṃ paro grāhiṃ kravyādaḥ piśācān
children.translated_text: Far away we drive hostility, <s>Nirṛti</s>, the seizer beyond, flesh-eaters, and <s>piśācas</s>.

children.text: rakṣo yat sarvaṃ durbhūtaṃ tat tama ivāpa hanmasi ||
children.translated_text: Whatever demon, whatever evil being there is, all that we strike away like darkness.

children.text: agneṣ ṭa prāṇam amṛtād āyuṣmato vanve jātavedasaḥ
children.translated_text: From <s>Agni</s>, from immortal <s>Jātavedas</s>, I win breath for you, from the long-lived one.

children.text: yathā na riṣyā amṛtaḥ sajūr asas tat te kṛṇomi tad u te sam ṛdhyatām ||
children.translated_text: So that you may not be harmed, immortal and united with your fellows, I do that for you; may that prosper for you.

children.text: śive te stāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī asaṃtāpe abhiśriyau
children.translated_text: May heaven and earth be auspicious for you, free from burning, giving shelter.

children.text: śaṃ te sūrya ā tapatu śaṃ vāto vātu te hṛde
children.translated_text: May the sun shine favorably upon you; may the wind blow favorably for your heart.

children.text: śivā abhi kṣarantu tvāpo divyāḥ payasvatīḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the heavenly waters, rich in milk, flow auspiciously over you.

children.text: śivās te santv oṣadhaya ut tvāhārṣam adharasyā uttarāṃ pṛthivīm abhi
children.translated_text: May the herbs be auspicious for you. I have brought you up from the lower earth to the upper earth.

children.text: tatra tvādityau rakṣatāṃ sūryācandramasāv ubhā ||
children.translated_text: There let the two <s>Ādityas</s>, both sun and moon, protect you.

children.text: yat te vāsaḥ paridhānaṃ yāṃ nīviṃ kṛṇuṣe tvam
children.translated_text: Whatever garment is your clothing, whatever waist-band you make for yourself,

children.text: śivaṃ te tanve tat kṛṇmaḥ saṃsparśe 'rūkṣṇam astu te ||
children.translated_text: we make that auspicious for your body; let it be smooth for you at the touch.

children.text: yat kṣureṇa marcayatā sutejasā vaptā vapasi keśaśmaśru
children.translated_text: When the barber shaves your hair and beard with the bright, cleansing razor,

children.text: śubhaṃ mukhaṃ mā na āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ ||
children.translated_text: may it make your face fair; do not take away our lifetime.

children.text: śivau te stāṃ vrīhiyavāv abalāsāv adomadhau
children.translated_text: May rice and barley, above and below, be auspicious for you and without weakness.

children.text: etau yakṣmaṃ vi bādhete etau muñcato aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: These two drive away <s>yakṣma</s> (disease); these two release from distress.

children.text: yad aśnāsi yat pibasi dhānyaṃ kṛṣyāḥ payaḥ
children.translated_text: What you eat, what you drink, grain of the plough, milk,

children.text: yad ādyaṃ yad anādyaṃ sarvaṃ te annam aviṣaṃ kṛṇomi ||
children.translated_text: what is edible and what is not edible: I make all your food free of poison.

children.text: ahne ca tvā rātraye cobhābhyāṃ pari dadmasi
children.translated_text: To day and to night, to both, we hand you over.

children.text: arāyebhyo jighatsubhya imaṃ me pari rakṣata ||
children.translated_text: Protect this man of mine from the ungenerous and from those who hunger to devour.

children.text: śataṃ te 'yutaṃ hāyanān dve yuge trīṇi catvāri kṛṇmaḥ
children.translated_text: A hundred, ten thousand years, two ages, three, and four, we make for you.

children.text: indrāgnī viśve devās te 'nu manyantām ahṛṇīyamānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, may all the gods, approve you, without anger.

children.text: śarade tvā hemantāya vasantāya grīṣmāya pari dadmasi
children.translated_text: For autumn, for winter, for spring, and for summer we hand you over.

children.text: varṣāṇi tubhyaṃ syonāni yeṣu vardhanta oṣadhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: The rainy seasons are pleasant for you, in which the plants grow.

children.text: mṛtyur īśe dvipadāṃ mṛtyur īśe catuṣpadām
children.translated_text: Death rules over two-footed beings; Death rules over four-footed beings.

children.text: tasmāt tvāṃ mṛtyor gopater ud bharāmi sa mā bibheḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore I raise you up from Death, the lord of cattle; do not be afraid.

children.text: so 'riṣṭa na mariṣyasi na mariṣyasi mā bibheḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, unharmed, you will not die; you will not die, do not be afraid.

children.text: na vai tatra mriyante no yanti adhamaṃ tamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There they do not die, nor do they go to the lowest darkness.

children.text: sarvo vai tatra jīvati gaur aśvaḥ puruṣaḥ paśuḥ
children.translated_text: There everything lives: cow, horse, man, and beast,

children.text: yatredaṃ brahma kriyate paridhir jīvanāya kam ||
children.translated_text: where this <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation) is performed as an enclosing boundary for life.

children.text: pari tvā pātu samānebhyo 'bhicārāt sabandhubhyaḥ
children.translated_text: May the enclosure protect you from equals, from hostile magic, and from kinsmen.

children.text: amamrir bhavāmṛto 'tijīvo mā te hāsiṣur asavaḥ śarīram ||
children.translated_text: Be undying, immortal, living beyond; let your life-breaths not leave your body.

children.text: ye mṛtyava ekaśataṃ yā nāṣṭrā atitāryāḥ
children.translated_text: The deaths that are one hundred and one, and the destructive snares that must be crossed beyond,

children.text: muñcantu tasmāt tvāṃ devā agner vaiśvānarād adhi ||
children.translated_text: from them may the gods release you, away from the fire of <s>Vaiśvānara</s>.

children.text: agneḥ śarīram asi pārayiṣṇu rakṣohāsi sapatnahā
children.translated_text: You are the body of <s>Agni</s>, carrying across; you are a slayer of <s>rakṣas</s> (demons), a slayer of rivals,

children.text: atho amīvacātanaḥ pūtudrur nāma bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: and also a driver away of disease, the medicine named <s>Pūtudru</s>.

children.text: Chapter 436
rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinam ā jigharmi mitraṃ prathiṣṭham upa yāmi śarma
children.translated_text: I anoint the vigorous slayer of <s>rakṣas</s>; I approach the friend, the broadest shelter.

children.text: śiśāno agniḥ kratubhiḥ samiddhaḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, sharpening himself, kindled by ritual powers, may he protect us from harm by day and by night.

children.text: ayodaṃṣṭro arciṣā yātudhānān upa spṛśa jātavedaḥ samiddhaḥ
children.translated_text: Iron-toothed, with your flame touch the <s>yātudhānas</s> (sorcerer-demons), O kindled <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: ā jihvayā mūradevān rabhasva kravyādo vṛṣṭvāpi dhatsvāsan ||
children.translated_text: With your tongue seize the deluded gods; wrap the flesh-eaters and set them in your mouth.

children.text: ubhobhayāvinn upa dhehi daṃṣṭrau hiṃsraḥ śiśāno 'varaṃ paraṃ ca
children.translated_text: On both sides set your two fangs, violent and sharpened, upon both the lower and the higher.

children.text: utāntarikṣe pari yāhy agne jambhaiḥ saṃ dhehy abhi yātudhānān ||
children.translated_text: And in the midspace go around, O <s>Agni</s>; with your jaws crush the <s>yātudhānas</s>.

children.text: agne tvacaṃ yātudhānasya bhinddhi hiṃsrāśanir harasā hantv enam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, split the skin of the <s>yātudhāna</s>; let the violent thunderbolt kill him with its heat.

children.text: pra parvāṇi jātavedaḥ śṛṇīhi kravyāt kraviṣṇur vi cinotv enam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Jātavedas</s>, shatter his joints; let the flesh-eating seeker of flesh pick him apart.

children.text: yatredānīṃ paśyasi jātavedas tiṣṭhantam agna uta vā carantam
children.translated_text: Wherever now, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, you see the <s>yātudhāna</s> standing or moving,

children.text: utāntarikṣe patantaṃ yātudhānaṃ tam astā vidhya śarvā śiśānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or flying in the midspace, shoot him, O archer, sharpening yourself.

children.text: yajñair iṣūḥ saṃnamamāno agne vācā śalyāṁ aśanibhir dihānaḥ
children.translated_text: Bending your arrows with sacrifices, O <s>Agni</s>, smearing their barbs with speech and thunderbolts,

children.text: tābhir vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān pratīco bāhūn prati bhaṅgdhy eṣām ||
children.translated_text: with those pierce the <s>yātudhānas</s> in the heart; break their arms backward.

children.text: utārabdhānt spṛṇuhi jātaveda utārebhāṇāṁ ṛṣṭibhir yātudhānān
children.translated_text: Strike the attacking <s>yātudhānas</s>, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, and the shrieking ones with spears.

children.text: agne pūrvo ni jahi śośucāna āmādaḥ kṣviṅkās tam adantv enīḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, first strike them down as you blaze; let the raw-flesh eaters, the devourers, eat them.

children.text: iha pra brūhi yatamaḥ so agne yātudhāno ya idaṃ kṛṇoti
children.translated_text: Here proclaim which one, O <s>Agni</s>, is that <s>yātudhāna</s> who does this.

children.text: tam ā rabhasva samidhā yaviṣṭha nṛcakṣasaś cakṣuṣe randhayainam ||
children.translated_text: Seize him with the fuel, O youngest one; subject him to the sight of men.

children.text: tīkṣṇenāgne cakṣuṣā rakṣa yajñaṃ prāñcaṃ vasubhyaḥ praṇaya pracetaḥ
children.translated_text: With keen eye, O <s>Agni</s>, guard the sacrifice; lead it eastward to the <s>Vasus</s>, O wise one.

children.text: hiṃsraṃ rakṣāṃsy abhi śośucānaṃ mā tvā dabhan yātudhānā nṛcakṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Blazing against the violent <s>rakṣases</s>, let the <s>yātudhānas</s> not deceive you, O watcher of men.

children.text: nṛcakṣā rakṣaḥ pari paśya vikṣu tasya trīṇi prati śṛṇīhy agrā
children.translated_text: Watcher of men, look around for the <s>rakṣas</s> among the settlements; break off its three points.

children.text: tasyāgne pṛṣṭīr harasā śṛṇīhi tredhā mūlaṃ yātudhānasya vṛśca ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, shatter its ribs with your heat; cut the root of the <s>yātudhāna</s> in three.

children.text: trir yātudhānaḥ prasitiṃ ta etv ṛtaṃ yo agne anṛtena hanti
children.translated_text: Let the <s>yātudhāna</s> who attacks truth with untruth come three times into your snare, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tam arciṣā sphūrjayan jātavedaḥ samakṣam enam gṛṇate ni yuṅdhi ||
children.translated_text: Flashing him with flame, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, bind him face to face for the singer.

children.text: yad agne adya mithunā śapāto yad vācas tṛṣṭaṃ janayanta rebhāḥ
children.translated_text: If today, O <s>Agni</s>, a pair of cursers has cursed, or if clamorous ones have produced sharpened speech,

children.text: manyor manasaḥ śaravyā jāyate yā tayā vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān ||
children.translated_text: the arrow that is born from wrath and from the mind: with it pierce the <s>yātudhānas</s> in the heart.

children.text: parā śṛṇīhi tapasā yātudhānān parāgne rakṣo harasā śṛṇīhi
children.translated_text: Cut away the <s>yātudhānas</s> with heat; O <s>Agni</s>, cut away the <s>rakṣas</s> with your blaze.

children.text: parārciṣā mūradevāñchṛṇīhi parāsutṛpaḥ śośucataḥ śṛṇīhi ||
children.translated_text: Cut away the deluded gods with flame; cut away the life-drinkers as they burn.

children.text: parādya devā vṛjinaṃ śṛṇantu pratyag enaṃ śapathā yantu sṛṣṭāḥ
children.translated_text: May the gods today cut away crookedness; let the curses that have been released go back against him.

children.text: vācāstenaṃ śarava ṛcchantu marman viśvasyaitu prasitiṃ yātudhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May arrows reach the speech-thief in his vital spot; let the <s>yātudhāna</s> enter every snare.

children.text: yaḥ pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā samaṅkte yo aśvyena paśunā yātudhānaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>yātudhāna</s> who smears himself with human flesh, or with horse flesh, or with cattle flesh,

children.text: yo aghnyāyā bharati kṣīram agne teṣāṃ śīrṣāṇi harasāpi vṛśca ||
children.translated_text: or who carries off the milk of the inviolate cow, O <s>Agni</s>, cut off their heads with your heat.

children.text: viṣaṃ gavāṃ yātudhānā bharantām ā vṛścantām aditaye durevāḥ
children.translated_text: Let the <s>yātudhānas</s> bear the poison of the cows; let the evil-doers be cut off for <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: paraiṇān devaḥ savitā dadātu parā bhāgam oṣadhīnāṃ jayantām ||
children.translated_text: Let the god <s>Savitṛ</s> give them away far from here; let them go away from the share of the plants.

children.text: saṃvatsarīṇaṃ paya usriyāyās tasya māśīd yātudhāno nṛcakṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The year-long milk of the red cow: may no <s>yātudhāna</s>, O watcher of men, obtain it.

children.text: pīyūṣam agne yatamas titṛpsāt taṃ pratyañcam arciṣā vidhya marmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: Whichever one, O <s>Agni</s>, would drink his fill of the milk, pierce him, turned toward you, with flame in the vital spot.

children.text: sanād agne mṛṇasi yātudhānān na tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ
children.translated_text: From of old, O <s>Agni</s>, you crush the <s>yātudhānas</s>; the <s>rakṣases</s> have not conquered you in battles.

children.text: sahamūrān anu daha kravyādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Burn up the deluded ones together with the flesh-eaters; let none escape your divine missile.

children.text: tvaṃ no agne adharād udaktas tvaṃ paścād uta rakṣā purastāt
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, guard us from below and from the north; you guard us from behind and also from in front.

children.text: prati tye te ajarāsas tapiṣṭhā aghaśaṃsaṃ śośucato dahantu ||
children.translated_text: May those undecaying, most burning flames of yours, blazing against him, burn the evil-speaker.

children.text: paścāt purastād adharād utottarāt kaviḥ kāvyena pari pāhy agne
children.translated_text: From behind, from in front, from below, and from the north, O sage, by your wisdom protect us all around, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: sakhā sakhāyam ajaro jarimne agne martāṁ amartyas tvaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: As an ageless friend protects a friend into old age, O <s>Agni</s>, you, immortal one, protect us mortals.

children.text: tad agne cakṣuḥ prati dhehi rebhe śaphārujo yena paśyasi yātudhānān
children.translated_text: Set that eye, O <s>Agni</s>, against the roaring hoof-breaker, with which you see the <s>yātudhānas</s>.

children.text: atharvavaj jyotiṣā daivyena satyaṃ dhūrvantam acitaṃ nyoṣa ||
children.translated_text: With divine light like <s>Atharvan</s>, burn down the truth-twisting, unthinking one.

children.text: pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi
children.translated_text: Around you, O <s>Agni</s>, we set a fortress; we establish the inspired, mighty one.

children.text: dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ dive dive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Day by day, hard in color, the slayer of <s>Bhaṅgurāvat</s>,

children.text: viṣeṇa bhaṅgurāvataḥ prati sma rakṣaso jahi
children.translated_text: with the poison of <s>Bhaṅgurāvat</s>, strike back against the <s>rakṣas</s>.

children.text: agne tigmena śociṣā tapuragrābhir arcibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with sharp flame, with blazing-fronted rays,

children.text: vi jyotiṣā bṛhatā bhāty agnir āvir viśvāni kṛṇute mahitvā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> shines forth with great light; by his greatness he makes all things manifest.

children.text: prādevīr māyāḥ sahate durevāḥ śiśīte śṛṅge rakṣobhyo vinikṣe ||
children.translated_text: He overcomes the hostile magical powers that are hard to approach; he sharpens his horns to hurl them against the <s>rakṣases</s>.

children.text: ye te śṛṅge ajare jātavedas tigmahetī brahmasaṃśite
children.translated_text: Those two horns of yours, undecaying, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, keen weapons whetted by sacred formulation,

children.text: tābhyāṃ durhārdam abhidāsantaṃ kimīdinaṃ
children.translated_text: with those two, against the hostile-hearted assailant, the <s>kimīdin</s>,

children.text: pratyañcam arciṣā jātavedo vi nikṣva ||
children.translated_text: thrust him away facing you with your flame, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: agnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati śukraśocir amartyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> drives the <s>rakṣases</s> away, bright-flamed, immortal,

children.text: śuciḥ pāvaka īḍyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: pure, purifying, worthy of praise.

children.text: Chapter 437
indrāsomā tapataṃ rakṣa ubjataṃ ny arpayataṃ vṛṣaṇā tamovṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, burn the <s>rakṣas</s>; strike it down; hurl down, O bulls, those who grow in darkness.

children.text: parā śṛṇītam acito ny oṣataṃ hataṃ nudethāṃ ni śiśītam attriṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Cut away the witless ones, burn them down; slay them, thrust them away, sharpen yourselves against the devourers.

children.text: indrāsomā sam aghaśaṃsam abhy aghaṃ tapur yayastu carur agnimāṃ iva
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, let the evil-speaker go into evil on every side; let a burning charm go at him like fire.

children.text: brahmadviṣe kravyāde ghoracakṣase dveṣo dhattam anavāyaṃ kimīdine ||
children.translated_text: Set inescapable hatred upon the hater of sacred formulation, the eater of raw flesh, the grim-eyed <s>kimīdin</s>.

children.text: indrāsomā duṣkṛto vavre antar anārambhaṇe tamasi pra vidhyatam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, pierce the evildoers in the enclosing pit, in supportless darkness,

children.text: yato naiṣāṃ punar ekaś canodayat tad vām astu sahase manyumac chavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: from where not one of them may ever come forth again; let that wrathful power of yours be strength for you.

children.text: indrāsomā vartayataṃ divo vadhaṃ saṃ pṛthivyā aghaśaṃsāya tarhaṇam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, roll down the weapon from heaven and, from earth, the crushing blow for the evil-speaker.

children.text: ut takṣataṃ svaryaṃ1 parvatebhyo yena rakṣo vāvṛdhānaṃ nijūrvathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Hew out a heavenly weapon from the mountains, by which you will crush the <s>rakṣas</s> as it grows strong.

children.text: indrāsomā vartayataṃ divas pary agnitaptebhir yuvam aśmahanmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, roll it around from heaven with fire-heated, stone-smiting missiles,

children.text: tapurvadhebhir ajarebhir attriṇo ni parśāne vidhyataṃ yantu nisvaram ||
children.translated_text: with scorching, undecaying weapons; pierce the devourers in the ribs, and let them go away shrieking.

children.text: indrāsomā pari vāṃ bhūtu viśvata iyaṃ matiḥ kakṣyāśveva vājinā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, may this thought be around you on every side like a girth around racehorses.

children.text: yāṃ vāṃ hotrāṃ parihinomi medhayemā brahmāṇi nṛpatī iva jinvatam ||
children.translated_text: The priestly office that I place around you with wisdom, these sacred formulations, let them quicken you like kings of men.

children.text: prati smarethāṃ tujayadbhir evair hataṃ druho rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvataḥ
children.translated_text: Remember with impelling aids; slay the treacheries of the shattering <s>rakṣases</s>.

children.text: indrāsomā duṣkṛte mā sugaṃ bhūd yo mā kadā cid abhidāsati druhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, let there be no easy path for the evildoer who ever attacks me with malice.

children.text: yo mā pākena manasā carantam abhicaṣṭe anṛtebhir vacobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever watches me as I go about with guileless mind, with words of falsehood,

children.text: āpa iva kāśinā samgṛbhītā asann astv asataḥ indra vaktā ||
children.translated_text: like waters grasped in the hand, let the speaker of untruth become nonexistent, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ye pākaśaṃsaṃ viharanta evair ye vā bhadraṃ dūṣayanti svadhābhiḥ
children.translated_text: Those who spread a base accusation with their devices, or who spoil what is good by their own powers,

children.text: ahaye vā tān pradadātu soma ā vā dadhātu nirṛter upaṣṭhe ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Soma</s> hand them over to the serpent, or place them in the lap of <s>Nirṛti</s>.

children.text: yo no rasaṃ dipsati pitvo agne aśvānāṃ gavāṃ yas tanūnām
