children.text: yat sabhāgayati dakṣiṇāḥ sabhāgayati yad anutiṣṭhata udavasyaty eva tat ||
children.translated_text: When he distributes shares, he distributes the dakṣiṇās; when they stand nearby, he thereby brings the rite to completion.

children.text: sa upahūtaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yat pṛthivyāṃ viśvarūpam ||
children.translated_text: Invited, he eats on the earth; invited in it is whatever manifold form is on the earth.

children.text: sa upahūto 'ntarikṣe bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yad divi viśvarūpam ||
children.translated_text: Invited, he eats in the midspace; invited in it is whatever manifold form is in heaven.

children.text: sa upahūto divi bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yad divi viśvarūpam ||
children.translated_text: Invited, he eats in heaven; invited in it is whatever manifold form is in heaven.

children.text: sa upahūto deveṣu bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yad divi viśvarūpam ||
children.translated_text: Invited, he eats among the gods; invited in it is whatever manifold form is in heaven.

children.text: sa upahūto lokeṣu bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yad divi viśvarūpam ||
children.translated_text: Invited, he eats among the worlds; invited in it is whatever manifold form is in heaven.

children.text: sa upahūta upahūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He is invited, invited indeed.

children.text: āpnotīmaṃ lokam āpnoty amum ||
children.translated_text: He obtains this world; he obtains that one.

children.text: jyotiṣmato lokān jayati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: He wins the luminous worlds, whoever knows thus.

children.text: Chapter 445
prajāpatiś ca parameṣṭhī ca śṛṅge indraḥ śiro agnir lalāṭaṃ yamaḥ kṛkāṭam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> and <s>Parameṣṭhin</s> are the two horns; <s>Indra</s> is the head; <s>Agni</s> the forehead; <s>Yama</s> the neck-joint.

children.text: somo rājā mastiṣko dyaur uttarahanuḥ pṛthivy adharahanuḥ ||
children.translated_text: King <s>Soma</s> is the brain; heaven is the upper jaw; earth is the lower jaw.

children.text: vidyuj jihvā maruto dantā revatīr grīvāḥ kṛttikā skandhā gharmo vahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Lightning is the tongue; the <s>Maruts</s> are the teeth; the <s>Revatīs</s> are the necks; the <s>Kṛttikās</s> are the shoulders; heat is the carrying-part.

children.text: viśvaṃ vāyuḥ svargo lokaḥ kṛṣṇadraṃ vidharaṇī niveṣyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Viśva</s> is the wind; the heavenly world is the dark holder, the settling-place.

children.text: śyenaḥ kroḍo 'ntarikṣaṃ pājasyaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ kakud bṛhatīḥ kīkasāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The eagle is the breast; the midspace is the flank; <s>Bṛhaspati</s> is the hump; the <s>Bṛhatīs</s> are the ribs.

children.text: devānāṃ patnīḥ pṛṣṭaya upasadaḥ parśavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The wives of the gods are the back-parts; the upasads are the sides.

children.text: mitraś ca varuṇaś cāṃsau tvaṣṭā cāryamā ca doṣaṇī mahādevo bāhū ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> are the shoulders; <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> and <s>Aryaman</s> are the forearms; <s>Mahādeva</s> is the arms.

children.text: indrāṇī bhasad vāyuḥ pucchaṃ pavamāno bālāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indrāṇī</s> is the rump; <s>Vāyu</s> is the tail; <s>Pavamāna</s> is the tail-hairs.

children.text: brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca śroṇī balam ūrū ||
children.translated_text: <s>Brahman</s> and kṣatra are the hips; strength is the thighs.

children.text: dhātā ca savitā cāṣṭhīvantau jaṅghā gandharvā apsarasaḥ kuṣṭhikā aditiḥ śaphāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dhātṛ</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s> are the knees; the shanks are the <s>Gandharvas</s> and <s>Apsarases</s>; <s>Aditi</s> is the hooves.

children.text: ceto hṛdayaṃ yakṛn medhā vrataṃ purītat ||
children.translated_text: Thought is the heart; understanding is the liver; the vow is the pericardium.

children.text: kṣut kukṣir irā vaniṣṭhuḥ parvatāḥ plāśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Hunger is the belly; refreshment is the entrail; the mountains are the lungs.

children.text: krodho vṛkkau manyur āṇḍau prajā śepaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Anger is the kidneys; wrath is the testicles; offspring is the penis.

children.text: nadī sūtrī varṣasya pataya stanā stanayitnur ūdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The river is the cord; the lords of rain are the breasts; thunder is the udder.

children.text: viśvavyacās carmauṣadhayo lomāni nakṣatrāṇi rūpam ||
children.translated_text: The all-pervading one is the hide; the plants are the hairs; the lunar mansions are the form.

children.text: devajanā gudā manuṣyā āntrāṇy atrā udaram ||
children.translated_text: The divine peoples are the rectums; human beings are the intestines; the atrā are the belly.

children.text: rakṣāṃsi lohitam itarajanā ūbadhyam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Rakṣases</s> are the blood; the other peoples are what is tied beneath.

children.text: abhraṃ pīvo majjā nidhanam ||
children.translated_text: The cloud is the fat; marrow is the nidhana.

children.text: agnir āsīna utthito 'śvinā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is seated; when standing up, it is the two <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: indraḥ prāṅ tiṣṭhan dakṣiṇā tiṣṭhan yamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Standing facing east is <s>Indra</s>; standing to the south is <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan dhātodaṅ tiṣṭhant savitā ||
children.translated_text: Standing facing west is <s>Dhātṛ</s>; standing to the north is <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: tṛṇāni prāptaḥ somo rājā ||
children.translated_text: When it has reached the grasses, it is King <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: mitra īkṣamāṇa āvṛtta ānandaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Looking on is <s>Mitra</s>; turned back is delight.

children.text: yujyamāno vaiśvadevo yuktaḥ prajāpatir vimuktaḥ sarvam ||
children.translated_text: Being yoked is what belongs to all the gods; yoked is <s>Prajāpati</s>; unyoked is everything.

children.text: etad vai viśvarūpaṃ sarvarūpaṃ gorūpam ||
children.translated_text: This indeed is the viśvarūpa (all-formed), the sarvarūpa (all-formed), the cow-form.

children.text: upainaṃ viśvarūpāḥ sarvarūpāḥ paśavas tiṣṭhanti ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: All-formed and every-formed cattle stand near him, whoever knows thus.

children.text: Chapter 446
śīrṣaktiṃ śīrṣāmayaṃ karṇaśūlaṃ vilohitam
children.translated_text: Head-pain, disease of the head, ear-ache, and the reddish disorder:

children.text: sarvaṃ śīrṣanyaṃ te rogaṃ bahir nir mantrayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: every disease of your head we charm forth and drive outside.

children.text: karṇābhyāṃ te kaṅkūṣebhyaḥ karṇaśūlaṃ visalpakam
children.translated_text: From your two ears, from the kaṅkūṣas, the ear-ache, the spreading eruption:

children.text: sarvaṃ śīrṣanyaṃ te rogaṃ bahir nir mantrayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: every disease of your head we charm forth and drive outside.

children.text: yasya hetoḥ pracyavate yakṣmaḥ karṇato āsyataḥ
children.translated_text: The cause for which <s>yakṣma</s> (consumptive disease) falls away from the ear and from the mouth:

children.text: sarvaṃ śīrṣanyaṃ te rogaṃ bahir nir mantrayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: every disease of your head we charm forth and drive outside.

children.text: yaḥ kṛṇoti pramotam andhaṃ kṛṇoti pūruṣam
children.translated_text: That which makes a man distorted, that which makes him blind:

children.text: sarvaṃ śīrṣanyaṃ te rogaṃ bahir nir mantrayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: every disease of your head we charm forth and drive outside.

children.text: aṅgabhedam aṅgajvaram viśvāṅgyaṃ visalpakam
children.translated_text: Limb-breaking pain, limb-fever, the disease of all the limbs, the spreading eruption:

children.text: sarvaṃ śīrṣanyaṃ te rogaṃ bahir nir mantrayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: every disease of your head we charm forth and drive outside.

children.text: yasya bhīmaḥ pratīkāśa udvepayati pūruṣam
children.translated_text: The fever whose terrible appearance makes a man tremble:

children.text: takmānaṃ viśvaśāradaṃ bahir nir mantrayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: the takman-fever that comes every autumn we charm forth and drive outside.

children.text: ya ūrū anusarpaty atho eti gavīnike
children.translated_text: That <s>yakṣma</s> which creeps along the thighs and also goes into the groin-parts:

children.text: yakṣmaṃ te antar aṅgebhyo bahir nir mantrayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: from within your limbs we charm forth and drive that <s>yakṣma</s> outside.

children.text: yadi kāmād apakāmāddhṛdayāj jāyate pari
children.translated_text: If, from desire or from lack of desire, it is born from the heart and spreads around,

children.text: hṛdo balāsam aṅgebhyo bahir nir mantrayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: from the heart, from the limbs, we charm the <s>balāsa</s> (wasting disease) out and away.

children.text: harimāṇaṃ te aṅgebhyo 'pvām antarodarāt
children.translated_text: The yellow disease from your limbs, the <s>apvā</s> (intestinal affliction) from within your belly,

children.text: yakṣmodhām antar ātmano bahir nir mantrayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: the seat of <s>yakṣma</s> (consumptive disease) from within your self, we charm out and away.

children.text: āso balāso bhavatu mūtraṃ bhavatv āmayat
children.translated_text: Let the <s>āsa</s> and <s>balāsa</s> be turned into urine; let the sickness become waste.

children.text: yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ nir avocam ahaṃ tvat ||
children.translated_text: I have pronounced away from you the poison of all the <s>yakṣmas</s> (consumptive diseases).

children.text: bahir bilaṃ nir dravatu kāhābāhaṃ tavodarāt
children.translated_text: Let the opening run outward; let the <s>kāhābāha</s> disorder leave your belly.

children.text: yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ nir avocam ahaṃ tvat ||
children.translated_text: I have pronounced away from you the poison of all the <s>yakṣmas</s> (consumptive diseases).

children.text: udarāt te klomno nābhyā hṛdayād adhi
children.translated_text: From your belly, from your lung, from your navel, and from your heart,

children.text: yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ nir avocam ahaṃ tvat ||
children.translated_text: I have pronounced away from you the poison of all the <s>yakṣmas</s> (consumptive diseases).

children.text: yāḥ sīmānaṃ virujanti mūrdhānaṃ praty arṣaṇīḥ
children.translated_text: Those that break the seam of the head and the skull, the attacking pains,

children.text: ahiṃsantīr anāmayā nir dravantu bahir bilam ||
children.translated_text: unharming and free from sickness, let them run out through the opening.

children.text: yā hṛdayam uparṣanty anutanvanti kīkasāḥ
children.translated_text: Those that attack the heart and stretch along the ribs,

children.text: ahiṃsantīr anāmayā nir dravantu bahir bilam ||
children.translated_text: unharming and free from sickness, let them run out through the opening.

children.text: yāḥ pārśve uparṣanty anunikṣanti pṛṣṭīḥ
children.translated_text: Those that attack the sides and pierce along the back,

children.text: ahiṃsantīr anāmayā nir dravantu bahir bilam ||
children.translated_text: unharming and free from sickness, let them run out through the opening.

children.text: yās tiraścīḥ uparṣanty arṣaṇīr vakṣaṇāsu te
children.translated_text: Those that attack crosswise, the pains in your groins,

children.text: ahiṃsantīr anāmayā nir dravantu bahir bilam ||
children.translated_text: unharming and free from sickness, let them run out through the opening.

children.text: yā gudā anusarpanty āntrāṇi mohayanti ca
children.translated_text: Those that creep along the anus and bewilder the intestines,

children.text: ahiṃsantīr anāmayā nir dravantu bahir bilam ||
children.translated_text: unharming and free from sickness, let them run out through the opening.

children.text: yā majjño nirdhayanti parūṃṣi virujanti ca
children.translated_text: Those that scrape out the marrow and break the joints,

children.text: ahiṃsantīr anāmayā nir dravantu bahir bilam ||
children.translated_text: unharming and free from sickness, let them run out through the opening.

children.text: ye aṅgāni madayanti yakṣmāso ropaṇās tava
children.translated_text: The <s>yakṣmas</s> (consumptive diseases) that numb your limbs, the sore-making ones of yours,

children.text: yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ nir avocam ahaṃ tvat ||
children.translated_text: I have pronounced away from you the poison of all the <s>yakṣmas</s> (consumptive diseases).

children.text: visalpasya vidradhasya vātīkārasya vālajeḥ
children.translated_text: Of <s>visalpa</s> (creeping eruption), of abscess, of wind-made disorder, and of <s>vālaji</s>,

children.text: yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ nir avocam ahaṃ tvat ||
children.translated_text: I have pronounced away from you the poison of all the <s>yakṣmas</s> (consumptive diseases).

children.text: pādābhyāṃ te jānubhyāṃ śroṇibhyāṃ pari bhaṃsasaḥ
children.translated_text: From your feet, from your knees, from your hips, and around your buttocks,

children.text: anūkād arṣaṇīr uṣṇihābhyaḥ śīrṣṇo rogam anīnaśam ||
children.translated_text: from your spine, from the pains, from the upper parts, and from the head, I have made the disease disappear.

children.text: saṃ te śīrṣṇaḥ kapālāni hṛdayasya ca yo vidhuḥ
children.translated_text: Together with the bones of your head, and whatever trembling there is of the heart,

children.text: udyann āditya raśmibhiḥ śīrṣṇo rogam anīnaśo 'ṅgabhedam aśīśamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: rising, O <s>Āditya</s>, with your rays, you have made the disease of the head disappear and have quieted the breaking of the limbs.

children.text: Chapter 447
asya vāmasya palitasya hotus tasya bhrātā madhyamo asty aśnaḥ
children.translated_text: Of this lovely grey-haired <s>Hotṛ</s>, his middle brother is the eater;

children.text: tṛtīyo bhrātā ghṛtapṛṣṭho asyātrāpaśyaṃ viśpatiṃ saptaputram ||
children.translated_text: his third brother has ghee on his back; here I saw the lord of the people, having seven sons.

children.text: sapta yuñjanti ratham ekacakram eko aśvo vahati saptanāmā
children.translated_text: Seven yoke the one-wheeled chariot; one horse, bearing seven names, draws it.

children.text: trinābhi cakram ajaram anarvaṃ yatremā viśvā bhuvanādhi tasthuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The wheel has three naves, undecaying and irresistible, on which all these worlds have taken their stand.

children.text: imaṃ ratham adhi ye sapta tasthuḥ saptacakraṃ sapta vahanty aśvāḥ
children.translated_text: Those seven have mounted this chariot; seven horses draw the seven-wheeled one.

children.text: sapta svasāro abhi saṃ navanta yatra gavām nihitā sapta nāma ||
children.translated_text: Seven sisters sing together around it, where the seven names of the cows have been set down.

children.text: ko dadarśa prathamaṃ jāyamānam asthanvantaṃ yad anasthā bibharti
children.translated_text: Who saw the first one being born, when the boneless one bears the one with bones?

children.text: bhūmyā asur asṛg ātmā kva svit ko vidvāṃsam upa gāt praṣṭum etat ||
children.translated_text: Where is the breath of the earth, its blood, its self? Who went to the wise one to ask this?

children.text: iha bravītu ya īm aṅga vedāsya vāmasya nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ
children.translated_text: Let him speak here who truly knows the hidden station of this lovely bird.

children.text: śīrṣṇaḥ kṣīraṃ duhrate gāvo asya vavriṃ vasānā udakaṃ padā 'puḥ ||
children.translated_text: From his head the cows milk out milk; clothed in a covering, they have drunk water with their foot.

children.text: pākaḥ pṛchāmi manasā 'vijānan devānām enā nihitā padāni
children.translated_text: Immature, not knowing, I ask in my mind about these hidden stations of the gods.

children.text: vatse baṣkaye 'dhi sapta tantūn vi tatnire kavaya otavā u ||
children.translated_text: Upon the yearling calf the poets stretched out seven threads, and also the weavers.

children.text: acikitvāṃs cikituṣaś cid atra kavīn pṛchāmi vidvano na vidvān
children.translated_text: Unknowing, I ask here the knowing poets, not knowing, as one asks the learned.

children.text: vi yas tastambha ṣaṭ imā rajāṃsy ajasya rūpe kiṃ api svid ekam ||
children.translated_text: What is that one thing, in the form of the unborn, by which he propped apart these six realms?

children.text: mātā pitaram ṛta ā babhāja 'dhīty agre manasā saṃ hi jagme
children.translated_text: The mother apportioned the father according to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); first, thinking, she came together with him in mind.

children.text: sā bībhatsur garbharasā nividdhā namasvanta id upavākam īyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: She, fearful and pierced by the fluid of the embryo, was approached with reverent words.

children.text: yuktā mātāsīd dhuri dakṣiṇāyā atiṣṭhad garbho vṛjanīṣv antaḥ
children.translated_text: The mother was yoked on the right side of the pole; the embryo stood within the enclosures.

children.text: amīmed vatso anu gām apaśyad viśvarūpyaṃ triṣu yojaneṣu ||
children.translated_text: The calf lowed; following the cow, he saw the all-formed one in the three distances.

children.text: tisro mātṝs trīn pitṝn bibhrad eka ūrdhvas tasthau nem ava glāpayanta
children.translated_text: Bearing three mothers and three fathers, the one stood upright; they do not make him sink down.

children.text: mantrayante divo amuṣya pṛṣṭhe viśvavido vācam aviśvavinnām ||
children.translated_text: On the back of yonder heaven they converse, all-knowing, with speech that is not all-knowing.

children.text: pañcāre cakre parivartamāne yasminn ātasthur bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: In the five-spoked wheel that turns around, on which all beings have taken their stand,

children.text: tasya nākṣas tapyate bhūribhāraḥ sanād eva na chidyate sanābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: its axle, though bearing much weight, is not heated; from of old its nave is not cut apart.

children.text: pañcapādaṃ pitaraṃ dvādaśākṛtiṃ diva āhuḥ pare ardhe purīṣiṇam
children.translated_text: They call the father five-footed, twelve-formed, rich in moisture, in the farther half of heaven.

children.text: atheme anya upare vicakṣaṇe saptacakre ṣaḍara āhur arpitam ||
children.translated_text: But other clear-sighted ones say that he is fixed in the nearer seven-wheeled, six-spoked one.

children.text: dvādaśāraṃ nahi taj jarāya varvarti cakraṃ pari dyām ṛtasya
children.translated_text: The twelve-spoked wheel of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) turns around heaven; indeed it does not grow old.

children.text: ā putrā agne mithunāso atra sapta śatāni viṃśatiś ca tasthuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Here, O <s>Agni</s>, seven hundred and twenty sons, paired together, have taken their stand.

children.text: sanemi cakram ajaraṃ vi vavṛta uttānāyāṃ daśa yuktā vahanti
children.translated_text: The wheel with one rim, undecaying, has rolled forth; ten yoked ones draw it on the outstretched one.

children.text: sūryasya cakṣū rajasaity āvṛtaṃ yasminn ātasthur bhuvanāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: The eye of <s>Sūrya</s> goes, enveloped in the midspace, in which all beings have taken their stand.

children.text: striyaḥ satīs tām u me puṃsaḥ āhuḥ paśyad akṣaṇvān vi cetad andhaḥ
children.translated_text: Though they are women, they call that one male to me; the one with eyes sees it, and the blind one discerns it.

children.text: kavir yaḥ putraḥ sa īm ā ciketa yas tā vijānāt sa pituṣ pitāsat ||
children.translated_text: The inspired poet who is the son has perceived it; he who knows those things becomes the father of his father.

children.text: sākaṃjānāṃ saptatham āhur ekajaṃ ṣaḍ id yamā ṛṣayo devajā iti
children.translated_text: Of those born together they call the seventh single-born; six are twins, seers born from the gods, they say.

children.text: teṣām iṣṭāni vihitāni dhāmaśa sthātre rejante vikṛtāni rūpaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Their desired things, arranged according to their stations, tremble for the standing one, transformed according to their forms.

children.text: avaḥ pareṇa para enā avareṇa padā vatsaṃ bibhratī gaur ud asthāt
children.translated_text: With the lower beyond and the higher on this side, the cow has stood up carrying the calf with her foot.

children.text: sā kadrīcī kaṃ svid ardhaṃ parāgāt kva svit sūte nahi yūthe asmin ||
children.translated_text: In what direction did she turn? Toward what half did she go away? Where does she give birth? For it is not within this herd.

children.text: avaḥ pareṇa pitaraṃ yo asya vedāvaḥ pareṇa para enāvareṇa
children.translated_text: Who knows the father of this one through the lower and the higher, and who knows the higher through this lower one?

children.text: kavīyamānaḥ ka iha pra vocad devaṃ manaḥ kuto adhi prajātam ||
children.translated_text: As he acts like a poet, who here can proclaim from where the divine mind was born?

children.text: ye arvāñcas tāṁ u parāca āhur ye parāñcas tāṁ u arvāca āhuḥ
children.translated_text: Those who are coming hither, they say, are going away; those who are going away, they say, are coming hither.

children.text: indraś ca yā cakrathuḥ soma tāni dhurā na yuktā rajaso vahanti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, what you two have made, those things bear the expanse like creatures yoked to the pole.

children.text: dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pari ṣasvajāte
children.translated_text: Two fair-winged birds, yoked together, companions, embrace the same tree.

children.text: tayor anyaḥ pippalaṃ svādv atty anaśnann anyo abhi cākaśīti ||
children.translated_text: Of the two, one eats the sweet fig; the other, not eating, looks on.

children.text: yasmin vṛkṣe madhvadaḥ suparṇā niviśante suvate cādhi viśve
children.translated_text: In the tree where the fair-winged honey-eaters settle, and where all bring forth upon it,

children.text: tasya yad āhuḥ pippalaṃ svādv agre tan non naśad yaḥ pitaraṃ na veda ||
children.translated_text: what they call its sweet fig at the top, that does not reach the one who does not know the father.

children.text: yatrā suparṇā amṛtasya bhakṣam animeṣaṃ vidathābhisvaranti
children.translated_text: Where the fair-winged birds, sleepless, call aloud at the ritual gatherings for the share of immortality,

children.text: enā viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ sa mā dhīraḥ pākam atrā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: there the guardian of the whole world, the wise one, has entered me, the unripe one.

children.text: Chapter 448
yad gāyatre adhi gāyatram āhitaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ vā traiṣṭubhān niratakṣata
children.translated_text: What <s>gāyatra</s> (Gāyatrī metre) has been set upon <s>gāyatra</s>, or what <s>traiṣṭubha</s> (Triṣṭubh metre) they fashioned out of <s>traiṣṭubha</s>,

children.text: yad vā jagaj jagaty āhitaṃ padaṃ ya it tad vidus te amṛtatvam ānaśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: or what foot of the moving world has been set in the <s>jagatī</s> (Jagatī metre), those who know that have attained immortality.

children.text: gāyatreṇa prati mimīte arkam arkeṇa sāma traiṣṭubhena vākam
children.translated_text: By the <s>gāyatra</s> he measures out the <s>arka</s> (chant); by the <s>arka</s>, the <s>sāman</s> (melody); by the <s>traiṣṭubha</s>, speech.

children.text: vākena vākaṃ dvipadā catuṣpadākṣareṇa mimate sapta vāṇīḥ ||
children.translated_text: By speech they measure speech; by the two-footed, the four-footed; by the syllable they measure the seven voices.

children.text: jagatā sindhuṃ divy askabhāyad rathaṃtare sūryaṃ pary apaśyat
children.translated_text: With the <s>jagatī</s> he propped up the heavenly stream; in the <s>rathantara</s> (chant) he beheld the sun on every side.

children.text: gāyatrasya samidhas tisra āhus tato mahnā pra ririce mahitvā ||
children.translated_text: They say the <s>gāyatra</s> has three kindling-sticks; from there, by greatness, it surpassed in majesty.

children.text: upa hvaye sudughāṃ dhenum etāṃ suhasto godhug uta dohad enām
children.translated_text: I call near this good-milking cow; let the good-handed milker also milk her.

children.text: śreṣṭhaṃ savaṃ savitā sāviṣan no 'bhīddho gharmas tad u ṣu pra vocat ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Savitṛ</s> impel the best pressing for us; the heated <s>gharma</s> (warm oblation), kindled, shall proclaim that.

children.text: hiṃkṛṇvatī vasupatnī vasūnāṃ vatsam ichantī manasābhyāgāt
children.translated_text: Making the hiṃ-sound, mistress of goods among goods, desiring her calf, she has come near with her mind.

children.text: duhām aśvibhyāṃ payo aghnyeyaṃ sā vardhatāṃ mahate saubhagāya ||
children.translated_text: Let this inviolable cow milk milk for the two <s>Aśvins</s>; may she grow for great good fortune.

children.text: gaur amīmed abhi vatsaṃ miṣantaṃ mūrdhānaṃ hiṅṅ akṛṇon mātavā u
children.translated_text: The cow has lowed toward the blinking calf; she has made the hiṅ-sound over its head, like a mother.

children.text: sṛkvāṇaṃ gharmam abhi vāvaśānā mimāti māyuṃ payate payobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Yearning toward the steaming warmth with her mouth, she bellows her cry and swells with milk.

children.text: ayaṃ sa śiṅkte yena gaur abhivṛtā mimāti māyuṃ dhvasanāv adhi śritā
children.translated_text: This is the sound by which the cow, enclosed, bellows her cry, resting upon the two resonant places.

children.text: sā cittibhir ni hi cakāra martyān vidyud bhavantī prati vavrim auhata ||
children.translated_text: She has hidden mortals by her thoughts; becoming lightning, she has drawn aside the covering.

children.text: anacchaye turagātu jīvam ejad dhruvaṃ madhya ā pastyānām
children.translated_text: Without shade, swift-going, living, it stirs; the fixed one stands in the middle of the dwellings.

children.text: jīvo mṛtasya carati svadhābhir amartyo martyenā sayoniḥ ||
children.translated_text: The living one moves by the powers of the dead, immortal, sharing one womb with the mortal.

children.text: vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe yuvānaṃ santaṃ palito jagāra
children.translated_text: The gray-haired one has swallowed the trembling moon on the surface of the waters, though it was young.

children.text: devasya paśya kāvyaṃ mahitvādya mamāra sa hyaḥ sam āna ||
children.translated_text: Behold the god's poetic work: by his greatness he has died today, though yesterday he was alive.

children.text: ya īṃ cakāra na so asya veda ya īṃ dadarśa hirug in nu tasmāt
children.translated_text: He who made this does not know it; he who saw it is surely hidden from that.

children.text: sa mātur yonā parivīto antar bahuprajā nirṛtir ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: Wrapped within his mother's womb, rich in offspring, he has entered destruction.

children.text: apaśyaṃ gopām anipadyamānam ā ca parā ca pathibhiś carantam
children.translated_text: I saw the herdsman, never falling, moving hither and away along the paths.

children.text: sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīr vasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣv antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Clothing himself in forms that go together and apart, he turns around and around within the worlds.

children.text: dyaur naḥ pitā janitā nābhir atra bandhur no mātā pṛthivī mahīyam
children.translated_text: Heaven is our father, our begetter; here is the navel, and great earth is our mother and kinswoman.

children.text: uttānayoś camvor yonir antar atrā pitā duhitur garbham ādhāt ||
children.translated_text: Between the two bowls turned upward is the womb; there the father placed the embryo of the daughter.

children.text: pṛchāmi tvā param antaṃ pṛthivyāḥ pṛchāmi vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ
children.translated_text: I ask you about the farthest end of the earth; I ask about the seed of the vigorous horse.

children.text: pṛchāmi viśvasya bhuvanasya nābhiṃ pṛchāmi vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma ||
children.translated_text: I ask about the navel of the whole world; I ask about the highest heaven of speech.

children.text: iyaṃ vediḥ paro antaḥ pṛthivyā ayaṃ somo vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ
children.translated_text: This altar is the farthest end of the earth; this <s>soma</s> is the seed of the vigorous horse.

children.text: ayaṃ yajño viśvasya bhuvanasya nābhir brahmāyaṃ vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma ||
children.translated_text: This sacrifice is the navel of the whole world; this <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation) is the highest heaven of speech.

children.text: na vi jānāmi yad ivedam asmi niṇyaḥ saṃnaddho manasā carāmi
children.translated_text: I do not discern what I am like; hidden, bound with mind, I wander.

children.text: yadā māgan prathamajā ṛtasyād id vāco aśnuve bhāgam asyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the first-born of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) has come to me, then I obtain a share of this speech.

children.text: apāṅ prāṅ eti svadhayā gṛbhīto 'martyo martyenā sayoniḥ
children.translated_text: It goes downward and forward, held by its own power, immortal, sharing one womb with the mortal.

children.text: tā śaśvantā viṣūcīnā viyantā ny anyaṃ cikyur na ni cikyur anyam ||
children.translated_text: Those two eternal ones go apart in opposite directions; they recognize one, but they do not recognize the other.

children.text: saptārdhagarbhā bhuvanasya reto viṣṇos tiṣṭhanti pradiśā vidharmaṇi
children.translated_text: The seven half-embryos, the seed of the world, stand in the ordinances of <s>Viṣṇu</s> in the directions.

children.text: te dhītibhir manasā te vipaścitaḥ paribhuvaḥ pari bhavanti viśvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: They, with their insights, with mind, they, the discerning ones, the encompassing ones, surround everything on every side.

children.text: ṛco akṣare parame vyoman yasmin devā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ
children.translated_text: The verses are in the imperishable, in the highest heaven, where all the gods have taken their seat.

children.text: yas tan na veda kim ṛcā kariṣyati ya it tad vidus te amī sam āsate ||
children.translated_text: He who does not know that, what will he do with a verse? Those who know it sit together here.

children.text: ṛcaḥ padaṃ mātrayā kalpayanto 'rdharcena cakﾱpur viśvam ejat
children.translated_text: Fashioning the foot of the verse by measure, with a half-verse they fashioned the whole moving world.

children.text: tripād brahma pururūpaṃ vi taṣṭhe tena jīvanti pradiśaś catasraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The three-footed <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), many-formed, has been spread out; by it the four directions live.

children.text: sūyavasād bhagavatī hi bhūyā adhā vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma
children.translated_text: Blessed one, may you be rich in good pasture; then may we be fortunate.

children.text: addhi tṛṇam aghnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddham udakam ācarantī ||
children.translated_text: Eat grass, inviolable cow, at all times; drink pure water as you go about.

children.text: gaur in mimāya salilāni takṣatī ekapadī dvipadī sā catuṣpadī
children.translated_text: The cow has lowed, fashioning the waters, one-footed, two-footed, and four-footed.

children.text: aṣṭāpadī navapadī babhūvuṣī sahasrākṣarā bhuvanasya paṅktis tasyāḥ samudrā adhi vi kṣaranti ||
children.translated_text: Having become eight-footed, nine-footed, thousand-syllabled, the <s>paṅkti</s> (fivefold metre) of the world, from her the oceans flow forth.

children.text: kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇā apo vasānā divam ut patanti
children.translated_text: The dark track: the tawny, fair-winged ones, clothed in waters, fly up to heaven.

children.text: taṃ āvavṛtrant sadanād ṛtasyād id ghṛtena pṛthivīṃ vy ūduḥ ||
children.translated_text: They have turned him away from the seat of <s>ṛta</s>; then with ghee they have spread out the earth.

children.text: apād eti prathamā padvatīnāṃ kas tad vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ciketa
children.translated_text: The footless first of those with feet goes forth; who has perceived that for you two, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>?

children.text: garbho bhāraṃ bharaty ā cid asyā ṛtaṃ piparti anṛtaṃ ni pāti ||
children.translated_text: The embryo bears the burden; from her it sustains <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order) and keeps untruth down.

children.text: virāḍ vāg virāṭ pṛthivī virāḍ antarikṣaṃ virāṭ prajāpatiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Virāj</s> is speech; <s>Virāj</s> is earth; <s>Virāj</s> is the midspace; <s>Virāj</s> is <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: virāṇ mṛtyuḥ sādhyānām adhirājo babhūva tasya bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ vaśe sa me bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ vaśe kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: <s>Virāj</s> became death, overlord of the <s>Sādhyas</s>; past and future are in his control. May he place past and future in my control.

children.text: śakamayaṃ dhūmam ārād apaśyaṃ viṣūvatā para enāvareṇa
children.translated_text: From afar I saw a smoke made of dung, with the far and the nearer one at the midpoint.

children.text: ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśnim apacanta vīrās tāni dharmāṇi prathamāny āsan ||
children.translated_text: The heroes cooked the dappled bull; these were the first <s>dharmas</s> (ordinances).

children.text: trayaḥ keśina ṛtuthā vi cakṣate saṃvatsare vapata eka eṣām
children.translated_text: Three long-haired ones look forth according to the seasons; in the year one of them is shorn.

children.text: viśvam anyo abhicaṣṭe śacībhir dhrājir ekasya dadṛśe na rūpam ||
children.translated_text: Another looks over the whole world with his powers; the gleam of one is seen, but not his form.

children.text: catvāri vāk parimitā padāni tāni vidur brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Speech is measured out in four quarters; the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, the wise ones, know them.

children.text: guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti ||
children.translated_text: Three, hidden in secret, do not stir forth; human beings speak the fourth quarter of speech.

children.text: indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇam agnim āhur atho divyaḥ sa suparṇo garutmān
children.translated_text: They call him <s>Indra</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Agni</s>; and he is the heavenly <s>Garutmān</s>, the fair-winged one.

children.text: ekaṃ sad viprā bahudhā vadanty agniṃ yamaṃ mātariśvānam āhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The real is one; inspired sages speak of it in many ways. They call it <s>Agni</s>, <s>Yama</s>, and <s>Mātariśvan</s>.

children.text: Chapter 449
yāṃ kalpayanti vahatau vadhūm iva viśvarūpāṃ hastakṛtāṃ cikitsavaḥ
children.translated_text: That which the skilled fashion at the bridal procession like a bride, all-formed and made by hand,

children.text: sārād etv apa nudāma enām ||
children.translated_text: let her go away from here; we drive her away.

children.text: śīrṣaṇvatī nasvatī karṇiṇī kṛtyākṛtā saṃbhṛtā viśvarūpā
children.translated_text: Having a head, a nose, and ears, gathered together by makers of <s>kṛtyā</s> (hostile sorcery), all-formed,

children.text: sārād etv apa nudāma enām ||
children.translated_text: let her go away from here; we drive her away.

children.text: śūdrakṛtā rājakṛtā strīkṛtā brahmabhiḥ kṛtā
children.translated_text: Made by a <s>Śūdra</s>, made by a king, made by a woman, made by <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>,

children.text: jāyā patyā nutteva kartāraṃ bandhv ṛchatu ||
children.translated_text: like a wife rejected by her husband, let her reach her maker, her own kinsman.

children.text: anayāham oṣadhyā sarvāḥ kṛtyā adūduṣam
children.translated_text: With this herb I have spoiled all <s>kṛtyās</s>,

children.text: yāṃ kṣetre cakrur yāṃ goṣu yāṃ vā te puruṣeṣu ||
children.translated_text: the one they made in the field, the one among the cows, or the one among your men.

children.text: agham astv aghakṛte śapathaḥ śapathīyate
children.translated_text: Let evil belong to the evil-doer; the curse is aimed at the curser.

children.text: pratyak pratiprahiṇmo yathā kṛtyākṛtaṃ hanat ||
children.translated_text: Back against them we send it, so that it may strike the maker of <s>kṛtyā</s>.

children.text: pratīcīna āṅgiraso 'dhyakṣo naḥ purohitaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, facing back, is our overseer, our <s>purohita</s> (house priest).

children.text: pratīcīḥ kṛtyā ākṛtyāmūn kṛtyākṛto jahi ||
children.translated_text: Turned back, O <s>kṛtyās</s>, strike those makers of <s>kṛtyā</s> with counter-sorcery.

children.text: yas tvovāca parehīti pratikūlam udāyyam
children.translated_text: Whoever said to you, 'Go away,' sending you forth against us,

children.text: taṃ kṛtye 'bhinivartasva māsmān icho anāgasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: turn back upon him, O <s>kṛtyā</s>; do not seek us, the guiltless.

children.text: yas te parūṃṣi saṃdadhau rathasyevarbhur dhiyā
children.translated_text: The one who fitted your limbs together with skill, like a craftsman fitting those of a chariot,

children.text: taṃ gaccha tatra te 'yanam ajñātas te 'yaṃ janaḥ ||
children.translated_text: go to him; there is your course. This people here is unknown to you.

children.text: ye tvā kṛtvālebhire vidvalā abhicāriṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who, having made you, laid hold of you, the skilled sorcerers,

children.text: śaṃbhv idaṃ kṛtyādūṣaṇaṃ prativartma punaḥsaraṃ tena tvā snapayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: with this auspicious <s>kṛtyā</s>-defilement, this reversing, returning charm, we bathe you.

children.text: yad durbhagāṃ prasnapitāṃ mṛtavatsām upeyima
children.translated_text: If we have gone near an unfortunate woman, put to sleep, whose children are dead,

children.text: apaitu sarvaṃ mat pāpaṃ draviṇaṃ mopa tiṣṭhatu ||
children.translated_text: let all sin depart from me; let wealth attend me.

children.text: yat te pitṛbhyo dadato yajñe vā nāma jagṛhuḥ
children.translated_text: If, while giving to the Fathers or at a sacrifice, they seized your name,

children.text: saṃdeśyāt sarvasmāt pāpād imā muñcantu tvauṣadhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: from every sin named by indication let these herbs release you.

children.text: devainasāt pitryān nāmagrāhāt saṃdeśyād abhiniṣkṛtāt
children.translated_text: From offense against the gods, from ancestral offense, from seizure of name, from designation, from an executed attack,

children.text: muñcantu tvā vīrudho vīryeṇa brahmaṇā ṛgbhiḥ payasā ṛṣīṇām ||
children.translated_text: let the plants release you with power, with <s>brahman</s> (sacred utterance), with <s>ṛg</s>-verses, and with the milk of the seers.

children.text: yathā vātaś cyāvayati bhūmyā reṇum antarikṣāc cābhram
children.translated_text: As the wind drives dust from the earth and a cloud from the midspace,

children.text: evā mat sarvaṃ durbhūtaṃ brahmanuttam apāyati ||
children.translated_text: so may every ill thing, driven away by <s>brahman</s>, depart from me.

children.text: apa krāma nānadatī vinaddhā gardabhīva
children.translated_text: Go away, sounding shrilly, bound like a she-ass.

children.text: kartṝn nakṣasveto nuttā brahmaṇā vīryāvatā ||
children.translated_text: Seek out your makers from here, driven away by powerful <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ panthāḥ kṛtyeti tvā nayāmo 'bhiprahitāṃ prati tvā pra hiṇmaḥ
children.translated_text: This is the path, O <s>kṛtyā</s>; we lead you as one sent forth, and we send you back.

children.text: tenābhi yāhi bhañjaty anasvatīva vāhinī viśvarūpā kurūṭinī ||
children.translated_text: Go by that path against them, breaking them, like a wagon-bearing draught animal, all-formed and misshapen.

children.text: parāk te jyotir apathaṃ te arvāg anyatrāsmad ayanā kṛṇuṣva
children.translated_text: Far away is your light; your path is away from us. Make your journeys elsewhere, away from us.

children.text: pareṇehi navatiṃ nāvyā ati durgāḥ srotyā mā kṣaṇiṣṭhāḥ parehi ||
children.translated_text: Go away beyond ninety navigable difficult streams; do not be harmed by the torrents. Go away.

children.text: vāta iva vṛkṣān ni mṛṇīhi pādaya mā gām aśvaṃ puruṣam ucchiṣa eṣām
children.translated_text: Like the wind, crush down the trees and make them fall; do not leave them cow, horse, or man.

children.text: kartṝn nivṛtyetaḥ kṛtye 'prajāstvāya bodhaya ||
children.translated_text: Turning back from here, O <s>kṛtyā</s>, awaken your makers to childlessness.

children.text: yāṃ te barhiṣi yāṃ śmaśāne kṣetre kṛtyāṃ valagaṃ vā nicakhnuḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>kṛtyā</s> or <s>valaga</s> (buried spell) that they buried for you in the sacrificial grass, in the cremation ground, or in the field,

children.text: agnau vā tvā gārhapatye 'bhiceruḥ pākaṃ santaṃ dhīratarā anāgasam ||
children.translated_text: or if the more calculating ones worked sorcery against you in the household fire, though you were harmless and simple,

children.text: upāhṛtam anubuddhaṃ nikhātaṃ vairaṃ tsāry anv avidāma kartram
children.translated_text: we have found the brought-in, detected, buried hostility, and the maker by following the track.

children.text: tad etu yata ābhṛtaṃ tatrāśva iva vi vartatāṃ hantu kṛtyākṛtaḥ prajām ||
children.translated_text: Let it go to the place from which it was brought; there let it turn about like a horse; let it slay the offspring of the maker of <s>kṛtyā</s>.

children.text: svāyasā asayaḥ santi no gṛhe vidmā te kṛtye yatidhā parūṃṣi
children.translated_text: Good iron knives are in our house; we know, O <s>kṛtyā</s>, how many your joints are.

children.text: ut tiṣṭhaiva parehīto 'jñāte kim ihecchasi ||
children.translated_text: Stand up at once; go away from here. Unknown one, what do you seek here?

children.text: grīvās te kṛtye pādau cāpi kartsyāmi nir drava
children.translated_text: I shall cut your neck, O <s>kṛtyā</s>, and your feet too; run away.

children.text: indrāgnī asmān rakṣatāṃ yau prajānāṃ prajāvatī ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> protect us, the two rich in progeny among creatures.

children.text: somo rājādhipā mṛḍitā ca bhūtasya naḥ patayo mṛḍayantu ||
children.translated_text: May king <s>Soma</s>, lord and gracious one, and the lords of being be gracious to us.

children.text: bhavāśarvāv asyatāṃ pāpakṛte kṛtyākṛte
children.translated_text: Let <s>Bhava</s> and <s>Śarva</s> shoot at the evil-doer, the maker of <s>kṛtyā</s>,

children.text: duṣkṛte vidyutaṃ devahetim ||
children.translated_text: at the wrong-doer, lightning, the divine missile.

children.text: yady eyatha dvipadī catuṣpadī kṛtyākṛtā saṃbhṛtā viśvarūpā
children.translated_text: If you have come as two-footed or four-footed, made by a maker of <s>kṛtyā</s>, gathered together and all-formed,

children.text: seto 'ṣṭāpadī bhūtvā punaḥ parehi ducchune ||
children.translated_text: become eight-footed from here and go back again, O evil one.

children.text: abhyaktāktā svaraṃkṛtā sarvaṃ bharantī duritaṃ parehi
children.translated_text: Anointed, smeared, adorned, bearing every evil, go away.

children.text: jānīhi kṛtye kartāraṃ duhiteva pitaraṃ svam ||
children.translated_text: Know your maker, O <s>kṛtyā</s>, as a daughter knows her own father.

children.text: parehi kṛtye mā tiṣṭho viddhasyeva padaṃ naya
children.translated_text: Go away, O <s>kṛtyā</s>; do not stand. Follow the track like one pierced.

children.text: mṛgaḥ sa mṛgayus tvaṃ na tvā nikartum arhati ||
children.translated_text: He is the hunted animal, and you are the hunter; he is not able to cut you down.

children.text: uta hanti pūrvāsinaṃ pratyādāyāpara iṣvā
children.translated_text: And with a later arrow, having turned it back, one strikes the one who sits before.

children.text: uta pūrvasya nighnato ni hanty aparaḥ prati ||
children.translated_text: And while the former one is striking, the latter strikes back.

children.text: etaddhi śṛṇu me vaco 'thehi yata eyatha
children.translated_text: Hear this word of mine; then go to the place from which you came.

children.text: yas tvā cakāra taṃ prati ||
children.translated_text: Go back against him who made you.

children.text: anāgohatyā vai bhīmā kṛtye mā no gām aśvaṃ puruṣaṃ vadhīḥ
children.translated_text: The killing of the guiltless is terrible indeed, O <s>kṛtyā</s>; do not slay our cow, horse, or man.

children.text: yatra yatrāsi nihitā tatas tvotthāpayāmasi parṇāl laghīyasī bhava ||
children.translated_text: Wherever you have been laid down, from there we raise you up; be lighter than a leaf.

children.text: yadi stha tamasāvṛtā jālenābhihitā iva
children.translated_text: If you are covered with darkness, as though wrapped in a net,

children.text: sarvāḥ saṃlupyetaḥ kṛtyāḥ punaḥ kartre pra hiṇmasi ||
children.translated_text: may all the <s>kṛtyās</s> (works of sorcery) be swept together; we send them back again to their maker.

children.text: kṛtyākṛto valagino 'bhiniṣkāriṇaḥ prajām
children.translated_text: The offspring of the makers of <s>kṛtyā</s>, of the trap-setters, of the hostile performers,

children.text: mṛṇīhi kṛtye mocchiṣo 'mūn kṛtyākṛto jahi ||
children.translated_text: crush them, O <s>kṛtyā</s>; leave nothing over. Strike down those makers of <s>kṛtyā</s>.

children.text: yathā sūryo mucyate tamasas pari rātriṃ jahāty uṣasaśca ketūn
children.translated_text: As <s>Sūrya</s> is released from darkness and leaves the night and the signals of dawn,

children.text: evāhaṃ sarvaṃ durbhūtaṃ kartraṃ kṛtyākṛtā kṛtaṃ hastīva rajo duritaṃ jahāmi ||
children.translated_text: so I cast off every evil condition, the deed done by the maker of <s>kṛtyā</s>, as an elephant casts off dust and misfortune.

children.text: Chapter 450
kena pārṣṇī ābhṛte pūruṣasya kena māṃsaṃ saṃbhṛtaṃ kena gulphau
children.translated_text: By what were the heels of man brought together? By what was the flesh gathered? By what the ankles?

children.text: kenāṅgulīḥ peśanīḥ kena khāni kenocchlakhau madhyataḥ kaḥ pratiṣṭhām ||
children.translated_text: By what the fingers and sinews? By what the openings? By what the two insteps? Who set the foundation in the middle?

children.text: kasmān nu gulphāv adharāv akṛṇvann aṣṭhīvantāv uttarau puruṣasya
children.translated_text: From what did they make the two lower ankles of man, and the two upper parts furnished with bones?

children.text: jaṅghe nirṛtya ny adadhuḥ kva svij jānunoḥ saṃdhī ka u tac ciketa ||
children.translated_text: Having stretched out the shanks, they set them down; where indeed are the joints of the knees? Who has known this?

children.text: catuṣṭayaṃ yujate saṃhitāntaṃ jānubhyām ūrdhvaṃ śithiraṃ kabandham
children.translated_text: The fourfold frame is joined, connected at its end; above the knees is the loose trunk.

children.text: śroṇī yad ūrū ka u taj jajāna yābhyāṃ kusindhaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ babhūva ||
children.translated_text: Who generated the hips and the thighs, by which the firm seat came into being?

children.text: kati devāḥ katame ta āsan ya uro grīvāś cikyuḥ puruṣasya
children.translated_text: How many gods were there, and which ones were they, who fashioned the chest and neck of man?

children.text: kati stanau vy adadhuḥ kaḥ kaphauḍau kati skandhān kati pṛṣṭīr acinvan ||
children.translated_text: How many breasts did they set apart? Who made the two <s>kaphauḍas</s> (obscure shoulder or chest parts)? How many shoulders, how many back-parts did they pile up?

children.text: ko asya bāhū sam abharad vīryaṃ karavād iti
children.translated_text: Who brought his arms together, saying, 'Let him perform heroic strength'?

children.text: aṃsau ko asya tad devaḥ kusindhe adhy ā dadhau ||
children.translated_text: What god set his two shoulders upon the bodily frame?

children.text: kaḥ sapta khāni vi tatarda śīrṣaṇi karṇāv imau nāsike cakṣaṇī mukham
children.translated_text: Who pierced open the seven openings in the head: these two ears, the nostrils, the two eyes, and the mouth,

children.text: yeṣāṃ purutrā vijayasya mahmani catuṣpādo dvipado yanti yāmam ||
children.translated_text: through the manifold greatness of whose victory four-footed and two-footed beings go their course?

children.text: hanvor hi jihvām adadhāt purūcīm adhā mahīm adhi śiśrāya vācam
children.translated_text: For he placed the broad tongue between the jaws; then upon it he set mighty speech.

children.text: sa ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣv antar apo vasānaḥ ka u tac ciketa ||
children.translated_text: He turns about within the worlds, clothed in waters; who has known this?

children.text: mastiṣkam asya yatamo lalāṭaṃ kakāṭikāṃ prathamo yaḥ kapālam
children.translated_text: Whichever god was first his brain, the forehead, the nape, and the skull,

children.text: citvā cityaṃ hanvoḥ pūruṣasya divaṃ ruroha katamaḥ sa devaḥ ||
children.translated_text: having piled up what was to be piled in the jaws of man, mounted to heaven: which god was he?

children.text: priyāpriyāṇi bahulā svapnaṃ saṃbādhatandryaḥ
children.translated_text: Dear and undear things, manifold dream, constriction and drowsiness,

children.text: ānandān ugro nandāṃś ca kasmād vahati pūruṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: joys and fierce delights: from what does man carry them?

children.text: ārtir avartir nirṛtiḥ kuto nu puruṣe 'matiḥ
children.translated_text: Pain, disorder, destruction: from where indeed are they in man, and lack of thought?

children.text: rāddhiḥ samṛddhir avyṛddhir matir uditayaḥ kutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Success, prosperity, failure, thought, and impulses: from where do they come?

children.text: ko asminn āpo vy adadhāt viṣūvṛtaḥ purūvṛtaḥ sindhusṛtyāya jātāḥ
children.translated_text: Who set the waters in him, flowing apart, flowing many ways, born for the course of rivers,

children.text: tīvrā aruṇā lohinīs tāmradhūmrā ūrdhvā avācīḥ puruṣe tiraścīḥ ||
children.translated_text: sharp, ruddy, red, coppery-smoky, upward, downward, and crosswise in man?

children.text: ko asmin rūpam adadhāt ko mahmānaṃ ca nāma ca
children.translated_text: Who placed form in him? Who placed greatness and name?

children.text: gātuṃ ko asmin kaḥ ketuṃ kaś caritrāni puruṣe ||
children.translated_text: Who placed movement in him? Who placed perception? Who placed the modes of conduct in man?

children.text: ko asmin prāṇaṃ avayat ko apānaṃ vyānam u
children.translated_text: Who wove breath in him? Who wove out-breath and the diffused breath?

children.text: samānam asmin ko devo 'dhi śiśrāya puruṣe ||
children.translated_text: What god set the equalizing breath within man?

children.text: ko asmin yajñam adadhād eko devo 'dhi puruṣe
children.translated_text: Who placed sacrifice in him, the one god set upon man?

children.text: ko asmint satyaṃ ko 'nṛtaṃ kuto mṛtyuḥ kuto 'mṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Who placed truth in him, who untruth? From where is death, from where immortality?

children.text: ko asmai vāsaḥ pary adadhāt ko asyāyur akalpayat
children.translated_text: Who wrapped clothing around him? Who fashioned his lifetime?

children.text: balaṃ ko asmai prāyacchat ko asyākalpayaj javam ||
children.translated_text: Who gave him strength? Who fashioned his swiftness?

children.text: kenāpo anv atanuta kenāhar akarod ruce
children.translated_text: By what did he stretch out the waters? By what did he make the day for shining?

children.text: uṣasaṃ kenānv ainddha kena sāyaṃbhavaṃ dade ||
children.translated_text: By what did he kindle the dawn? By what did he take up the evening state?

children.text: ko asmin reto ny adadhāt tantur ā tāyatām iti
children.translated_text: Who placed seed in him, saying, 'Let the thread be extended'?

children.text: medhāṃ ko asminn adhy auhat ko bāṇaṃ ko nṛto dadhau ||
children.translated_text: Who set intelligence upon him? Who set the arrow, who dancing?

children.text: kenemāṃ bhūmim aurṇot kena pary abhavad divam
children.translated_text: By what did man cover this earth? By what did he encompass heaven?

children.text: kenābhi mahnā parvatān kena karmāṇi puruṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By what greatness did he encompass the mountains? By what did man perform his works?

children.text: kena parjanyam anv eti kena somaṃ vicakṣaṇam
children.translated_text: By what does he follow <s>Parjanya</s>? By what the discerning <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: kena yajñam ca śraddhāṃ ca kenāsmin nihitaṃ manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By what sacrifice and faith? By what is mind placed in him?

children.text: kena śrotriyam āpnoti kenemaṃ parameṣṭhinam
children.translated_text: By what does he attain the Veda-knowing one? By what this highest one?

children.text: kenemam agniṃ pūruṣaḥ kena saṃvatsaraṃ mame ||
children.translated_text: By what does man attain this <s>Agni</s>? By what does he take possession of the year?

children.text: brahma śrotriyam āpnoti brahmemaṃ parameṣṭhinam
children.translated_text: By <s>brahman</s> he attains the Veda-knowing one; by <s>brahman</s> this highest one.

children.text: brahmemam agniṃ pūruṣo brahma saṃvatsaraṃ mame ||
children.translated_text: By <s>brahman</s> man attains this <s>Agni</s>; by <s>brahman</s> he takes possession of the year.

children.text: kena devāṁ anu kṣiyati kena daivajanīr viśaḥ
children.translated_text: By what does he dwell among the gods? By what among the peoples born of the gods?

children.text: kenedam anyan nakṣatraṃ kena sat kṣatram ucyate ||
children.translated_text: By what is this other asterism? By what is true royal power said to be?

children.text: brahma devāṁ anu kṣiyati brahma daivajanīr viśaḥ
children.translated_text: By <s>brahman</s> he dwells among the gods; by <s>brahman</s> among the peoples born of the gods.

children.text: brahmedam anyan nakṣatraṃ brahma sat kṣatram ucyate ||
children.translated_text: By <s>brahman</s> is this other asterism; by <s>brahman</s> true royal power is said to be.

children.text: keneyaṃ bhūmir vihitā kena dyaur uttarā hitā
children.translated_text: By what has this earth been arranged? By what has the upper heaven been set in place?

children.text: kenedam ūrdhvaṃ tiryak cāntarikṣam vyaco hitam ||
children.translated_text: By what has this wide midspace been set upward, crosswise, and breadthwise?

children.text: brahmaṇā bhūmir vihitā brahma dyaur uttarā hitā
children.translated_text: By <s>brahman</s> the earth has been arranged; by <s>brahman</s> the upper heaven has been set in place.

children.text: brahmedam ūrdhvaṃ tiryak cāntarikṣaṃ vyaco hitam ||
children.translated_text: By <s>brahman</s> this wide midspace has been set upward and crosswise.

children.text: mūrdhānam asya saṃsīvyātharvā hṛdayaṃ ca yat
children.translated_text: Having sewn together his head, <s>Atharvan</s>, and what was his heart,

children.text: mastiṣkād ūrdhvaḥ prairayat pavamāno 'dhi śīrṣataḥ ||
children.translated_text: from the brain upward the purifying one impelled it from above the head.

children.text: tad vā atharvaṇaḥ śiro devakośaḥ samubjitaḥ
children.translated_text: That indeed is the head of <s>Atharvan</s>, the upraised treasury of the gods.

children.text: tat prāṇo abhi rakṣati śiro annam atho manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Breath guards that head, and food, and also mind.

children.text: ūrdhvo nu sṛṣṭā3s tiryaṅ nu sṛṣṭā3s sarvā diśaḥ puruṣa ā babhūvā3ṃ
children.translated_text: Was he created upright, was he created crosswise? Man came into being in all directions,

children.text: puraṃ yo brahmaṇo veda yasyāḥ puruṣa ucyate ||
children.translated_text: the one who knows the city of <s>brahman</s>, of which man is so called.

children.text: yo vai tāṃ brahmaṇo vedāmṛtenāvṛtāṃ puram
children.translated_text: Whoever truly knows that city of <s>brahman</s>, covered with immortality,

children.text: tasmai brahma ca brāhmāś ca cakṣuḥ prāṇaṃ prajāṃ daduḥ ||
children.translated_text: to him <s>brahman</s> and the <s>brāhmaṇas</s> have given sight, breath, and progeny.

children.text: na vai tam cakṣur jahāti na prāṇo jarasaḥ purā
children.translated_text: Sight does not leave him, nor breath, before old age,

children.text: puraṃ yo brahmaṇo veda yasyāḥ puruṣa ucyate ||
children.translated_text: the one who knows the city of <s>brahman</s>, of which man is so called.

children.text: aṣṭācakrā navadvārā devānāṃ pūr ayodhyā
children.translated_text: Eight-wheeled, nine-doored, unconquerable is the city of the gods;

children.text: tasyāṃ hiraṇyayaḥ kośaḥ svargo jyotiṣāvṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in it is a golden treasure-chamber, heaven, enveloped in light.

children.text: tasmin hiraṇyaye kośe tryare tripratiṣṭhite
children.translated_text: In that golden treasure-chamber, three-spoked and set on three supports,

children.text: tasmin yad yakṣam ātmanvat tad vai brahmavido viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: whatever self-possessing mystery is there, that indeed the knowers of <s>brahman</s> (sacred power) know.

children.text: prabhrājamānāṃ hariṇīṃ yaśasā saṃparīvṛtām
children.translated_text: Shining forth, tawny, surrounded on all sides by glory,

children.text: puraṃ hiraṇyayīṃ brahmā viveśāparājitām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>brahman</s>-priest entered the golden, unconquered city.

children.text: Chapter 451
ayaṃ me varaṇo maṇiḥ sapatnakṣayaṇo vṛṣā
children.translated_text: This <s>varaṇa</s> jewel of mine is a bull that destroys rivals;

children.text: tenā rabhasva tvaṃ śatrūn pra mṛṇīhi durasyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: with it seize your enemies; crush those who are hostile.

children.text: praiṇān chṛṇīhi pra mṛṇā rabhasva maṇis te astu puraetā purastāt
children.translated_text: Cut them down, crush them, seize them; let the jewel be your forerunner in front.

children.text: avārayanta varaṇena devā abhyācāram asurāṇāṃ śvaḥ śvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With the <s>varaṇa</s>, the gods warded off the repeated assault of the <s>Asuras</s>, day after day.

children.text: ayaṃ maṇir varaṇo viśvabheṣajaḥ sahasrākṣo harito hiraṇyayaḥ
children.translated_text: This jewel, the <s>varaṇa</s>, is a remedy for all, thousand-eyed, green-gold and golden;

children.text: sa te śatrūn adharān pādayāti pūrvas tān dabhnuhi ye tvā dviṣanti ||
children.translated_text: it makes your enemies fall below; overpower first those who hate you.

children.text: ayaṃ te kṛtyāṃ vitatām pauruṣeyād ayaṃ bhayāt
children.translated_text: This one will protect you from sorcery spread out by a man, this one from fear;

children.text: ayaṃ tvā sarvasmāt pāpād varaṇo vārayiṣyate ||
children.translated_text: this <s>varaṇa</s> will ward you from every evil.

children.text: varaṇo vārayātā ayaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>varaṇa</s> here, this divine forest-tree, is a warder;

children.text: yakṣmo yo asminn āviṣṭas tam u devā avīvaran ||
children.translated_text: the <s>yakṣma</s> (wasting disease) that has entered here, that indeed the gods have warded off.

children.text: svapnaṃ suptvā yadi paśyāsi pāpaṃ mṛgaḥ sṛtiṃ yati dhāvād ajuṣṭām
children.translated_text: If, having slept, you see an evil dream, if a wild beast runs along an unwelcome path,

children.text: parikṣavācchakuneḥ pāpavādād ayaṃ maṇir varaṇo vārayiṣyate ||
children.translated_text: from ill-omened sneezing around you and from a bird's evil cry, this jewel, the <s>varaṇa</s>, will ward you off.

children.text: arātyās tvā nirṛtyā abhicārād atho bhayāt
children.translated_text: From hostility, from <s>Nirṛti</s>, from sorcery, and also from fear,

children.text: mṛtyor ojīyaso vadhād varaṇo vārayiṣyate ||
children.translated_text: from death, from the stronger blow of destruction, the <s>varaṇa</s> will ward you off.

children.text: yan me mātā yan me pitā bhrātaro yac ca me svā yad enaś cakṛmā vayam
children.translated_text: Whatever my mother, whatever my father, my brothers, and whatever is my own, whatever sin we have committed,

children.text: tato no vārayiṣyate 'yaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: from that this divine forest-tree will ward us off.

children.text: varaṇena pravyathitā bhrātṛvyā me sabandhavaḥ
children.translated_text: By the <s>varaṇa</s> my brother-rivals, together with their kinsmen, have been made to tremble;

children.text: asūrtaṃ rajo apy agus te yantv adhamaṃ tamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they have gone into sunless dust; let them go to the lowest darkness.

children.text: ariṣṭo 'ham ariṣṭagur āyuṣmānt sarvapūruṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Uninjured am I, with an uninjured path, long-lived, together with all my people;

children.text: tam māyaṃ varaṇo maṇiḥ pari pātu diśo diśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let this <s>varaṇa</s> jewel protect me on every side.

children.text: ayaṃ me varaṇa urasi rājā devo vanaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>varaṇa</s> upon my breast, the king, the divine forest-tree,

children.text: sa me śatrūn vi bādhatām indro dasyūn ivāsurān ||
children.translated_text: let it drive away my enemies, as <s>Indra</s> drove away the <s>Dasyus</s>, the <s>Asuras</s>.

children.text: imaṃ bibharmi varaṇam āyuṣmāṁ chataśāradaḥ
children.translated_text: I bear this <s>varaṇa</s>, long-lived, one who will live a hundred autumns;

children.text: sa me rāṣṭraṃ ca kṣatraṃ ca paśūn ojaś ca me dadhat ||
children.translated_text: let it bestow on me realm and ruling power, cattle and vigor.

children.text: yathā vāto vanaspatīn vṛkṣān bhanakty ojasā
children.translated_text: As the wind breaks forest-trees, trees, with its force,

children.text: evā sapatnān me bhaṅgdhi pūrvān jātāṁ utāparān varaṇas tvābhi rakṣatu ||
children.translated_text: so break my rivals, those born before and those born after; let the <s>varaṇa</s> protect you.

children.text: yathā vātaś cāgniś ca vṛkṣān psāto vanaspatīn
children.translated_text: As wind and fire consume trees and forest-trees,

children.text: evā sapatnān me psāhi pūrvān jātāṁ utāparān varaṇas tvābhi rakṣatu ||
children.translated_text: so consume my rivals, those born before and those born after; let the <s>varaṇa</s> protect you.

children.text: yathā vātena prakṣīṇā vṛkṣāḥ śere nyarpitāḥ
children.translated_text: As trees, wasted by the wind, lie cast down,

children.text: evā sapatnāṃs tvaṃ mama pra kṣiṇīhi ny arpaya
children.translated_text: so do you waste my rivals and cast them down,

children.text: pūrvān jātāṁ utāparān varaṇas tvābhi rakṣatu ||
children.translated_text: those born before and those born after; let the <s>varaṇa</s> protect you.

children.text: tāṃs tvaṃ pra chinddhi varaṇa purā diṣṭāt purāyuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Cut them off, O <s>varaṇa</s>, before their allotted time, before their life-span,

children.text: ya enaṃ paśuṣu dipsanti ye cāsya rāṣṭradipsavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: those who seek to injure this man among his cattle, and those who seek to injure his realm.

children.text: yathā sūryo atibhāti yathāsmin teja āhitam
children.translated_text: As the sun shines beyond all, as brilliance is set in it,

children.text: evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yachatu
children.translated_text: so let my <s>varaṇa</s> jewel assign to me fame and prosperity;

children.text: tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mā ||
children.translated_text: let it sprinkle me with splendor; let it anoint me with glory.

children.text: yathā yaśaś candramasy āditye ca nṛcakṣasi
children.translated_text: As glory is in the moon and in the sun, visible to men,

children.text: evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yachatu
children.translated_text: so let my <s>varaṇa</s> jewel assign to me fame and prosperity;

children.text: tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mā ||
children.translated_text: let it sprinkle me with splendor; let it anoint me with glory.

children.text: yathā yaśaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yathāsmin jātavedasi
children.translated_text: As glory is on the earth, as it is in this <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yachatu
children.translated_text: so let my <s>varaṇa</s> jewel assign to me fame and prosperity;

children.text: tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mā ||
children.translated_text: let it sprinkle me with splendor; let it anoint me with glory.

children.text: yathā yaśaḥ kanyāyāṃ yathāsmint saṃbhṛte rathe
children.translated_text: As glory is in a maiden, as it is in this assembled chariot,

children.text: evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yachatu
children.translated_text: so let my <s>varaṇa</s> jewel assign to me fame and prosperity;

children.text: tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mā ||
children.translated_text: let it sprinkle me with splendor; let it anoint me with glory.

children.text: yathā yaśaḥ somapīthe madhuparke yathā yaśaḥ
children.translated_text: As glory is at the soma-drinking and at the honey-mixture, as there is glory,

children.text: evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yachatu
children.translated_text: so let my <s>varaṇa</s> jewel assign to me fame and prosperity;

children.text: tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mā ||
children.translated_text: let it sprinkle me with splendor; let it anoint me with glory.

children.text: yathā yaśo 'gnihotre vaṣaṭkāre yathā yaśaḥ
children.translated_text: As glory is in the <s>Agnihotra</s> and in the <s>vaṣaṭ</s>-call, as there is glory,

children.text: evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yachatu
children.translated_text: so let my <s>varaṇa</s> jewel assign to me fame and prosperity;

children.text: tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mā ||
children.translated_text: let it sprinkle me with splendor; let it anoint me with glory.

children.text: yathā yaśo yajamāne yathāsmin yajña āhitam
children.translated_text: As glory is in the sacrificer, as it is set in this sacrifice,

children.text: evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yachatu
children.translated_text: so let my <s>varaṇa</s> jewel assign to me fame and prosperity;

children.text: tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mā ||
children.translated_text: let it sprinkle me with splendor; let it anoint me with glory.

children.text: yathā yaśaḥ prajāpatau yathāsmin parameṣṭhini
children.translated_text: As glory is in <s>Prajāpati</s>, as it is in this <s>Parameṣṭhin</s>,

children.text: evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yachatu
children.translated_text: so let my <s>varaṇa</s> jewel assign to me fame and prosperity;

children.text: tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mā ||
children.translated_text: let it sprinkle me with splendor; let it anoint me with glory.

children.text: yathā deveṣv amṛtaṃ yathaiṣu satyam āhitam
children.translated_text: As immortality is among the gods, as truth is set among them,

children.text: evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yachatu
children.translated_text: so let my <s>varaṇa</s> jewel assign to me fame and prosperity;

children.text: tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mā ||
children.translated_text: let it sprinkle me with splendor; let it anoint me with glory.

children.text: Chapter 452
indrasya prathamo ratho devānām aparo ratho varuṇasya tṛtīya it
children.translated_text: The first chariot is <s>Indra</s>'s chariot, the next chariot is the gods', and the third is <s>Varuṇa</s>'s;

children.text: ahīnām apamā ratha sthāṇum ārad athārṣat ||
children.translated_text: the last chariot of the serpents has sped far away from the post.

children.text: darbhaḥ śocis tarūṇakam aśvasya vāraḥ paruṣasya vāraḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>darbha</s> grass is flame, a tender shoot, the horse's hair, the rough one's hair,

children.text: rathasya bandhuram ||
children.translated_text: the chariot's fastening.

children.text: ava śveta padā jahi pūrveṇa cāpareṇa ca
children.translated_text: Strike down, O white one, with your foot, with the front one and with the back one;

children.text: udaplutam iva dārv ahīnām arasaṃ viṣaṃ vār ugram ||
children.translated_text: like a piece of wood floating up, make the fierce poison of the serpents sapless; ward it off.

children.text: araṃghuṣo nimajyonmajya punar abravīt
children.translated_text: <s>Araṃghuṣa</s>, sinking and rising up, spoke again:

children.text: udaplutam iva dārv ahīnām arasaṃ viṣaṃ vār ugram ||
children.translated_text: like a piece of wood floating up, make the fierce poison of the serpents sapless; ward it off.

children.text: paidvo hanti kasarṇīlaṃ paidvaḥ śvitram utāsitam
children.translated_text: <s>Paidva</s> kills the <s>kasarṇīla</s>, <s>Paidva</s> the white one and also the black one;

children.text: paidvo ratharvyāḥ śiraḥ saṃ bibheda pṛdākvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Paidva</s> has split apart the head of <s>Ratharvī</s>'s <s>pṛdāku</s> serpent.

children.text: paidva prehi prathamo 'nu tvā vayam emasi
children.translated_text: Go forward, O <s>Paidva</s>, as the first; we follow after you.

children.text: ahīn vy asyatāt patho yena smā vayam emasi ||
children.translated_text: Drive the serpents from the path by which we are to go.

children.text: idaṃ paidvo ajāyatedam asya parāyaṇam
children.translated_text: This <s>Paidva</s> has been born; this is his going-forth.

children.text: imāny arvataḥ padāhighnyo vājinīvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: These are the hoofprints of the steed, the smiters, rich in victorious force.

children.text: saṃyataṃ na vi ṣparad vyāttaṃ na saṃ yamat
children.translated_text: It does not burst what is bound, nor does it bind together what is opened wide.

children.text: asmin kṣetre dvāv ahī strī ca pumāṃś ca tāv ubhāv arasā ||
children.translated_text: In this field there are two serpents, a female and a male; both of them are without sap.

children.text: arasāsa ihāhayo ye anti ye ca dūrake
children.translated_text: Without sap are the serpents here, those that are near and those that are far away.

children.text: ghanena hanmi vṛścikam ahiṃ daṇḍenāgatam ||
children.translated_text: With a club I strike the scorpion, and with a staff the serpent that has come.

children.text: aghāśvasyedaṃ bheṣajam ubhayoḥ svajasya ca
children.translated_text: This is the remedy for the evil horse, and for both kinds of <s>svaja</s> serpent.

children.text: indro me 'him aghāyantam ahiṃ paidvo arandhayat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has subdued for me the hostile serpent; <s>Paidva</s> has subdued the serpent.

children.text: paidvasya manmahe vayaṃ sthirasya sthiradhāmnaḥ
children.translated_text: We call to mind <s>Paidva</s>, the firm one of firm abode.

children.text: ime paścā pṛdākavaḥ pradīdhyata āsate ||
children.translated_text: These <s>pṛdāku</s> serpents sit behind, blazing forth.

children.text: naṣṭāsavo naṣṭaviṣā hatā indreṇa vajriṇā
children.translated_text: Their life-breath is lost, their poison is lost; they have been slain by <s>Indra</s>, the thunderbolt-bearer.

children.text: jaghānendro jaghnimā vayam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has struck them down; we too have struck them down.

children.text: hatās tiraścirājayo nipiṣṭāsaḥ pṛdākavaḥ
children.translated_text: The cross-striped ones have been slain; the <s>pṛdāku</s> serpents have been crushed.

children.text: darviṃ karikrataṃ śvitraṃ darbheṣv asitaṃ jahi ||
children.translated_text: Kill in the grasses the <s>darvi</s>, the <s>karikrata</s>, the white one, and the black one.

children.text: kairātikā kumārikā sakā khanati bheṣajam
children.translated_text: The young <s>Kairātikā</s> girl digs up the remedy,

children.text: hiraṇyayībhir abhribhir girīnām upa sānuṣu ||
children.translated_text: with golden mattocks on the ridges of the mountains.

children.text: āyam agan yuvā bhiṣak pṛśnihāparājitaḥ
children.translated_text: This young healer has come, the speckled-slayer, unconquered.

children.text: sa vai svajasya jambhana ubhayor vṛścikasya ca ||
children.translated_text: He indeed is the crusher of the <s>svaja</s> serpent and of both kinds of scorpion.

children.text: indro me 'him arandhayan mitraś ca varuṇaś ca
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has subdued the serpent for me, and so have <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: vātāparjanyobhā ||
children.translated_text: and both <s>Vāta</s> and <s>Parjanya</s>.

children.text: indro me 'him arandhayat pṛdākuṃ ca pṛdākvam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has subdued for me the serpent, the <s>pṛdāku</s> and the <s>pṛdākva</s>,

children.text: svajaṃ tiraścirājiṃ kasarṇīlaṃ daśonasim ||
children.translated_text: the <s>svaja</s>, the cross-striped one, the <s>kasarṇīla</s>, and the <s>daśonasi</s>.

children.text: indro jaghāna prathamaṃ janitāram ahe tava
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the first begetter, has slain your sire, O serpent.

children.text: teṣām u tṛhyamāṇānāṃ kaḥ svit teṣām asad rasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When they are being crushed, what sap of theirs can remain?

children.text: saṃ hi śīrṣāṇy agrabhaṃ pauñjiṣṭha iva karvaram
children.translated_text: For I have seized their heads, like a <s>pauñjiṣṭha</s> seizing a bundle.

children.text: sindhor madhyaṃ paretya vy anijam aher viṣam ||
children.translated_text: Having gone to the middle of the river, I have washed out the serpent's poison.

children.text: ahīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ parā vahantu sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the rivers carry away the poison of all serpents.

children.text: hatās tiraścirājayo nipiṣṭāsaḥ pṛdākavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The cross-striped ones have been slain; the <s>pṛdāku</s> serpents have been crushed.

children.text: oṣadhīnām ahaṃ vṛṇa urvarīr iva sādhuyā
children.translated_text: I choose the herbs, as one chooses fertile fields in the proper way.

children.text: nayāmy arvatīr ivāhe niraitu viṣam ||
children.translated_text: I lead them like swift mares; let the serpent's poison go forth.

children.text: yad agnau sūrye viṣaṃ pṛthivyām oṣadhīṣu yat
children.translated_text: Whatever poison is in fire, in the sun, on earth, and whatever is in the herbs,

children.text: kāndāviṣaṃ kanaknakaṃ niraitv aitu te viṣam ||
children.translated_text: the root-poison, the <s>kanaknaka</s>, let it go forth; let your poison depart.

children.text: ye agnijā oṣadhijā ahīnāṃ ye apsujā vidyuta ābabhūvuḥ
children.translated_text: Those serpents that are born of fire, born of herbs, born in the waters, and that have arisen from lightning,

children.text: yeṣāṃ jātāni bahudhā mahānti tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namasā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: the many great broods of them: to those serpents we pay homage.

children.text: taudī nāmāsi kanyā ghṛtācī nāma vā asi
children.translated_text: You are the maiden named <s>Taudī</s>, or else you are named <s>Ghṛtācī</s>.

children.text: adhaspadena te padam ā dade viṣadūṣaṇam ||
children.translated_text: With the sole of my foot I take hold of your poison-spoiling footstep.

children.text: aṅgādaṅgāt pra cyāvaya hṛdayam pari varjaya
children.translated_text: Drive it forth from limb after limb; spare the heart.

children.text: adhā viṣasya yat tejo 'vācīnaṃ tad etu te ||
children.translated_text: Then let whatever fiery force of the poison is yours go downward.

children.text: āre abhūd viṣam araud viṣe viṣam aprāg api
children.translated_text: The poison has gone far away; poison has cried out against poison and gone forward.

children.text: agnir viṣam aher nir adhāt somo nir aṇayīt
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has put away the serpent's poison; <s>Soma</s> has led it away.

children.text: daṃṣṭāram anv agād viṣam ahir amṛta ||
children.translated_text: The poison has gone after the biter; the serpent is without its death-dealing force.

children.text: Chapter 453
indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balaṃ sthendrasya vīryaṃ sthendrasya nṛmṇaṃ stha
children.translated_text: You are <s>Indra</s>'s might; you are <s>Indra</s>'s power; you are <s>Indra</s>'s strength; you are <s>Indra</s>'s heroic energy; you are <s>Indra</s>'s manly force.

children.text: jiṣṇave yogāya brahmayogair vo yunajmi ||
children.translated_text: For victorious yoking I yoke you with <s>brahman</s>-yokings.

children.text: indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balaṃ sthendrasya vīryaṃ sthendrasya nṛmṇaṃ stha
children.translated_text: You are <s>Indra</s>'s might; you are <s>Indra</s>'s power; you are <s>Indra</s>'s strength; you are <s>Indra</s>'s heroic energy; you are <s>Indra</s>'s manly force.

children.text: jiṣṇave yogāya kṣatrayogair vo yunajmi ||
children.translated_text: For victorious yoking I yoke you with <s>kṣatra</s>-yokings.

children.text: indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balaṃ sthendrasya vīryaṃ sthendrasya nṛmṇaṃ stha
children.translated_text: You are <s>Indra</s>'s might; you are <s>Indra</s>'s power; you are <s>Indra</s>'s strength; you are <s>Indra</s>'s heroic energy; you are <s>Indra</s>'s manly force.

children.text: jiṣṇave yogāyendrayogair vo yunajmi ||
children.translated_text: For victorious yoking I yoke you with <s>Indra</s>-yokings.

children.text: indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balaṃ sthendrasya vīryaṃ sthendrasya nṛmṇaṃ stha
children.translated_text: You are <s>Indra</s>'s might; you are <s>Indra</s>'s power; you are <s>Indra</s>'s strength; you are <s>Indra</s>'s heroic energy; you are <s>Indra</s>'s manly force.

children.text: jiṣṇave yogāya somayogair vo yunajmi ||
children.translated_text: For victorious yoking I yoke you with <s>Soma</s>-yokings.

children.text: indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balaṃ sthendrasya vīryaṃ sthendrasya nṛmṇaṃ stha
children.translated_text: You are <s>Indra</s>'s might; you are <s>Indra</s>'s power; you are <s>Indra</s>'s strength; you are <s>Indra</s>'s heroic energy; you are <s>Indra</s>'s manly force.

children.text: jiṣṇave yogāyāpsuyogair vo yunajmi ||
children.translated_text: For victorious yoking I yoke you with water-yokings.

children.text: indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balaṃ sthendrasya vīryaṃ sthendrasya nṛmṇaṃ stha
children.translated_text: You are <s>Indra</s>'s might; you are <s>Indra</s>'s power; you are <s>Indra</s>'s strength; you are <s>Indra</s>'s heroic energy; you are <s>Indra</s>'s manly force.

children.text: jiṣṇave yogāya viśvāni mā bhūtāny upa tiṣṭhantu yuktā ma āpa stha ||
children.translated_text: For victorious yoking, let all beings attend me, yoked; you are waters joined to me.

children.text: agner bhāga stha apāṃ śukram āpo devīr varco asmāsu dhatta
children.translated_text: You are the share of <s>Agni</s>, the brightness of the waters; divine waters, place brilliance in us.

children.text: prajāpater vo dhāmnāsmai lokāya sādaye ||
children.translated_text: By the ordinance of <s>Prajāpati</s> I set you down for this world.

children.text: indrasya bhāga stha apāṃ śukram āpo devīr varco asmāsu dhatta
children.translated_text: You are the share of <s>Indra</s>, the brightness of the waters; divine waters, place brilliance in us.

children.text: prajāpater vo dhāmnāsmai lokāya sādaye ||
children.translated_text: By the ordinance of <s>Prajāpati</s> I set you down for this world.

children.text: somasya bhāga stha apāṃ śukram āpo devīr varco asmāsu dhatta
children.translated_text: You are the share of <s>Soma</s>, the brightness of the waters; divine waters, place brilliance in us.

children.text: prajāpater vo dhāmnāsmai lokāya sādaye ||
children.translated_text: By the ordinance of <s>Prajāpati</s> I set you down for this world.

children.text: varuṇasya bhāga stha apāṃ śukram āpo devīr varco asmāsu dhatta
children.translated_text: You are the share of <s>Varuṇa</s>, the brightness of the waters; divine waters, place brilliance in us.

children.text: prajāpater vo dhāmnāsmai lokāya sādaye ||
children.translated_text: By the ordinance of <s>Prajāpati</s> I set you down for this world.

children.text: mitrāvaruṇayor bhāga stha apāṃ śukram āpo devīr varco asmāsu dhatta
children.translated_text: You are the share of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, the brightness of the waters; divine waters, place brilliance in us.

children.text: prajāpater vo dhāmnāsmai lokāya sādaye ||
children.translated_text: By the ordinance of <s>Prajāpati</s> I set you down for this world.

children.text: yamasya bhāga stha apām śukram āpo devīr varco asmāsu dhatta
children.translated_text: You are the share of <s>Yama</s>, the brightness of the waters; divine waters, place brilliance in us.

children.text: prajāpater vo dhāmnāsmai lokāya sādaye ||
children.translated_text: By the ordinance of <s>Prajāpati</s> I set you down for this world.

children.text: pitṝṇāṃ bhāga stha apāṃ śukram āpo devīr varco asmāsu dhatta
