children.translated_text: You are the share of the Fathers, the brightness of the waters; divine waters, place brilliance in us.

children.text: prajāpater vo dhāmnāsmai lokāya sādaye ||
children.translated_text: By the ordinance of <s>Prajāpati</s> I set you down for this world.

children.text: devasya savitur bhāga stha apāṃ śukram āpo devīr varco asmāsu dhatta
children.translated_text: You are the share of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, the brightness of the waters; divine waters, place brilliance in us.

children.text: prajāpater vo dhāmnāsmai lokāya sādaye ||
children.translated_text: By the ordinance of <s>Prajāpati</s> I set you down for this world.

children.text: yo va āpo 'pāṃ bhāgo 'psv antar yajuṣyo devayajanaḥ
children.translated_text: O waters, whatever share of the waters is within the waters, fit for the <s>yajus</s>, a divine place of sacrifice,

children.text: idaṃ tam ati sṛjāmi taṃ mābhyavanikṣi
children.translated_text: I send this forth beyond him; let it not wash over me.

children.text: tena tam abhyatisṛjāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: With it we send that man forth beyond, the one who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: taṃ vadheyaṃ taṃ stṛṣīyānena brahmaṇānena karmaṇānayā menyā ||
children.translated_text: With this <s>brahman</s>, with this rite, with this hostile force, may I slay him, may I crush him.

children.text: yo va āpo 'pām ūrmir apsv antar yajuṣyo devayajanaḥ
children.translated_text: O waters, whatever wave of the waters is within the waters, fit for the <s>yajus</s>, a divine place of sacrifice,

children.text: idaṃ tam ati sṛjāmi taṃ mābhyavanikṣi
children.translated_text: I send this forth beyond him; let it not wash over me.

children.text: tena tam abhyatisṛjāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ

children.text: taṃ vadheyaṃ taṃ stṛṣīyānena brahmaṇānena karmaṇānayā menyā ||

children.text: yo va āpo 'pām vatso 'psv antar yajuṣyo devayajanaḥ
children.translated_text: O waters, whatever calf of the waters is within the waters, fit for the <s>yajus</s>, a divine place of sacrifice,

children.text: idaṃ tam ati sṛjāmi taṃ mābhyavanikṣi

children.text: taṃ vadheyaṃ taṃ stṛṣīyānena brahmaṇānena karmaṇānayā menyā ||

children.text: yo va āpo 'pāṃ vṛṣabho 'psv antar yajuṣyo devayajanaḥ

children.translated_text: I send this forth beyond him; let it not wash over me.

children.text: tena tam abhyatisṛjāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ

children.text: yo va āpo 'pāṃ aśmā pṛśnir divyo 'psv antar yajuṣyo devayajanaḥ
children.translated_text: O waters, whatever speckled heavenly stone of the waters is within the waters, fit for the <s>yajus</s>, a divine place of sacrifice,

children.text: idaṃ tam ati sṛjāmi taṃ mābhyavanikṣi
children.translated_text: I send this forth beyond him; let it not wash over me.

children.text: tena tam abhyatisṛjāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ

children.text: taṃ vadheyaṃ taṃ stṛṣīyānena brahmaṇānena karmaṇānayā menyā ||
children.translated_text: With this <s>brahman</s>, with this rite, with this hostile force, may I slay him, may I crush him.

children.text: yo va āpo 'pāṃ agnayo 'psv antar yajuṣyo devayajanaḥ
children.translated_text: O waters, whatever fires of the waters are within the waters, fit for the <s>yajus</s>, a divine place of sacrifice,

children.text: idaṃ tam ati sṛjāmi taṃ mābhyavanikṣi
children.translated_text: I send this forth beyond him; let it not wash over me.

children.text: tena tam abhyatisṛjāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: With it we send that man forth beyond, the one who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: taṃ vadheyaṃ taṃ stṛṣīyānena brahmaṇānena karmaṇānayā menyā ||
children.translated_text: With this <s>brahman</s>, with this rite, with this hostile force, may I slay him, may I crush him.

children.text: yad arvācīnaṃ traihāyaṇād anṛtaṃ kiṃcodima
children.translated_text: Whatever falsehood we have uttered in these last three years, whatever at all is recent,

children.text: āpo mā tasmāt sarvasmād duritāt pāntv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the waters protect me from all that evil, from distress.

children.text: samudraṃ vaḥ pra hiṇomi svāṃ yonim apītana
children.translated_text: I send you forth to the ocean; go to your own womb.

children.text: ariṣṭāḥ sarvahāyaso mā ca naḥ kiṃcanāmamat ||
children.translated_text: Unharmed, lasting through every year, let nothing whatever of ours suffer harm.

children.text: ariprā āpo apa ripram asmat
children.translated_text: Waters free from impurity, drive impurity away from us.

children.text: prāsmad eno duritaṃ supratīkāḥ pra duṣvapnyam pra malaṃ vahantu ||
children.translated_text: Fair-faced ones, let them carry away from us guilt, evil, bad dreams, and defilement.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahā pṛthivīsaṃśito 'gnitejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by earth, fiery with the splendor of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: pṛthivīm anu vi krame 'haṃ pṛthivyās taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: I stride along the earth; from the earth we cast out that man who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahāntarikṣasaṃśito vāyutejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by the atmosphere, powerful with the splendor of <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: antarikṣam anu vi krame 'haṃ antarikṣāt taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: I stride along the atmosphere; from the atmosphere we cast out that man who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahā dyausaṃśitaḥ sūryatejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by heaven, powerful with the splendor of the sun.

children.text: divam anu vi krame 'haṃ divas taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: I stride along heaven; from heaven we cast out that man who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahā diksaṃśito manastejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by the directions, powerful with the splendor of mind.

children.text: diśo anu vi krame 'haṃ digbhyas taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: I stride along the directions; from the directions we cast out that man who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahāśāsaṃśito vātatejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by the quarters of hope, powerful with the splendor of wind.

children.text: āśā anu vi krame 'haṃ āśābhyas taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: I stride along the quarters of hope; from the quarters of hope we cast out that man who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahā ṛksaṃśito sāmatejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by the <s>ṛc</s>-verses, powerful with the splendor of the <s>sāman</s>-chants.

children.text: ṛco 'nu vi krame 'haṃ ṛgbhyas taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: I stride along the <s>ṛc</s>-verses; from the <s>ṛc</s>-verses we cast out that man who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahā yajñasaṃśito brahmatejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by sacrifice, powerful with the splendor of <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: yajñam anu vi krame 'haṃ yajñāt taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: I stride along sacrifice; from sacrifice we cast out that man who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahauṣadhīsaṃśito somatejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by the herbs, powerful with the splendor of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: oṣadhīr anu vi krame 'haṃ oṣadhībhyas taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: I stride along the herbs; from the herbs we cast out that man who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahāpsusaṃśito varuṇatejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by the waters, powerful with the splendor of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: apo 'nu vi krame 'haṃ adbhyas taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: I stride along the waters; from the waters we cast out that man who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahā kṛṣisaṃśito 'nnatejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by agriculture, powerful with the splendor of food.

children.text: kṛṣim anu vi krame 'haṃ kṛṣyās taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: I stride along agriculture; from agriculture we cast out that man who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si sapatnahā prāṇasaṃśitaḥ puruṣatejāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, slayer of rivals, sharpened by breath, possessing the vigor of a man.

children.text: prāṇam anu vi krame 'haṃ prāṇāt taṃ nir bhajāmo yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: Following breath I stride forth; from breath we drive away him who hates us and whom we hate.

children.text: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: Let him not live; let breath abandon him.

children.text: jitam asmākam udbhinnam asmākam abhyaṣṭhāṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā arātīḥ
children.translated_text: Won is ours; broken open is ours. Let all hostile armies and enmities stand beneath us.

children.text: idam aham āmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasya varcas tejaḥ prāṇam āyur ni veṣṭayāmīdam enam adharāñcaṃ pādayāmi ||
children.translated_text: Here I enclose the luster, vigor, breath, and life-span of the descendant of so-and-so, the son of so-and-so; here I make him fall downward.

children.text: sūryasyāvṛtam anvāvarte dakṣiṇām anv āvṛtam
children.translated_text: I turn after the course of the sun; I turn after the course to the south.

children.text: sā me draviṇaṃ yacchatu sā me brāhmaṇavarcasam ||
children.translated_text: May she grant me wealth; may she grant me <s>brāhmaṇavarcas</s> (brāhmaṇical radiance).

children.text: diśo jyotiṣmatīr abhyāvarte
children.translated_text: I turn toward the luminous directions.

children.text: tā me draviṇaṃ yacchantu tā me brāhmaṇavarcasam ||
children.translated_text: May they grant me wealth; may they grant me <s>brāhmaṇavarcas</s> (brāhmaṇical radiance).

children.text: saptaṛṣīn abhyāvarte
children.translated_text: I turn toward the <s>Saptaṛṣis</s>.

children.text: te me draviṇaṃ yacchantu te me brāhmaṇavarcasam ||
children.translated_text: May they grant me wealth; may they grant me <s>brāhmaṇavarcas</s> (brāhmaṇical radiance).

children.text: brahmābhyāvarte
children.translated_text: I turn toward <s>brahman</s> (sacred power).

children.text: tan me draviṇaṃ yacchatu tan me brāhmaṇavarcasam ||
children.translated_text: May that grant me wealth; may that grant me <s>brāhmaṇavarcas</s> (brāhmaṇical radiance).

children.text: brāhmaṇāṁ abhyāvarte
children.translated_text: I turn toward the brāhmaṇas.

children.text: te me draviṇaṃ yacchantu te me brāhmaṇavarcasam ||
children.translated_text: May they grant me wealth; may they grant me <s>brāhmaṇavarcas</s> (brāhmaṇical radiance).

children.text: yam vayaṃ mṛgayāmahe taṃ vadhai stṛṇavāmahai
children.translated_text: The one whom we hunt, let us strew him down with weapons.

children.text: vyātte parameṣṭhino brahmaṇāpīpadāma tam ||
children.translated_text: In the opened mouth of <s>Parameṣṭhin</s> let us make him fall by <s>brahman</s> (sacred power).

children.text: vaiśvānarasya daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ hetis taṃ sam adhād abhi
children.translated_text: With the two fangs of <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the missile has set itself fully against him.

children.text: iyaṃ taṃ psātv āhutiḥ samid devī sahīyasī ||
children.translated_text: Let this offering devour him, the divine, stronger kindling-stick.

children.text: rājño varuṇasya bandho 'si
children.translated_text: You are the bond of king <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: so 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram anne prāṇe badhāna ||
children.translated_text: Bind that descendant of so-and-so, the son of so-and-so, in food and in breath.

children.text: yat te annaṃ bhuvas pata ākṣiyati pṛthivīm anu
children.translated_text: Whatever food of yours, lord of existence, is wasted upon the earth,

children.text: tasya nas tvaṃ bhuvas pate samprayaccha prajāpate ||
children.translated_text: of that, lord of existence, grant us our share, O <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: apo divyā acāyiṣaṃ rasena sam apṛkṣmahi
children.translated_text: I have sought the heavenly waters; we have mingled with their sap.

children.text: payasvān agna āgamaṃ taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā ||
children.translated_text: Rich in milk, O <s>Agni</s>, I have come; join me with radiance.

children.text: saṃ māgne varcasā sṛja saṃ prajayā sam āyuṣā
children.translated_text: Join me, O <s>Agni</s>, with radiance, with offspring, and with life-span.

children.text: vidyur me asya devā indro vidyāt saha ṛṣibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the gods know this of me; may <s>Indra</s> know it together with the seers.

children.text: yad agne adya mithunā śapato yad vācas tṛṣṭaṃ janayanta rebhāḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever paired curse, O <s>Agni</s>, has been uttered today, whatever harsh speech the shouting ones have produced,

children.text: manyor manasaḥ śaravyā jāyate yā tayā vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān ||
children.translated_text: with that arrow born from anger and from the mind, pierce the sorcerers in the heart.

children.text: parā śṛṇīhi tapasā yātudhānān parāgne rakṣo harasā śṛṇīhi
children.translated_text: Cut off the sorcerers with heat; cut off the demon, O <s>Agni</s>, with your burning force.

children.text: parārciṣā mūradevāṁ chṛṇīhi parāsutṛpaḥ śośucataḥ śṛṇīhi ||
children.translated_text: Cut off the foolish gods with your flame; cut off those who gloat over others' life, blazing against them.

children.text: apām asmai vajraṃ pra harāmi caturbhṛṣṭiṃ śīrṣabhidyāya vidvān
children.translated_text: For him I hurl the four-edged thunderbolt of the waters, knowingly, to split the head.

children.text: so asyāṅgāni pra śṛṇātu sarvā tan me devā anu jānantu viśve ||
children.translated_text: Let it cut apart all his limbs; may all the gods approve that for me.

children.text: Chapter 454
arātīyor bhrātṛvyasya durhārdo dviṣataḥ śiraḥ
children.translated_text: The head of the enemy, the kinsman-rival, the ill-hearted hater,

children.text: api vṛścāmy ojasā ||
children.translated_text: I cut off with might.

children.text: varma mahyam ayaṃ maṇiḥ phālāj jātaḥ kariṣyati
children.translated_text: This amulet, born from the ploughshare, will make armor for me.

children.text: pūrṇo manthena māgamad rasena saha varcasā ||
children.translated_text: May it come to me filled with churning, together with sap and radiance.

children.text: yat tvā śikvaḥ parāvadhīt takṣā hastena vāsyā
children.translated_text: When the splinter, the carpenter, or the axe in the hand cut you down,

children.text: āpas tvā tasmāj jīvalāḥ punantu śucayaḥ śucim ||
children.translated_text: may the life-giving waters, pure ones, purify you from that, pure for the pure.

children.text: hiraṇyasrag ayaṃ maṇiḥ śraddhāṃ yajñaṃ maho dadhat
children.translated_text: This amulet with a golden garland, bearing faith, sacrifice, and greatness,

children.text: gṛhe vasatu no 'tithiḥ ||
children.translated_text: let it dwell in our house as a guest.

children.text: tasmai ghṛtaṃ surāṃ madhv annamannam kṣadāmahe
children.translated_text: For it we provide ghee, liquor, honey, and food after food.

children.text: sa naḥ piteva putrebhyaḥ śreyaḥ śreyaś cikitsatu bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvo devebhyo maṇir etya ||
children.translated_text: Like a father for his sons, may the amulet discern better and better welfare for us, more and more, day after day, as it goes to the gods.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir maṇiṃ phālaṃ ghṛtaścutam ugraṃ khadiram ojase
children.translated_text: The amulet, the ploughshare dripping with ghee, fierce and made of khadira, which <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound on for strength,

children.text: tam agniḥ praty amuñcata so asmai duha ājyaṃ bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> fastened that on; it milks ghee for him more and more, day after day. With that, strike down your haters.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir maṇiṃ phālaṃ ghṛtaścutam ugraṃ khadiram ojase
children.translated_text: The amulet, the ploughshare dripping with ghee, fierce and made of khadira, which <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound on for strength,

children.text: tam indraḥ praty amuñcataujase vīryāya kam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> fastened that on for strength and heroic power.

children.text: so asmai balam id duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: It milks strength for him, more and more, day after day. With that, strike down your haters.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir maṇiṃ phālaṃ ghṛtaścutam ugram khadiram ojase
children.translated_text: The amulet, the ploughshare dripping with ghee, fierce and made of khadira, which <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound on for strength,

children.text: taṃ somaḥ praty amuñcata mahe śrotrāya cakṣase
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> fastened that on for great hearing and sight.

children.text: so asmai varca id duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvam dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: It milks radiance for him, more and more, day after day. With that, strike down your haters.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir maṇiṃ phālaṃ ghṛtaścutam ugraṃ khadiram ojase
children.translated_text: The amulet, the ploughshare dripping with ghee, fierce and made of khadira, which <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound on for strength,

children.text: taṃ sūryaḥ praty amuñcata tenemā ajayad diśaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s> fastened that on; with it he won these directions.

children.text: so asmai bhūtim id duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: It milks prosperity for him, more and more, day after day. With that, strike down your haters.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir maṇiṃ phālaṃ ghṛtaścutam ugram khadiram ojase
children.translated_text: The amulet, the ploughshare dripping with ghee, fierce and made of khadira, which <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound on for strength,

children.text: tam bibhrac candramā maṇim asurāṇāṃ puro 'jayad dānavānāṃ hiraṇyayīḥ
children.translated_text: Bearing that amulet, <s>Candramas</s> won the golden cities of the asuras and dānavas.

children.text: so asmai śriyam id duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: It milks splendor for him, more and more, day after day. With that, strike down your haters.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir vātāya maṇim āśave
children.translated_text: The amulet which <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound on for swift <s>Vāta</s>,

children.text: so asmai vājinam id duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: it milks racing vigor for him, more and more, day after day. With that, strike down your haters.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir vātāya maṇim āśave
children.translated_text: The amulet which <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound on for swift <s>Vāta</s>,

children.text: tenemāṃ maṇinā kṛṣim aśvināv abhi rakṣataḥ
children.translated_text: with this amulet the two <s>Aśvins</s> protect agriculture.

children.text: sa bhiṣagbhyāṃ maho duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: It milks greatness for the two physicians, more and more, day after day. With that, strike down your haters.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir vātāya maṇim āśave
children.translated_text: The amulet which <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound on for swift <s>Vāta</s>,

children.text: tam bibhrat savitā maṇiṃ tenedam ajayat svaḥ
children.translated_text: bearing that amulet, <s>Savitṛ</s> won this heavenly world with it.

children.text: so asmai sūnṛtāṃ duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: It milks fair speech for him, more and more, day after day. With that, strike down your haters.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir vātāya maṇim āśave
children.translated_text: The amulet which <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound on for swift <s>Vāta</s>.

children.text: tam āpo bibhratīr maṇiṃ sadā dhāvanty akṣitāḥ
children.translated_text: The waters, bearing that <s>maṇi</s> (amulet), ever flow, unfailing.

children.text: sa ābhyo 'mṛtam id duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: From them it milks out immortality, again and again, tomorrow after tomorrow; with it, strike down those who hate you.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir vātāya maṇim āśave
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s> that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound upon swift <s>Vāta</s>,

children.text: tam rājā varuṇo maṇiṃ praty amuñcata śaṃbhuvam
children.translated_text: that <s>maṇi</s> King <s>Varuṇa</s> fastened on, bringing welfare.

children.text: so asmai satyam id duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: For him it milks out truth, again and again, tomorrow after tomorrow; with it, strike down those who hate you.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir vātāya maṇim āśave
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s> that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound upon swift <s>Vāta</s>,

children.text: taṃ devā bibhrato maṇiṃ sarvāṃllokān yudhājayan
children.translated_text: bearing that <s>maṇi</s>, the gods won all the worlds in battle.

children.text: sa ebhyo jitim id duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: For them it milks out victory, again and again, tomorrow after tomorrow; with it, strike down those who hate you.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir vātāya maṇim āśave
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s> that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound upon swift <s>Vāta</s>,

children.text: tam imaṃ devatā maṇiṃ praty amuñcanta śambhuvam
children.translated_text: this very <s>maṇi</s> the deities fastened on, bringing welfare.

children.text: sa ābhyo viśvam id duhe bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvaḥ śvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: From them it milks out the whole world, again and again, tomorrow after tomorrow; with it, strike down those who hate you.

children.text: ṛtavas tam abadhnatārtavās tam abadhnata
children.translated_text: The seasons bound it; the seasonal divisions bound it.

children.text: saṃvatsaras taṃ baddhvā sarvaṃ bhūtaṃ vi rakṣati ||
children.translated_text: Having bound it, the year protects every being.

children.text: antardeśā abadhnata pradiśas tam abadhnata
children.translated_text: The intermediate regions bound it; the directions bound it.

children.text: prajāpatisṛṣṭo maṇir dviṣato me 'dharāṁ akaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s>, created by <s>Prajāpati</s>, has made those who hate me lower.

children.text: atharvāṇo abadhnatātharvaṇā abadhnata
children.translated_text: The <s>Atharvans</s> bound it; the <s>Atharvaṇas</s> bound it.

children.text: tair medino aṅgiraso dasyūnāṃ bibhiduḥ puras tena tvam dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: With them the fat <s>Aṅgirases</s> split the strongholds of the <s>Dasyus</s>; with it, strike down those who hate you.

children.text: taṃ dhātā praty amuñcata sa bhūtaṃ vy akalpayat
children.translated_text: <s>Dhātṛ</s> fastened it on; it arranged created being.

children.text: tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
children.translated_text: With it, strike down those who hate you.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir devebhyo asurakṣitim
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s> that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound for the gods as protection against the <s>Asuras</s>,

children.text: sa māyaṃ maṇir āgamad rasena saha varcasā ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>maṇi</s> come to me, together with sap and brilliance.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir devebhyo asurakṣitim
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s> that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound for the gods as protection against the <s>Asuras</s>,

children.text: sa māyaṃ maṇir āgamat saha gobhir ajāvibhir annena prajayā saha ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>maṇi</s> come to me, together with cattle, goats and sheep, with food and offspring.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir devebhyo asurakṣitim
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s> that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound for the gods as protection against the <s>Asuras</s>,

children.text: sa māyaṃ maṇir āgamat saha vrīhiyavābhyāṃ mahasā bhūtyā saha ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>maṇi</s> come to me, together with rice and barley, with greatness and prosperity.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir devebhyo asurakṣitim
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s> that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound for the gods as protection against the <s>Asuras</s>,

children.text: sa māyaṃ maṇir āgaman madhor ghṛtasya dhārayā kīlālena maṇiḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>maṇi</s> come to me with a stream of honey and ghee, together with nourishing drink.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir devebhyo asurakṣitim
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s> that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound for the gods as protection against the <s>Asuras</s>,

children.text: sa māyaṃ maṇir āgamad ūrjayā payasā saha draviṇena śriyā saha ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>maṇi</s> come to me, together with vigor and milk, with wealth and splendor.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir devebhyo asurakṣitim
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s> that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound for the gods as protection against the <s>Asuras</s>,

children.text: sa māyaṃ maṇir āgamat tejasā tviṣyā saha yaśasā kīrtyā saha ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>maṇi</s> come to me, together with fiery energy and radiance, with fame and renown.

children.text: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir devebhyo asurakṣitim
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇi</s> that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bound for the gods as protection against the <s>Asuras</s>,

children.text: sa māyaṃ maṇir āgamat sarvābhir bhūtibhiḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>maṇi</s> come to me with all prosperities.

children.text: tam imaṃ devatā maṇiṃ mahyaṃ dadatu puṣṭaye
children.translated_text: May the deities give me this <s>maṇi</s> for nourishment,

children.text: abhibhuṃ kṣatravardhanaṃ sapatnadambhanaṃ maṇim ||
children.translated_text: the overpowering <s>maṇi</s> that increases <s>kṣatra</s> (sovereign power) and crushes rivals.

children.text: brahmaṇā tejasā saha prati muñcāmi me śivam
children.translated_text: With <s>brahman</s> (sacred power), together with brilliance, I fasten what is auspicious on myself.

children.text: asapatnaḥ sapatnahā sapatnān me 'dharāṁ akaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Rival-free and a slayer of rivals, it has made my rivals lower.

children.text: uttaraṃ dviṣato mām ayaṃ maṇiḥ kṛṇotu devajāḥ
children.translated_text: May this god-born <s>maṇi</s> make me higher than those who hate me.

children.text: yasya lokā ime trayaḥ payo dugdham upāsate
children.translated_text: The one whom these three worlds serve, as milk that has been milked,

children.text: sa māyam adhi rohatu maṇiḥ śraiṣṭhyāya mūrdhataḥ ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>maṇi</s> mount upon me, over my head, for supremacy.

children.text: yaṃ devāḥ pitaro manuṣyā upajīvanti sarvadā
children.translated_text: The one on whom gods, fathers, and men live at all times,

children.text: sa māyam adhi rohatu maṇiḥ śraiṣṭhyāya mūrdhataḥ ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>maṇi</s> mount upon me, over my head, for supremacy.

children.text: yathā bījam urvarāyāṃ kṛṣṭe phālena rohati
children.translated_text: As seed grows in a field that has been ploughed with the ploughshare,

children.text: evā mayi prajā paśavo 'nnamannaṃ vi rohatu ||
children.translated_text: so may offspring, cattle, and food upon food grow forth in me.

children.text: yasmai tvā yajñavardhana maṇe pratyamucaṃ śivam
children.translated_text: O <s>maṇi</s>, increaser of sacrifice, for whom I have fastened you on as auspicious,

children.text: taṃ tvaṃ śatadakṣiṇa maṇe śraiṣṭhyāya jinvatāt ||
children.translated_text: you, O <s>maṇi</s> of a hundred gifts, invigorate him for supremacy.

children.text: etam idhmaṃ samāhitaṃ juṣāṇo agne prati harya homaiḥ
children.translated_text: Enjoying this kindling-stick laid together, O <s>Agni</s>, welcome the oblations.

children.text: tasmin videma sumatiṃ svasti prajām cakṣuḥ paśūnt samiddhe jātavedasi brahmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: In that well-kindled <s>Jātavedas</s>, may we find favor, welfare, offspring, sight, and cattle through <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: Chapter 455
kasminnaṅge tapo asyādhi tiṣṭhati kasminn aṅga ṛtam asyādhy āhitam
children.translated_text: In what limb of this does austerity stand? In what limb of it is ṛta (cosmic order) set?

children.text: kva vrataṃ kva śraddhāsya tiṣṭhati kasminn aṅge satyam asya pratiṣṭhitam ||
children.translated_text: Where does its vow stand, where its faith? In what limb of it is truth established?

children.text: kasmād aṅgād dīpyate agnir asya kasmād aṅgāt pavate mātariśvā
children.translated_text: From what limb of it does <s>Agni</s> blaze? From what limb does <s>Mātariśvan</s> blow?

children.text: kasmād aṅgād vi mimīte 'dhi candramā maha skambhasya mimāno aṅgam ||
children.translated_text: From what limb does the moon measure out, measuring the limb of the great <s>Skambha</s>?

children.text: kasminn aṅge tiṣṭhati bhūmir asya kasminn aṅge tiṣṭhaty antarikṣam
children.translated_text: In what limb of it does the earth stand? In what limb does the midspace stand?

children.text: kasminn aṅge tiṣṭhaty āhitā dyauḥ kasminn aṅge tiṣṭhaty uttaraṃ divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In what limb is heaven set? In what limb does what is beyond heaven stand?

children.text: kva prepsan dīpyata ūrdhvo agniḥ kva prepsan pavate mātariśvā
children.translated_text: Toward what does <s>Agni</s>, seeking to reach it, blaze upward? Toward what does <s>Mātariśvan</s>, seeking to reach it, blow?

children.text: yatra prepsantīr abhiyanty āvṛtaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: Where the encircling ones, seeking to reach it, advance: tell me of that <s>Skambha</s>, which indeed is he?

children.text: kvārdhamāsāḥ kva yanti māsāḥ saṃvatsareṇa saha saṃvidānāḥ
children.translated_text: Where do the half-months go, where the months, agreeing with the year?

children.text: yatra yanty ṛtavo yatrārtavāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: Where the seasons go, where the seasonal divisions go: tell me of that <s>Skambha</s>, which indeed is he?

children.text: kva prepsantī yuvatī virūpe ahorātre dravataḥ saṃvidāne
children.translated_text: Toward what do the two young women of different form, day and night, run, seeking to reach it and agreeing together?

children.text: yatra prepsantīr abhiyanty āpaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: Where the waters, seeking to reach it, advance: tell me of that <s>Skambha</s>, which indeed is he?

children.text: yasmint stabdhvā prajāpatir lokānt sarvāṁ adhārayat
children.translated_text: In whom <s>Prajāpati</s>, propping them up, upheld all the worlds:

children.text: skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: tell me of that <s>Skambha</s>, which indeed is he?

children.text: yat paramam avamam yac ca madhyamaṃ prajāpatiḥ sasṛje viśvarūpam
children.translated_text: That highest, lowest, and middle thing which <s>Prajāpati</s> created in all forms,

children.text: kiyatā skambhaḥ pra viveśa tatra yan na prāviśat kiyat tad babhūva ||
children.translated_text: how much of it did <s>Skambha</s> enter? How much became that which he did not enter?

children.text: kiyatā skambhaḥ pra viveśa bhūtam kiyad bhaviṣyad anvāśaye 'sya
children.translated_text: By how much did <s>Skambha</s> enter what has come into being? By how much does what is to be rest deposited within him?

children.text: ekaṃ yad aṅgam akṛṇot sahasradhā kiyatā skambhaḥ pra viveśa tatra ||
children.translated_text: When he made one limb thousandfold, by how much did <s>Skambha</s> enter there?

children.text: yatra lokāṃś ca kośāṃś cāpo brahma janā viduḥ
children.translated_text: Where people know the worlds, the treasure-houses, the waters, and <s>brahman</s>,

children.text: asac ca yatra sac cānta skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: and where both non-being and being are within: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: yatra tapaḥ parākramya vrataṃ dhārayaty uttaram
children.translated_text: Where austerity, exerting itself, upholds the higher vow,

children.text: ṛtaṃ ca yatra śraddhā cāpo brahma samāhitāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: and where <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), faith, the waters, and <s>brahman</s> are gathered: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: yasmin bhūmir antarikṣaṃ dyaur yasminn adhy āhitā
children.translated_text: In whom earth, midspace, and heaven have been set,

children.text: yatrāgniś candramāḥ sūryo vātas tiṣṭhanty ārpitāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: where <s>Agni</s>, the moon, the sun, and wind stand fixed: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: yasya trayastriṃśad devā aṅge sarve samāhitāḥ
children.translated_text: In whose limb all the thirty-three gods are gathered:

children.text: skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: yatra ṛṣayaḥ prathamajā ṛcaḥ sāma yajur mahī
children.translated_text: Where the first-born seers, the verses, the chants, the sacrificial formula, and the great earth are,

children.text: ekarṣir yasminn ārpitaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: in whom the one seer is fixed: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: yatrāmṛtaṃ ca mṛtyuś ca puruṣe 'dhi samāhite
children.translated_text: Where immortality and death are gathered within the person,

children.text: samudro yasya nāḍyaḥ puruṣe 'dhi samāhitāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: where the ocean, his channels, are gathered within the person: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: yasya catasraḥ pradiśo nāḍyas tiṣṭhanti prathamāḥ
children.translated_text: Whose four quarters stand as the first channels,

children.text: yajño yatra parākrāntaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: where sacrifice has advanced forth: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: ye puruṣe brahma vidus te viduḥ parameṣṭhinam
children.translated_text: Those who know <s>brahman</s> in the person know the one who stands in the highest place.

children.text: yo veda parameṣṭhinaṃ yaś ca veda prajāpatim
children.translated_text: Who knows the one who stands in the highest place, and who knows <s>Prajāpati</s>,

children.text: jyeṣṭhaṃ ye brāhmaṇaṃ vidus te skambham anusaṃviduḥ ||
children.translated_text: those who know the eldest <s>brāhmaṇa</s> understand <s>Skambha</s> along with him.

children.text: yasya śiro vaiśvānaraś cakṣur aṅgiraso 'bhavan
children.translated_text: Whose head was <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, whose eye the <s>Aṅgirases</s> became,

children.text: aṅgāni yasya yātavaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose limbs were the sorcerous powers: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: yasya brahma mukham āhur jihvāṃ madhukaśām uta
children.translated_text: Whose mouth they call <s>brahman</s>, and whose tongue they call the honey-lash,

children.text: virājam ūdho yasyāhuḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose udder they call <s>Virāj</s>: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: yasmād ṛco apātakṣan yajur yasmād apākaṣan
children.translated_text: From whom they fashioned the verses, from whom they drew out the sacrificial formula,

children.text: sāmāni yasya lomāny atharvāṅgiraso mukhaṃ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose hairs are the chants and whose mouth is the <s>Atharvāṅgiras</s>: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: asacchākhāṃ pratiṣṭhantīṃ paramam iva janā viduḥ
children.translated_text: People know the branch of non-being, standing firm, as if it were the highest.

children.text: uto san manyante 'vare ye te śākhām upāsate ||
children.translated_text: And those lower ones who attend upon that branch think that it is being.

children.text: yatrādityāś ca rudrāś ca vasavaś ca samāhitāḥ
children.translated_text: Where the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, and <s>Vasus</s> are gathered,

children.text: bhūtaṃ ca yatra bhavyaṃ ca sarve lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: and where what has been and what is to be, all the worlds, are established: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: yasya trayastriṃśad devā nidhiṃ rakṣanti sarvadā
children.translated_text: Whose treasure the thirty-three gods always guard,

children.text: nidhiṃ tam adya ko veda yaṃ devā abhirakṣatha ||
children.translated_text: who today knows that treasure which you gods guard on every side?

children.text: yatra devā brahmavido brahma jyeṣṭham upāsate
children.translated_text: Where the gods who know <s>brahman</s> attend upon <s>brahman</s> as eldest,

children.text: yo vai tān vidyāt pratyakṣaṃ sa brahmā veditā syāt ||
children.translated_text: whoever should know them directly would be a knower of <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: bṛhanto nāma te devā ye 'sataḥ pari jajñire
children.translated_text: Those gods are called great who were born forth from non-being.

children.text: ekaṃ tad aṅgaṃ skambhasyāsad āhuḥ paro janāḥ ||
children.translated_text: That one limb of <s>Skambha</s>, people beyond call non-being.

children.text: yatra skambhaḥ prajanayan purāṇaṃ vyavartayat
children.translated_text: Where <s>Skambha</s>, generating, set the ancient one in motion,

children.text: ekaṃ tad aṅgaṃ skambhasya purāṇam anusaṃviduḥ ||
children.translated_text: they understand that one limb of <s>Skambha</s> as the ancient one.

children.text: yasya trayastriṃśad devā aṅge gātrā vibhejire
children.translated_text: In whose limb the thirty-three gods divided their bodies,

children.text: tān vai trayastriṃśad devān eke brahmavido viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: those thirty-three gods some knowers of <s>brahman</s> truly know.

children.text: hiraṇyagarbham paramam anatyudyaṃ janā viduḥ
children.translated_text: People know <s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s> as supreme, not to be passed beyond.

children.text: skambhas tad agre prāsiñcaddhiraṇyaṃ loke antarā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Skambha</s> poured out that gold at the beginning, in the middle realm.

children.text: skambhe lokāḥ skambhe tapaḥ skambhe 'dhy ṛtam āhitam
children.translated_text: In <s>Skambha</s> are the worlds; in <s>Skambha</s> is austerity; in <s>Skambha</s> <s>ṛta</s> is set.

children.text: skambha tvā veda pratyakṣam indre sarvaṃ samāhitam ||
children.translated_text: I know you, <s>Skambha</s>, directly: in <s>Indra</s> everything is gathered.

children.text: indre lokā indre tapa indre 'dhy ṛtam āhitam
children.translated_text: In <s>Indra</s> are the worlds; in <s>Indra</s> is austerity; in <s>Indra</s> <s>ṛta</s> is set.

children.text: indraṃ tvā veda pratyakṣaṃ skambhe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
children.translated_text: I know you directly as <s>Indra</s>: in <s>Skambha</s> everything is established.

children.text: nāma nāmnā johavīti purā sūryāt puroṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: He calls name by name, before the sun, before the dawn.

children.text: yad ajaḥ prathamaṃ saṃbabhūva sa ha tat svarājyam iyāya yasmān nānyat param asti bhūtam ||
children.translated_text: When the unborn one first came into being, he attained that self-rule, from which there is no other being higher.

children.text: yasya bhūmiḥ pramāntarikṣam utodaram
children.translated_text: Whose earth is the measuring ground, and whose belly is the midspace,

children.text: divaṃ yaś cakre mūrdhānaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who made heaven his head: homage to that eldest <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: yasya sūryaś cakṣuś candramāś ca punarṇavaḥ
children.translated_text: Whose eye is the sun, and whose ever-renewed one is the moon,

children.text: agniṃ yaś cakra āsyaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who made <s>Agni</s> his mouth: homage to that eldest <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: yasya vātaḥ prāṇāpānau cakṣur aṅgiraso 'bhavan
children.translated_text: Whose breath and out-breath are wind, and whose eye the <s>Aṅgirases</s> became,

children.text: diśo yaś cakre prajñānīs tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who made the directions his faculties of understanding: homage to that eldest <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: skambho dādhāra dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe ime skambho dādhārorv antarikṣam
children.translated_text: <s>Skambha</s> has upheld both these, heaven and earth; <s>Skambha</s> has upheld the wide midspace.

children.text: skambho dādhāra pradiśaḥ ṣaḍ urvīḥ skambha idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanam ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: <s>Skambha</s> has upheld the six broad quarters; <s>Skambha</s> has entered this whole world of beings.

children.text: yaḥ śramāt tapaso jāto lokānt sarvānt samānaśe
children.translated_text: He who was born from toil and austerity has pervaded all the worlds alike,

children.text: somaṃ yaś cakre kevalaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who made <s>Soma</s> alone: homage to that eldest <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: kathaṃ vāto nelayati kathaṃ na ramate manaḥ
children.translated_text: How does the wind not stir? How does the mind not take rest?

children.text: kim āpaḥ satyaṃ prepsantīr nelayanti kadācana ||
children.translated_text: Why do the waters, seeking truth, never cease moving?

children.text: mahad yakṣaṃ bhuvanasya madhye tapasi krāntaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe
children.translated_text: A great wondrous being in the middle of the world, advancing in austerity on the back of the waters:

children.text: tasmiṃ chrayante ya u ke ca devā vṛkṣasya skandhaḥ parita iva śākhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: on him rest whatever gods there are, like branches all around the trunk of a tree.

children.text: yasmai hastābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ vācā śrotreṇa cakṣuṣā
children.translated_text: To whom, with hands, with feet, with speech, with hearing, and with sight,

children.text: yasmai devāḥ sadā baliṃ prayacchanti vimite 'mitaṃ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: to whom the gods always present tribute, the measurable to the immeasurable: tell me that <s>Skambha</s>; which one indeed is he?

children.text: apa tasya hataṃ tamo vyāvṛttaḥ sa pāpmanā
children.translated_text: His darkness has been struck away; he has turned back from evil.

children.text: sarvāṇi tasmin jyotīṃṣi yāni trīṇi prajāpatau ||
children.translated_text: All the lights are in him, the three that are in <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: yo vetasaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ salile veda
children.translated_text: Whoever knows the golden reed standing in the waters

children.text: sa vai guhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: he indeed is the hidden <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: tantram eke yuvatī virūpe abhyākrāmaṃ vayataḥ ṣaṇmayūkham
children.translated_text: Two young women, of different forms, have approached the loom; they weave a web with six rays.

children.text: prānyā tantūṃs tirate dhatte anyā nāpa vṛñjāte na gamāto antam ||
children.translated_text: One stretches out the threads; the other sets them in place. They do not cut them off, nor do they reach the end.

children.text: tayor ahaṃ parinṛtyantyor iva na vi jānāmi yatarā parastāt
children.translated_text: As the two move around as if dancing, I do not know which of them is beyond.

children.text: pumān enad vayaty ud gṛṇatti pumān enad vi jabhārādhi nāke ||
children.translated_text: A male weaves this and proclaims it; a male has spread this out above in the vault of heaven.

children.text: ime mayūkhā upa tastabhur divaṃ sāmāni cakrus tasarāṇi vātave ||
children.translated_text: These rays have propped up heaven; the <s>Sāman</s>-chants have made shuttles for weaving.

children.text: Chapter 456
yo bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca sarvaṃ yaś cādhitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: Whoever presides over all that has been and will be, and over everything,

children.text: svaryasya ca kevalaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and who alone belongs to the heavenly realm: homage to that eldest <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: skambheneme viṣṭabhite dyauś ca bhūmiś ca tiṣṭhataḥ
children.translated_text: By <s>Skambha</s> these two, heaven and earth, stand held apart.

children.text: skambha idaṃ sarvam ātmanvad yat prāṇan nimiṣac ca yat ||
children.translated_text: In <s>Skambha</s> all this possesses selfhood: whatever breathes and whatever blinks.

children.text: tisro ha prajā atyāyam āyan ny anyā arkam abhito 'viśanta
children.translated_text: Three peoples passed beyond; others entered around the chant.

children.text: bṛhan ha tasthau rajaso vimāno harito hariṇīr ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: The great one stood as measurer of the midspace; the tawny one entered the tawny mares.

children.text: dvādaśa pradhayaś cakram ekaṃ trīṇi nabhyāni ka u tac ciketa
children.translated_text: Twelve are the fellies, one is the wheel, and three are the hubs: who has understood this?

children.text: tatrāhatās trīṇi śatāni śaṅkavaḥ ṣaṣṭiś ca khīlā avicācalā ye ||
children.translated_text: In it are fixed three hundred pegs and sixty pins, which do not shake loose.

children.text: idaṃ savitar vi jānīhi ṣaḍ yamā eka ekajaḥ
children.translated_text: Know this, O <s>Savitar</s>: six are the pairs, and one is single-born.

children.text: tasmin hāpitvam icchante ya eṣām eka ekajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In him they seek kinship, those of whom each is single-born.

children.text: āviḥ san nihitaṃ guhā jaran nāma mahat padam
children.translated_text: Manifest, yet hidden in the cave, growing old, is the great place by name.

children.text: tatredaṃ sarvam ārpitam ejat prāṇat pratiṣṭhitam ||
children.translated_text: There all this is set: what moves, what breathes, and what is established.

children.text: ekacakraṃ vartata ekanemi sahasrākṣaraṃ pra puro ni paścā
children.translated_text: The one-wheeled, one-rimmed, thousand-marked thing rolls forward before and backward behind.

children.text: ardhena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna yad asyārdhaṃ kva tad babhūva ||
children.translated_text: With one half it generated the whole world; where did its other half come to be?

children.text: pañcavāhī vahatyagram eṣāṃ praṣṭayo yuktā anusaṃvahanti
children.translated_text: Five-drawn, it carries the foremost of these; the yoked teams carry along after it.

children.text: ayātam asya dadṛśe na yātaṃ paraṃ nedīyo 'varaṃ davīyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Its arrival is seen, not its going; the farther is nearer, the lower more distant.

children.text: tiryagbilaś camasa ūrdhvabudhnas tasmin yaśo nihitaṃ viśvarūpam
children.translated_text: The bowl has its opening sideways and its bottom upward; in it is placed glory of every form.

children.text: tad āsata ṛṣayaḥ sapta sākaṃ ye asya gopā mahato babhūvuḥ ||
children.translated_text: There the seven seers sit together, who became guardians of this great one.

children.text: yā purastād yujyate yā ca paścād yā viśvato yujyate yā ca sarvataḥ
children.translated_text: She who is yoked in front, who is yoked behind, who is yoked on every side, who is yoked everywhere,

children.text: yayā yajñaḥ prāṅ tāyate tāṃ tvā pṛcchāmi katamā sā ṛcām ||
children.translated_text: by whom the sacrifice is stretched forward: I ask you, which one is she among the verses?

children.text: yad ejati patati yac ca tiṣṭhati prāṇad aprāṇan nimiṣac ca yad bhuvat
children.translated_text: Whatever stirs, whatever flies, and whatever stands, whatever has become, breathing or not breathing, blinking or not blinking,

children.text: tad dādhāra pṛthivīṃ viśvarūpaṃ tat sambhūya bhavaty ekam eva ||
children.translated_text: that, of every form, has upheld the earth; having come together, it becomes one alone.

children.text: anantaṃ vitataṃ purutrānantam antavac cā samante
children.translated_text: Endless, stretched out in many places, endless and yet bounded on every side:

children.text: te nākapālaś carati vicinvan vidvān bhūtam uta bhavyam asya ||
children.translated_text: through that the guardian of heaven moves, searching, knowing this one's past and future.

children.text: prajāpatiś carati garbhe antar adṛśyamāno bahudhā vi jāyate
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> moves within the womb, unseen, and is born forth in many ways.

children.text: ardhena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna yad asyārdhaṃ katamaḥ sa ketuḥ ||
children.translated_text: With one half he generated the whole world; what sign is that other half of his?

children.text: ūrdhvaṃ bharantam udakaṃ kumbhenevodahāryam
children.translated_text: All see with the eye the one who bears water upward, as if water to be drawn up with a jar;

children.text: paśyanti sarve cakṣuṣā na sarve manasā viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: not all know him with the mind.

children.text: dūre pūrṇena vasati dūra ūnena hīyate
children.translated_text: He dwells far away with fullness; far away he is diminished with deficiency.

children.text: mahad yakṣaṃ bhuvanasya madhye tasmai baliṃ rāṣṭrabhṛto bharanti ||
children.translated_text: The great wonder is in the middle of the world; to it the bearers of the realm bring tribute.

children.text: yataḥ sūryaḥ udety astaṃ yatra ca gacchati
children.translated_text: Whence the sun rises and where it goes to set,

children.text: tad eva manye 'haṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ tad u nāty eti kiṃcana ||
children.translated_text: that very one I think is eldest; nothing at all passes beyond it.

children.text: ye arvāṅ madhya uta vā purāṇaṃ vedaṃ vidvāṃsam abhito vadanti
children.translated_text: Those who speak here, around the knowing <s>Veda</s>, whether recent, middle, or ancient,

children.text: ādityam eva te pari vadanti sarve agniṃ dvitīyaṃ trivṛtaṃ ca haṃsam ||
children.translated_text: all of them speak of the <s>Āditya</s> alone, of <s>Agni</s> as second, and of the threefold swan.

children.text: sahasrāhṇyaṃ viyatāv asya pakṣau harer haṃsasya patataḥ svargam
children.translated_text: The two wings of this tawny swan, flying to heaven, extend through a thousand days.

children.text: sa devānt sarvān urasy upadadya saṃpaśyan yāti bhuvanāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: Having placed all the gods upon his breast, he goes, beholding all the worlds.

children.text: satyenordhvas tapati brahmaṇārvāṅ vi paśyati
children.translated_text: By truth he burns upward; by <s>brahman</s> he looks downward.

children.text: prāṇena tiryaṅ prāṇati yasmin jyeṣṭham adhi śritam ||
children.translated_text: By breath he breathes across, he in whom the eldest is established.

children.text: yo vai te vidyād araṇī yābhyāṃ nirmathyate vasu
children.translated_text: Whoever should know your two fire-sticks, by which the treasure is churned forth,

children.text: sa vidvān jyeṣṭhaṃ manyeta sa vidyād brāhmaṇaṃ mahat ||
children.translated_text: he, knowing, would consider the eldest; he would know the great <s>brāhmaṇa</s>.

children.text: apād agre sam abhavat so agre svar ābharat
children.translated_text: At first he came into being without feet; at first he brought the heavenly light.

children.text: catuṣpād bhūtvā bhogyaḥ sarvam ādatta bhojanam ||
children.translated_text: Having become four-footed and fit to enjoy, he took all food for eating.

children.text: bhogyo bhavad atho annam adad bahu
children.translated_text: He became the enjoyer, and then he ate much food,

children.text: yo devam uttarāvantam upāsātai sanātanam ||
children.translated_text: whoever should worship the eternal god who possesses the higher realm.

children.text: sanātanam enam āhur utādya syāt punarṇavaḥ
children.translated_text: They call this one eternal, and yet today he may be new again.

children.text: ahorātre pra jāyete anyonyasya rūpayoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Day and night are born forth from one another's forms.

children.text: śataṃ sahasram ayutaṃ nyarbudam asaṃkhyeyaṃ svam asmin niviṣṭam
children.translated_text: A hundred, a thousand, ten thousand, a hundred million, the uncountable, his own, are lodged in him.

children.text: tad asya ghnanty abhipaśyata eva tasmād devo rocat eṣa etat ||
children.translated_text: They strike that of his while he himself looks on; therefore this god shines in this way.

children.text: bālād ekam aṇīyaskam utaikaṃ neva dṛśyate
children.translated_text: One thing is smaller than a hair, and one is not even seen.

children.text: tataḥ pariṣvajīyasī devatā sā mama priyā ||
children.translated_text: Greater than an embrace from that is that deity, dear to me.

children.text: iyaṃ kalyāṇy ajarā martyasyāmṛtā gṛhe
children.translated_text: This auspicious one, ageless and immortal, is in the house of the mortal.

children.text: yasmai kṛtā śaye sa yaś cakāra jajāra saḥ ||
children.translated_text: He for whom she was made lies upon her; he who made her has grown old.

children.text: tvaṃ strī tvaṃ pumān asi tvaṃ kumāra uta vā kumārī
children.translated_text: You are woman; you are man; you are a boy and also a girl.

children.text: tvaṃ jīrṇo daṇḍena vañcasi tvaṃ jāto bhavasi viśvatomukhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are the old man who totters with a staff; once born, you become facing every direction.

children.text: utaiṣāṃ pitota vā putra eṣām utaiṣāṃ jyeṣṭha uta vā kaniṣṭhaḥ
children.translated_text: You are their father, and you are their son; you are their eldest and also their youngest.

children.text: eko ha devo manasi praviṣṭaḥ prathamo jātaḥ sa u garbhe antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The one god, first-born, has entered the mind; he too is within the womb.

children.text: pūrṇāt pūrṇam ud acati pūrṇaṃ pūrṇena sicyate
children.translated_text: From fullness fullness rises up; fullness is sprinkled with fullness.

children.text: uto tad adya vidyāma yatas tat pariṣicyate ||
children.translated_text: And today we know that from which it is sprinkled all around.

children.text: eṣā sanatnī sanam eva jātaiṣā purāṇī pari sarvaṃ babhūva
children.translated_text: She is primeval, born from what is old; she is ancient and has encompassed everything.

children.text: mahī devy uṣaso vibhātī saikenaikena miṣatā vi caṣṭe ||
children.translated_text: The great goddess <s>Uṣas</s>, shining forth, looks out with each and every blink.

children.text: avir vai nāma devatartenāste parīvṛtā
children.translated_text: The deity is named <s>Avir</s>; she sits enclosed by <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: tasyā rūpeṇeme vṛkṣā haritā haritasrajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By her form these trees are green, wearing green garlands.

children.text: anti santaṃ na jahāty anti santaṃ na paśyati
children.translated_text: She does not abandon one who is near; she does not see one who is near.

children.text: devasya paśya kāvyaṃ na mamāra na jīryati ||
children.translated_text: Behold the god's poetic work: it has not died and does not grow old.

children.text: apūrveṇeṣitā vācas tā vadanti yathāyatham
children.translated_text: Set in motion by the unprecedented one, those voices speak each in its proper way.

children.text: vadantīr yatra gacchanti tad āhur brāhmaṇaṃ mahat ||
children.translated_text: Where the speaking voices go, that they call the great <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: yatra devāś ca manuṣyāś cārā nābhāv iva śritāḥ
children.translated_text: Where gods and human beings are set like spokes in a nave,

children.text: apāṃ tvā puṣpaṃ pṛcchāmi yatra tan māyayā hitam ||
children.translated_text: I ask you about the flower of the waters, where that is placed by <s>māyā</s> (hidden power).

children.text: yebhir vāta iṣitaḥ pravāti ye dadante pañca diśaḥ sadhrīcīḥ
children.translated_text: By whom the wind, impelled, blows, and who hold the five directions together in one course,

children.text: ya āhutim atyamanyanta devā apāṃ netāraḥ katame ta āsan ||
children.translated_text: which gods esteemed the oblation beyond measure? Who were those leaders of the waters?

children.text: imām eṣāṃ pṛthivīṃ vasta eko 'ntarikṣaṃ pary eko babhūva
children.translated_text: One of them clothed this earth; one encompassed the atmosphere.

children.text: divam eṣāṃ dadate yo vidhartā viśvā āśāḥ prati rakṣanty eke ||
children.translated_text: The one who is their supporter bestowed heaven on them; others guard all the regions.

children.text: yo vidyāt sūtraṃ vitataṃ yasminn otāḥ prajā imāḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever knows the stretched thread in which these creatures are woven,

children.text: sūtraṃ sūtrasya yo vidyāt sa vidyād brāhmaṇaṃ mahat ||
children.translated_text: whoever knows the thread of the thread, he would know the great <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: vedāhaṃ sūtraṃ vitataṃ yasminn otāḥ prajā imāḥ
children.translated_text: I know the stretched thread in which these creatures are woven.

children.text: sūtraṃ sūtrasyāhaṃ vedātho yad brāhmaṇaṃ mahat ||
children.translated_text: I know the thread of the thread, and also what the great <s>brahman</s> is.

children.text: yad antarā dyāvāpṛthivī agnir ait pradahan viśvadāvyaḥ
children.translated_text: When <s>Agni</s>, devouring all, went between heaven and earth, burning,

children.text: yatrātiṣṭhann ekapatnīḥ parastāt kvevāsīn mātariśvā tadānīm ||
children.translated_text: where did the single-spoused ones stand beyond? Where then was <s>Mātariśvan</s>?

children.text: apsv āsīn mātariśvā praviṣṭaḥ praviṣṭā devāḥ salilāny āsan
children.translated_text: <s>Mātariśvan</s> was in the waters, entered within; the gods had entered the waters.

children.text: bṛhan ha tasthau rajaso vimānaḥ pavamāno harita ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: The great one stood as measurer of the space; the purifying green one entered in.

children.text: uttareṇeva gāyatrīm amṛte 'dhi vi cakrame
children.translated_text: As if beyond the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, he strode forth upon immortality.

children.text: sāmnā ye sāma saṃvidur ajas tad dadṛśe kva ||
children.translated_text: Those who know the <s>sāman</s> by the <s>sāman</s>: where was the unborn one seen?

children.text: niveśanaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ deva iva savitā satyadharmā
children.translated_text: A dwelling-place, a meeting-place of goods, like the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, true to his law,

children.text: indro na tasthau samare dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: he stood like <s>Indra</s> in the contest for riches.

children.text: puṇḍarīkaṃ navadvāraṃ tribhir guṇebhir āvṛtam
children.translated_text: The lotus with nine gates, covered by the three strands,

children.text: tasmin yad yakṣam ātmanvat tad vai brahmavido viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: the mysterious being within it, possessed of self: that indeed the knowers of <s>brahman</s> know.

children.text: akāmo dhīro amṛtaḥ svayaṃbhū rasena tṛpto na kutaścanonaḥ
children.translated_text: Desireless, wise, immortal, self-born, satisfied with essence and lacking nothing from anywhere,

children.text: tam eva vidvān na bibhāya mṛtyor ātmānaṃ dhīram ajaraṃ yuvānam ||
children.translated_text: knowing that very one, one does not fear death: the wise, undecaying, youthful <s>ātman</s> (self).

children.text: Chapter 457
aghāyatām api nahyā mukhāni sapatneṣu vajram arpayaitam
children.translated_text: Bind shut the mouths of the evil-speakers; set this thunderbolt against the rivals.

children.text: indreṇa dattā prathamā śataudanā bhrātṛvyaghnī yajamānasya gātuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The first <s>śataudanā</s>, given by <s>Indra</s>, slayer of kinsman-rivals, is the path of the sacrificer.

children.text: vediṣ ṭe carma bhavatu barhir lomāni yāni te
children.translated_text: Let the altar be your hide; let the sacrificial grass be those hairs of yours.

children.text: eṣā tvā raśanāgrabhīd grāvā tvaiṣo 'dhi nṛtyatu ||
children.translated_text: This halter has seized you; let this pressing-stone dance upon you.

children.text: bālās te prokṣaṇīḥ santu jihvā saṃ mārṣṭu aghnye
children.translated_text: Let your hairs be the sprinkling vessels; let the tongue wipe, O inviolable one.

children.text: śuddhā tvaṃ yajñiyā bhūtvā divaṃ prehi śataudane ||
children.translated_text: Having become pure and fit for sacrifice, go to heaven, O <s>śataudanā</s>.

children.text: yaḥ śataudanāṃ pacati kāmapreṇa sa kalpate
children.translated_text: He who cooks the <s>śataudanā</s> becomes fitted with the fulfiller of desires.

children.text: prītā hy asya ṛtvijaḥ sarve yanti yathāyatham ||
children.translated_text: For all his priests, being pleased, go each in the proper way.

children.text: sa svargam ā rohati yatrādas tridivaṃ divaḥ
children.translated_text: He ascends to heaven, there to the third heaven above the sky,

children.text: apūpanābhiṃ kṛtvā yo dadāti śataudanām ||
children.translated_text: who, making a cake her navel, gives the <s>śataudanā</s>.

children.text: sa tāṃllokānt sam āpnoti ye divyā ye ca pārthivāḥ
children.translated_text: He obtains all those worlds, both heavenly and earthly,

children.text: hiraṇyajyotiṣaṃ kṛtvā yo dadāti śataudanām ||
children.translated_text: who, making gold her light, gives the <s>śataudanā</s>.

children.text: ye te devi śamitāraḥ paktāro ye ca te janāḥ
children.translated_text: Those of yours, O goddess, who are slaughterers, cooks, and those people of yours,

children.text: te tvā sarve gopsyanti maibhyo bhaiṣīḥ śataudane ||
children.translated_text: they all will protect you; do not fear them, O <s>śataudanā</s>.

children.text: vasavas tvā dakṣiṇata uttarān marutas tvā
children.translated_text: The <s>Vasus</s> will protect you on the south; the <s>Maruts</s> will protect you on the north.

children.text: ādityāḥ paścād gopsyanti sāgniṣṭomam ati drava ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Ādityas</s> will protect you from behind; pass beyond together with the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>.

children.text: devāḥ pitaro manuṣyā gandharvāpsarasaś ca ye
children.translated_text: The gods, the fathers, human beings, and whatever <s>Gandharvas</s> and <s>Apsarases</s> there are,

children.text: te tvā sarve gopsyanti sātirātram ati drava ||
children.translated_text: they all will protect you; pass beyond together with the <s>Atirātra</s>.

children.text: antarikṣaṃ divaṃ bhūmim ādityān maruto diśaḥ
children.translated_text: The atmosphere, heaven, earth, the <s>Ādityas</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, and the directions:

children.text: lokānt sa sarvān āpnoti yo dadāti śataudanām ||
children.translated_text: he obtains all the worlds, he who gives the <s>śataudanā</s>.

children.text: ghṛtaṃ prokṣantī subhagā devī devān gamiṣyati
children.translated_text: Sprinkling ghee, the fortunate goddess will go to the gods.

children.text: paktāram aghnye mā hiṃsīr divaṃ prehi śataudane ||
children.translated_text: Do not harm the cook, O inviolable one; go to heaven, O <s>śataudanā</s>.

children.text: ye devā diviṣado antarikṣasadaś ca ye ye ceme bhūmyām adhi
children.translated_text: The gods who sit in heaven, those who sit in the atmosphere, and those who are here upon the earth:

children.text: tebhyas tvaṃ dhukṣva sarvadā kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: for them do you always milk out milk, ghee, and honey.

children.text: yat te śiro yat te mukhaṃ yau karṇau ye ca te hanū
children.translated_text: Your head, your mouth, your two ears, and your two jaws:

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and honey.

children.text: yau ta oṣṭhau ye nāsike ye śṛṅge ye ca te 'kṣiṇī
children.translated_text: Your two lips, your two nostrils, your horns, and your eyes:

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and honey.

children.text: yat te klomā yaddhṛdayaṃ purītat sahakaṇṭhikā
children.translated_text: Your lung, your heart, the pericardium with the throat:

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and honey.

children.text: yat te yakṛd ye matasne yad āntram yāś ca te gudāḥ
children.translated_text: Your liver, your kidneys, your intestine, and your bowels:

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and honey.

children.text: yas te plāśir yo vaniṣṭhur yau kukṣī yac ca carma te
children.translated_text: Your spleen, your rectum, your two belly-sides, and your hide:

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and honey.

children.text: yat te majjā yad asthi yan māṃsaṃ yac ca lohitam
children.translated_text: Your marrow, your bone, your flesh, and your blood:

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and honey.

children.text: yau te bāhū ye doṣaṇī yāv aṃsau yā ca te kakut
children.translated_text: Your two forelegs, your two lower forelegs, your two shoulders, and your hump:

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and honey.

children.text: yās te grīvā ye skandhā yāḥ pṛṣṭīr yāś ca parśavaḥ
children.translated_text: Those necks of yours, those shoulders, those back-parts, and those ribs,

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and also honey.

children.text: yau ta ūrū aṣṭhīvantau ye śroṇī yā ca te bhasat
children.translated_text: Those two thighs of yours, furnished with bones, those hips, and your buttock,

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and also honey.

children.text: yat te pucchaṃ ye te bālā yad ūdho ye ca te stanāḥ
children.translated_text: That tail of yours, those hairs of yours, that udder, and those teats of yours,

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and also honey.

children.text: yās te jaṅghāḥ yāḥ kuṣṭhikā ṛcharā ye ca te śaphāḥ
children.translated_text: Those shanks of yours, those fetlocks, the lower legs, and those hooves of yours,

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and also honey.

children.text: yat te carma śataudane yāni lomāny aghnye
children.translated_text: That hide of yours, O hundred-cooked one, and whatever hairs are yours, O inviolable cow,

children.text: āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpir atho madhu ||
children.translated_text: let them milk curds for the giver, milk, ghee, and also honey.

children.text: kroḍau te stāṃ puroḍāśāv ājyenābhighāritau
children.translated_text: Let your two haunches be two sacrificial cakes, sprinkled with ghee;

children.text: tau pakṣau devi kṛtvā sā paktāraṃ divaṃ vaha ||
children.translated_text: making them your two wings, O goddess, carry the cooker to heaven.

children.text: ulūkhale musale yaś ca carmaṇi yo vā śūrpe taṇḍulaḥ kaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The grain of rice, the small fragment, that is in the mortar, in the pestle, on the hide, or in the winnowing basket,

children.text: yaṃ vā vāto mātariśvā pavamāno mamāthāgniṣ ṭaddhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: or whatever the wind, <s>Mātariśvan</s>, the purifier, has crushed, let <s>Agni</s> the hotṛ make that well-offered.

children.text: apo devīr madhumatīr ghṛtaścuto brahmaṇāṃ hasteṣu prapṛthak sādayāmi
children.translated_text: The divine waters, sweet as honey and dripping with ghee, I set separately in the hands of the brahmans.

children.text: yatkāma idam abhiṣiñcāmi vo 'haṃ tan me sarvaṃ saṃpadyatāṃ vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: With whatever desire I sprinkle you here, may all that be fulfilled for me; may we be lords of riches.

children.text: Chapter 458
namas te jāyamānāyai jātāyā uta te namaḥ
children.translated_text: Homage to you as you are being born; homage also to you when born.

children.text: bālebhyaḥ śaphebhyo rūpāyāghnye te namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Homage to your hairs, to your hooves, to your form, O inviolable cow.

children.text: yo vidyāt sapta pravataḥ sapta vidyāt parāvataḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever should know the seven descents and should know the seven far distances,

children.text: śiro yajñasya yo vidyāt sa vaśāṃ prati gṛhṇīyāt ||
children.translated_text: whoever should know the head of the sacrifice, he should receive the <s>vaśā</s>.

children.text: vedāhaṃ sapta pravataḥ sapta veda parāvataḥ
children.translated_text: I know the seven descents; I know the seven far distances.

children.text: śiro yajñasyāhaṃ veda somaṃ cāsyāṃ vicakṣaṇam ||
children.translated_text: I know the head of the sacrifice, and <s>Soma</s>, clear-seeing, within her.

children.text: yayā dyaur yayā pṛthivī yayāpo gupitā imāḥ
children.translated_text: By whom heaven, by whom earth, by whom these waters are protected,

children.text: vaśāṃ sahasradhārāṃ brahmaṇācchāvadāmasi ||
children.translated_text: that thousand-streamed <s>vaśā</s> we call hither by means of <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: śataṃ kaṃsāḥ śataṃ dogdhāraḥ śataṃ goptāro adhi pṛṣṭhe asyāḥ
children.translated_text: A hundred bowls, a hundred milkers, a hundred guardians are upon her back.

children.text: ye devās tasyāṃ prāṇanti te vaśāṃ vidur ekadhā ||
children.translated_text: The gods who breathe in her know the <s>vaśā</s> in one way.

children.text: yajñapadīrākṣīrā svadhāprāṇā mahīlukā
children.translated_text: Having sacrifice as her feet, milk as her eyes, svadhā as her breath, broad in her brightness,

children.text: vaśā parjanyapatnī devāṁ apy eti brahmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: the <s>vaśā</s>, wife of <s>Parjanya</s>, approaches the gods through <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: anu tvāgniḥ prāviśad anu somo vaśe tvā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has entered after you; <s>Soma</s> has entered after you, O <s>Vaśā</s>.

children.text: ūdhas te bhadre parjanyo vidyutas te stanā vaśe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Parjanya</s> is your udder, O blessed one; the lightning-flashes are your teats, O <s>Vaśā</s>.

children.text: apas tvaṃ dhukṣe prathamā urvarā aparā vaśe
children.translated_text: You milk the waters as the first; the fertile field as the second, O <s>Vaśā</s>.

children.text: tṛtīyaṃ rāṣṭraṃ dhukṣe 'nnaṃ kṣīraṃ vaśe tvam ||
children.translated_text: As the third you milk the kingdom, food, and milk, O <s>Vaśā</s>.

children.text: yad ādityair hūyamānopātiṣṭha ṛtāvari
children.translated_text: When, invoked by the <s>Ādityas</s>, you stood near, O keeper of <s>ṛta</s>,

children.text: indraḥ sahasraṃ pātrānt somaṃ tvāpāyayad vaśe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> made you, O <s>Vaśā</s>, drink <s>Soma</s> in a thousand vessels.

children.text: yad anūcīndram air āt tvā ṛṣabho 'hvayat
children.translated_text: When, following <s>Indra</s>, the bull called you to himself,

children.text: tasmāt te vṛtrahā payaḥ kṣīraṃ kruddho 'harad vaśe ||
children.translated_text: therefore the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, angered, took away milk from you, O <s>Vaśā</s>.

children.text: yat te kruddho dhanapatir ā kṣīram aharad vaśe
children.translated_text: The milk which the lord of wealth, angered, took away from you, O <s>Vaśā</s>,

children.text: idaṃ tad adya nākas triṣu pātreṣu rakṣati ||
children.translated_text: this heavenly vault today guards that in three vessels.

children.text: triṣu pātreṣu taṃ somam ā devy aharad vaśā
children.translated_text: The divine <s>Vaśā</s> brought that <s>Soma</s> in three vessels

children.text: atharvā yatra dīkṣito barhiṣy āsta hiraṇyaye ||
children.translated_text: to where <s>Atharvan</s>, consecrated, sat upon the golden barhis.

children.text: saṃ hi somenāgata sam u sarveṇa padvatā
children.translated_text: She has come together with <s>Soma</s>, and together with every footed creature.

children.text: vaśā samudram adhyaṣṭhād gandharvaiḥ kalibhiḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaśā</s> stood over the ocean, together with the <s>Gandharvas</s> and the kalis.

children.text: saṃ hi vātenāgata sam u sarvaiḥ patatribhiḥ
children.translated_text: She has come together with the wind, and together with all winged creatures.

children.text: vaśā samudre prānṛtyad ṛcaḥ sāmāni bibhratī ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaśā</s> danced forth in the ocean, bearing the Ṛc-verses and the Sāman-chants.

children.text: saṃ hi sūryeṇāgata sam u sarveṇa cakṣuṣā
children.translated_text: She has come together with the sun, and together with all sight.

children.text: vaśā samudram aty akhyad bhadrā jyotīṃṣi bibhratī ||
children.translated_text: The blessed <s>Vaśā</s> looked out beyond the ocean, bearing the lights.

children.text: abhīvṛtā hiraṇyena yad atiṣṭha ṛtāvari
children.translated_text: When you stood enveloped in gold, O keeper of <s>ṛta</s>,

children.text: aśvaḥ samudro bhūtvādhy askandad vaśe tvā ||
children.translated_text: the horse, becoming the ocean, mounted you, O <s>Vaśā</s>.

children.text: tad bhadrāḥ sam agacchanta vaśā deṣṭry atho svadhā
children.translated_text: Then the blessed ones came together: the <s>Vaśā</s>, the guide, and also <s>svadhā</s>.

children.text: atharvā yatra dīkṣito barhiṣy āsta hiraṇyaye ||
children.translated_text: There <s>Atharvan</s>, consecrated, sat upon the golden barhis.

children.text: vaśā mātā rājanyasya vaśā mātā svadhe tava
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaśā</s> is the mother of the royal power; the <s>Vaśā</s> is the mother of your <s>svadhā</s>.

children.text: vaśāyā yajña āyudhaṃ tataś cittam ajāyata ||
children.translated_text: The sacrifice is the weapon of the <s>Vaśā</s>; from that thought was born.

children.text: ūrdhvo bindur ud acarad brahmaṇaḥ kakudād adhi
children.translated_text: The upright drop rose up from the summit of <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: tatas tvaṃ jajñiṣe vaśe tato hotājāyata ||
children.translated_text: From that you were born, O <s>Vaśā</s>; from that the hotṛ was born.

children.text: āsnas te gāthā abhavann uṣṇihābhyo balaṃ vaśe
children.translated_text: From your mouth the gāthās arose; from the uṣṇih-verses, strength, O <s>Vaśā</s>.

children.text: pājasyāj jajñe yajña stanebhyo raśmayas tava ||
children.translated_text: From vigor sacrifice was born; from your teats, the rays.

children.text: īrmābhyām ayanaṃ jātaṃ sakthibhyāṃ ca vaśe tava
children.translated_text: From the forelegs a path was born, and from your thighs, O <s>Vaśā</s>.

children.text: āntrebhyo jajñire atrā udarād adhi vīrudhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: From the entrails the atrās were born; from the belly, the plants.

children.text: yad udaraṃ varuṇasyānuprāviśathā vaśe
children.translated_text: When you entered the belly of <s>Varuṇa</s>, O <s>Vaśā</s>,

children.text: tatas tvā brahmod ahvayat sa hi netram avet tava ||
children.translated_text: then <s>brahman</s> called you forth, for it knew your guiding rein.

children.text: sarve garbhād avepanta jāyamānād asūsvaḥ
children.translated_text: All trembled at the embryo as it was being born, as you brought forth.

children.text: sasūva hi tām āhurvaśeti brahmabhiḥ kﾱptaḥ sa hy asyā bandhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: For they say that she gave birth to that one, as the <s>Vaśā</s>, fashioned by the brahmans; he indeed is her kinsman.

children.text: yudha ekaḥ saṃ sṛjati yo asyā eka id vaśī
children.translated_text: One alone sends forth the battles, he who alone is her master.

children.text: tarāṃsi yajñā abhavan tarasāṃ cakṣur abhavad vaśā ||
children.translated_text: The powers became sacrifices; the <s>Vaśā</s> became the eye of the powers.

children.text: vaśā yajñaṃ praty agṛhṇād vaśā sūryam adhārayat
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaśā</s> received the sacrifice; the <s>Vaśā</s> upheld the sun.

children.text: vaśāyām antar aviśad odano brahmaṇā saha ||
children.translated_text: Within the <s>Vaśā</s> the cooked oblation entered, together with <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: vaśām evāmṛtam āhur vaśāṃ mṛtyum upāsate
children.translated_text: They call the <s>Vaśā</s> immortality; they worship the <s>Vaśā</s> as death.

children.text: vaśedaṃ sarvam abhavad devā manuṣyā asurāḥ pitara ṛṣayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaśā</s> became all this: gods, humans, asuras, ancestors, and seers.

children.text: ya evaṃ vidyāt sa vaśāṃ prati gṛhṇīyāt
children.translated_text: Whoever should know thus should receive the <s>vaśā</s>.

children.text: tathā hi yajñaḥ sarvapād duhe dātre 'napasphuran ||
children.translated_text: For in that way the sacrifice, with all its feet, milks for the giver, without kicking.

children.text: tisro jihvā varuṇasyāntar dīdyaty āsani
children.translated_text: The three tongues of <s>Varuṇa</s> shine within the mouth.

children.text: tāsāṃ yā madhye rājati sā vaśā duṣpratigrahā ||
children.translated_text: The one among them that gleams in the middle is the <s>Vaśā</s>, hard to receive.

children.text: caturdhā reto abhavad vaśāyāḥ
children.translated_text: Fourfold became the seed of the <s>Vaśā</s>:

children.text: āpas turīyam amṛtaṃ turīyaṃ yajñas turīyaṃ paśavas turīyam ||
