children.translated_text: the waters are one quarter, immortality one quarter, sacrifice one quarter, and cattle one quarter.

children.text: vaśā dyaur vaśā pṛthivī vaśā viṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Vaśā</s> is heaven; <s>Vaśā</s> is earth; <s>Vaśā</s> is <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: vaśāyā dugdham apibant sādhyā vasavaś ca ye ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Sādhyas</s> and those <s>Vasus</s> drank the milk of <s>Vaśā</s>.

children.text: vaśāyā dugdhaṃ pītvā sādhyā vasavaś ca ye
children.translated_text: Having drunk the milk of <s>Vaśā</s>, the <s>Sādhyas</s> and those <s>Vasus</s>

children.text: te vai bradhnasya viṣṭapi payo asyā upāsate ||
children.translated_text: attend upon her milk on the summit of <s>Bradhna</s>.

children.text: somam enām eke duhre ghṛtam eka upāsate
children.translated_text: Some milk her as <s>Soma</s>; others attend upon her as ghee.

children.text: ya evaṃ viduṣe vaśāṃ dadus te gatās tridivaṃ divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who have given <s>Vaśā</s> to one who knows thus have gone to the third heaven of heaven.

children.text: brāhmaṇebhyo vaśāṃ dattvā sarvāṃllokānt sam aśnute
children.translated_text: Having given <s>Vaśā</s> to the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, one enjoys all the worlds.

children.text: ṛtaṃ hy asyām ārpitam api brahmātho tapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) is fixed in her, and also <s>brahman</s> and austerity.

children.text: vaśāṃ devā upa jīvanti vaśāṃ manuṣyā uta
children.translated_text: The gods live upon <s>Vaśā</s>, and human beings likewise upon <s>Vaśā</s>.

children.text: vaśedaṃ sarvam abhavad yāvat sūryo vipaśyati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vaśā</s> became all this, as far as the sun looks forth.

children.text: Chapter 459
agne jāyasvāditir nāthiteyaṃ brahmaudanaṃ pacati putrakāmā
children.translated_text: Be born, O <s>Agni</s>; this <s>Aditi</s>, seeking help, cooks the <s>brahmaudana</s>, desiring a son.

children.text: saptaṛṣayo bhūtakṛtas te tvā manthantu prajayā saheha ||
children.translated_text: May the Seven Seers, the makers of beings, churn you here together with offspring.

children.text: kṛṇuta dhūmaṃ vṛṣaṇaḥ sakhāyo 'droghāvitā vācam accha
children.translated_text: Make smoke, virile friends; with an undeceiving protector turn toward the voice.

children.text: ayam agniḥ pṛtanāṣāṭ suvīro yena devā asahanta dasyūn ||
children.translated_text: This is <s>Agni</s>, battle-conquering and rich in heroes, by whom the gods overcame the <s>Dasyus</s>.

children.text: agne 'janiṣṭhā mahate vīryāya brahmaudanāya paktave jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, you were born for great heroic power, for the <s>brahmaudana</s>, to be cooked.

children.text: saptaṛṣayo bhūtakṛtas te tvājījanann asyai rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yaccha ||
children.translated_text: The Seven Seers, makers of beings, begot you; assign to this woman wealth with all its heroes.

children.text: samiddho agne samidhā sam idhyasva vidvān devān yajñiyāṁ eha vakṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Kindled, O <s>Agni</s>, flame up with fuel; knowing well, bring the worshipful gods here.

children.text: tebhyo haviḥ śrapayaṃ jātaveda uttamaṃ nākam adhi rohayemam ||
children.translated_text: Cooking the oblation for them, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, make this man ascend the highest firmament.

children.text: tredhā bhāgo nihito yaḥ purā vo devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ martyānām
children.translated_text: The threefold share that was formerly set down for you belongs to the gods, the Fathers, and mortals.

children.text: aṃśāṁ jānīdhvaṃ vi bhajāmi tān vo yo devānāṃ sa imāṃ pārayāti ||
children.translated_text: Know your portions; I divide them for you. He who belongs to the gods carries this offering across.

children.text: agne sahasvān abhibhūr abhīd asi nīco ny ubja dviṣataḥ sapatnān
children.translated_text: O mighty <s>Agni</s>, overpowering and superior, you are turned against them; thrust the hostile rivals downward.

children.text: iyaṃ mātrā mīyamānā mitā ca sajātāṃs te balihṛtaḥ kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: May this measure, being measured and marked out, make your kinsmen bring tribute to you.

children.text: sākaṃ sajātaiḥ payasā sahaidhy ud ubjaināṃ mahate vīryāya
children.translated_text: Together with your kinsmen, grow with milk; raise her up for great heroic power.

children.text: ūrdhvo nākasyādhi roha viṣṭapaṃ svargo loka iti yaṃ vadanti ||
children.translated_text: Rise upward above the height of the firmament, to the world that they call heaven.

children.text: iyaṃ mahī prati gṛhṇātu carma pṛthivī devī sumanasyamānā
children.translated_text: Let this great divine earth, gracious in mind, receive the hide.

children.text: atha gacchema sukṛtasya lokam ||
children.translated_text: Then may we go to the world of the well-doer.

children.text: etau grāvāṇau sayujā yuṅdhi carmaṇi nirbhinddhyaṃśūn yajamānāya sādhu
children.translated_text: Yoke these two pressing stones, joined together, upon the hide; crush the stalks properly for the sacrificer.

children.text: avaghnatī ni jahi ya imāṃ pṛtanyava ūrdhvaṃ prajām udbharanty ud ūha ||
children.translated_text: Striking down, slay those who would fight against her; raising the offspring upward, carry it up.

children.text: gṛhāṇa grāvāṇau sakṛtau vīra hasta ā te devā yajñiyā yajñam aguḥ
children.translated_text: Take the two well-made pressing stones in your hand, O hero; the worshipful gods have come to your sacrifice.

children.text: trayo varā yatamāṃs tvaṃ vṛṇīṣe tās te samṛddhīr iha rādhayāmi ||
children.translated_text: There are three boons: whichever you choose, those prosperities I make successful for you here.

children.text: iyaṃ te dhītir idam u te janitraṃ gṛhṇātu tvām aditiḥ śūraputrā
children.translated_text: This is your inspired thought, and this is your birthplace; may <s>Aditi</s>, mother of heroic sons, take hold of you.

children.text: parā punīhi ya imāṃ pṛtanyavo 'syai rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yaccha ||
children.translated_text: Purify away those who would fight against her; assign to this woman wealth with all its heroes.

children.text: upaśvase druvaye sīdatā yūyaṃ vi vicyadhvaṃ yajñiyāsas tuṣaiḥ
children.translated_text: Sit down, all of you, for breathing and for firmness; separate yourselves, worshipful ones, from the husks.

children.text: śriyā samānān ati sarvānt syāmādhaspadaṃ dviṣatas pādayāmi ||
children.translated_text: May we surpass all our equals in splendor; I set the hostile ones beneath our feet.

children.text: parehi nāri punar ehi kṣipram apāṃ tvā goṣṭho adhy arukṣad bharāya
children.translated_text: Go away, woman; come back quickly. The fold of the waters has mounted upon you for carrying.

children.text: tāsāṃ gṛhṇītād yatamā yajñiyā asan vibhājya dhīrītarā jahītāt ||
children.translated_text: Take whichever of them are fit for sacrifice; after dividing them, leave the others behind.

children.text: emā agur yoṣitaḥ śumbhamānā ut tiṣṭha nāri tavasaṃ rabhasva
children.translated_text: These women have come adorned; arise, woman, seize the strong one.

children.text: supatnī patyā prajayā prajāvaty ā tvāgan yajñaḥ prati kumbhaṃ gṛbhāya ||
children.translated_text: As a good wife with husband, with offspring and rich in progeny, the sacrifice has come to you; take hold of the jar.

children.text: ūrjo bhāgo nihito yaḥ purā va ṛṣipraśiṣṭāpa ā bharaitāḥ
children.translated_text: The share of vigor that was set down for you of old: bring these waters, instructed by the seers.

children.text: ayaṃ yajño gātuvin nāthavit prajāvid ugraḥ paśuvid vīravid vo astu ||
children.translated_text: May this fierce sacrifice be for you a finder of the path, a finder of refuge, a finder of offspring, a finder of cattle, and a finder of heroes.

children.text: agne carur yajñiyas tvādhy arukṣacchucis tapiṣṭhas tapasā tapainam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, the worshipful <s>caru</s> (cooked oblation) has mounted upon you; pure and hottest, heat it with heat.

children.text: ārṣeyā daivā abhisaṃgatya bhāgam imaṃ tapiṣṭhā ṛtubhis tapantu ||
children.translated_text: May the seer-born, divine, hottest ones, coming together to their share, heat this with the seasons.

children.text: śuddhāḥ pūtā yoṣito yajñiyā imā āpaś carum ava sarpantu śubhrāḥ
children.translated_text: Pure, purified, worshipful women, these bright waters, let them glide down into the <s>caru</s>.

children.text: aduḥ prajāṃ bahulāṃ paśūn naḥ paktaudanasya sukṛtām etu lokam ||
children.translated_text: They have given us abundant offspring and cattle; may the cooked <s>odana</s> go to the world of the well-doers.

children.text: brahmaṇā śuddhā uta pūtā ghṛtena somasyāṃśavas taṇḍulā yajñiyā ime
children.translated_text: Purified by <s>brahman</s> and also cleansed with ghee, these <s>Soma</s> stalks, these worshipful rice grains,

children.text: apaḥ pra viśata prati gṛhṇātu vaś carur imaṃ paktvā sukṛtām eta lokam ||
children.translated_text: enter the waters; let the <s>caru</s> receive you. Having cooked this, go to the world of the well-doers.

children.text: uruḥ prathasva mahatā mahimnā sahasrapṛṣṭhaḥ sukṛtasya loke
children.translated_text: Spread wide with great greatness, thousand-backed, in the world of the well-done.

children.text: pitāmahāḥ pitaraḥ prajopajāhaṃ paktā pañcadaśas te asmi ||
children.translated_text: Grandfathers, Fathers, and descendants: I, the cook, am your fifteenth.

children.text: sahasrapṛṣṭhaḥ śatadhāro akṣito brahmaudano devayānaḥ svargaḥ
children.translated_text: Thousand-backed, hundred-streamed, imperishable, the <s>brahmaudana</s> is the gods' path and heavenly.

children.text: amūṃs ta ā dadhāmi prajayā reṣayainān balihārāya mṛḍatān mahyam eva ||
children.translated_text: I place those yonder for you together with offspring; for tribute-bearing, may they be gracious to me alone.

children.text: udehi vediṃ prajayā vardhayaināṃ nudasva rakṣaḥ prataraṃ dhehy enām
children.translated_text: Rise up to the altar; increase her with offspring; drive away the <s>Rakṣas</s>; set her farther across.

children.text: śriyā samānān ati sarvānt syāmādhaspadaṃ dviṣatas pādayāmi ||
children.translated_text: May we surpass all our equals in splendor; I set the hostile ones beneath our feet.

children.text: abhyāvartasva paśubhiḥ sahaināṃ pratyaṅṅ enāṃ devatābhiḥ sahaidhi
children.translated_text: Turn back with cattle together with her; come back toward her and thrive together with the deities.

children.text: mā tvā prāpac chapatho mābhicāraḥ sve kṣetre anamīvā vi rāja ||
children.translated_text: Let no curse reach you, nor sorcery; shine in your own field, free from sickness.

children.text: ṛtena taṣṭā manasā hitaiṣā brahmaudanasya vihitā vedir agre
children.translated_text: Fashioned by <s>ṛta</s> and placed by thought, this altar of the <s>brahmaudana</s> was arranged at the beginning.

children.text: aṃsadhrīṃ śuddhām upa dhehi nāri tatraudanaṃ sādaya daivānām ||
children.translated_text: Lay down the pure shoulder-piece, O woman; set the gods' <s>odana</s> there.

children.text: aditer hastāṃ srucam etāṃ dvitīyāṃ saptaṛṣayo bhūtakṛto yām akṛṇvan
children.translated_text: This second ladle is <s>Aditi</s>'s hand, which the Seven Seers, makers of beings, fashioned.

children.text: sā gātrāṇi viduṣy odanasya darvir vedyām adhy enaṃ cinotu ||
children.translated_text: Knowing the limbs of the <s>odana</s>, may that ladle arrange it here upon the altar.

children.text: śṛtaṃ tvā havyam upa sīdantu daivā niḥsṛpyāgneḥ punar enān pra sīda
children.translated_text: Cooked as an oblation, may the divine ones sit near you; having slipped forth from <s>Agni</s>, sit again among them.

children.text: somena pūto jaṭhare sīda brahmaṇām ārṣeyās te mā riṣan prāśitāraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Purified by <s>Soma</s>, sit in the belly; may your eaters, the ṛṣi-descended <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, not come to harm.

children.text: soma rājant saṃjñānam ā vapaibhyaḥ subrāhmaṇā yatame tvopasīdān
children.translated_text: O king <s>Soma</s>, pour concord into these; into whichever good <s>brāhmaṇas</s> have sat beside you.

children.text: ṛṣīn ārṣeyāṃs tapaso 'dhi jātān brahmaudane suhavā johavīmi ||
children.translated_text: I invoke, as easy to call at the <s>brahmaudana</s> (sacred rice porridge), the ṛṣis, the ṛṣi-descended ones born from austerity.

children.text: śuddhāḥ pūtā yoṣito yajñiyā imā brahmaṇāṃ hasteṣu prapṛthak sādayāmi
children.translated_text: These women, pure, purified, fit for sacrifice, I set separately in the hands of the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>.

children.text: yatkāma idam abhiṣiñcāmi vo 'ham indro marutvānt sa dadād idaṃ me ||
children.translated_text: For whatever desire I now sprinkle you, may <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s> grant that to me.

children.text: idaṃ me jyotir amṛtaṃ hiraṇyaṃ pakvaṃ kṣetrāt kāmadughā ma eṣā
children.translated_text: This light of mine is immortal gold, cooked from the field; this is my wish-milking cow.

children.text: idaṃ dhanaṃ ni dadhe brāhmaṇeṣu kṛṇve panthāṃ pitṛṣu yaḥ svargaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This wealth I deposit among the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>; I make the path among the ancestors that leads to heaven.

children.text: agnau tuṣān ā vapa jātavedasi paraḥ kambūkāṁ apa mṛḍḍhi dūram
children.translated_text: Pour the husks into <s>Agni Jātavedas</s>; wipe the chaff far away, beyond reach.

children.text: etaṃ śuśruma gṛharājasya bhāgam atho vidma nirṛter bhāgadheyam ||
children.translated_text: We have heard this as the share of the lord of the house, and we also know the allotted portion of <s>Nirṛti</s>.

children.text: śrāmyataḥ pacato viddhi sunvataḥ panthāṃ svargam adhi rohayainam
children.translated_text: Know him as he labors, cooks, and presses; raise him up onto the path to heaven.

children.text: yena rohāt param āpadya yad vaya uttamaṃ nākaṃ paramaṃ vyoma ||
children.translated_text: By that path may he ascend, attaining what is farther, the highest vault, the highest heaven.

children.text: babhrer adhvaryo mukham etad vi mṛḍḍhy ājyāya lokaṃ kṛṇuhi pravidvān
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryu</s>, wipe clean this mouth of the brown one; knowingly make a place for the ghee.

children.text: ghṛtena gātrānu sarvā vi mṛḍḍhi kṛṇve panthāṃ pitṛṣu yaḥ svargaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With ghee wipe all the limbs; I make the path among the ancestors that leads to heaven.

children.text: babhre rakṣaḥ samadam ā vapaibhyo 'brāhmaṇā yatame tvopasīdān
children.translated_text: O brown one, cast the reveling demon away from these, away from whichever non-<s>brāhmaṇas</s> have sat beside you.

children.text: purīṣiṇaḥ prathamānāḥ purastād ārṣeyās te mā riṣan prāśitāraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The dung-smeared ones are first in front; may your eaters, the ṛṣi-descended ones, not come to harm.

children.text: ārṣeyeṣu ni dadha odana tvā nānārṣeyāṇām apy asty atra
children.translated_text: Among the ṛṣi-descended I place you, O <s>odana</s> (cooked rice); there is nothing here even for those not descended from ṛṣis.

children.text: agnir me goptā marutaś ca sarve viśve devā abhi rakṣantu pakvam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is my guardian, and all the <s>Maruts</s>; may all the gods protect the cooked offering.

children.text: yajñaṃ duhānaṃ sadam it prapīnaṃ pumāṃsaṃ dhenuṃ sadanaṃ rayīṇām
children.translated_text: Milking the sacrifice, always full, a male, a milch cow, the abode of riches,

children.text: prajāmṛtatvam uta dīrgham āyū rāyaś ca poṣair upa tvā sadema ||
children.translated_text: with offspring, immortality, and long life, with wealth and nourishments, may we sit near you.

children.text: vṛṣabho 'si svarga ṛṣīn ārṣeyān gaccha
children.translated_text: You are a bull; go to heaven, to the ṛṣis and the ṛṣi-descended ones.

children.text: sukṛtāṃ loke sīda tatra nau saṃskṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Sit in the world of those who have done good; there be well prepared for us.

children.text: samācinuṣvānusaṃprayāhy agne pathaḥ kalpaya devayānān
children.translated_text: Gather yourself together; follow along, O <s>Agni</s>; prepare the god-going paths.

children.text: etaiḥ sukṛtair anu gacchema yajñaṃ nāke tiṣṭhantam adhi saptaraśmau ||
children.translated_text: With these good deeds may we follow the sacrifice that stands in the heavenly vault upon the seven-rayed one.

children.text: yena devā jyotiṣā dyām udāyan brahmaudanaṃ paktvā sukṛtasya lokam
children.translated_text: By the light with which the gods went up to heaven, after cooking the <s>brahmaudana</s>, to the world of merit,

children.text: tena geṣma sukṛtasya lokaṃ svar ārohanto abhi nākam uttamam ||
children.translated_text: by that may we go to the world of merit, ascending to the sun and to the highest vault.

children.text: Chapter 460
bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ mābhi yātaṃ bhūtapatī paśupatī namo vām
children.translated_text: O <s>Bhava</s> and <s>Śarva</s>, be gracious; do not come against us. Lords of beings, lords of cattle, homage to you.

children.text: pratihitām āyatāṃ mā vi srāṣṭaṃ mā no hiṃsiṣṭaṃ dvipado mā catuṣpadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not let loose your stretched, set weapon; do not harm our bipeds, nor our quadrupeds.

children.text: śune kroṣṭre mā śarīrāṇi kartam aliklavebhyo gṛdhrebhyo ye ca kṛṣṇā aviṣyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Do not make our bodies over to the dog, the jackal, the aliklavas, the vultures, or those black ones greedy for carrion.

children.text: makṣikās te paśupate vayāṃsi te vighase mā vidanta ||
children.translated_text: Your flies, O <s>Paśupati</s>, and your birds: let them not find us as food.

children.text: krandāya te prāṇāya yāś ca te bhava ropayaḥ
children.translated_text: For your cry, for your breath, and for those missiles of yours, O <s>Bhava</s>,

children.text: namas te rudra kṛṇmaḥ sahasrākṣāyāmartya ||
children.translated_text: we make homage to you, O <s>Rudra</s>, thousand-eyed, immortal one.

children.text: purastāt te namaḥ kṛṇma uttarād adharād uta
children.translated_text: From in front we make homage to you, and from the north and from below,

children.text: abhīvargād divas pary antarikṣāya te namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: from the surrounding heaven; to the midspace, homage to you.

children.text: mukhāya te paśupate yāni cakṣūṃṣi te bhava
children.translated_text: To your face, O <s>Paśupati</s>, and to whatever eyes are yours, O <s>Bhava</s>,

children.text: tvace rūpāya saṃdṛśe pratīcīnāya te namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: to your skin, form, and visible appearance, to your backward-facing aspect, homage to you.

children.text: aṅgebhyas ta udarāya jihvāyā āsyāya te
children.translated_text: To your limbs, to your belly, to your tongue and to your mouth,

children.text: dadbhyo gandhāya te namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: to your teeth and to your smell, homage to you.

children.text: astrā nīlaśikhaṇḍena sahasrākṣeṇa vājinā
children.translated_text: With the weapon of the blue-crested, thousand-eyed, strong one,

children.text: rudreṇārdhakaghātinā tena mā sam arāmahi ||
children.translated_text: with <s>Rudra</s>, who strikes by halves: may we not come into conflict with him.

children.text: sa no bhavaḥ pari vṛṇaktu viśvata āpa ivāgniḥ pari vṛṇaktu no bhavaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Bhava</s> protect us on every side; as waters surround fire, may <s>Bhava</s> surround us.

children.text: mā no 'bhi māṃsta namo astv asmai ||
children.translated_text: Let him not threaten us; homage be to him.

children.text: catur namo aṣṭakṛtvo bhavāya daśakṛtvaḥ paśupate namas te
children.translated_text: Fourfold homage, eight times to <s>Bhava</s>; ten times, O <s>Paśupati</s>, homage to you.

children.text: taveme pañca paśavo vibhaktā gāvo aśvāḥ puruṣā ajāvayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: These five animals of yours are apportioned: cattle, horses, men, goats, and sheep.

children.text: tava catasraḥ pradiśas tava dyaus tava pṛthivī tavedam ugrorv antarikṣam
children.translated_text: Yours are the four quarters; yours is heaven, yours earth, yours this wide and formidable midspace.

children.text: tavedaṃ sarvam ātmanvad yat prāṇat pṛthivīm anu ||
children.translated_text: Yours is all this that has a self, whatever breathes upon the earth.

children.text: uruḥ kośo vasudhānas tavāyaṃ yasminn imā viśvā bhuvanāny antaḥ
children.translated_text: This broad treasure-chest, holding wealth, is yours, in which all these worlds are contained.

children.text: sa no mṛḍa paśupate namas te paraḥ kroṣṭāro abhibhāḥ śvānaḥ paro yantv agharudo vikeśyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be gracious to us, O <s>Paśupati</s>; homage to you. Let the howling jackals, overpowering dogs, and ill-crying disheveled ones go far away.

children.text: dhanur bibharṣi haritaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ sahasraghniṃ śatavadhaṃ śikhaṇḍin
children.translated_text: You bear a tawny, golden bow, thousand-slaying and hundred-killing, O crested one.

children.text: rudrasyeṣuś carati devahetis tasyai namo yatamasyāṃ diśītaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Rudra</s>'s arrow, the divine missile, flies; homage to it, in whatever direction it has been aimed.

children.text: yo 'bhiyāto nilayate tvāṃ rudra nicikīrṣati
children.translated_text: Whoever has come against you, hides, O <s>Rudra</s>, and wishes to injure you,

children.text: paścād anuprayuṅkṣe taṃ viddhasya padanīr iva ||
children.translated_text: after him you send pursuit, like one tracking the footstep of a man who has been pierced.

children.text: bhavārudrau sayujā saṃvidānāvubhāvugrau carato vīryāya
children.translated_text: <s>Bhava</s> and <s>Rudra</s>, joined together and of one mind, both fierce, move about for heroic power.

children.text: tābhyāṃ namo yatamasyāṃ diśītaḥ ||
children.translated_text: To them homage, in whatever direction they may be.

children.text: namas te astv āyate namo astu parāyate
children.translated_text: Homage be to you as you come near; homage be as you go away.

children.text: namas te rudra tiṣṭhata āsīnāyota te namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Homage to you, O <s>Rudra</s>, as you stand, and homage to you as you sit.

children.text: namaḥ sāyaṃ namaḥ prātar namo rātryā namo divā
children.translated_text: Homage in the evening, homage in the morning; homage by night, homage by day.

children.text: bhavāya ca śarvāya cobhābhyām akaraṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: To <s>Bhava</s> and to <s>Śarva</s>, to both, I have made homage.

children.text: sahasrākṣam atipaśyaṃ purastād rudram asyantaṃ bahudhā vipaścitam
children.translated_text: I saw before me the thousand-eyed <s>Rudra</s>, hurling his weapon, manifoldly wise.

children.text: mopārāma jihvayeyamānam ||
children.translated_text: May I not desist from him who is set in motion by the tongue.

children.text: śyāvāśvaṃ kṛṣṇam asitaṃ mṛṇantaṃ bhīmaṃ rathaṃ keśinaḥ pādayantam
children.translated_text: We meet in front the dark-horsed, black, dark one, crushing, terrible, making the long-haired ones fall from the chariot.

children.text: pūrve pratīmo namo astv asmai ||
children.translated_text: Homage be to him.

children.text: mā no 'bhi srā matyaṃ devahetiṃ mā naḥ krudhaḥ paśupate namas te
children.translated_text: Do not let the divine missile strike us mortals; do not be angry with us, O <s>Paśupati</s>; homage to you.

children.text: anyatrāsmad divyāṃ śākhāṃ vi dhūnu ||
children.translated_text: Shake the heavenly branch away elsewhere, away from us.

children.text: mā no hiṃsīr adhi no brūhi pari ṇo vṛṅdhi mā krudhaḥ
children.translated_text: Do not injure us; speak in our favor; encompass us protectively; do not be angry.

children.text: mā tvayā sam arāmahi ||
children.translated_text: May we not come into hostile conflict with you.

children.text: mā no goṣu puruṣeṣu mā gṛdho no ajāviṣu
children.translated_text: Do not be greedy for our cows or our people, nor for our goats and sheep.

children.text: anyatrogra vi vartaya piyārūṇāṃ prajāṃ jahi ||
children.translated_text: Turn it elsewhere, O fierce one; strike down the progeny of the <s>Piyārūṇas</s>.

children.text: yasya takmā kāsikā hetir ekam aśvasyeva vṛṣaṇaḥ kranda eti
children.translated_text: He whose missile is fever and cough, who comes with a roar like a virile horse,

children.text: abhipūrvaṃ nirṇayate namo astv asmai ||
children.translated_text: who drives it forth against what lies before him: homage be to him.

children.text: yo 'ntarikṣe tiṣṭhati viṣṭabhito 'yajvanaḥ pramṛṇan devapīyūn
children.translated_text: He who stands in the midspace, held firm, crushing the non-sacrificers, the god-haters,

children.text: tasmai namo daśabhiḥ śakvarībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: to him homage with ten śakvarī-verses.

children.text: tubhyam āraṇyāḥ paśavo mṛgā vane hitā haṃsāḥ suparṇāḥ śakunā vayāṃsi
children.translated_text: For you are the forest animals, the beasts set in the wood, the geese, the fair-winged birds, and the flying creatures.

children.text: tava yakṣaṃ paśupate apsv antas tubhyaṃ kṣaranti divyā āpo vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: Your wondrous power, O <s>Paśupati</s>, is within the waters; for your increase the heavenly waters flow.

children.text: śiṃśumārā ajagarāḥ purīkayā jaṣā matsyā rajasā yebhyo asyasi
children.translated_text: The river-monsters, the pythons, the aquatic creatures, the large fish and fishes through the atmosphere, at whom you shoot,

children.text: na te dūraṃ na pariṣṭhāsti te bhava sadyaḥ sarvāṃ pari paśyasi bhūmiṃ pūrvasmāddhaṃsyuttarasmint samudre ||
children.translated_text: for you there is nothing distant and no remoteness, O <s>Bhava</s>; at once you see the whole earth, and from the eastern ocean you strike in the northern ocean.

children.text: mā no rudra takmanā mā viṣeṇa mā naḥ saṃ srā divyenāgninā
children.translated_text: Do not harm us, O <s>Rudra</s>, with fever or with poison; do not scorch us with heavenly fire.

children.text: anyatrāsmad vidyutaṃ pātayaitām ||
children.translated_text: Cast this lightning elsewhere, away from us.

children.text: bhavo divo bhava īśe pṛthivyā bhava ā papra urv antarikṣam
children.translated_text: <s>Bhava</s> is lord of heaven; <s>Bhava</s> is lord of earth; <s>Bhava</s> has filled the wide midspace.

children.text: tasyai namo yatamasyāṃ diśītaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Homage to that direction, whichever one you are in.

children.text: bhava rājan yajamānāya mṛḍa paśūnāṃ hi paśupatir babhūtha
children.translated_text: O king <s>Bhava</s>, be gracious to the sacrificer; for you have become <s>Paśupati</s>, lord of animals.

children.text: yaḥ śraddadhāti santi devā iti catuṣpade dvipade 'sya mṛḍa ||
children.translated_text: To the one who has faith that the gods exist, be gracious to his four-footed and two-footed creatures.

children.text: mā no mahāntam uta mā no arbhakaṃ mā no vahantam uta mā no vakṣyataḥ
children.translated_text: Do not harm our great one, nor our small one; do not harm the one who carries, nor the one who is to carry.

children.text: mā no hiṃsīḥ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca svāṃ tanvaṃ rudra mā rīriṣo naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not injure our father or mother; O <s>Rudra</s>, do not damage our own body.

children.text: rudrasyailabakārebhyo 'saṃsūktagilebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: For the howling ones of <s>Rudra</s>, for the unsung devourers,

children.text: idaṃ mahāsyebhyaḥ śvabhyo akaraṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for these great-mouthed dogs I have made homage.

children.text: namas te ghoṣiṇībhyo namas te keśinībhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Homage to your clamorous ones; homage to your long-haired ones.

children.text: namo namaskṛtābhyo namaḥ saṃbhuñjatībhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Homage to those honored with homage; homage to those who share in the feast.

children.text: namas te deva senābhyaḥ svasti no abhayaṃ ca naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Homage to your divine armies; may there be well-being for us and fearlessness for us.

children.text: Chapter 461
tasyaudanasya bṛhaspatiḥ śiro brahma mukham ||
children.translated_text: Of that <s>odana</s>, <s>Bṛhaspati</s> is the head, and <s>brahman</s> is the mouth.

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivī śrotre sūryācandramasāv akṣiṇī saptaṛṣayaḥ prāṇāpānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Heaven and earth are the two ears; sun and moon are the two eyes; the seven seers are the breaths and down-breaths.

children.text: cakṣur musalaṃ kāma ulūkhalam ||
children.translated_text: Sight is the pestle; desire is the mortar.

children.text: ditiḥ śūrpam aditiḥ śūrpagrāhī vāto 'pāvinak ||
children.translated_text: <s>Diti</s> is the winnowing basket; <s>Aditi</s> is the holder of the winnowing basket; the wind is the winnower.

children.text: aśvāḥ kaṇā gāvas taṇḍulā maśakās tuṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Horses are the broken grains, cows are the rice-grains, and mosquitoes are the husks.

children.text: kabru phalīkaraṇāḥ śaro 'bhram ||
children.translated_text: The speckled ones are the chaff; the reed is the cloud.

children.text: śyāmam ayo 'sya māṃsāni lohitam asya lohitam ||
children.translated_text: Black iron is its flesh; red metal is its blood.

children.text: trapu bhasma haritaṃ varṇaḥ puṣkaram asya gandhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Tin is its ash; green is its color; the lotus is its fragrance.

children.text: khalaḥ pātraṃ sphyāv aṃsāv īṣe anūkye ||
children.translated_text: The threshing floor is the vessel; the two sphyas are the shoulders; the two poles are the back-parts.

children.text: āntrāṇi jatravo gudā varatrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The intestines, the collarbones, and the entrails are the straps.

children.text: iyam eva pṛthivī kumbhī bhavati rādhyamānasyaudanasya dyaur apidhānam ||
children.translated_text: This very earth becomes the cooking pot for the <s>odana</s> as it is being cooked; heaven is the lid.

children.text: sītāḥ parśavaḥ sikatā ūbadhyam ||
children.translated_text: The furrows are the ribs; the sands are the binding.

children.text: ṛtaṃ hastāvanejanaṃ kulyopasecanam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ṛta</s> is the water for washing the hands; the canal is the sprinkling water.

children.text: ṛcā kumbhy adhihitārtvijyena preṣitā ||
children.translated_text: The pot is set upon the ṛc-verses and impelled by priestly service.

children.text: brahmaṇā parigṛhītā sāmnā paryūḍhā ||
children.translated_text: It is enclosed by <s>brahman</s> and surrounded by the sāman.

children.text: bṛhad āyavanaṃ rathantaraṃ darviḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Bṛhat is the fanning implement; the Rathantara is the ladle.

children.text: ṛtavaḥ paktāra ārtavāḥ samindhate ||
children.translated_text: The seasons are the cooks; the seasonal divisions kindle it.

children.text: caruṃ pañcabilam ukhaṃ gharmo 'bhīndhe ||
children.translated_text: The heated vessel warms the five-holed pot of the caru-oblation.

children.text: odanena yajñavataḥ sarve lokāḥ samāpyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Through the <s>odana</s>, all worlds are to be attained by the one who possesses sacrifice.

children.text: yasmint samudro dyaur bhūmis trayo 'varaparaṃ śritāḥ ||
children.translated_text: In which the ocean, heaven, and earth, the three, lower and higher, have taken refuge,

children.text: yasya devā akalpantocchiṣṭe ṣaḍ aśītayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in whose remainder the gods fashioned the eighty-six,

children.text: taṃ tvaudanasya pṛcchāmi yo asya mahimā mahān ||
children.translated_text: that <s>odana</s> I ask you about, whose greatness is great.

children.text: sa ya odanasya mahimānaṃ vidyāt ||
children.translated_text: He who knows the greatness of the <s>odana</s>

children.text: nālpa iti brūyān nānupasecana iti nedaṃ ca kiṃceti ||
children.translated_text: should not say, 'It is small,' nor 'It has no sauce,' nor 'This is nothing at all.'

children.text: yāvad dātābhimanasyeta tan nāti vadet ||
children.translated_text: As much as the giver may value it in his mind, he should not speak beyond that.

children.text: brahmavādino vadanti parāñcam odanaṃ prāśīḥ pratyañcam iti ||
children.translated_text: The expounders of <s>brahman</s> say, 'Did you eat the <s>odana</s> facing away, or facing toward yourself?'

children.text: tvam odanaṃ prāśīs tvām odanā iti ||
children.translated_text: 'You ate the <s>odana</s>; the <s>odanas</s> ate you.'

children.text: parāñcaṃ cainaṃ prāśīḥ prāṇās tvā hāsyantīty enam āha ||
children.translated_text: If you ate it facing away, he says to him, 'The breaths will leave you.'

children.text: pratyañcaṃ cainaṃ prāśīr apānās tvā hāsyantīty enam āha ||
children.translated_text: If you ate it facing toward yourself, he says to him, 'The down-breaths will leave you.'

children.text: naivāham odanaṃ na mām odanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: 'I did not eat the <s>odana</s>, nor did the <s>odana</s> eat me.

children.text: odana evaudanaṃ prāśīt ||
children.translated_text: The <s>odana</s> itself ate the <s>odana</s>.'

children.text: tataś cainam anyena śīrṣṇā prāśīr yena caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
children.translated_text: Then, if you ate it with another head than that with which the former seers ate it,

children.text: jyeṣṭhatas te prajā mariṣyatīty enam āha
children.translated_text: he says to him, 'Your eldest offspring will die.'

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: 'But I ate it neither facing this way, nor facing away, nor facing toward myself,

children.text: bṛhaspatinā śīrṣṇā
children.translated_text: but with <s>Bṛhaspati</s> as the head.

children.text: tenainaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tenainam ajīgamam
children.translated_text: With that I ate it; with that I gained it.'

children.text: eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> is indeed all-limbed, all-jointed, all-bodied.

children.text: sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ sambhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: All-limbed, all-jointed, all-bodied becomes the one who knows thus.

children.text: tataś cainam anyābhyāṃ śrotrābhyāṃ prāśīr yābhyāṃ caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
children.translated_text: Then, if you ate it with other ears than those with which the former seers ate it,

children.text: badhiro bhaviṣyasīty enam āha
children.translated_text: he says to him, 'You will become deaf.'

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: 'But I ate it neither facing this way, nor facing away, nor facing toward myself,

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ śrotrābhyām
children.translated_text: but with heaven and earth as the two ears.

children.text: tābhyām enaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tābhyām enam ajīgamam
children.translated_text: With them I ate it; with them I gained it.'

children.text: eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> is indeed all-limbed, all-jointed, all-bodied.

children.text: sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ sambhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: All-limbed, all-jointed, all-bodied becomes the one who knows thus.

children.text: tataś cainam anyābhyām akṣībhyāṃ prāśīr yābhyāṃ caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
children.translated_text: Then, if you ate it with other eyes than those with which the former seers ate it,

children.text: andho bhaviṣyasīty enam āha
children.translated_text: He says to him, "You will become blind."

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: But I did not eat it turned toward, nor turned away, nor turned back.

children.text: sūryācandramasābhyām akṣībhyām
children.translated_text: I ate it with <s>Sūrya</s> and <s>Candramas</s> as my two eyes;

children.text: tābhyām enaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tābhyām enam ajīgamam
children.translated_text: with those two I ate it, with those two I made it come to me.

children.text: eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> (cooked rice offering) is indeed all-limbed, all-jointed, all-bodied.

children.text: sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ sambhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: All-limbed, all-jointed, all-bodied indeed becomes the one who knows thus.

children.text: tataś cainam anyena mukhena prāśīr yena caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
children.translated_text: Then you ate it with another mouth than that with which the former seers ate it.

children.text: mukhatas te prajā mariṣyatīty enam āha
children.translated_text: He says to him, "Your offspring will die from the mouth."

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: But I did not eat it turned toward, nor turned away, nor turned back.

children.text: brahmaṇā mukhena
children.translated_text: I ate it with <s>brahman</s> as my mouth;

children.text: tenainaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tenainam ajīgamam
children.translated_text: with that I ate it, with that I made it come to me.

children.text: eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> (cooked rice offering) is indeed all-limbed, all-jointed, all-bodied.

children.text: sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ sambhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: All-limbed, all-jointed, all-bodied indeed becomes the one who knows thus.

children.text: tataś cainam anyayā jihvayā prāśīr yayā caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
children.translated_text: Then you ate it with another tongue than that with which the former seers ate it.

children.text: jihvā te mariṣyatīty enam āha
children.translated_text: He says to him, "Your tongue will die."

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: But I did not eat it turned toward, nor turned away, nor turned back.

children.text: agner jihvayā
children.translated_text: I ate it with the tongue of <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: tayainaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tayainam ajīgamam
children.translated_text: with that I ate it, with that I made it come to me.

children.text: eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> (cooked rice offering) is indeed all-limbed, all-jointed, all-bodied.

children.text: sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ sambhavati ya evaṃ veda ||

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam

children.text: apsu mariṣyasīty enam āha

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam

children.text: tataś cainam anyābhyām ūrubhyāṃ prāśīr yābhyāṃ caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan

children.text: ūrū te mariṣyata ity enam āha
children.translated_text: He says to him, "Your two thighs will die."

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: But I did not eat it turned toward, nor turned away, nor turned back.

children.translated_text: I ate it with the two thighs of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>;

children.text: tābhyām enaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tābhyām enam ajīgamam

children.translated_text: Then you ate it with other two knees than those with which the former seers ate it.

children.text: srāmo bhaviṣyasīty enam āha
children.translated_text: He says to him, "You will become lame."

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: But I did not eat it turned toward, nor turned away, nor turned back.

children.text: tvaṣṭur aṣṭhīvadbhyām
children.translated_text: I ate it with the two knees of <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>.

children.text: tābhyām enaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tābhyām enam ajīgamam
children.translated_text: With those two I ate it; with those two I reached it.

children.text: eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> is indeed all-limbed, all-jointed, and entire in body.

children.text: sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ sambhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: All-limbed, all-jointed, and entire in body indeed becomes the one who knows this.

children.translated_text: Then, with the other two feet with which the former seers ate this, you ate it.

children.text: bahucārī bhaviṣyasīty enam āha
children.translated_text: He says to him, 'You will become one who wanders much.'

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: I did not approach it turned hither, nor turned away, nor turned backward.

children.text: aśvinoḥ pādābhyām
children.translated_text: I approached it with the feet of the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: tābhyām enaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tābhyām enam ajīgamam
children.translated_text: With those two I ate it; with those two I reached it.

children.text: eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> is indeed all-limbed, all-jointed, and entire in body.

children.text: sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ saṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: All-limbed, all-jointed, and entire in body indeed becomes the one who knows this.

children.text: sarpas tvā haniṣyatīty enam āha
children.translated_text: He says to him, 'A serpent will strike you.'

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: I did not approach it turned hither, nor turned away, nor turned backward.

children.translated_text: With those two I ate it; with those two I reached it.

children.text: eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> is indeed all-limbed, all-jointed, and entire in body.

children.translated_text: Then, with the other two hands with which the former seers ate this, you ate it.

children.text: brāhmaṇaṃ haniṣyasīty enam āha
children.translated_text: He says to him, 'You will strike a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>.'

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: I did not approach it turned hither, nor turned away, nor turned backward.

children.text: ṛtasya hastābhyām
children.translated_text: I approached it with the hands of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: tābhyām enaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tābhyām enam ajīgamam
children.translated_text: With those two I ate it; with those two I reached it.

children.text: eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> is indeed all-limbed, all-jointed, and entire in body.

children.translated_text: All-limbed, all-jointed, and entire in body indeed becomes the one who knows this.

children.text: tataś cainam anyayā pratiṣṭhayā prāśīr yayā caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
children.translated_text: Then, with the other foundation with which the former seers ate this, you ate it.

children.text: apratiṣṭhāno 'nāyatano mariṣyasīty enam āha
children.translated_text: He says to him, 'Without foundation, without abode, you will die.'

children.text: taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
children.translated_text: I did not approach it turned hither, nor turned away, nor turned backward.

children.text: satye pratiṣṭhāya
children.translated_text: I approached it with foundation in truth.

children.text: tayainaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tayainam ajīgamam
children.translated_text: With that I ate it; with that I reached it.

children.text: eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> is indeed all-limbed, all-jointed, and entire in body.

children.text: sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ saṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: All-limbed, all-jointed, and entire in body indeed becomes the one who knows this.

children.text: etad vai bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ yad odanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This <s>odana</s> is indeed the summit of <s>Bradhna</s>.

children.text: bradhnaloko bhavati bradhnasya viṣṭapi śrayate ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: He comes to have the world of <s>Bradhna</s>; he rests upon the summit of <s>Bradhna</s>, who knows this.

children.text: etasmād vā odanāt trayastriṃśataṃ lokān niramimīta prajāpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: From this <s>odana</s>, <s>Prajāpati</s> fashioned the thirty-three worlds.

children.text: teṣāṃ prajñānāya yajñam asṛjata ||
children.translated_text: For the knowing of them he created the sacrifice.

children.text: sa ya evaṃ viduṣa upadraṣṭā bhavati prāṇaṃ ruṇaddhi ||
children.translated_text: Whoever becomes an assailant of one who knows thus cuts off his own breath.

children.text: na ca prāṇaṃ ruṇaddhi sarvajyāniṃ jīyate ||
children.translated_text: And not only does he cut off his breath; he suffers the loss of everything.

children.text: na ca sarvajyāniṃ jīyate purainaṃ jarasaḥ prāṇo jahāti ||
children.translated_text: And not only does he suffer the loss of everything; before old age his breath leaves him.

children.text: Chapter 462
prāṇāya namo yasya sarvam idaṃ vaśe
children.translated_text: Homage to <s>Prāṇa</s>, in whose power all this stands,

children.text: yo bhūtaḥ sarvasyeśvaro yasmint sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
children.translated_text: who has come into being, lord of all, in whom everything is established.

children.text: namas te prāṇa krandāya namas te stanayitnave
children.translated_text: Homage to you, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, when you roar; homage to you when you thunder.

children.text: namas te prāṇa vidyute namas te prāṇa varṣate ||
children.translated_text: Homage to you, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, when you lighten; homage to you, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, when you rain.

children.text: yat prāṇa stanayitnunābhikrandaty oṣadhīḥ
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, with thunder you roar over the plants,

children.text: pravīyante garbhān dadhate 'tho bahvīr vijāyante ||
children.translated_text: they are abundantly strengthened, they take embryos, and then they are born in great numbers.

children.text: yat prāṇa ṛtāv āgate 'bhikrandaty oṣadhīḥ
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, at the coming of the season, you roar over the plants,

children.text: sarvaṃ tadā pramodate yat kiṃca bhūmyām adhi ||
children.translated_text: then everything rejoices, whatever is upon the earth.

children.text: yadā prāṇo abhyavarṣīd varṣeṇa pṛthivīṃ mahīm
children.translated_text: When <s>Prāṇa</s> has rained upon the great earth with rain,

children.text: paśavas tat pramodante maho vai no bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: the animals rejoice at it, saying, 'There will indeed be greatness for us.'

children.text: abhivṛṣṭā oṣadhayaḥ prāṇena sam avādiran
children.translated_text: The plants, rained upon, spoke together with <s>Prāṇa</s>:

children.text: āyur vai naḥ prātītaraḥ sarvā naḥ surabhīr akaḥ ||
children.translated_text: 'You have indeed carried our life forward; you have made us all fragrant.'

children.text: namas te astv āyate namo astu parāyate
children.translated_text: Homage be to you as you come; homage be to you as you go away.

children.text: namas te prāṇa tiṣṭhata āsīnāyota te namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Homage to you, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, as you stand, and homage also to you as you sit.

children.text: namas te prāṇa prāṇate namo astv apānate
children.translated_text: Homage to you, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, as you breathe in; homage be to you as you breathe out.

children.text: parācīnāya te namaḥ pratīcīnāya te namaḥ sarvasmai ta idaṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Homage to you as you go away; homage to you as you come back. To you in every form is this homage.

children.text: yā te prāṇa priyā tanūr yo te prāṇa preyasī
children.translated_text: That dear body of yours, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, and that most beloved one of yours, O <s>Prāṇa</s>,

children.text: atho yad bheṣajaṃ tava tasya no dhehi jīvase ||
children.translated_text: and whatever healing power is yours, bestow that upon us so that we may live.

children.text: prāṇaḥ prajā anu vaste pitā putram iva priyam
children.translated_text: <s>Prāṇa</s> clothes the creatures as a father clothes his beloved son.

children.text: prāṇo ha sarvasyeśvaro yac ca prāṇati yac ca na ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prāṇa</s> indeed is lord of all, of what breathes and what does not.

children.text: prāṇo mṛtyuḥ prāṇas takmā prāṇaṃ devā upāsate
children.translated_text: <s>Prāṇa</s> is death; <s>Prāṇa</s> is fever; the gods worship <s>Prāṇa</s>.

children.text: prāṇo ha satyavādinam uttame loka ā dadhat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prāṇa</s> indeed places the truth-speaker in the highest world.

children.text: prāṇo virāṭ prāṇo deṣṭrī prāṇaṃ sarva upāsate
children.translated_text: <s>Prāṇa</s> is <s>Virāj</s>; <s>Prāṇa</s> is the guide; all worship <s>Prāṇa</s>.

children.text: prāṇo ha sūryaś candramāḥ prāṇam āhuḥ prajāpatim ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prāṇa</s> indeed is the sun and the moon; they call <s>Prāṇa</s> <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: prāṇāpānau vrīhiyavāv anaḍvān prāṇa ucyate
children.translated_text: The in-breath and out-breath are rice and barley; the ox is called <s>Prāṇa</s>.

children.text: yave ha prāṇa āhito 'pāno vrīhir ucyate ||
children.translated_text: In barley, indeed, <s>Prāṇa</s> is placed; rice is called <s>Apāna</s>.

children.text: apānati prāṇati puruṣo garbhe antarā
children.translated_text: A person breathes out and breathes in within the womb.

children.text: yadā tvaṃ prāṇa jinvasy atha sa jāyate punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When you quicken him, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, then he is born again.

children.text: prāṇam āhur mātariśvānaṃ vāto ha prāṇa ucyate
children.translated_text: They call <s>Prāṇa</s> <s>Mātariśvan</s>; the wind indeed is called <s>Prāṇa</s>.

children.text: prāṇe ha bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ ca prāṇe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
children.translated_text: In <s>Prāṇa</s> the past and the future, in <s>Prāṇa</s> everything is established.

children.text: ātharvaṇīr āṅgirasīr daivīr manuṣyajā uta
children.translated_text: Atharvanic, Angirasic, divine, and also human-born

children.text: oṣadhayaḥ pra jāyante yadā tvaṃ prāṇa jinvasi ||
children.translated_text: plants are born when you, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, quicken them.

children.text: yadā prāṇo abhyavarṣīd varṣeṇa pṛthivīṃ mahīm
children.translated_text: When <s>Prāṇa</s> has rained upon the great earth with rain,

children.text: oṣadhayaḥ prajāyante 'tho yāḥ kāś ca vīrudhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the plants are born, and then whatever creeping plants there are.

children.text: yas te prāṇedaṃ veda yasmiṃś cāsi pratiṣṭhitaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever knows this of yours, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, and that in which you are established,

children.text: sarve tasmai baliṃ harān amuṣmiṃl loka uttame ||
children.translated_text: may all bring tribute to him in that highest world.

children.text: yathā prāṇa balihṛtas tubhyaṃ sarvāḥ prajā imāḥ
children.translated_text: Just as, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, all these creatures are tribute-bearers to you,

children.text: evā tasmai baliṃ harān yas tvā śṛṇavat suśravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus may we bring tribute to him, whoever shall hear you, O well-famed one.

children.text: antar garbhaś carati devatāsv ābhūto bhūtaḥ sa u jāyate punaḥ
children.translated_text: The embryo moves within the deities; having become manifest, the being is born again.

children.text: sa bhūto bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyat pitā putraṃ pra viveśā śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: As the being, he entered the future and what is to be; the father entered the son with his powers.

children.text: ekaṃ pādaṃ notkhidati salilāddhaṃsa uccaran
children.translated_text: The swan, rising up from the waters, does not tear up one foot.

children.text: yad aṅga sa tam utkhiden naivādya na śvaḥ syāt
children.translated_text: If, indeed, he were to tear that one up, there would be neither today nor tomorrow.

children.text: na rātrī nāhaḥ syān na vyucchet kadācana ||
children.translated_text: There would be neither night nor day, nor would dawn ever break.

children.text: aṣṭācakraṃ vartata ekanemi sahasrākṣaraṃ pra puro ni paścā
children.translated_text: The eight-wheeled, single-rimmed one turns, with a thousand spokes, forward in front and down behind.

children.text: ardhena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna yad asyārdhaṃ katamaḥ sa ketuḥ ||
children.translated_text: With one half he generated the whole world; as for his other half, what sign is that?

children.text: yo asya viśvajanmana īśe viśvasya ceṣṭataḥ
children.translated_text: He who rules over this one born of all, and over everything that moves in the universe,

children.text: anyeṣu kṣipradhanvane tasmai prāṇa namo 'stu te ||
children.translated_text: to you, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, swift-bowed among others, let there be homage.

children.text: yo asya sarvajanmana īśe sarvasya ceṣṭataḥ
children.translated_text: He who rules over this one born of all, and over all that moves,

children.text: atandro brahmaṇā dhīraḥ prāṇo mānutiṣṭhatu ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Prāṇa</s>, tireless, wise through <s>brahman</s> (sacred power), stand firm after me.

children.text: ūrdhvaḥ supteṣu jāgāra nanu tiryaṅ nipadyate
children.translated_text: Upright, he has kept watch among those who sleep; he does not lie down crosswise.

children.text: na suptam asya supteṣv anu śuśrāva kaścana ||
children.translated_text: No one among the sleepers has ever heard of him sleeping.

children.text: prāṇa mā mat paryāvṛto na mad anyo bhaviṣyasi
children.translated_text: O <s>Prāṇa</s>, do not turn away from me; you shall not become other than me.

children.text: apāṃ garbham iva jīvase prāṇa badhnāmi tvā mayi ||
children.translated_text: For life, as an embryo of the waters, O <s>Prāṇa</s>, I bind you within myself.

children.text: Chapter 463
brahmacārīṣṇaṃś carati rodasī ubhe tasmin devāḥ saṃmanaso bhavanti
children.translated_text: The <s>brahmacārin</s> (Vedic student) moves heating both heaven and earth; in him the gods become of one mind.

children.text: sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ divaṃ ca sa ācāryaṃ tapasā piparti ||
children.translated_text: He has upheld earth and heaven; by tapas (ascetic heat) he nourishes the ācārya (teacher).

children.text: brahmacāriṇaṃ pitaro devajanāḥ pṛthag devā anusaṃyanti sarve
children.translated_text: The Fathers, the divine peoples, and all the gods separately follow the <s>brahmacārin</s>.

children.text: gandharvā enam anv āyan trayastriṃśat triśatāḥ ṣaṭsahasrāḥ sarvānt sa devāṃs tapasā piparti ||
children.translated_text: The Gandharvas followed him, thirty-three, three hundred, and six thousand; he nourishes all the gods by tapas.

children.text: ācārya upanayamāno brahmacāriṇaṃ kṛṇute garbham antaḥ
children.translated_text: The ācārya, initiating the <s>brahmacārin</s>, makes him an embryo within himself.

children.text: taṃ rātrīs tisra udare bibharti taṃ jātaṃ draṣṭum abhisaṃyanti devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: For three nights he bears him in his belly; when he is born, the gods come together to see him.

children.text: iyaṃ samit pṛthivī dyaur dvitīyotāntarikṣaṃ samidhā pṛṇāti
children.translated_text: This earth is the first fuel-stick, heaven the second; and the midspace fills him with fuel.

children.text: brahmacārī samidhā mekhalayā śrameṇa lokāṃs tapasā piparti ||
children.translated_text: With fuel-stick, girdle, labor, and tapas, the <s>brahmacārin</s> nourishes the worlds.

children.text: pūrvo jāto brahmaṇo brahmacārī gharmaṃ vasānas tapasodatiṣṭhat
children.translated_text: Born before <s>brahman</s>, the <s>brahmacārin</s>, clothed in heat, arose through tapas.

children.text: tasmāj jātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brahma jyeṣṭhaṃ devāś ca sarve amṛtena sākam ||
children.translated_text: From him was born the brāhmaṇa, and <s>brahman</s> the eldest, together with all the gods and immortality.

children.text: brahmacāry eti samidhā samiddhaḥ kārṣṇaṃ vasāno dīkṣito dīrghaśmaśruḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>brahmacārin</s> goes, kindled with fuel, wearing the black antelope skin, consecrated, long-bearded.

children.text: sa sadya eti pūrvasmād uttaraṃ samudraṃ lokānt saṃgṛbhya muhur ācarikrat ||
children.translated_text: At once he goes from the eastern to the northern ocean; grasping the worlds, again and again he strides about.

children.text: brahmacārī janayan brahmāpo lokaṃ prajāpatiṃ parameṣṭhinaṃ virājam
children.translated_text: The <s>brahmacārin</s>, generating <s>brahman</s>, the waters, the world, <s>Prajāpati</s>, <s>Parameṣṭhin</s>, and <s>Virāj</s>,

children.text: garbho bhūtvāmṛtasya yonāv indro ha bhūtvāsurāṃs tatarha ||
children.translated_text: having become an embryo in the womb of immortality, and indeed having become <s>Indra</s>, struck down the Asuras.

children.text: ācāryas tatakṣa nabhasī ubhe ime urvī gambhīre pṛthivīṃ divaṃ ca
children.translated_text: The ācārya fashioned these two expanses, broad and deep, earth and heaven.

children.text: te rakṣati tapasā brahmacārī tasmin devāḥ saṃmanaso bhavanti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>brahmacārin</s> protects them by tapas; in him the gods become of one mind.

children.text: imāṃ bhūmiṃ pṛthivīṃ brahmacārī bhikṣām ā jabhāra prathamo divaṃ ca
children.translated_text: The <s>brahmacārin</s> was the first to bring this ground, the earth, as alms, and heaven too.

children.text: te kṛtvā samidhāv upāste tayor ārpitā bhuvanāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: Having made them fuel-sticks, he attends upon them; on those two all the worlds are set.

children.text: arvāg anyaḥ paro anyo divas pṛṣṭhād guhā nidhī nihitau brāhmaṇasya
children.translated_text: One is on this side, the other beyond the back of heaven; the two hidden treasures of the brāhmaṇa are deposited in a secret place.

children.text: tau rakṣati tapasā brahmacārī tat kevalaṃ kṛṇute brahma vidvān ||
children.translated_text: The <s>brahmacārin</s> protects them by tapas; knowing <s>brahman</s>, he makes that his own alone.

children.text: arvāg anya ito anyaḥ pṛthivyā agnī sameto nabhasī antareme
children.translated_text: One is on this side, the other on this side of earth; the two fires have come together within these two expanses.

children.text: tayoḥ śrayante raśmayo 'dhi dṛḍhās tān ā tiṣṭhati tapasā brahmacārī ||
children.translated_text: Upon them the rays rest, firmly fixed; the <s>brahmacārin</s> mounts them by tapas.

children.text: abhikrandan stanayann aruṇaḥ śitiṅgo bṛhac chepo 'nu bhūmau jabhāra
children.translated_text: Bellowing, thundering, ruddy, white-marked, with great generative force, he carried it upon the earth.

children.text: brahmacārī siñcati sānau retaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tena jīvanti pradiśaś catasraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>brahmacārin</s> pours seed upon the summit; through that the four regions live upon the earth.

children.text: agnau sūrye candramasi mātariśvan brahmacāry apsu samidham ā dadhāti
children.translated_text: In <s>Agni</s>, in the sun, in the moon, in <s>Mātariśvan</s>, and in the waters, the <s>brahmacārin</s> places fuel.

children.text: tāsām arcīṃṣi pṛthag abhre caranti tāsām ājyaṃ puruṣo varṣam āpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Their flames move separately in the cloud; their ghee is the person, the rain, and the waters.

children.text: ācāryo mṛtyur varuṇaḥ soma oṣadhayaḥ payaḥ
children.translated_text: The ācārya was death, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Soma</s>, the plants, and milk.

children.text: jīmūtā āsant satvānas tair idaṃ svar ābhṛtam ||
children.translated_text: The clouds were the strong beings; by them this heaven was brought here.

children.text: amā ghṛtaṃ kṛṇute kevalam ācāryo bhūtvā varuṇaḥ
children.translated_text: At home he makes ghee, alone, after becoming the ācārya, <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: yadyad aicchat prajāpatau tad brahmacārī prāyacchat svān mitro adhy ātmanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whatever he desired in <s>Prajāpati</s>, that the <s>brahmacārin</s> bestowed; <s>Mitra</s>, from his own self, presided over it.

children.text: ācāryo brahmacārī brahmacārī prajāpatiḥ
children.translated_text: The ācārya is the <s>brahmacārin</s>; the <s>brahmacārin</s> is <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: prajāpatir virājati virāḍ indro 'bhavad vaśī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> shines forth; <s>Virāj</s> became <s>Indra</s>, the master.

children.text: brahmacaryeṇa tapasā rājā rāṣṭraṃ virakṣati
children.translated_text: By <s>brahmacarya</s> (disciplined studentship) and tapas, the king protects the kingdom.

children.text: ācāryo brahmacaryeṇa brahmacāriṇam icchate ||
children.translated_text: By <s>brahmacarya</s> the ācārya seeks a <s>brahmacārin</s>.

children.text: brahmacaryeṇa kanyā yuvānaṃ vindate patim
children.translated_text: By <s>brahmacarya</s> a maiden finds a young husband.

children.text: anaḍvān brahmacaryeṇāśvo ghāsaṃ jigīṣati ||
children.translated_text: By <s>brahmacarya</s> the bull, and the horse, seeks to win fodder.

children.text: brahmacaryeṇa tapasā devā mṛtyum apāghnata
children.translated_text: By <s>brahmacarya</s> and tapas the gods drove away death.

children.text: indro ha brahmacaryeṇa devebhyaḥ svar ābharat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, indeed, by <s>brahmacarya</s>, brought heaven's light to the gods.

children.text: oṣadhayo bhūtabhavyam ahorātre vanaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: The plants, what has been and what will be, day and night, and the forest tree,

children.text: saṃvatsaraḥ saha ṛtubhis te jātā brahmacāriṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the year together with the seasons: these were born from the <s>brahmacārin</s>.

children.text: pārthivā divyāḥ paśava āraṇyā grāmyāś ca ye
children.translated_text: The earthly and heavenly animals, those of the forest and those of the village,

children.text: apakṣāḥ pakṣiṇaś ca ye te jātā brahmacāriṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: those without wings and those with wings: these were born from the <s>brahmacārin</s>.

children.text: pṛthak sarve prājāpatyāḥ prāṇān ātmasu bibhrati
children.translated_text: All the separate offspring of <s>Prajāpati</s> bear breaths in their own selves.

children.text: tānt sarvān brahma rakṣati brahmacāriṇy ābhṛtam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Brahman</s> protects all of them, brought into the <s>brahmacārin</s>.

children.text: devānām etat pariṣūtam anabhyārūḍhaṃ carati rocamānam
children.translated_text: This, filtered out from the gods, unmounted by others, moves shining.

children.text: tasmāj jātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brahma jyeṣṭhaṃ devāś ca sarve amṛtena sākam ||
children.translated_text: From it was born the brāhmaṇa, and <s>brahman</s> the eldest, together with all the gods and immortality.

children.text: brahmacārī brahma bhrājad bibharti tasmin devā adhi viśve samotāḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>brahmacārī</s> (Vedic celibate student), shining with <s>brahman</s>, bears <s>brahman</s>; in him all the gods are gathered together.

children.text: prāṇāpānau janayann ād vyānaṃ vācaṃ mano hṛdayaṃ brahma medhām ||
children.translated_text: Generating <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s>, then <s>vyāna</s>, speech, mind, heart, <s>brahman</s>, and inspired understanding,

children.text: cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ yaśo asmāsu dhehy annaṃ reto lohitam udaram ||
children.translated_text: place in us sight, hearing, renown, food, seed, blood, and belly.

children.text: tāni kalpad brahmacārī salilasya pṛṣṭhe tapo 'tiṣṭhat tapyamānaḥ samudre
children.translated_text: Having fashioned those things, the <s>brahmacārī</s> stood with austerity on the back of the waters, heating himself in the ocean.

children.text: sa snāto babhruḥ piṅgalaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bahu rocate ||
children.translated_text: He, bathed, brown and tawny, shines widely upon the earth.

children.text: Chapter 464
agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn oṣadhīr uta vīrudhaḥ
children.translated_text: We call upon <s>Agni</s>, the forest trees, the healing herbs, and also the plants;

children.text: indraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sūryaṃ te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: upon <s>Indra</s>, <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, and <s>Sūrya</s>; may they release us from distress.

children.text: brūmo rājānaṃ varuṇaṃ mitraṃ viṣṇum atho bhagam
children.translated_text: We call upon king <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and also <s>Bhaga</s>;

children.text: aṃśaṃ vivasvantaṃ brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we call upon <s>Aṃśa</s> and <s>Vivasvant</s>; may they release us from distress.

children.text: brūmo devaṃ savitāraṃ dhātāram uta pūṣaṇam
children.translated_text: We call upon the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, upon <s>Dhātṛ</s>, and also upon <s>Pūṣan</s>;

children.text: tvaṣṭāram agriyaṃ brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we call upon foremost <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>; may they release us from distress.

children.text: gandharvāpsaraso brūmo aśvinā brahmaṇaspatim
children.translated_text: We call upon the <s>Gandharvas</s> and <s>Apsarases</s>, the two <s>Aśvins</s>, and <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>;

children.text: aryamā nāma yo devas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the god whose name is <s>Aryaman</s>; may they release us from distress.

children.text: ahorātre idaṃ brūmaḥ sūryācandramasāv ubhā
children.translated_text: We call upon day and night, and both <s>Sūrya</s> and the moon;

children.text: viśvān ādityān brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we call upon all the <s>Ādityas</s>; may they release us from distress.

children.text: vātaṃ brūmaḥ parjanyam antarikṣam atho diśaḥ
children.translated_text: We call upon the wind, <s>Parjanya</s>, the midspace, and also the quarters;

children.text: āśāś ca sarvā brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we call upon all the regions; may they release us from distress.

children.text: muñcantu mā śapathyād ahorātre atho uṣāḥ
children.translated_text: May day and night, and also the dawns, release me from the curse;

children.text: somo mā devo muñcatu yam āhuś candramā iti ||
children.translated_text: may the god <s>Soma</s>, whom they call the moon, release me.

children.text: pārthivā divyāḥ paśava āraṇyā uta ye mṛgāḥ
children.translated_text: The earthly and heavenly animals, the forest creatures, and whatever wild beasts there are,

children.text: śakuntān pakṣiṇo brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the birds and winged creatures we call upon; may they release us from distress.

children.text: bhavāśarvāv idaṃ brūmo rudraṃ paśupatiś ca yaḥ
children.translated_text: We call upon <s>Bhava</s> and <s>Śarva</s>, and <s>Rudra</s>, who is also <s>Paśupati</s>;

children.text: iṣūr yā eṣāṃ saṃvidma tā naḥ santu sadā śivāḥ ||
children.translated_text: whatever arrows of theirs we know, may those always be auspicious for us.

children.text: divaṃ brūmo nakṣatrāṇi bhūmiṃ yakṣāṇi parvatān
children.translated_text: We call upon heaven, the stars, earth, the spirits, and the mountains;

children.text: samudrā nadyo veśantās te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the oceans, rivers, and pools; may they release us from distress.

children.text: saptaṛṣīn vā idaṃ brūmo 'po devīḥ prajāpatim
children.translated_text: We call upon the seven seers, the divine waters, and <s>Prajāpati</s>;

children.text: pitṝn yamaśreṣṭhān brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we call upon the Fathers, foremost with <s>Yama</s>; may they release us from distress.

children.text: ye devā diviṣado antarikṣasadaś ca ye
children.translated_text: Those gods who dwell in heaven, and those who dwell in the midspace,

children.text: pṛthivyāṃ śakrā ye śritās te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the mighty ones who have taken refuge on earth, may they release us from distress.

children.text: ādityā rudrā vasavo divi devā atharvāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, <s>Vasus</s>, the gods in heaven, and the <s>Atharvans</s>,

children.text: aṅgiraso manīṣiṇas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the inspired <s>Aṅgirases</s>: may they release us from distress.

children.text: yajñaṃ brūmo yajamānam ṛcaḥ sāmāni bheṣajā
children.translated_text: We call upon the sacrifice, the sacrificer, the verses, the chants, and the remedies;

children.text: yajūṃṣi hotrā brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we call upon the sacrificial formulas and priestly functions; may they release us from distress.

children.text: pañca rājyāni vīrudhāṃ somaśreṣṭhāni brūmaḥ
children.translated_text: We call upon the five kingdoms of plants, whose chief is <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: darbho bhaṅgo yavaḥ sahas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>darbha</s> grass, hemp, barley, and <s>saha</s> grass; may they release us from distress.

children.text: arāyān brūmo rakṣāṃsi sarpān puṇyajanān pitṝn
children.translated_text: We call upon hostile beings, demons, serpents, blessed spirits, and the Fathers;

children.text: mṛtyūn ekaśataṃ brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we call upon the one hundred and one deaths; may they release us from distress.

children.text: ṛtūn brūma ṛtupatīn ārtavān uta hāyanān
children.translated_text: We call upon the seasons, the lords of the seasons, the seasonal times, and the years;

children.text: samāḥ saṃvatsarān māsāṃs te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the years, the full years, and the months; may they release us from distress.

children.text: eta devā dakṣiṇataḥ paścāt prāñca udeta
children.translated_text: Come, gods, from the south, from the west; rise up here from the east;

children.text: purastād uttarācchakrā viśve devāḥ sametya te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: from the front and from the north, mighty ones, all the gods gathered together, may they release us from distress.

children.text: viśvān devān idaṃ brūmaḥ satyasaṃdhān ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: We call upon all the gods, true to their bonds and increasers of truth;

children.text: viśvābhiḥ patnībhiḥ saha te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: together with all their wives, may they release us from distress.

children.text: sarvān devān idaṃ brūmaḥ satyasaṃdhān ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: We call upon every god, true to their bonds and increasers of truth;

children.text: sarvābhiḥ patnībhiḥ saha te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: together with all their wives, may they release us from distress.

children.text: bhūtaṃ brūmo bhūtapatiṃ bhūtānām uta yo vaśī
children.translated_text: We call upon being, the lord of beings, and the one who rules beings;

children.text: bhūtāni sarvā saṃgatya te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: all beings, having assembled together, may they release us from distress.

children.text: yā devīḥ pañca pradiśo ye devā dvādaśa ṛtavaḥ
children.translated_text: The divine five directions, and the gods who are the twelve seasons of the year,

children.text: saṃvatsarasya ye daṃṣṭrās te naḥ santu sadā śivāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the fangs of the year, may they always be auspicious for us.

children.text: yan mātalī rathakrītam amṛtaṃ veda bheṣajam
children.translated_text: The immortal remedy that <s>Mātali</s> knew, won by the chariot,

children.text: tad indro apsu prāveśayat tad āpo datta bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: that <s>Indra</s> placed in the waters; O waters, give that remedy.

children.text: Chapter 465
ucchiṣṭe nāma rūpaṃ cocchiṣṭe loka āhitaḥ
children.translated_text: In the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s> (sacrificial remainder) are name and form, and in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s> the world is established.

children.text: ucchiṣṭa indraś cāgniś ca viśvam antaḥ samāhitam ||
children.translated_text: In the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s> are <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>; the whole universe is gathered within it.

children.text: ucchiṣṭe dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ samāhitam
children.translated_text: In the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s> heaven and earth and every being are gathered;

children.text: āpaḥ samudra ucchiṣṭe candramā vāta āhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the waters, the ocean, the moon, and the wind are established in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: sann ucchiṣṭe asaṃś cobhau mṛtyur vājaḥ prajāpatiḥ
children.translated_text: In the existent <s>ucchiṣṭa</s> are both being and non-being, death, strength, and <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: laukyā ucchiṣṭa āyattā vraś ca draś cāpi śrīr mayi ||
children.translated_text: Worldly things depend on the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>; growth and movement, and also splendor, are in me.

children.text: dṛḍho dṛṃha sthiro nyo brahma viśvasṛjo daśa
children.translated_text: Firm, strengthening, stable, set below, are <s>brahman</s> and the ten creators of all;

children.text: nābhim iva sarvataś cakram ucchiṣṭe devatāḥ śritāḥ ||
children.translated_text: like a wheel around the nave on every side, the deities rest in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: ṛk sāma yajur ucchiṣṭa udgīthaḥ prastutaṃ stutam
children.translated_text: The <s>Ṛc</s>, <s>Sāman</s>, and <s>Yajus</s> are in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>; the <s>udgītha</s>, the <s>prastuta</s>, and the <s>stuta</s>,

children.text: hiṅkāra ucchiṣṭe svaraḥ sāmno meḍiś ca tan mayi ||
children.translated_text: the <s>hiṅkāra</s>, the tone, and the peg of the <s>Sāman</s> are in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>; may that be in me.

children.text: aindrāgnaṃ pāvamānaṃ mahānāmnīr mahāvratam
children.translated_text: The <s>Aindrāgna</s>, the <s>Pāvamāna</s>, the <s>Mahānāmnī</s> verses, and the <s>Mahāvrata</s>,

children.text: ucchiṣṭe yajñasyāṅgāny antar garbha iva mātari ||
children.translated_text: the limbs of the sacrifice are within the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>, like an embryo within its mother.

children.text: rājasūyaṃ vājapeyam agniṣṭomastad adhvaraḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Rājasūya</s>, the <s>Vājapeya</s>, the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, and that <s>adhvara</s> rite,

children.text: arkāśvamedhāv ucchiṣṭe jīvabarhir madintamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Arka</s> and <s>Aśvamedha</s> are in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>, together with the living <s>barhis</s>, most exhilarating.

children.text: agnyādheyam atho dīkṣā kāmapraś chandasā saha
children.translated_text: The kindling of the sacred fires, and also initiation, desire-granting rite, and meter,

children.text: utsannā yajñāḥ satrāṇy ucchiṣṭe 'dhi samāhitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the completed sacrifices and the <s>sattra</s> sessions are established upon the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: agnihotraṃ ca śraddhā ca vaṣaṭkāro vrataṃ tapaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>agnihotra</s>, faith, the <s>vaṣaṭ</s> call, the vow, and austerity,

children.text: dakṣiṇeṣṭaṃ pūrtaṃ cocchiṣṭe 'dhi samāhitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the sacrificial fee, offered rites, and public works are established upon the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: ekarātro dvirātraḥ sadyaḥkrīḥ prakrīr ukthyaḥ
children.translated_text: The one-night rite, the two-night rite, the immediately bought and pre-bought forms, and the <s>ukthya</s>,

children.text: otaṃ nihitam ucchiṣṭe yajñasyāṇūni vidyayā ||
children.translated_text: the tiny parts of the sacrifice are woven and deposited in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s> through sacred knowledge.

children.text: catūrātraḥ pañcarātraḥ ṣaḍrātraś cobhayaḥ saha
children.translated_text: The four-night, five-night, and six-night rites, and both forms together,

children.text: ṣoḍaśī saptarātraś cocchiṣṭāj jajñire sarve ye yajñā amṛte hitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s> and the seven-night rite, and all sacrifices set in immortality, were born from the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: pratīhāro nidhanaṃ viśvajic cābhijic ca yaḥ
children.translated_text: The Pratīhāra, the Nidhana, and whatever is Viśvajit and Abhijit,

children.text: sāhnātirātrāv ucchiṣṭe dvādaśāho 'pi tan mayi ||
children.translated_text: the Sāhna and Atirātra rites are in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s> (sacrificial remnant); the twelve-day rite too, that is in me.

children.text: sūnṛtā saṃnatiḥ kṣemaḥ svadhorjāmṛtaṃ sahaḥ
children.translated_text: Kindly speech, submission, security, <s>svadhā</s> (ancestral oblation), nourishment, immortality, and might,

children.text: ucchiṣṭe sarve pratyañcaḥ kāmāḥ kāmena tātṛpuḥ ||
children.translated_text: in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s> all desires, turned inward, were satisfied by desire.

children.text: nava bhūmīḥ samudrā ucchiṣṭe 'dhi śritā divaḥ
children.translated_text: The nine earths and the oceans are set upon the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>, as are the heavens.

children.text: ā sūryo bhāty ucchiṣṭe 'horātre api tan mayi ||
children.translated_text: The sun shines in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>; day and night too, that is in me.

children.text: upahavyaṃ viṣūvantaṃ ye ca yajñā guhā hitāḥ
children.translated_text: The Upahavya, the Viṣūvant, and the sacrifices that are hidden in secret,

children.text: bibharti bhartā viśvasyocchiṣṭo janituḥ pitā ||
children.translated_text: the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>, bearer of the universe, bears them, the father of the begetter.

children.text: pitā janitur ucchiṣṭo 'soḥ pautraḥ pitāmahaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>ucchiṣṭa</s> is the father of the begetter, the grandson of vital breath, the grandfather.

children.text: sa kṣiyati viśvasyeśāno vṛṣā bhūmyām atighnyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He dwells as lord of all, a bull upon the earth, inviolable.

children.text: ṛtaṃ satyaṃ tapo rāṣṭraṃ śramo dharmaś ca karma ca
children.translated_text: Cosmic order, truth, tapas, kingdom, labor, <s>dharma</s> (normative order), and action,

children.text: bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyad ucchiṣṭe vīryaṃ lakṣmīr balaṃ bale ||
children.translated_text: what has been and what will be are in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>; vigor, fortune, and strength are in strength.

children.text: samṛddhir oja ākūtiḥ kṣatraṃ rāṣṭraṃ ṣaḍ urvyaḥ
children.translated_text: Success, force, intention, dominion, kingdom, and the six broad expanses,

children.text: saṃvatsaro 'dhy ucchiṣṭa iḍā praiṣā grahā haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: the year rests upon the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>, along with Iḍā, the summonses, the grahas, and the oblation.

children.text: caturhotāra āpriyaś cāturmāsyāni nīvidaḥ
children.translated_text: The four Hotṛ priests, the Āprī verses, the Cāturmāsya rites, and the Nivids,

children.text: ucchiṣṭe yajñā hotrāḥ paśubandhās tad iṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sacrifices, priestly offices, animal sacrifices, and those iṣṭis are in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: ardhamāsāś ca māsāś cārtavā ṛtubhiḥ saha
children.translated_text: The half-months and the months, the seasonal periods together with the seasons,

children.text: ucchiṣṭe ghoṣiṇīr āpa stanayitnuḥ śrutir mahī ||
children.translated_text: the roaring waters, the thunder, sound, and the great earth are in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: śarkarāḥ sikatā aśmāna oṣadhayo vīrudhas tṛṇā
children.translated_text: Gravel, sand, stones, herbs, creepers, and grasses,

children.text: abhrāṇi vidyuto varṣam ucchiṣṭe saṃśritā śritā ||
children.translated_text: clouds, lightning, and rain are sheltered and set in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: rāddhiḥ prāptiḥ samāptir vyāptir maha edhatuḥ
children.translated_text: Prosperity, attainment, completion, pervasion, greatness, and growth,

children.text: atyāptir ucchiṣṭe bhūtiś cāhitā nihitā hitā ||
children.translated_text: surpassing attainment and flourishing are placed, deposited, and set in the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: yac ca prāṇati prāṇena yac ca paśyati cakṣuṣā
children.translated_text: Whatever breathes with breath, and whatever sees with the eye,

children.text: ucchiṣṭāj jajñire sarve divi devā diviśritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: all the gods abiding in heaven were born from the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: ṛcaḥ sāmāni chandāṃsi purāṇaṃ yajuṣā saha
children.translated_text: The Ṛcs, the Sāmans, the metres, the Purāṇa together with the Yajus,

children.text: ucchiṣṭāj jajñire sarve divi devā diviśritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: all the gods abiding in heaven were born from the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: prāṇāpānau cakṣuḥ śrotram akṣitiś ca kṣitiś ca yā
children.translated_text: Breath and downward breath, sight and hearing, and whatever is imperishable and perishable,

children.text: ucchiṣṭāj jajñire sarve divi devā diviśritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: all the gods abiding in heaven were born from the <s>ucchiṣṭa</s>.

children.text: ānandā modāḥ pramudo 'bhīmodamudaś ca ye
