children.text: yad yat kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna eha gatvā tsaran viṣaktaṃ bila āsasāda
children.translated_text: If, when the black bird came here, it touched something hanging loose or sticking in the hole,

children.text: yad vā dāsy ārdrahastā samaṅkta ulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ śumbhatāpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or if a servant-woman with wet hands smeared the mortar, pestle, winnowing basket, or hearth,

children.text: ayaṃ grāvā pṛthubudhno vayodhāḥ pūtaḥ pavitrair apahantu rakṣaḥ
children.translated_text: let this pressing stone, broad-based and strength-giving, purified by purifiers, drive away the demon.

children.text: āroha carma mahi śarma yaccha mā daṃpatī pautram aghaṃ nigātām ||
children.translated_text: Mount the hide; grant great shelter; let no evil reach the married couple or their grandson.

children.text: vanaspatiḥ saha devair na āgan rakṣaḥ piśācāṁ apabādhamānaḥ
children.translated_text: The lord of the forest has come to us with the gods, driving away demons and piśācas.

children.text: sa ucchrayātai pravadāti vācaṃ tena lokāṁ abhi sarvān jayema ||
children.translated_text: May he rise up and utter speech; by him may we conquer all the worlds.

children.text: sapta medhān paśavaḥ paryagṛhṇan ya eṣāṃ jyotiṣmāṁ uta yaś cakarśa
children.translated_text: The animals encompassed the seven sacrificial powers, whatever among them was luminous and whatever was lean.

children.text: trayastriṃśad devatās tānt sacante sa naḥ svargam abhi neṣa lokam ||
children.translated_text: The thirty-three deities attend them; may he lead us toward the heavenly world.

children.text: svargaṃ lokam abhi no nayāsi saṃ jāyayā saha putraiḥ syāma
children.translated_text: You lead us toward the heavenly world; may we be together with wife and sons.

children.text: gṛhṇāmi hastam anu maitv atra mā nas tārīn nirṛtir mo arātiḥ ||
children.translated_text: I take the hand; let it follow me here; let <s>Nirṛti</s> not pass over us, nor hostility.

children.text: grāhiṃ pāpmānam ati tāṁ ayāma tamo vyasya pravadāsi valgu
children.translated_text: We have gone beyond seizure and evil; scattering darkness, you speak beautifully.

children.text: vānaspatya udyato mā jihiṃsīr mā taṇḍulaṃ viśarīr devayantam ||
children.translated_text: O wooden implement, raised up, do not injure me; do not scatter the rice-grain that serves the gods.

children.text: viśvavyacā ghṛtapṛṣṭho bhaviṣyant sayonir lokam upayāhy etam
children.translated_text: Becoming all-pervading, with ghee on your back, go to this world, sharing the same womb.

children.text: varṣavṛddham upayaccha śūrpaṃ tuṣaṃ palāvān apa tad vinaktu ||
children.translated_text: Offer the winnowing basket, grown by rain; let it separate away the chaff and husks.

children.text: trayo lokāḥ saṃmitā brāhmaṇena dyaur evāsau pṛthivy antarikṣam
children.translated_text: The three worlds are measured out by sacred utterance: that heaven, earth, and midspace.

children.text: aṃśūn gṛbhītvānvārabhethām āpyāyantāṃ punar āyantu śūrpam ||
children.translated_text: Taking hold of the stalks, you two should begin after them; may they swell again and return to the winnowing basket.

children.text: pṛthag rūpāṇi bahudhā paśūnām ekarūpo bhavasi saṃ samṛddhyā
children.translated_text: The forms of animals are separate and manifold; through complete prosperity you become one form.

children.text: etāṃ tvacaṃ lohinīṃ tāṃ nudasva grāvā śumbhāti malaga iva vastrā ||
children.translated_text: Drive away that red skin; the pressing stone cleans it like a washerman cleaning garments.

children.text: pṛthivīṃ tvā pṛthivyām āveśayāmi tanūḥ samānī vikṛtā ta eṣā
children.translated_text: I set you, earth, into earth; this same body of yours has been transformed.

children.text: yadyad dyuttaṃ likhitam arpaṇena tena mā susror brahmaṇāpi tad vapāmi ||
children.translated_text: Whatever has been scraped or marked by the scraping tool, with that, O well-flowing one, I also winnow it by sacred utterance.

children.text: janitrīva pratiharyāsi sūnuṃ saṃ tvā dadhāmi pṛthivīṃ pṛthivyā
children.translated_text: You are to be received back like a mother receiving her son; I join you, earth, with earth.

children.text: ukhā kumbhī vedyāṃ mā vyathiṣṭhā yajñāyudhair ājyenātiṣaktā ||
children.translated_text: O pot, O cauldron, do not tremble on the altar, touched for sacrifice with the ritual implements and with ghee.

children.text: agniḥ pacan rakṣatu tvā purastād indro rakṣatu dakṣiṇato marutvān
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s>, while cooking, protect you from the east; may <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s> protect you from the south.

children.text: varuṇas tvā dṛṃhāddharuṇe pratīcyā uttarāt tvā somaḥ saṃdadātai ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> make you firm on the western support; from the north may <s>Soma</s> join you together.

children.text: pūtāḥ pavitraiḥ pavante abhrād divaṃ ca yanti pṛthivīṃ ca lokān
children.translated_text: Purified by purifiers, they purify themselves; from the cloud they go to heaven, to earth, and to the worlds.

children.text: tā jīvalā jīvadhanyāḥ pratiṣṭhāḥ pātra āsiktāḥ pary agnir indhām ||
children.translated_text: Those life-giving, grain-sustaining foundations, poured into the vessel: may <s>Agni</s> kindle around them.

children.text: āyanti divaḥ pṛthivīṃ sacante bhūmyāḥ sacante adhy antarikṣam
children.translated_text: They come from heaven and join the earth; from the earth they join what is above, the midspace.

children.text: śuddhāḥ satīs tā u śumbhanta eva tā naḥ svargam abhi lokaṃ nayantu ||
children.translated_text: Being pure, they indeed make themselves beautiful; may they lead us toward the heavenly world.

children.text: uteva prabhvīr uta saṃmitāsa uta śukrāḥ śucayaś cāmṛtāsaḥ
children.translated_text: They are both powerful and measured, both bright, pure, and immortal.

children.text: tā odanaṃ daṃpatibhyāṃ praśiṣṭā āpaḥ śikṣantīḥ pacatā sunāthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those waters, assigned to the <s>odana</s> for the married couple, instructing it: cook it well, under good guidance.

children.text: saṃkhyātā stokāḥ pṛthivīṃ sacante prāṇāpānaiḥ saṃmitā oṣadhībhiḥ
children.translated_text: Numbered drops join the earth, measured with the breaths in and out and with the plants.

children.text: asaṃkhyātā opyamānāḥ suvarṇāḥ sarvaṃ vyāpuḥ śucayaḥ śucitvam ||
children.translated_text: Unnumbered, being poured in, golden and pure, they have pervaded all purity.

children.text: udyodhanty abhivalganti taptāḥ phenam asyanti bahulāṃś ca bindūn
children.translated_text: Heated, they shine and leap about; they throw up foam and many drops.

children.text: yoṣeva dṛṣṭvā patim ṛtviyāyaitais taṇḍulair bhavatā sam āpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a woman when she sees her husband at the proper season, with these rice-grains, O waters, come together.

children.text: utthāpaya sīdato budhna enān adbhir ātmānam abhisaṃspṛśantām
children.translated_text: Lift these up from where they sit on the bottom; let them touch themselves all around with the waters.

children.text: amāsi pātrair udakaṃ yad etan mitās taṇḍulāḥ pradiśo yadīmāḥ ||
children.translated_text: This water that is at home with the vessels, and these measured rice-grains, when they are the quarters,

children.text: prayaccha parśuṃ tvarayā harauṣam ahiṃsanta oṣadhīr dāntu parvan
children.translated_text: hand over the axe quickly; bring the fresh plant; without injuring the plants, let them cut at the joint.

children.text: yāsāṃ somaḥ pari rājyaṃ babhūvāmanyutā no vīrudho bhavantu ||
children.translated_text: The plants over which <s>Soma</s> became king: let those plants be without anger toward us.

children.text: navaṃ barhir odanāya stṛṇīta priyaṃ hṛdaś cakṣuṣo valgv astu
children.translated_text: Spread fresh <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass) for the <s>odana</s>; may it be dear to the heart and pleasant to the eye.

children.text: tasmin devāḥ saha daivīr viśantv imaṃ prāśnantv ṛtubhir niṣadya ||
children.translated_text: May the gods enter it together with the divine ones; may they eat this, sitting down in due seasons.

children.text: vanaspate stīrṇam āsīda barhir agniṣṭomaiḥ saṃmito devatābhiḥ
children.translated_text: O lord of the forest, sit on the strewn <s>barhis</s>, measured by the Agniṣṭoma rites together with the deities.

children.text: tvaṣṭreva rūpaṃ sukṛtaṃ svadhityainā ehāḥ pari pātre dadṛśrām ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> fashioning a well-made form with the axe, may we behold these here around the vessel.

children.text: ṣaṣṭyāṃ śaratsu nidhipā abhīcchāt svaḥ pakvenābhyaśnavātai
children.translated_text: In the sixtieth autumns may the treasure-guardian desire it; by the cooked offering may one attain heaven.

children.text: upainaṃ jīvān pitaraś ca putrā etaṃ svargaṃ gamayāntam agneḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the living fathers and sons approach him as he goes to that heaven from <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: dhartā dhriyasva dharuṇe pṛthivyā acyutaṃ tvā devatāś cyāvayantu
children.translated_text: O holder, hold firm in the foundation of the earth; may the deities move you, yet not make you fall.

children.text: taṃ tvā daṃpatī jīvantau jīvaputrāv udvāsayātaḥ pary agnidhānāt ||
children.translated_text: The living married couple, with living sons, shall lift you away from around the fire-place.

children.text: sarvānt samāgā abhijitya lokān yāvantaḥ kāmāḥ samatītṛpas tān
children.translated_text: Having together conquered all the worlds, and all the desires there are, may you two be fully satisfied with them.

children.text: vigāhethām āyavanaṃ ca darvir ekasmin pātre adhy uddharainam ||
children.translated_text: Enter both the pouring-vessel and the ladle; in one vessel let him lift this up.

children.text: upastṛṇīhi prathaya purastād ghṛtena pātram abhighārayaitat
children.translated_text: Spread the underlayer; make the vessel broad in front; pour ghee over this vessel.

children.text: vāśrevosrā taruṇaṃ stanasyum imaṃ devāso abhihiṅkṛṇota ||
children.translated_text: Like a lowing cow over her young calf that longs for the udder, O gods, bellow over this.

children.text: upāstarīr akaro lokam etam uruḥ prathatām asamaḥ svargaḥ
children.translated_text: You have made the underlayers and this world; may <s>svarga</s> (heaven) spread out wide, broad, and unequalled.

children.text: tasmiṃchrayātai mahiṣaḥ suparṇo devā enaṃ devatābhyaḥ prayacchān ||
children.translated_text: In it may the great eagle-bull settle, handing this over to the gods for the deities.

children.text: yadyaj jāyā pacati tvat paraḥ paraḥ patir vā jāye tvat tiraḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever the wife cooks apart from you, or the husband apart from you, O wife,

children.text: saṃ tat sṛjethāṃ saha vāṃ tad astu sampādayantau saha lokam ekam ||
children.translated_text: may you two bring that together; may it belong to you both, as you together accomplish one single world.

children.text: yāvanto asyāḥ pṛthivīṃ sacante asmat putrāḥ pari ye saṃbabhūvuḥ
children.translated_text: As many sons of this woman as cling to the earth, those who have been born from us,

children.text: sarvāṃs tāṁ upa pātre hvayethāṃ nābhiṃ jānānāḥ śiśavaḥ samāyān ||
children.translated_text: call all of them to the vessel; knowing the navel, let the children come together.

children.text: vasor yā dhārā madhunā prapīnā ghṛtena miśrā amṛtasya nābhayaḥ
children.translated_text: The streams of wealth, swollen with honey, mixed with ghee, are navels of immortality.

children.text: sarvās tā ava rundhe svargaḥ ṣaṣṭyāṃ śaratsu nidhipā abhīchāt ||
children.translated_text: <s>Svarga</s> (heaven) wins all those; in the sixtieth autumn may the guardian of treasure seek them.

children.text: nidhiṃ nidhipā abhy enam ichād anīśvarā abhitaḥ santu ye 'nye
children.translated_text: Let the guardian of treasure seek this treasure; let others who have no lordship stand around it.

children.text: asmābhir datto nihitaḥ svargas tribhiḥ kāṇḍais trīnt svargān arukṣat ||
children.translated_text: Given by us, deposited, and heavenly, it has climbed the three heavens with the three sections.

children.text: agnī rakṣas tapatu yad videvaṃ kravyād piśāca iha mā pra pāsta
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s> burn the demon, whatever is hostile to the gods; let no flesh-eating <s>piśāca</s> devour anything here.

children.text: nudāma enam apa rudhmo asmad ādityā enam aṅgirasaḥ sacantām ||
children.translated_text: We drive him away; we shut him away from us. Let the <s>Ādityas</s> and the <s>Aṅgirases</s> accompany him.

children.text: ādityebhyo aṅgirobhyo madhv idaṃ ghṛtena miśraṃ prati vedayāmi
children.translated_text: To the <s>Ādityas</s> and the <s>Aṅgirases</s> I announce this honey mixed with ghee.

children.text: śuddhahastau brāhmaṇasyānihatyaitaṃ svargaṃ sukṛtāv apītam ||
children.translated_text: With pure hands, without injuring the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, O doers of good, drink this heavenly portion.

children.text: idaṃ prāpam uttamaṃ kāṇḍam asya yasmāl lokāt parameṣṭhī samāpa
children.translated_text: I have reached this highest section of it, from the world from which <s>Parameṣṭhin</s> attained his completion.

children.text: ā siñca sarpir ghṛtavat sam aṅgdhy eṣa bhāgo aṅgiraso no atra ||
children.translated_text: Pour on melted butter; anoint it with ghee. This is the share of the <s>Aṅgirases</s> for us here.

children.text: satyāya ca tapase devatābhyo nidhiṃ śevadhiṃ pari dadma etam
children.translated_text: For truth, for austerity, and for the deities we hand over this treasure and storehouse.

children.text: mā no dyūte 'va gān mā samityāṃ mā smānyasmā ut sṛjatā purā mat ||
children.translated_text: Let it not go from us in gambling, nor in the assembly; do not give us over to another before our time.

children.text: ahaṃ pacāmy ahaṃ dadāmi mamed u karman karuṇe 'dhi jāyā
children.translated_text: I cook, I give; mine indeed is the rite; upon the kindly wife it is established.

children.text: kaumāro loko ajaniṣṭa putro 'nvārabhethāṃ vaya uttarāvat ||
children.translated_text: A youthful world, a son, has been born; may you two take hold of later life.

children.text: na kilbiṣam atra nādhāro asti na yan mitraiḥ samamamāna eti
children.translated_text: There is no sin here and no deficiency; there is no going away on equal terms with companions.

children.text: anūnaṃ pātraṃ nihitaṃ na etat paktāraṃ pakvaḥ punar ā viśāti ||
children.translated_text: This vessel, set down, is not lacking; the cooked food enters the cook again.

children.text: priyaṃ priyāṇāṃ kṛṇavāma tamas te yantu yatame dviṣanti
children.translated_text: Let us make him dear among dear ones; let those who hate you go to darkness.

children.text: dhenur anaḍvān vayovaya āyad eva pauruṣeyam apa mṛtyuṃ nudantu ||
children.translated_text: Let the cow, the draught-ox, and every span of life, as far as human life extends, drive death away.

children.text: sam agnayaḥ vidur anyo anyaṃ ya oṣadhīḥ sacate yaś ca sindhūn
children.translated_text: The fires know one another: the one that accompanies the plants and the one that accompanies the rivers.

children.text: yāvanto devā divy ātapanti hiraṇyaṃ jyotiḥ pacato babhūva ||
children.translated_text: As many gods as shine in heaven, the cooked oblation has become golden light.

children.text: eṣā tvacāṃ puruṣe saṃ babhūvānagnāḥ sarve paśavo ye anye
children.translated_text: This has become a covering among men, while all the other animals are unclothed.

children.text: kṣatreṇātmānaṃ pari dhāpayātho 'motaṃ vāso mukham odanasya ||
children.translated_text: With royal power you two clothe yourselves; the mouth is the garment of the <s>odana</s> (cooked oblation).

children.text: yad akṣeṣu vadā yat samityāṃ yad vā vadā anṛtaṃ vittakāmyā
children.translated_text: Whatever falsehood you have spoken at dice, in the assembly, or from desire for wealth,

children.text: samānaṃ tantum abhi samvasānau tasmint sarvaṃ śamalaṃ sādayāthaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you two, clothing yourselves in the same thread, set all that impurity down in it.

children.text: varṣaṃ vanuṣvāpi gacha devāṃs tvaco dhūmaṃ pary ut pātayāsi
children.translated_text: Win the rain; go to the gods. From the covering you send the smoke flying upward all around.

children.text: viśvavyacā ghṛtapṛṣṭho bhaviṣyant sayonir lokam upa yāhy etam ||
children.translated_text: Becoming all-expansive, with ghee upon your back, go to this world, joined with your own womb.

children.text: tanvaṃ svargo bahudhā vi cakre yathā vida ātmann anyavarṇām
children.translated_text: The heavenly one has fashioned the body in many ways, as he knew the differently colored form within himself.

children.text: apājait kṛṣṇāṃ ruśatīṃ punāno yā lohinī tāṃ te agnau juhomi ||
children.translated_text: Purifying, he has driven away the black and the bright; that red one of yours I offer into the fire.

children.text: prācyai tvā diśe 'gnaye 'dhipataye 'sitāya rakṣitra ādityāyeṣumate
children.translated_text: For the eastern direction I dedicate you to <s>Agni</s> as overlord, to the dark guardian, to the arrow-bearing <s>Āditya</s>.

children.text: etaṃ pari dadmas taṃ no gopāyatāsmākam aitoḥ
children.translated_text: We hand this over to them; may they protect it for us, for what is ours from here.

children.text: diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣaj jarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātv atha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||
children.translated_text: May what is allotted here lead us on to old age; may old age hand us over to death; then may we be united with the cooked oblation.

children.text: dakṣiṇāyai tvā diśa indrāyādhipataye tiraścirājaye rakṣitre yamāyeṣumate
children.translated_text: For the southern direction I dedicate you to <s>Indra</s> as overlord, to the cross-ruling guardian, to arrow-bearing <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: etaṃ pari dadmas taṃ no gopāyatāsmākam aitoḥ
children.translated_text: We hand this over to them; may they protect it for us, for what is ours from here.

children.text: diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣaj jarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātv atha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||
children.translated_text: May what is allotted here lead us on to old age; may old age hand us over to death; then may we be united with the cooked oblation.

children.text: pratīcyai tvā diśe varuṇāyādhipataye pṛdākave rakṣitre 'nnāyeṣumate
children.translated_text: For the western direction I dedicate you to <s>Varuṇa</s> as overlord, to the serpent guardian, to arrow-bearing Food.

children.text: etaṃ pari dadmas taṃ no gopāyatāsmākam aitoḥ
children.translated_text: We hand this over to them; may they protect it for us, for what is ours from here.

children.text: diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣaj jarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātv atha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||
children.translated_text: May what is allotted here lead us on to old age; may old age hand us over to death; then may we be united with the cooked oblation.

children.text: udīcyai tvā diśe somāyādhipataye svajāya rakṣitre 'śanyā iṣumatyai
children.translated_text: For the northern direction I dedicate you to <s>Soma</s> as overlord, to the self-born guardian, to arrow-bearing lightning.

children.text: etaṃ pari dadmas taṃ no gopāyatāsmākam aitoḥ
children.translated_text: We hand this over to them; may they protect it for us, for what is ours from here.

children.text: diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣaj jarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātv atha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||
children.translated_text: May what is allotted here lead us on to old age; may old age hand us over to death; then may we be united with the cooked oblation.

children.text: dhruvāyai tvā diśe viṣṇave 'dhipataye kalmāṣagrīvāya rakṣitra oṣadhībhya iṣumatībhyaḥ
children.translated_text: For the fixed direction I dedicate you to <s>Viṣṇu</s> as overlord, to the speckled-necked guardian, to the arrow-bearing herbs.

children.text: etaṃ pari dadmas taṃ no gopāyatāsmākam aitoḥ
children.translated_text: We hand this over to them; may they protect it for us, for what is ours from here.

children.text: diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣaj jarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātv atha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||
children.translated_text: May what is allotted here lead us on to old age; may old age hand us over to death; then may we be united with the cooked oblation.

children.text: ūrdhvāyai tvā diśe bṛhaspataye 'dhipataye śvitrāya rakṣitre varṣāyeṣumate
children.translated_text: For the upward direction I dedicate you to <s>Bṛhaspati</s> as overlord, to the white guardian, to arrow-bearing rain.

children.text: etaṃ pari dadmas taṃ no gopāyatāsmākam aitoḥ
children.translated_text: We hand this over to them; may they protect it for us, for what is ours from here.

children.text: diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣaj jarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadātv atha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||
children.translated_text: May what is appointed lead us here down to old age; may old age hand us over to death; then may we come together with the ripe one.
